text.body:
nyāyadīpikā -- indirāvadanāmbhojarājahamasāya viṣṇave | amandānandasandohasundarākṛtaye namaḥ || 1 || dharmavijñānavairāgyaparamaiśvaryaśālinaḥ | ānandarīrthabhagavatpādān vande nirantaram || 2 || sa padmanābhatīrthārkagogaṇo'stu dṛśe mama | na tattvamārge gamanaṃ vinā yadupajīvanam || 3 || praṇamya caraṇadvandvaṃ gurūṇāṃ tatkṛpābalāt | vyākariṣye yathābodhaṃ gītātatparyanirṇayam || 4 || athāśeṣapuriṣārthahetubhūtāmanyairanyathā vyākhyātāṃ gītāṃ yathāvadvyākhyātukāmo bhagavānācāryaḥ prāripsitasya granthasyāvighnena parisamāptyādiprayojanāmiṣṭadevatānatiṃ śiṣṭācāraparamparādiprāptāṃ śiṣyajanaśikṣārthaṃ granthe nibadhnāti, granthārambhaṃ ca pratijānīte || samasteti || antarāyaparijihīrṣādimanto devatāntaranatimācaranto dṛṣṭāḥ | tatkiṃ nārāyaṇapraṇāmenetyata uktam || samastetyādi || nārāyaṇasyaiva samastaguṇasampūrṇatvenāśeṣadoṣadūratvena nikhilaprārthitapradānasāmarthyāditareṣāṃ tatprasādāsāditaśaktimattvāttatpraṇāma eva kartavya iti bhāvaḥ | sampūrṇamiti guṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ pūrṇatāmāha | vivarjitamiti ca doṣavarjanasya niḥśeṣatām | samastagītāsu bhagavadgītāyāḥ prādhānyajñāpanāya gītetyevoktam | "mukhyasya nirviśeṣeṇa śabda" iti smṛteḥ | svayameva gītābhāṣyasya kṛtatvāt kiṃ purarārambheṇetyatastātparyamityuktam | vyākhyātatve'pi gītāyāstadarthasya śiṣyāṇāṃ buddhyārohārthaṃ śabdānukaraṇādyantareṇa punastātparyimevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | nanvanekeṣu grantheṣu vidyamāneṣu ko viśeṣo gītāyā yena tasyā eva tātparyamucyate | api ca, bhāratamadhyagatatvādgītāyāḥ kutastasyā eva pṛthak tātparyamucyata ityato bhāratasya sarvaśāstrottamatvādyuktaṃ tadantargatagītāyā eva tātparyakathanam | bhārate'pi gītāyā uttamatvāttasyāḥ pṛktātparyakathanaṃ copapannamiti parihāramabhipretya bhāratasya sarivaśāstrottamatvaṃ, bhārate'pi gītāyā eva uttamatvameva kuta ityatantatpurāṇavacanena sādhayita || śāstreṣviti || bhārate'pi gītānāmasahasrayoruttamatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || taditi || bhāratajñānādapyāñjasyena gītādijñānasya mokṣasādhanatvādyuktaṃ bhārate'pi gītāderuttamatvamiti bhāvaḥ | gītānāmasahasrasamānaśāstrāntarajñānasyāpyāñjasyena mokṣahetutvāt ko viśeṣo gītāderityata āha || neti || bhāraratasya sarvaśāstrottamatvameva kuta ityata āha || bhāratamiti || vedapadena vedayantīti sarvaśāstrāṇyucyante | bhāratādestulā''ropaṇaṃ nāma tatpratinidherāropaṇam | etadeva kuta ityato mahābhārataśabdārthaparyālocanayaiva jñāyata ityāha || mahattvāditi || madattvāttata eva bhāroṇa tatatvācca mahābhāratamityarthaḥ | kiñca mahābhārataśabdanirvacanajñānādeva yadā sarvapāpakṣayo bhavati tadā kiṃ vaicyaṃ tasya sarvaśāstrottamatvamiti bhāvenāha || niruktamiti || niruktaṃ nirvacanam | asya mahābhārataraśabdasya | bhāratasyaivaṃ sarvaśāstrottamatve kiṃ nimittamityataḥ paramāptakṛtatvaṃ darśayati || svayamiti || nanvāpto nāma yathārthadarśī yathādṛṣṭārthavādī ca | tatra vyāsasya yathārthadarśitvaṃ kutaḥ ? bhagavadavatāreṣvapi pṛthvādiṣvajñānādidarśanādityata uktam || svayamiti || astu vyāsasya yathārthadarśitvaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇāvatāratvenājñānabhramasandehaśūnyatvāt | yathādṛṣṭārthavāditvaṃ tu kutaḥ ? tasya pramādenāyathādṛṣṭavāditvābhāve'pi vipralipsayā tatsambhavādityata āha || brahmeti || vakturvipralipsā śrotṛṇāmayogyatāyāṃ sambhavati | prakṛte ca brahmādīnāṃ yogyānāmeva śrotṛtvena bhagavato vipralambhābhāvādyuktaṃ yathādṛṣṭārthavāditvamiti bhāvaḥ apahāsenāyathādṛṣṭārthavāditvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || tattveti || apahāsasya prasaṅgadoṣanibandhanatvādatra ca tattvanirṇayasya prasaktatvena tadasambhavānnātrāpahāsenāpi vyāsasyāyathādṛṣṭārthavāditvamiti bhāvaḥ evaṃbhūtāptaracitatvasya bhāgavatādiṣvapi sāmyātko viśeṣo bhāratasyetyata uktam || kevalamiti || nāsuramohanādyarthamapyatrānyaducyate | anyathāpratītasya guhyadarśanabhāṣābhyāmuktatvāt | anyatra kvacidvyāmohanārthamanyathā kathanāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ paramāptimūlatvenaiva na bhāratasya sarvaśāstrottamatvaṃ kintu vedasaṃvāditayā pañcamavedatvenāpīti bhāvenāha || pañcamamiti || evaṃ gītātātparyakathanasya yuktatāṃ prasādhya śrotṛśemuṣīmanukūlayiṣyannādāveva aśeṣagītāpratipādyamarthaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa darśayati || tatreti || tatra gītāyām | iti kathyata iti śeṣaḥ | kṛṣṇasyāpyarjunādaviśeṣātkathaṃ tadvodhakatvamityato bhagavānnārāyaṇa ityuktam | āptasamastakāmasya bhagavataḥ kimarjunabodhanenetyata uktam || ātmana iti || prayojanābhāve'pi prītyatiśayavaśānmakaturapatyapālanavattadbodhanaṃ yaktumiti bhāvaḥ | arjunasya bhagavatpriyatvameva kutaḥ ? aparokṣajñānitvāt "jñīnī priyatamo'to me" iti smṛteriti cettadva kuta ityata āha ||uttameti || etadapi kuta ityata āha || sākṣāditi || sākṣādindraḥ purandaraḥ | sākṣādavatāro nāveśamātramiti vā | atra devatvameva vaktavyam | indrāvatāramiti svarūpakathanam | arjunabodhane kā prāptirityata āha || nārāyaṇeti || bāndhavādinigrahasyādharmatvāt kimucyate'dharmatvenāśaṅkyetyata etannigrahasya kaimutyena dharmatvamāha || kṣatriyāṇāmiti || bhāgavatamātrasyaitādṛśanigrahaḥ paramadharmaḥ | atraiva niyuktānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu viśeṣato'pi paramadharma ityarthaḥ | bāndhavādinigrahaḥ kathaṃ paramadharma ityato bāndhavādīti vaktavye nārāyaṇadviṭ‌tadanubandhītyuktam | bāndhavāditve'pi keṣāñcinnārāyaṇadveṣitvāt keṣāñcittatsambandhitvāt tannigraho dharma eveti bhāvaḥ | nanvayaṃ dharmaścecchāstrodita eva bhavet | tathā ca na śāstraviduṣā'dharmatvenā'śaṅkyeta | śaṅkyate ca | ato na dharma ityata āha || bandhusnehāditi || na śāstramukheneyaṃ śaṅkā | api tu snehamātranibandhanaiveti bhāvaḥ | jñāninaḥ snehamātreṇa sañjātayā śaṅkayā kathaṃ svakīyaparamadharmanivṛttirityata uktam || nivṛttaprāyamiti || evamāśaṅkayā nivṛttaprāyaścedetadyuddhakaraṇameva bodhanīyaṃ, bhagavanmahimādike kimarthamucyata ityato bodhyārthamāha || sveti || na kevalaṃ yuddhādisvavihitavṛttimātraṃ paramo dharmaḥ | yena tadeva bodhyaṃ syāt | api tu bhaktyādikamapi | tatrārjunasya dharmaikadeśe'dharmaśaṅkāyāmapi prāptalokopakārāya pamagradharmo bhagavatā bodhyate | tatra bhagavanmahimādyuktistu bhaktyutpādanāyeti bhāvaḥ | nanu yuddhādisvavihitavṛttinivṛtto'pyarjuno na paramadharmanivṛttaḥ | bhaktyādimattvāt | ataḥ kiṃ bodhyata ityata āha || taditi || na bhaktyādikaṃ pratyekaṃ paramadharmaḥ | yena tāvatā tasya na paramadharmanivṛttiḥ | kintu militameva | ate'nyatamābhāve'pi paramadharmanivṛtteryuktaṃ tadbodhanamiti bhāvaḥ | tarhi prakṛtyādivarṇanaṃ kvopayujyuta ityato'stu svavihitavṛtterdhakmatvaṃ, tadviruddhasyādharmatvaṃ ca | bhagavadbhaktyā tadārādhanasya dharmatvaṃ tadviruddhasyādharmatvaṃ ca kuta ityāśaṅkānivārāṇāya sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatvahetuṃ vaktuṃ sarvanirūpaṇamiti bhāvenāha || bhagavaditi || sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatvena dharmādharmatayā bhagavanniyatayoreva tathābhāvāttasya caivaṃ vidhayoreva tathā niyamanopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | nanvarjunasya devatvādi kutaḥ | svavihitetyādergītātātparyārthatvaṃ ca kuta ityata āha || sarvañceti || arjuno deva ityādyetacca sarvaṃ gītāyāṃmevāvagamyate | na ca pramāṇāntaraṃ tatrānveṣaṇīyam | svavihitetyādikaṃ ca sarvaṃ gītāyāmavagamyata eva | na tu tadarthatayā balāducyata ityarthaḥ | tatra tāvannārāyaṇadviṭ‌nubandhinigrahaṃ bandhusnehādadharmatvenā''śaṅkya tato nivṛttaprāyamarjunaṃ bhagavānnārāyaṇo bodhayatītyetāvadgītāyāṃ sphuṭamavagamyate | "yacchreyaḥ syānniścitaṃ brūhi tanme" iti prārthanāttasya nivṛttaprāyātāvagamāt | sākṣānnivṛttau tadanupapatteḥ | nārāyaṇadviṭ‌tadanubandhinigrahasya kṣatriyāṇāṃ paramadharmatvaṃ gītāyāṃ kenāvagamyata ityata āha || atheti || yuddhasya uktavidhasyeti śeṣaḥ | avagamyata iti sarvatrānuṣajyate | svavihitavṛttyā bhaktyā bhagavadārādhanameva paramadharmaḥ | tadviruddhaḥ sarvo'pyadharma ityetatkenāvagamyate ityata āha || yata iti || yata ityanena svavihitavṛttyā bhaktyā bhagavadārādhanasya kartavyatvamavagamyate | bhaktyā'rcanasyaivābhyarcanatvāt | svakarmaṇetyanena svavihitavṛttyā bhagavadārādhanasyaiva mukhyataḥ kartavyatvam | mokṣasādhanasyaiva mukhyakartavyatvāt | śreyānityanena svavihitavṛtteḥ kartavyatvamasvavihitavṛttestyajyatvaṃ ca | śreyasa eva kartavyatvādaśreyasastyājyatvāt | sarvetyanena bhaktyā bhagavadārādhanasya kartavyatvam | sarvaguhyatamatayā, hitasādhanatayā, bhagavatpraptisādhanatayā ca vihitasya kartavyatvāt | sarvadharmānityanena svavihitavṛttyā bhaktyā bhagavadārādhanasaiva kartavyatvaṃ, tadanyasya tyājyatvaṃ ca | svavihitavṛttyā bhaktyā bhagavadārādhanasaiva śaraṇāgatitvāt | sarvadharmapadenaitadviruddhasya dharmābhāsasya vivakṣitatvāt | sarvapāpagamanahetutayā vihitasya kartavyatvāt | tadarthatvena niṣiddhasya tyājyatvāt || svadharmeṇa || bhaktyā ceti saṃyojeyam | kartavyatyājyatvābhyāṃ dharmādharmatva iti bhāvaḥ| nanu śravaṇādirūpasvavihitavṛttyaiva parokṣāparokṣajñanayorjñānino'pi mokṣasya gītāyāmeva tadadhīnatvāvagamāt | na caivaṃ śravaṇādivaiyyarthyam | anyathā jñānāderbhaktyādhīnatvānupapattiriti vācyam | śravaṇāderjñānādisādhanatve'pi bhaktereva tebhyaḥ śravaṇādisarvasādhanebhya uttimatvasyātra vivakṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanupa na bhaktyā svavihitavṛttyā bhagavadārādhanaṃ kartavyaṃ tadviruddhaṃ tyājyamiti gītābhimatam | tatra bhaktimataḥ kartavyatyājyābhāva1mātrasyābhimatatvādityata āha || matkarmeti || na bhaktasya kartavyatyājyābhāvo gītābhimataḥ | tatraiva bhaktasyāpi svavihitavṛttyā bhagavadārādhanasya tadviruddhasya tyājyatayā'vagamāditi bhāvaḥ | taduktaṃ svavihitavṛttirūpaṃ madviṣayaṃ ca karma matkarma tadeva tatkarma | haṅgavarjitosvavihitābhagavadviṣayakarmasaṅgavarjitaḥ | tadeva vikarmocyate | bhagavatpraptihetutayoktameva karma kartavyam | tadarthatvena niṣiddhameva tyājyamiti | nanvarjunasya jñānitve kathaṃ taṃ prati svavihitavṛttyā bhagavadārādhanaṃ vidhīyate | jñāninastadabhāvasya gītābhimatatvādityata āha || kurviti || na jñāninaḥ svavihitavṛttyādyabhāvo gītā'imataḥ | tatra "evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ | kuru karmaiva" iti jñānino'pi svavihitavṛttyādeḥ kartavyatayā'vagamāditi bhāvaḥ svavihitaṃ, bhagavadarthameva pūrvaiḥ kṛtaṃ tadubhayameva bhagavatkarma | yaduktamarjuno bhagavato'tipriyoparokṣajñānyuttamādhikārī devaśceti tatkenāvagamyata ityata āha || sudurdarśamiti || sudurdarśamityanenāparokṣajñānitvamavagamyate | devaiḥ saha paṭhitatvena devatvaṃ ca | iṣṭosīti priyatamatvam | daivīti devatvam | mahātmāna ityananyamanaskatayā bhagavantaṃ bhajatāṃ devatvamaparokṣajñānitvaṃ cāvagamyate | tādṛśabhajanavataścārjunasya tajjñāyate | darśayāmāsetyaparokṣajñānitvam | bhagavadatipriyatvaṃ devatvaṃ ceti saṃyojeyam | devatvenaivottamādhikāritvaṃ cāvagatam | yaduktaṃ sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatvaṃ tatkenāvagamyate | tathātve ca tasya sarvasmādbhedena, sarvasya ca satyatvena, tasya sarvottamatvena, sarvaguṇapūrṇatvena, nirdoṣatvenānanyādhīnatvena, mokṣapradatvena, sarvaśāstrapratipādyatvena ca bhāvyam | sarvasya tadadhīnatāyāḥ sākṣātparamparayā caitatsāpekṣatvāt | tadetatsarvaṃ kenāvagamyata ityata āha || neti || na me vidurityanena pūrṇatva1mavagamyate | ahamādiriti sarvottamatvam | yo māmiti nirdoṣatvaṃ, sarvasya tadadhīnatvaṃ, tajjñānānmokṣaśca | janmādīnāṃ doṣatvāt | sarvapāpakṣayasya mokṣatvāt | buddhiriti sarvasya tadadhīnatvam | etāmiti tajjñānānmokṣaḥ | niṣkampayogasya suyujyatvāt | ahamiti sarvasya tadadhīnatvaṃ tajjñānānmokṣaśca | ajñānajatamasaḥ saṃsāratvāt | teṣāmiti tajjñānānmokṣaḥ | bhoktāramiti sarvasya tadadhīnatvaṃ tajjñānānmokṣaśca | śāntermokṣatvāt | jñānamitita sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tatparatvam | bhagavajjñānenaiva sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ jñātatvokteḥ | ahamiti sarvasya tadadhīnatvam | matta iti sarvottamatvam | mayīti sarvasya tadadhīnatvam | idamiti tajjñānānmokṣaḥ | rājeti sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tatparatvam | bhagavadvidyāyāḥ prādhānyokteḥ | pradhānānusāritvāccāpradhānānām | mayeti sarvasya tadadhīnatvaṃ nirdoṣatvaṃ ca | tateḥ preraṇārthatvāt | avyaktapadena cākāryatvokteḥ | na cāhamiti tasyānanyādhīnatvam | bhūtabhṛditi sarvasya tadadhīnatvam | tasyānanyādhīnatvaṃ ca | na tvaditi sarvottamatvam | paramiti sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tatparatvam | jñāyate'nenati jñānaśabdoditabhagavacchāstrasya sarvaśāstrottamatvokteḥ | apradhānasya pradhānānuyāyitvāt | mameti sarvasya tadadhīnatvam | brahmaṇo hīti sarvasya tadadhīnatvaṃ tajjñānānmokṣaśca | dvāviti sarvasmādbhagavato bhedaḥ, sarvottamatvaṃ, sarvasya tadadhīnatvaṃ, sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tatparatvaṃ tajjñānānmokṣaśca | na me pārtheti pūrṇatvam | prathamā'dipadenāsatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ ta ityādi, dvitīyana jagatsatyatvaṃ gṛhyate | yuduktaṃ jñānino'pi bhagavatkarmeti tatra śrutiṃ yodāharati || adheti || atha viṣṇo te stutiryajñaśca haviṣmatā jñāninā'pyarthyaḥ sādhyaścetyarthaḥ | jñānino mokṣaniyamātkiṃ karmaṇetyata āha || paśyannapīti || suniyataṃ varṇāśramocitam | āpnuyāt teneti śeṣaḥ | yadyasmāttenātmanaḥ klṛptamānandotkarṣamāpnuyāttasmāditi vā | yaduktaṃ viṣṇubhaktereva sarvasādhanottamatvamityādi tatra śrutiṃ darśayita || bhaktyeti || jñānaṃ vinā bhakterabhāvātkathaṃ bhaktyā jñānamityata uktam || anākulamiti || prāgalpatayā''kulasya sato'nākulatvaṃ bhaktyābhavatīti bhāvaḥ | mokṣasādhanatvādbhaktestadanantaramabhāvā'śaṅkāṃ prasaṅgādvārayati || mukto'pīti || ūyasī bhaktiḥ bhūyobhaktiḥ | muktau bhedābhāvātsāmyādvā na bhaktiryuktetyata uktam || tadvaśa iti || muktau bhaktisadbhāve sukhādiphalamapi syāt | anyathā tadanupapatteḥ | phalāṅgīkāre ca vṛddhyādiprāptirityata āha || sādhyeti || na muktabhakteḥ phalasadbhāvaḥ | tasyāḥ sādhanatvābhāvāt | na caitāvatā'nupapattiḥ | yaḥ pūrvatanabhaktyā sādhya ānandastatsvarūpatvena bhakteḥ phalatvāt | phalasya ca tadā'nubhavāditi bhāvaḥ | kīdṛśī sā viṣṇubhaktirityata āha || brahmeti || kathaṃ bhaktereva jñānādisādhanatvamucyate | śravaṇādestatsādhanatvaśravaṇādityata āha || sarveti || tadeva vivṛṇoti || temaiveti || mokṣo mokṣādiḥ | atiparipakvabhaktiyoga eva mokṣasādhanaṃ, na bhagavad‌dṛṣṭiḥ | sā tu tatsādhanatvānmokṣasādhanatvenocyate | parikvabhaktiyoga eva dṛṣṭisādhanaṃ, na tu dhyānam | tattu tatsādhanamiti dṛṣṭisādhanatayocyate | pakvo bhaktiyoga eva jñānasādhanaṃ, na tu śravaṇādi | tattu tatsādhanatayā jñānasādhanatvenocyata iti bhāvaḥ | yaduktam arjunasya devatvāduttamādhikāritvaṃ, tato'parokṣajñānitvamiti tatrārjunasya devatvottamādhikāritvayorvyāptau, uttamādhikāritvāparokṣajñānitvayorvyāptau ca śrutimudāharati || adhameti || martyā martayottamāḥ | samā madhyamāḥ | devānāmuttamādhikāritvaṃ kuta ityato brahmadarśanāvinābhāvādityāha || naiveti || kathaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ śravaṇādyupalabhyata ityata āha || tirohitamiti || evaṃ cnna punaḥ śrotavyaṃ pūrvavat, bhūyastirobhāvaprāpterityata āha || bahuvāreti || tadabhyāsāt śravaṇādyabhyāsāt | bahuvārābhyāsena jñānasyātirobhāvaḥ kva dṛṣṭa ityata āha || yatheti || abhyāsapradarśanārthamuktaṃ vyāseti | prathamaśravaṇādyevaitatkiṃ na syādityata uktaṃ devānāmiti | devatvena prāgapi śravaṇādyastyeveti bhāvaḥ | yadviṣṇorbrahmarudrādisarvottamatvamuktaṃ tatra śrutīrudāharati || asyeti || hareḥ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvam | tathāpi kathaṃ tasya jīvādatiśaya ityāśaṅ‌kāparihārāyacyata antavanta iti | tatraikasya śarīriṇo dehanāśamātramucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || śarīriṇāmiti || īśvaraḥ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśī | śarīriṇāṃ tu nityatvamātramevāsti | na tu sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvam | dehahānyādisadbhāvāt | ato'sti jīvādīśvarasyātiśaya iti bhāvaḥ | astvavināśīti śloke bhagavadvācakasadbhāvaḥ | tathāpi yena sarvamidaṃ tataṃ tadavināśīti vyāptirūpeṇokteḥ kathaṃ viṣṇorevetyadhāryata ityata āha || yeneti || yadyapi vyāptirūpeṇedamucyate | tathāpi sarvatatatvasya viṣṇulakṣaṇatvena tatraiva paryavasānādyuktamavadhāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ | kathamidamīśvarasya lakṣaṇam ? jīvānāmapi kālatastatatvena tatrātivyāpterityata āha || neti|| na kevalamātra kālatastatirucyate1 | api tu deśato guṇataśca | na ca sā jīvānāmastīti bhāvaḥ | atra jīvasya pratipādyatāniṣedhaparaṃ bhāṣyamamukhyārthaparaṃ cānumatamiti na tadvirodhaḥ | tatra jīvebhyo'pi taterādhikyāt | na tvevāhamiti punarukteśceti | nanvantavanta ityatra jīvasya dehahānirevocyate | na tu nāśāntaram | ataḥ kathamādipadaprakṣepeṇa vyākhyānamityata āha || anicchayeti || satyaṃ dehahānirevātrokteti | tathāpi duḥkhaprāptihānyoraniṣṭatvena tadvato duḥkhaprāptiniyamāditi bhāvaḥ | astvevaṃ jīvādīśvarasyātiśayaḥ | tataḥ ca kimityāśaṃkāparihārāyottarārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe || tasmāditi || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvena sātiśayatvādityarthaḥ | sātiśayatve'pi kutastatpūjā kāryetyata āha || taditi || na kvalaṃ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvāttatpūjā'tra kartavyetyucyate | api tu rasvaprakāreṇāvināśitvātsa eva svatantraḥ | tataśca tadadhīnatvaṃ mukteḥ | yuddhādisvakarmaṇā''rādhitaśceśvaro mokṣaṃ dadāti | atastatpūjā kartavyetyevābhipretamiti bhāvaḥ | astvīśvarasya sātiśayatvānmokṣapradānaśaktiḥ | tathāpi svakarmaṇā''rādhito harirmokṣaṃ dadātītyetadgītābhimatamityetatkutaḥ | mukterjñānabhaktisādhyatāyā gītābhimatatvādityata āha || ye tviti || kevalakarmaṇā mokṣasiddheḥ gītānabhimatatve'pi bhaktijñānasahitena sābhimataiva | "ye tu sarvāṇi" iti tathoktatvāt | tādṛśaṃ ca karmātrābhipretamiti bhāvaḥ | "matparā" ityanena bhagavajjñānamucyate | ananyayogaḥ ananyabhaktiḥ | "anāśino'prameyasya" iti prakṛtaśarīriviṣayaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || jīveti || jīvapakṣe'nāśino'prameyasyetyatra jīvo vācya iti pakṣe | īśvaragrahaṇapakṣe sphuṭamarthabhedasambhavāt tadvihāya
