tajjñāpakasadbhāvāccetyāha || avināśīti || avināśītyatra bhagavatā tāvadīśvara eva pratipādya iti samarthitam | yaduktamavināśitvaṃ tadevātra pratyabhijñāyate anāśina iti | yadapi sarvatatatvamuktaṃ tadevāprameyasyeti pratyabhijñāyate | ato'pyatreśvara evocyata iti bhāvaḥ | jīvasya dehahānisadbhāvādīśvaradehasya nityatvādīśvarasya jīvādatiśaya iti yadvyākhyānaṃ na tadgītā'bhimataṃ bhavitumarhati | dehasyānityatvaniyamādityato gītāyāmeva iti viśeṣaṇānmuktadehasyāpi nityatvamanujñāyate | kimu hareḥ | anyathā tadviśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāt | ato yuktameva vyākhyānamiti bhāvenāha || ima iti || nanu muktadehasyāpi kathaṃ nityatvam? dehasyāntyatvaniyamādityata āha || ciditi || jaḍaśarīratvamevānityatve prayojakam | tacca muktadehasya cidānandātmakatvena tato vyāvartamānamanityatvamapi vyāvartayatīti bhāvaḥ | cidānandātmakatvaṃ dehasya kathamityata āha || svarūpeti || svarūpaṃ1 cidānandātmakamiti bhāvaḥ | muktānāṃ deha eva nāsti | "aśarīraṃ vāva santam" ityāderityato āha || ciditi || jaḍadehābhāvaparāśrutiriti bhāvaḥ | bhinnadehābhāvaparā ceti bhāvenāha || svarūpeti || nanu muktānāṃ nityācidānandātmakadehasadbhāva eva kuta ityata āha || na vartata iti || apare doṣāḥ | supeśasaḥ surūpāḥ | unmiṣanmaṇipraveśaniṣkābharaṇāḥ sphuradratnapravarahārābharaṇaāḥ | suvarcasaḥ sukāntimantaḥ | atra jaḍābhāvamuktvā teṣāṃ śarīrokterarthāccidānandātmakadehavattvaṃ jñāyate | nanvetāni vākyāni gauṇamokṣaparāṇyeva mukhyamuktau jīveśvasayoraikyenaitadanupapatterityata āha || na ceti || kuto netyato mukhyamokṣānantaramapi bhedasiya śrutismṛtisiddhatvādityāha || idamiti || atrāpunarāvṛttiśravaṇānmukhyamokṣatvaṃ jñāyate | na kevalaṃ muktānāmīśvarādbhinnatayā vyathādyabhāvamātramapi tu bhinnatayaiva paramānandanubhavo'pyastīti bhāvenāha || yo vedeti || etadvākyayoḥ parabrahmaprakaraṇagatatvānmukhyamokṣaparatvam | anyonyaṃ sakhāyaste sarve muktāḥ | svavagatena yaśorūpeṇa brahmādisabhāṃ sahamāneneśvareṇa nimittena nandati | katham? yato'sau eṣāmaniṣṭaspardhī divyānnadātā sannindriyāya hito bhavatītyarthaḥ | atrāpyaniṣṭābhāvaśrayaṇānmukhyamokṣaviṣayatvam | kaścidbrahmā ṛcāṃ samyaguccāraṇaṃ kurvannāste | svayaṃ cātipuṣṭimān kaścidbrahmā śakkarīṣu chandomatīṣu ṛkṣu gāyatraṃ sāma gāyati | kaścidbrahmā purāṇavidyāṃ vadati | kaścidbrahmā | viṣṇormūrti dhyāyatītyarthaḥ | asya ca brahmabāhulyapratipādakatvānmukhyamokṣaviṣayatvam | jakṣan bhakṣayan hasaṃśca ramamāṇo ratiṃ prāpnuvan | paramasāmyaṃ nāma yogyānandapūrvatvameva | na uta sarvanāmyamiti bhāvena muktatāratamye ca mānamāha || muktā iti || devā devagandharvāḥ | tattvarūpāḥ tattvābhimānino bṛhaspatyādayaḥ | uktebhyo'nye ye manuṣyottamāste bhūpācchatāṃśonā ityarthaḥ | tāratamyasadbhāve parasparaṃ virodhaḥ syādityata āha || akṣaṇvanta iti || prāptākṣikarṇaphalāḥ parasparavirodhaśūnyā muktāḥ jñānādiguṇeṣvasamā babhūvuḥ | tatra kecitkṣīrasāgaramagnāḥ | tecidaśvatthavanamupavartamānāḥ | kecitsnātavyahṛdā iva gambhīrā bhagavantaṃ dadṛśurityarthaḥ | idaṃ vākyaṃ "śrutvā viṣṇuṃ" ityāgamena mukhyamuktiviṣayatayā vyākhyātam | ata eva ṛcāṃ tva ityasya ṛtvigviṣayatvavarṇanaṃ parāstam | tāratamye'pūrtiḥ syādityata āha || kāmasyeti || yatrecchāviṣayāḥ paryāptāstatra lote māmamṛtaṃ kurvityarthaḥ | tathāpi na jīveśabhedo yuktaḥ | tadabhedābhidhāyakaśrutivirodhādityata āha || na ceti || kuto na virodha iti cedarthāntarasambhavāt | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cenna | śrutyantarebhyo evārthāntarasyāvagamādityāha || saṃjñeti ||"prajñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati | na pretya saṃjñā'sti" iti yājñavalkyavākyānantaraṃ tadabhipa prāyamajānantyāḥ maitreyyāścodyavākyam -- "atraiva mā bhagavān 1mohāntamāpīpanna pretya saṃjñā'sti" iti | tadartha ucyate saṃjñeti | yadi mokṣe jñānaṃ naśyettarhi tasyāpuruṣārthatvaṃ syāt | bhavati cāsau puruṣārthaḥ | atastatra jñānābhāvavacanaṃ mohakamovetyarthaḥ | "sa hovāca | navā are ahaṃ mohaṃ bravīmi" ityasyartha itīti | jñānānāśakathanaṃ kathaṃ na mohakamityata ucyate -- "avināśī vā ayamātmā'nucchittidharmā" iti | tasyārto bhūtajeti | bhautikajñānaṃ supyata iti madvākyārtho na tu nijajñānamapītyato na madvākyaṃ mohakamiti bhāvaḥ | bhūtajānāmamuktānāmetadviṣaye jñānaṃ lupyata iti vā | kuto nijaṃ jñānaṃna lupyata ityata āha || na ceti || ātmanāśaḥ ātmasvarūpabhūtajñānanāśaḥ | ātmātiriktamapi yadā na naśyati tadā kiṃ vācyamatipremāspadātmasvarapajñānaṃ na naśyatītyarthaḥ | jñeyānāśo'pi kuta ityāśaṃkāparihārarūpaṃ -- "yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati | taditara itaraṃ jighrati | yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūt tatkena kaṃ paśyettatkena kaṃ jighredyenedaṃ sarvaṃ vijānāti taṃ ca kena vijānīyāt | vijñātāramare kena vijānīyāt" iti vākyaṃ vyākhyāyate || svabhāvata iti || ātmavyatirekeṇa jñeyasadbhāva eva ghrāṇādibhogasyeśvarajñānasyātmajñānasya ca sambhavādanyathā'sambhavājjñeyasadbhāvo'ṅgīkārya ityarthaḥ | nirviśeṣadvaite karmakartṛbhāvavirodhāt svajñānaṃ ca nopapadyate | yo jñeyābhāve bhogādyasambhava uktaḥ so'pyastvityata āha || yadeti || anyadgandhādi | kathaṃ bhogādyabhāve puruṣārthatābhāva ityata āha || taditi || puruṣeṇārthyo hi puruṣārthaḥ | na hi bhogādyabhāvaṃ puruṣo'rthayate | tadarthaṃ yatate vā | ato bhogādyabhāvarūpo mokṣo na puruṣārtha ityarthaḥ | "etāvadare khalvamṛtatvam" ityupasaṃhāravākyaṃ vyākriyate || tasmāditi || bhogādyabhāve'puruṣārthatvaprasakterbhogādyaṅgīkāryam | bhogādisambhavācca bhinnā viṣayādayaḥ | tataśca svarūpajñānamiti bhāvaḥ | "yadvaitanna paśyati na tu taddvitīyamasti" ityasyārtho yaditi | "tato'nyadvibhaktaṃ yatpaśyet" ityetadvyākriyate || pradhāneti || anyadavatāravyatiriktamīśvareṇa bhinnatayā dṛṣṭatvātpradhānapuruṣādikaṃ bhinnameveśvarādityuktam | abhinnatayā sarvajñeneśvareṇādṛṣṭatvācca bhinnamityupapādakaṃ "paśyan vai tanna paśyati" iti | etadvākyaṃ vyākriyate || paśyanniti || pradhānādīnāṃ svato bhinnatvena darśanamīśvarasya bhramaḥ kiṃ na syādityāśaṃkāparihārarūpaṃ -- "na hi draṣṭurdraṣṭerviparilopo vidyate" ityetadvyākriyate || na hīti || viparilopo viparītatvam | avināśitvāditi | nityatvena nirdoṣatvādityarthaḥ | "paramaṃ brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" iti śrutiṃ vyakhyātuṃ tadupayuktamāha || brahmāṇīti || śrutivyākhyānaṃ apīti | yadyapi paramaṃ brahma veda tathāpi brahmaiva bhavati na paraṃ brahma bhavatītyarthaḥ | kuta itthaṃ kalpyate? parabrahmajñānena parabrahmatvaṃ bhavatityevārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || yadīti || yadi jīvasya muktau parameśvaraikyaṃ syāttarhi saṃsāre'pi tathā syāt | prāgbhinnasya paścādabhedānupapatternaitadyujyate | tathātve duḥkhānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ | kuto na syādduḥkhitetyata āha || duḥkhīti || parameśvarabhūtasyāpyajñānavaśādduḥkhitvamityata āha || kuta iti || sarvajñasyāpi bhrāntyā'jñānamityata āha || kveti || bhramasyādhiṣṭhānājñānamūlatvādajñānasya ca bhrāntimūlatvāṅgīkāre'nyāśrayateti bhāvaḥ | "ahaṃ brahmāsmi" tattvamasīti śrutidvayaṃ vyācaṣṭe || aheyatvāditi || asanānmiteriti || svasmin parimiternirāsādityarthaḥ | virodhināṃ nirasanātpramitirūpatvācceti vā | tviṭ‌ (tviṅ) prakāśana iti dhātostejastvāttvamitīritaḥ | na kevalametacchabdavācyatvaṃ harerapi tu sarvaśabdavācyatvaṃ cetyāha || sarvairiti || sarvaśabdavācyatve'pi rūpaviśeṣaniyamo'stītyāha || yuṣmaditi || tattvamasīti vākyaṃ nābhedaparam | pūrvottaravākyānanusāritvāditi bhāvenā'dita eva prakārāntareṇa vyākriyate | tatra "sarvān vedānadhītya mahāmanā anūcānamānī stabdha eyāya" ityetadvyākriyate || sarvāniti || "taṃ ha pitovāca śvetaketo yannu khalu somyaivaṃ mahāmānā asūcānamānī stabdho'syuta tamādeśamaprākṣyo yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavatyamataṃ matamavijñātaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavati" ityetadvyākriyate || akṛtācāramiti || ādiśyata ityādeśo nārayaṇaḥ | jñāte śrute mate ca | avijñātajñānādīnāmiti || avijñātāśrutāmatajñānaśravaṇamananānāmityarthaḥ | avijñātānyajñānādīnāṃ yatphalaṃ tattadabhāve'pi bhagavajjñānādimātreṇāpi bhavatītyarthaḥ | avijñātānyajñānādīnāṃ jātānāmapi yatphalaṃ tadapi bhagavajjñānādau jāta eva jātaṃ bhavatīti ca | paramātmajñānādau satyanyadajñātādyapi jñātādivadbhavatīti vā | evaṃvidhatvādīśvarasya tajjñāne svātmano'tyantādhamatvajñānasambhavena keśavo'smītyādyabhimānāyogānnāsau tvayā pṛṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ | tatrā'dyayojanādvaye prādhānyaṃ hetuḥ | tṛtīyayojanāyāṃ sādṛśyaṃ hetuḥ | jātamapi jagajjñānādi paramātmajñānādau satyeva saphalamiti kathamityata āha || tadadhīnamiti || bhagavajjñānādi tāvadevaṃ bhavati | vaśīkṛtaviśvo jagatsṛṣṭyādikarteśvara iti | evaṃ ca bhagavajjñānādau sati jagattadadhīnamiti jñānādikaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavati | tataśca mokṣādiphalaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | evamajñātasyāpi jagato jñānādinā phalaṃ kiṃ na syādityataḥ kā phalapratyāśā pratyutānartha eva bhavatītyāha || svātantryeṇeti || uktarītyā bhagavajjñānādyabhāve jagataḥ svātantryeṇaiva jñānādi prāpyate | tacca mithyājñānatvādanarthakṛdityarthaḥ | sādṛśyādebhagavajjñānādau satyanyajjñātādivadbhavatītyatroktaṃ "yathā somyekena mṛtpiṇḍena sarvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt" iti dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyācaṣṭe || yathā ceti || jñātaṃ jñātādi | prādhānyādbhagavajjñānādimātreṇājñātāderapyanyasya jñānādiphalaṃ bhavati, bhagavajjñānādau satyeva jñātasyāpyanyasya jñānādeḥ phalaṃ bhavatītyubhayatroktaṃ "vācārambhaṇaṃ vikāro nāmadheyaṃ mṛttiketyeva satyam" iti dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || yasmātsāṃketikanāmadheyasya vācā''rambhaṇaṃ kriyate atastadvikāro'ta evāpradhānam | mṛttiketyādisaṃskṛtajñānamātreṇa sāṃketikājñānādāvapi tatphalaṃ vidvāniti vyavahāraviṣayatvādikaṃ bhavati | saṃskṛtanāmajñāna eva ca sāṃketikānāmajñānaṃ saphalaṃ bhavati | tanmātreṇa vidvāniti vyavahāraviṣayatvādyabhāvādityarthaḥ || tanmūlamiti || tatpradhānakatvādityarthaḥ | "evaṃ somya sa ādeśo bhavati" iti dārṣṭāntikavākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe || evamiti|| pradhāno'tastajjñānādinoktaprakāradvayenānyajñānādisāphalyaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ sadṛśaśceti draṣṭavyam | prādhānyameveśvarasya kuta ityataḥ sadeva somyetyādinā svātantryeṇa jagatkāraṇatvamuktam | tadevāha || svatantraḥ kāraṇabhūta iti || īśvaro'hamiti bhāvākaraṇe hetutayeśvaramāhātmyamuktam | māhātmyāntaraṃ cocyate -- "sanmūlāḥ somyemāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ" iti | tadarthamāha || tanmūlamiti || māhātmyānramuktvā abhedabuddhiṃ mā kurvityucyate -- "sa eṣo'ṇimaitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasi śvetaketo"iti | tadvyācaṣṭe || sa iti || vyāpakaḥ pūrṇa ityātmaśabdasyārthadvayam | pūrṇo guṇaiḥ | naiva so'sīti | atattvamasīti vibhajya vyākhyānāntaram | jīveśvarabhede "sa yathā śakuniḥ" ityādinoktadṛṣṭāntavākyāni vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || yadapi "jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti, "sa eṣa jīvenātmanā'nuprabhūtaḥ" iti jīveśābhedābhidhāyakavatpratīyamānaṃ vākyadvayaṃ tat "ityādiśrutivirodha" ityādipadagṛhītaṃ vyākhyāyate || na iti || "jīvāpetaṃ vāva kiledaṃ mriyate | na jīvo mriyate" ityasyārthastadadhīnamiti | "prapañco yadi vidyeta nivarteta na saṃśayaḥ" ityādiśrutiḥ bhedamithyātvābhidhāyakavatpratīyamānā prāgādipadagṛhītā vyākhyāyate || jīveti || vida utpattāviti dhātumāśritya "yadi vidyeta" ityetadutpādyaścediti vyākhyātam | bhrāntikalpitatvādbhedasya kathamanādinityatetyāśaṃkānivartakasya "māyāmātramidaṃ dvaitam" ityasyārtho viṣṇoriti | bhedasya satyatve kathamadvaitaṃ sthānāntare kathyata ityata uktaṃ advaitaṃ paramārthata iti | asyārtho'dvaita iti | anena paramārthata iti tasiḥ prathamārtha ityuktaṃ bhavati | advaitavākyaṃ paramārtho bhagavānadvaita ityāhetyarthaḥ | kiṃ tatparamatvamityata āha || paramatvamiti || evaṃ paramatvavato'dvaitatvaṃ nāma kimityata āha || ityādaya iti || so'ya paramadvaite abhāvaḥ | tadidaṃ paramatvavato'dvaitatvaṃ tadevādvaitaśrutyartha ityarthaḥ | sarvādvaitamevārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || santīti || bādhakābhāvācca na bhedasya kalpitatvamityarthapratipādakaṃ vikalpa iti vākyam | tasyārtho vikalpa iti | "sa ātmā tattvamasi" ityādivākyasya bhedaparatvasiddhyarthaṃ "yathā somya" ityādivākyasya svoktamarthamanaṅgīkṛtya arthāntaratākalpanāyāṃ udāhṛtaśrutivirodho bādhakaḥ | bādhakāntaraṃ cāha || eketi || yathaikamṛtpiṇḍavijñānena sarvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt, yato nāmarūpātmakaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāgālambanamātraṃ na tu pāramārthikaṃ, mattikaiva satyā tathā paramātmajñāne sati jagajjñānaṃ bhavati | tato'tirekeṇābhāvādityanyathā vyakhyānaṃ na yujyate | "mṛtā jñātayā sarvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt | vācārambhaṇaṃ vikāro mṛttikaiva satyā" ityetāvatā pūrṇatvenaikādiśabdānāṃ vaiyyarthyāt | sarvamṛṇmayānāmekamṛtpiṇḍātirekeṇābhāvābhāvāt | nāmadheyasyāpi vikāratvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiñca vācārambhaṇavākye yadi īśeśitavyādiprapañcasya paramātmanyāropitatayā tato'tirekeṇābhāvo vivakṣitastarhi pratijñānaṃ paramātmajñānna jagajjñānaṃ na syāt | satyajñānena mithyājñānasyānupapatteḥ | virodhāttayorjñānayorityāha || na ceti || nanu paramātmajñānena ḍaganmithyeti jñāyata eva | taḥ kathamucyate brahmaṇyāropitatve ḍagataḥ tajjñānena ḍagaḍjñānānupapattirityata āha || na hīti || evaṃ cetparamātmajñānena prapañcābhāvajñānaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyam | na tu prapañcajñānaṃ brahmajñānena bhavatīti | tathā loke vyavahārābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | ito'pi nātra prapañcasya paramātmātirekeṇābhāvo vivakṣita ityāha || navakṛtva iti || kimato yadyevaṃ vācārambhaṇaśrutirbhedapakṣe yuktetyata āha || tasmāditi || tasmātpūrvavākyānāṃ bhedaparatvādityarthaḥ | atattvamasīti bhedaparatayā yojanāyāṃ "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvam" iti pūrvavākyavirodhaḥ syādityatastasya śrutyoktamarthaṃ smārayati || aitadātmyamiti || astvevamātmasambandhīti yojanā | sambandhaśca tādātmyamityataḥ svasvāmibhāvasambandha eveti bhāvenāha || taditi || tattvamasīti padavibhāgamabhyupetyāpi pūrvottaravākyānāṃ bhedaparatvāt bhedaparatayā śrutisiddhamarthāntaraṃ cāha || tvamapīti || na so'sīti vyāvṛttikathanamātram | ito'pyaitadātmyaparāmarśo'yamityāha || taditi || aitadātmyaparāmarśe taditipadasyaikaliṅgatvaṃ guṇaḥ syāt | tataścaitadātmyaparāmarśo'yamityarthaḥ | prācīnapakṣepi tasmādanyadataditi na liṅgavaiṣamyam | bhavedayamaitadātmyaparāmarśo bhavatāmanuguṇo yadyaitadātmyapadena tatsambandhyucyate | na ca tanniścitam | sarvo'pi īśeśitavyādiprapañcaḥ paramātmātmaka ityapyarthasambhavāditi cet | tatkimatra īśeśitavyādiprapañcasya sākṣātparamātmābhedo'bhidhīyata iti te matam uta īśeśitavyādiprapañca eva paramātmātirikto nāstīti svarūpato niṣidhyate? nādyaḥ | mithyāsatyayorabhedāyogāt | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati || avidyamānamiti || yadyeṣā śrutirīśeśitavyādiprapañcaṃ paramātmātirekeṇa pratiṣedhati tadonmattavākyavadapramāṇaṃ syāt | avidyamānasyaiveśeśitavyādiprapañcasya svayameva tadaikṣatetyādau paramātmātirekeṇa vihitatvāt | na ca vācyamatra niṣeddhuṃ tadaikṣatetyādāvīśeśitavyādiprapañco'nūdyata eva, ato na doṣa iti | īśeśitavyādiprapañcasya śrutiṃ vinā'tmano bhinnatvenāprāptatayā'nuvādāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | ito'pi niṣedhāya tadaikṣatetyādau prapañco'nūdyata iti na yujyate | "yadidaṃ vadanti tanna yujyate" iti vākyena, niṣedhe viśeṣayuktyā ca hīnatvāt | tadvinā'nuvādasya kvāpyadṛṣṭatvādityāha || anuvādo'pīti || tādṛśavākyādyabhāve'pi niṣedhāyātrānuvādaḥ prapañcasyetyaṅgīkāre ko doṣa iti cet adṛṣṭakalpanetyekaṃ dūṣaṇam | aparaṃ cāha || atiprasaṅgaśceti || kathamityata āha || abhedeti || anyatheti sambadhyate | yadyetādṛśavākyādyabhāve'pyaitadātmyamityādau niṣeddhuṃ tadaikṣatetyādinā paramātmātiriktatayā prapañco'nūdyata iti kalpyate tarhi tadaikṣatetyādau prapañcasya paramātmātirekeṇābhāvaṃ niṣidhyātiriktatvena bhāvaṃ vidhātumaitadātmyamityādinā prapañcasya paramātmātirekeṇābhāvo'nūdyata ityapi syādaviśeṣādityarthaḥ | itaśca niṣedhāyāyaṃ prapañcasya paramātmātiriktatayā sadbhāvānuvādo na bhavatītyetadeva yuktamityāha || sarveti || anuvādo bhavan śākhādāveva bhavet | tadante tu niṣedhaḥ | na cātra tadasti | bhedasyaiva śākhānteṣūktatvāt | ato'pi na bhedasya niṣedhāya śrutāvanuvāda ityarthaḥ | śākhānteṣu kāstā bhedoktaya ityata āha || neti || yaduktamabhedānuvādena bhedopadeśaḥ syāditi na tadyujyate | abhedasya śrutiṃ vinā'prāptatvāt | kiṃ nāmeśeśitavyādiprapañcasya paramātmabhinnatayā'nuvādena tanniṣedha eva yuktaḥ | īśeśitavyādiprapañcasya paramātmabhinnatāyāḥ pratyakṣādipraptatvādityata āha || na ceti || atreśvarapadena paramātmocyate | paramātmana eva pratyakṣādyasiddhatvena tatpratiyogikeśeśitavyādiprapañcasya bhedaḥ sutarāṃ pratyakṣādinā gṛhyata iti tanna | tathāsati prapañcabhinnatayā śrutāvapi paramātmanirūpaṇaprasaṅgāt | anyathā pratyakṣādinā'pi tadbhedasya viṣayīkartumaśkyatvāt | tathā conmattavākyameveti bhāvaḥ | īśvarasyaiva pratyakṣādinā'siddherīśeśitavyasya ca tadākāreṇāsiddheḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśādīśvarādirūpaprapañcasya bhedaḥ sutarāṃ tenāsiddha iti vā | ito'pi na paramātmātiriktaprapañcaniṣedho yujyata ityata āha || tatpakṣa iti || yadi paramātmātiriktaḥ sarvo'pi prapañco mithyā syāt tadā sarvaśrutīnāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | tathāhi | "ekamevādvitīyam" "yaḥ sarvajñaḥ" ityādiśrutiraikyādidharmapratipādikā uta ātmāsvarūpapratipādikā | ādye'pyaikyasārvajñādidharmāḥ kiṃ svarūpātiriktāḥ svarūpaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | tathātve mithyātvāpātāt | dvitīyastu tṛtīyo'ntarbhavati | nāpyasau yuktaḥ | svarūpasya svataḥ siddhatvena pratipādanabaiyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ | śuddhasvarūpasyāpratipādyatve'pi bhedābhāvasārvajñādyupalakṣitasvarūpasya pratipādyaratvānna śrutivaiyarthyamityata āha || lakṣiteti || lakṣitasyāpi śuddhādviśeṣābhāvena tadvadasyāpyapratipādyatvānna tatpratipādakatvaṃ śruteryuktamityarthaḥ | kutaḥ śuddhādviśeṣābhāvo lakṣitasyetyata āha || nirviśeṣatveti || lakṣitamiti yadoktaṃ tadaiva tasya nirviśeṣatvamapyuktameva | anyathā viśiṣṭatvāpattyā mithyātvāpātāt | atastasya na śuddhādviśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhavatu dharmāṇāṃ mithyātvam | tathāpi śrutestatpratipādakatve ko doṣa ityata āha || mithyeti || ito'pi nā'tmātiriktasya sarvasya mithyātvaṃ yuktamityāha || mithyātvamiti || ātmātiriktasya sarvasya mithyātve tanmithyātvaṃ satyaṃ mithyā vā | nādyaḥ | ātmātiriktaṃ sarvaṃ mithyeti pakṣakṣateḥ | ato mithyetyevāṅgīkāryamiti bhāvaḥ | kimato yadyevamityata āha || ata iti || itaśca nātmaviśeṣāṇāṃ mithyātvamiti vā''ha || mithyeti || na sārvajñādiviśeṣā asanto yena śruteraprāmāṇyaṃ syāt | nāpi śuddhaṃ lakṣyaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ śrutivedyamityucyate | yenoktadoṣaḥ syāt | kiṃ nāmaikasminnevātmani upādhibhedabhinnetannimittasārvajñādiviśeṣāśca bhavanti | tadupādhibhedabhinnamaupādhikaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasvarūpaṃ śrutipratipādyamiti cet, kimasāvupādhiḥ mithyā satyo vā || ādye doṣamāha || upādhīti || upādhikṛta evātmani bhedo viśeṣāścetyaṅgīkṛtyopādhermithyātvāṅgīkāre tadbhinnasvarūpasya tannimittaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca mithyātvaṃ syāt | tathāca tadabhidhāyakaśruteraprāmāṇyaṃ syāt | neha nānetyādau niṣedhāya mithyābhūtamapi taducyate śrutāviti cettarhi svayameva mithyābhūtamupādhibhedabhinnasvarūpaṃ tannimittaviśeṣāṃśca vidhāya punastanniṣedhe śruterunmattavākyatvameva syāt | niṣedhāya tadanūdyata iti cenna | upādhibhedabhinnasvarūpasya tannimittaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca pratyakṣādyaprāptatvenānuvādānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati | satyeti || yadyapyatrāpasiddhānto vaktuṃ śakyaḥ | tathāpi tasyātisphuṭatvena doṣāntaramevoktam | brahmātiriktasya satyatvamaṅgīkṛtyāpi brahmaṇyupādhibhedamaṅgīkurvatāṃ dūṣaṇāya ca | ādipadenopādherapyekadeśasambandha ityādivakṣyamāṇasaṅgrahaḥ | satyopādhipakṣe'pi doṣāḥ samā ityanena mithyopādhipakṣe'pyeti bhavantīti sūcayati | nanvekatve'pyākāśasya tathā mahānasākāśagadadhūmānubhavastasyaiva na sarvākāśasyopādhibhedāt | tathā'trāpi syādityata āha || acetanānāmiti || kiṃ mahānasākāśasambandhavattve'pi dhūmasya sarvākāśasambandhābhāvavadduḥkhāśrayatvābhāvo'stvityucyate uta tadanubhāvabhāvavadanubhāvabhāvaḥ | nādyaḥ | asmākamaniṣṭābhāvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | ākāśasyācetanatvena anubhavaprāpterevābhāvena dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyāditi bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ cābhyupagamavādaḥ | ākāśasyāntarbhedavattvāt | upasaṃharati || ata iti || 18 || yaduktaṃ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvādīśvaraḥ svatantra iti | tadayuktam | "ayamasya dehaviyogakartā", "anenāyaṃ dehādviyojitaḥ" iti jīvasyāpi svatantryapratīterityāśaṃkāparihārāyocyate "ya enamiti" | tatra jīvasya dehaviyogādau kathamapi kartṛtvaṃ nāstītyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || ya enamiti || ya enaṃ jīvaṃ svātantryeṇa dehaviyogakartāraṃ paśyati, yaścainaṃ jīvaṃ jīvāntareṇa svātantryeṇa dehādviyojitaṃ paśyati tau na vijānīta ityevaṃ vyakhyāyam | na tu pāratantryeṇamāpi jīvasya hantṛtvādikaṃ paśyan na jānātītyarthaḥ | kuto'nyo'rtho na syādityata āha || anyatheti || jīvasya pāratantryeṇāpi hantṛtvābhāve "mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi" itīśvarādhīnatayā jīvasya hantṛtvoktivirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ jīvo nitya iti na tadyuktam | "ayaṃ jīvasya hantā", "anenāyaṃ jīvo hataḥ" iti vyavahāreṇa cetanasyānityatvāvagamādityāśaṃkā parihārāyapyayameva ślokaḥ | tatra prathamapakṣe ya enamiti padaṃ jīvaviṣayatayā vyākhyātam | neśvaraviṣayatayā | tatra dehaviyogarūpahananasya vivakṣitatvāt | tatra jīvasyaiva svātantryābhāvādīśvarasya tadbhāvāt | asmin pakṣe tu "ya enaṃ cetanaṃ hantāraṃ paśyati sa na jānāti" iti cetanaṃ prati hananasya vivakṣitatvāt | cetanahananasya jīvavadīśvareṇāpyakaraṇāt enamiti padamubhayorapi vācakamityāha || cetanamiti || 19 || nanu jīvanityatvādeḥ pūrvamevoktatvātkimuttaraślokenetyata āha || jīveti || nedaṃ bhagavadvākyaṃ, yena punaruktiḥ syāti | kintu yaduktaṃ svayaṃ jīveśvarayorutpattivināśarāhityam, īśvarasya śarīrato'pyutpattyādyabhāvena svātantryaṃ, jīvasya svarūpato janmādiśūnyasyāpi dehotpattyādinā'svātantryaṃ tatra pramāṇatvena mantravarṇo'yamudāhriyata iti bhāvaḥ | atreśvarapratipādanāpratīteḥ kathametadityato nāyaṃ bhūtvetyatra dehato'pyutpattirāhityaśravaṇāttasya ceśvaraliṅgatvāt pūrvārdhastatpratipādaka iti bhāvenāha || ayamiti || etena vā śabdādeva pūrvatra naño'nukarṣasambhavāt kiṃ tadantareṇeti parāstam | api cātra "na mriyate" iti dehaviyogābhāvaśca śrūyate | maraṇaśabdasya dehaviyoga eva prasiddhatvāddehaviyogābhāvasya ceśvaraliṅgatvāt tatpratipādakaḥ pūrvārdha iti bhāvenāha || maraṇamiti || dehaviyoga iva svarūpanāśe'pi maraṇaśabdasya prasiddhatvāt so'rthaḥ kiṃ na syādityataḥ svarūpanāśe maraṇaśabdasya prasiddhireva nāstītyāha || na hīti || yadi maraṇaśabdasya na svarūpanāśo'rthaḥ tarhi īśvarasvarūpānāśe nāyaṃ mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ syāt | tadabhidhāyakaśabdāntarābhāvāt | tathā ca maraṇaśabdasya svarūpanāśe'rthe grāhye naitadbalāt pūrvārdhasyeśvaraparatvasiddhirityata āha || svarūpeti || nātreśvarasya svarūpānāśo vaktavyaḥ | yenaitatpadasya tatparatvaṃ kalpyate | yasya dehanāśopi nāsti tasya svarūpānāśaḥ kimu vācya iti kaimutyenaiva siddhetityarthaḥ | atra jīvasyotpattyādyabhāvādikathanaṃ na śrūyata ityuttarārdhastadviṣaya iti bhāvenāha || ayamiti || atrāpīśvara eva pratipādyaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || "na jāyate " "ajaḥ" iti paunaruktyam | nanu punaruktibhayena pūrvottarārdhayorviṣayabhedakalpane śāśvatopyanya eva prasajyate | nityapadena punarukterityata āha || neti || na śāśvatapadena nityatvamucyate | yena punaruktiḥ syāt | api tu jīvopyajo nityaścettarhi īśvaravatsvātantryādimānapi syāt | tathā ca na tatpūjā kāryeti śaṃkānirāsāya tasyāsvātantaryādyahānamevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | jīvasāyāsvātantryādikaṃ svarūpaṃ, tacca na jahāti, tena ca śāśvata ityucyata ityetatkuta ityata āha || alpeti || tathāpi purāṇa iti punaruktirityata āha || purāṇīti || nānena purāṇapadenānāditvamucyate | yena paunaruktyaṃ syāt | kintu jīvasyeśvaravadajatvādisadbhāve'pi kuto na svātantryādītyato dehotpattyādibhāvena tadvadajatvādyabhāva evocyata iti bhāvaḥ || 20 || yaduktaṃ "jīve svātantryaṃ manyamāno na jānāti" iti tatra "nāyaṃ hanti" iti heturuktaḥ | atha jñānināṃ tādṛśābhimānābhāvaśca tatra heturucyate "vedeti" | tatrāvināśinityapadayoḥ paunaruktyaparihārāyārthabhedamāha || avināśinamiti || jīvasya samīpoktatvādenamityasya jīvaviṣayatvapratītinirāsāyāha || enamiti || samastaślokaṃ śrutyaiva vyācaṣṭe || kartṛtvamiti || jānan avināśitvādihetuneti śeṣaḥ | kartā kartṛtvābhimānī | jīvasya samīpoktatvāttadviṣayo'yaṃ ślokaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyaśceti || īśvarasya śarīrāpāyarahitatvāt tatparatve śakyate punaruktiparihāraḥ | na tu jīvaparatve | tasya dehanāśasadbhāvāt | ataḥ punaruktivirodhāte samīpoktamapi jīvaṃ vihāyeśvaragrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 21 || nanvastvīśvaraviṣaye śokābhāvo, jīvaviṣayo tu bhaviṣyati | jīvo nityastasya dehayogaviyogau kaumārādivadityukte'pi sarvalokaprasiddhajanimṛtisadbhāvāt yuddhe ca tatprāpteriyāśaṃkāparihāratvena ślokamavatārayita || jīvasyeti || śarīrayogaviyogayoḥ kaumarādivacchokakāraṇatvābhāvo'ṅgīkṛtaścettarhi janimṛtī api na śokakāraṇaṃ, yataḥ śarīrayogaviyogāveva janimṛtī ityarthaḥ || 22 || astyīśvarasya svato nāśābhāvaḥ | tathāpi yuddhagataśastrādikāraṇaviśeṣeṇa cchedādiprāpteḥ śoka ityāśaṃkāparihāratvena ślokamavatārayati || kāraṇata'pīti || anyathātvaṃ chedādi || 23 || jīvaviṣaye'pyetadāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokamavatārayati || acchedyatveti || nanu "nityaḥ sarvagataḥ" iti nityatvaṃ punaḥ kimarthamucyate | atra sarvagatavastupratipādanāt kathaṃ cāsya jīvaviṣayatvam? na cāyamardha īśvaraviṣayaḥ | jīvasya samīpoktatvādityata āha || nityamiti || nityaṃ sarvagatasthāṇurityarthaḥ | kaḥ sarvagataḥ? kiṃ ca tatsthatvamityata āha || sarvagata iti || nātra nityatvaṃ sarvagatatvaṃ cocyate | yena punaruktirīśvaraviṣayatvaṃ cāśaṃketa | kintu "jīvasyāpīśvaravadacchedyatvādisadbhāve sarvasāmyam, tathāca kiṃ tatpūjayā" ityato nityaṃ tadadhīnatvādyevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | sarvagatasthāṇutvoktyā vaiṣamyaheturdarśitaḥ | nanvatra sarvagata ityeva yuktam | na tu sarvagatastha it | sarvagatasayaivācalatvopapatteḥ | aṇau tadanupapatterityata āha || hetuto'pīti || nātrācalapadena kriyārāhityamucyate | yena sarvagata ityeva padavibhāgaśaṃkā | kintvastu jīvasyeśvarādhīnatvam | tadapi kadācinnaśyati | tataśca sarvasāmyam | tathāca na tatpūjā kāryetyataḥ tadadhīnatvānāśa evocyata iti bhāvaḥ | nityapadenaivāsyārthasya siddheḥ kimannatyata uktaṃ hetuta iti | nityamapi sarvagatasthatvaṃ varādikāraṇaviśeṣeṇa naśyatviti śaṃ,ānirākaraṇānnaitadvaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ | tathāpi sanātana ita punaruktirityata āha || nādeneti || na sanātanapadena nityatvamucyate | yena punaruktiḥ syāt | api tu svātantryābhāve jīvasya vidhiniṣedhabaddhatvaṃ hetvantaramucyata iti bhāvaḥ ata evānūktahetūpanyāsātprāk asvātantryoktāvapyapaunaruktyam | nanvacchedya iti ślokaḥ prakṛteśvaraviṣaya eva kiṃ na syāt | kimanena pratītapadavibhāgatyāgādinetyata āha || nityamiti || smṛtisamākhyānājjīvaviṣaya evāyaṃ śloka iti bhāvaḥ | ito'pi nāyaṃ śloka īśvaraviṣaya ityāha || acchedya iti || "nainaṃ chindanti" itīśvarasyācchedyatvāderuktatvāt "acchedyo'yam" ityacchedyatvādeḥ punaruktiprasaṅgo'sya ślokasyeśvaraviṣayatāyām | ato nāyaṃ tatpara ityarthaḥ | jīvasya samīpoktatvāt "avyakto'yam" ityasyāpi tadviṣayatvapratītinirāsāyāha || yasminniti || yasminnayaṃ sthita ityuktyā sarvagatapadeneśvarasyāpi samīpoktatvaṃ sūcayati | yadyatreśvaraḥ pratipādyastarhitasmādityuttaravākyamanupapannaṃ syāt | na hīśvarasyālvaktatvādijñāne yuddhagataśokābhāvo bhavati | nāpyasmin pakṣe tasmāditi parāmarśaviṣayo'sti | yadi tasya jīvaviṣayatā tadā dūroktatvadeṣa ityata āha || evamiti || nātra yuddhagataśoko nivāryate | nāpi tasmāditi parāmarśaviṣayābhāvaḥ | yato'trācchedyatvādisāmyājjīvasyāpi svātantryeṇa kimīśvarapūjayetyataḥ sanātanatvādihetunā īśvarasyaiva svātantryamuktam | astvīśvarasya svātantryaṃ, kiṃ tāvatā tatpūjayetyato yasmādīśvara eva svatantro'stasyaiva saṃsāraśokanāśakatvaṃ yujyate | sa ca svakarmaṇā'vyaktatvādiguṇayuktatvena jñāta eva sarvasaṃsāraduḥkhanāśaṃ saṃsāraśokaṃ pariharetyevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | bhavedayamatrārtho'bhipreto yadi svakarmaṇā bhagavajjñānaṃ, jñāto bhagavān sarvaduḥanāśaṃ karotīti gītābhimataṃ syāt | tadeva kuta ityata āha || teṣāmiti || atra māṃ dhyāyanta ityanenaiva jñānaṃ labhyate | evametatprakaraṇaṃ jīveśvaraparatayā vyākhyāya athāsyobhayaparatve yuktiṃ cāha || na tveveti || teṣāmiti || atra māṃ dhyāyanta ityanenaiva jñānaṃ labhyate | evametatprakaraṇaṃ jīveśvaraparatayā vyākhyāya athāsyobhayaparatve yuktiṃ cāha || na tveveti || nanvekaḥ prasaṅgādevopakrāntaḥ | prakaraṇaṃ tvekaviṣayameva kiṃ na syādityataḥ sarvatrobhayaliṅgasadbhāvādubhayaviṣayaṃ prakaraṇamityāha || dehina iti || astūpakramavaśādubhayoḥ prākaraṇikatvaṃ tathāpi yadvākyaṃ yadviṣayatayā vyākhyātaṃ tasya tadviṣayatā kuta ityato yadvākyaṃ yadviṣayatayā vyākhyātaṃ tatra talliṅgasadbhāvāttasya tadviṣayatvaṃ yuktamiti vā'ha || dehina iti || nanvastu tatra tatra jīvaḥ pratipādyaḥ | dehitvādiviśeṣaṇānāṃ jīvādanyatra niravakāśatvāt | avināśitvādīnāṃ tu jīve'pi sambhavāt kathaṃ tadvākyasyeśvaraviṣayatvaniścaya ityata āha || na hīti || īśvaro'pi tatsambhavaḥ kathamityata āha || paramātmana iti || na ca tatra tatra bhāṣyavirodhaḥ śaṃkanīyaḥ | atra ca mukhyayaiva vṛttyārthamaṅgīkṛtya paunaruktyādiśaṃkonmūlanaṃ vinā kevalāmukhyārthagrahaṇe bādhakānāmuktatvāt | bhāṣye punarmukhyārthamaparityajyaivārthāntarasyoktatvāditi || tathāpi naiteṣāṃ vākyānāmuktārthatā yuktā | asaṅgatatvādityato "nāsataḥ" ityantānāṃ saṅgateruktatvāt " avināśi tu" ityādīnāṃ saṅgatiṃ darśayan "avināśi tu"ityasya ślokasya "nāsataḥ" ityanena saṅgatiṃ sākṣādasambhavādavatārakrameṇāha || yasmāditi || evambhūta iti || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśītyarthaḥ | asya ślokasyoktaprakāreṇa "anāśinaḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇenāpi saṅgatirityāha || atastadarthamiti || athavā "nāsataḥ" ityetaccheṣatvenāpi "anāśinaḥ" ityasya saṅgatirityanenoktam | "antavantaḥ" ityanenāpi saṅgatirityāha || anyeṣāmiti || prākṛtadehinaśca | jīvā iti śeṣaḥ | anena "śarīriṇaḥ" ityanyopayogamācaṣṭe | nityatvādityanena "nityasya" ityasya | ata evāsya "na tvevāham" , "dehino'smin" ityanena gatārthatā'pi parihṛtā bhavati | "nāyaṃ hanti" ityatra hetutayā prakṛtānuvādo'yamityāśrayaṇāt | ata evoktaṃ "nityasyoktāḥ" iti || "nāyaṃ hanti" ityasya "ya enam" ityanena saṅgatimāha || tasmāddhanteti || etena "nāyaṃ hanti" ityetatpunaruktam | jīvāsvātantryāderuktasvāt | na ca "ya enam" ityanena saṅgatiṃ sākṣādasambhavādavatārakrameṇāha || yasmāditi || evambhūta iti || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśītyarthaḥ | asya ślokasyoktaprakāreṇa "anāśinaḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇenāpi saṅgatirityāha || atantadarthamiti || athavā "nāsataḥ " ityetaccheṣatvenāpi "anāśinaḥ" ityasya saṅgatirityanenoktam | "antavantaḥ" ityasyoktarītyā "anāśinaḥ"ityanena saṅgatau sddhāyāṃ "nāyaṃ hanti" ityanenāpi saṅgatirityāha || anyeṣāmiti || prākṛtadehinaśca | jīvā iti śeṣaḥ | anena "śarīriṇaḥ" ityasyopayogamācaṣṭe | nityatvādityanena "nityasya" ityasya | ata evāsya "na tvevāham", ityatra hetutayā prakṛtānuvādo'yamityāśrayaṇāt | ata evoktaṃ "nityasyoktāḥ" iti | "nāyaṃ hanti" ityasya "ya enam"ityanena saṅgatimāha || tasmāddhanteti || etena "nāyaṃ hanti"ityetatpunaruktam | jīvāsvātantryāderuktatvāt | na ca "ya enam" ityetadupapādanāyaktānuvādo'yaṃ pramāṇānupanyāsenopapādanāyogādityetadapi parākṛtam | " nāyaṃ hanti" ityetatprakṛtam " antavantaḥ" ityapekṣya pravṛttamityuktatvāt | mantravarṇasya jīveśvaranityatvopapādakatvamuktam | " nāyaṃ hanti" ityetadupapādakatvenāpi saṅgatirityāha || yasmādayameveti || etena mantravarṇasya jīveśvaranityatvamātropapādakatve'dhikaviśeṣaṇokteranupayoga ityetadapirahṛtam | jīvavadityanena " purāṇaḥ" ityasyopayogaṃ darśayati | " na hanyate" ityasya pūrvārdhaprakṛtena parameśvarasyaiva svātantryamityanena saṅgatimabhipretya tadghaṭanāya tātparyamāha || jīvastviti || anenāsya gatārthatā parihṛtā bhavati | " vedāvināśinam" itīśvarāvināśitvādeḥ " kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ" ityanena sākṣātsaṅgaterabhāvādavatārakrameṇa tāmāha || ata evamiti || eteneśvarāvināśitvādeḥ prāgevoktatvātpunaruktirityapi parāntam | " kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ" ityetadupapādakasvatantryopapādanāyoktānuvādo'yamityāśritatvāt | " vāsāṃsi" ityetasya prakṛteneśvarasvātantryeṇāpi saṅgatimāha || vāsasa iti || nainamityasya prakṛteneśvarasvātantryeṇapi saṃgatimāha || īśvarasyeti || jñātavyamiti sambandhaḥ| yadvā tathāpi nāsya prakaraṇasyobhayaviṣayatvaṃ yuktam | ubhayapratipādanasya prasaṅagānanuguṇatvāt | yuddhavidhānasyaiva prakṛtatvādato nobhayapratipādanaṃ prasaṅagānuguṇam | yuddhaṃ kartavyaṃ, tacceśvarasyaiva svatantratvena mokṣapradānasamarthatvāttatpūjātvena kāryamityatrābhipretam| tatreśvarasya nityatvapratipādanaṃ yuddhavidhānāya śokanivāraṇārthamupayujyate | tasya sarvaprakāreṇāvināśaratvādipratipādanaṃ ca tatpūjāvidhānārthaṃ tasya mokṣadatvasāmarthyasamarthanāya svātantryopapādakatayopayujyate | jīvasya nityatvavarṇanaṃ yuddhavidhānāya śokanivāraṇārthamupayujyate | tasya dehanāśādivarṇanamapi śokanivāraṇāya parameśvarasyaiva svātantryasiddhyarthaṃ jīvasyāsvātantryapradarśanāyopayujyate -- iti bhāvena sarvavākyānyabhipretārthe yojayati || yasmādevambhūta iti || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśītyarthaḥ | yasmādevambhūta ityavināśitvityabhinate prameye yojyam | atantatpūjeti nāsata iti | atantadarthamityanāśina iti | anyeṣāmityantavanta iti | prākṛtadehina iti śarīriṇa iti | ata iti nāyaṃ hantīti | nityanvāditi na hanyata iti | tasmāditi ya enamiti | yasmāditi na mriyata iti | tatsaṃyogeti nāyaṃ bhūtveti | jīvastviti na hanyata iti | ata evamiti vedeti | vāsasa iti vāsāṃsīti | īśvasyeti nainamiti | yadyapyetadvyākhyānata eva siddhaṃ, tathāpi viprakīrṇatayoktaṃ na mandabuddhāvārohatīti piṇḍīkṛtyoktam | atra "nainaṃ chindanti " iti vartamānaprayogaḥ kālāntaracchedādyanujñārtha ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || nainamiti || na kālāntaracchedādyanujñārthaṃ vartamānaprayogaḥ | kintu mama dehe chedādikaṃ nāstīti tatra yuktitayā chedādiprāpitisadbhāve'pīdānīṃ tadabhāvasya pratyakṣata eva darśayituṃ śakyatvasūcanārthameveti bhāvaḥ | atreśvarasvarūpasyaiva cedādeyabhāvaḥ kathyate na tu taddehasyāpi | dehasya "niśataśarairvibhidyamānatvaci " iti tadbhāvokteḥ | ataḥ svadehasyeti kathamucyata ityato'bhiprāyamāha || cchedeti || mṛṣā pradarśanaṃ kimarthamityata āha || īśvara iti || kuto mṛṣā, paramārthata eva kiṃ na syādityato vā'ha || īśvara iti || svatantrasya paramārthatastadayuktamityarthaḥ || 24 || "avyakto'yam" itīśvaraviṣayamityuktam | tatreśavarasyāvyaktatvādikathane kā saṅgatirityataḥ "sarvagatasthāṇuḥ"iti paramātmanaḥ sarvagatatvamabhihitam | tatreśvarasya deho'sti na vā? ādye dehinaḥ sarvatra vartamānasya sarvatra darśanaṃ syāt | dvitīye śarīracchedādinirāso na yukta ityāśaṃkānirāsāyādyapadamavatārayati || sarveti || dehitve'vyaktatvaṃ kathaṃ yujyata ityāśaṃkya tatparihātatvenācitantyapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe || kathamiti || avintyaśakteḥ prativandhe nāśe vā sati pratītiprasaṅga ityāśaṃkāparihārāyāvikāryapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe || na ceti || nanvekenaiva śabdena pūrteḥ kimarthaṃ nainamityatra prati ptatyenamiti vacanam | "avyakto'yam"ityatra prativiśeṣaṇam "ayam"iti vacanaṃ ca kimarthamityata āha || yānīti || ādipadena naño grahaṇam | anena prativiśeṣaṇamapi vīpsārūpeṇa "enam"ityādibahuśabdayojanāṃ sūcayati | evaṃ cejjīvasya bāhulyābhāvāt "acchedyo'yam"iti pṛthagvacanaṃ vyarthamityata āha || jīve tviti || jīve kṛthagvacanamiti śeṣaḥ | nanvīśvarasya dehavattvaṃ, tasya ca dehasya chedādirāhityamevambhāvaśca sarvarūpāṇāmityetatkuta ityata uktam "ucyate"iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe || sarvamiti || kāstāḥ śrutaya ityata āha || saditi || chedādidoṣarahito deho yasyāsau saddehaḥ | sukhagandhaḥ | sukhātmakagandho vā | jñānajñāna ityāderatiśayitajñānādimānityarthaḥ | nanvīśvarasya dehasadbhāve śrutivipratipattestatsandeha eva syātkuto niścayastadbhāvasyetyataḥ śrutyantareṇa tadvyavasthāṃ darśayati || adeha iti || svarūpavān svarūpabhūtadehavān || sukhajñānādirūpakaḥ || astīti saṃbandhaḥ | tataśca dehavānucyata ityanuṣajyate | dehadehinoraikyamanyatrādṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ yujyata ityata āha || sa ceti || nanu sukhajñānādirūpakaḥ || astīti saṃbandhaḥ | tataśca deho viṣṇorananyaścet tadā tasya sukhādiguṇarūpatvaṃ prasajyate | na ca tadyujyate | "ānandabhuk" ityādāvānandabhoktṛtvasyoktatvāt | ekasya ca bhoktṛbhogyabhāvādarśanādityata āha || guṇeti || dṛṣṭopyayamabhinne bhoktṛbhogyabhāvaḥ kiṃnimitta upapadyata ityata āha || abhinne'pīti || asti | tenābhinne'pi bhoktṛbhogyabhāva upapadyata iti śeṣaḥ | viśeṣasadbhāva eva kuta ityata āha || ayamiti || nanvayaṃ viśeṣo viśeṣite'nyo'nanyo vā? ādye bhedaparamparayā'navasthā | dvitīye viśeṣaviśeṣibhāvavyavahārāyodaḥ | tatrāpi viśeṣāṅgīkāre'navasthetyata āha || viśeṣo'pīti || viśeṣo viśeṣito'nanya iti na bhedaparamparayā'navasthā | na eva viśeṣo yathā'bhinne'pi vastuni bhoktṛbhogyabhāvanirvāhakaḥ tathā viśeṣito bhedarahitasyāpi svasya viśeṣatvaṃ, viśeṣiṇo viśeṣitvaṃ ca nirvahatīti na viśeṣaparamparayā'pyanavasthetyarthaḥ | itopyekasyaiva harerbhoktṛbhogyabhāvo yukta ityāha || parameti || abhinnasyaiva svasya bhoktṛbhogyabhāve'nupapattiṃ parihartuṃ hareraiśvaryaṃ kuta ityata āha || yukteti || yuktāyuktatvaṃ vastunoriti śeṣaḥ | tatra īśvare | tarhīśvare duḥkhitvādyapi kalpyatāmayuktyabhāvādityata uktam | pramāṇeti || ekasyaiva bhoktṛbhogyatvādikaṃ pramāṇāvagatatvādviruddhamapyaiśvaryabalādaṅgīkāryaṃ nānyat | tasyāprāmāṇikatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ekasyaiva bhoktṛbhogyabhāvādiguṇā eveśvarasya pramāṇikā na duḥkhādidoṣā ityatra śrutyantaraṃ cāha || guṇā iti || kathaṃ na doṣāḥ śrutāḥ? "janitota viṣṇoḥ"ityādau pratīterityata āha || ajñairiti || pirakṛtaguṇānāṃ bhagavatā'bhede, sarvāṇyapi rūpāṇyovaṃvidhānītyatra ca śrutīrāha || ekamiti || ekam ekatvahaṅkhyāyogi | evetyavahavādibhedanirākaraṇam | advitīyaṃ samābhyadhikarahitam | kiñcana nāneti rūpāvayavaguṇakarmabhedaḥ | tarhi bhedābhedau syātāmityata āha || mṛtyoriti || mṛtyoḥ mṛtyuṃ tama āpnoti | nāneveti bhedābhedau bhedadarśane ko'nartha ityata āha || yatheti || yathā parvateṣu durge śikhare vṛṣṭamudakam adho vidhāvati evaṃ guṇādīn bhinnān paśyan tān dṛṣṭānanu teṣāmeva darśanāntaramadho vidhāvatītyarthaḥ | sarvādvaitaparāḥ śrutaya etā ityatastāḥ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || matsyeti || atyantābhede vyavahārabhedaḥ kiṃnimitta ityata āha || abhede'pīti || yadyabhinnaṣu guṇādiviśeṣeṣu viśeṣo varitate tarhi viśeṣiṇāṃ viśeṣasya tathābhedaviśeṣayoḥ bhedo'bhedo vā | ādeye'nasthā | dvitīye vyavahāraviśeṣāyogaḥ | tatrāpi viśeṣāṅgīkāre'navasthaivetyata āha || viśeṣiṇāmiti || viśeṣiṇāṃ viśeṣasya tathābhedaviśeṣayoḥ bhedābhāvānna bhedaparamparayā'navasthā | na ca vyavahāraviśeṣānupapattiḥ | yatantatta viśeṣo'ṅgīkriyate | na caivaṃ viśeṣaparamparayā'navasthā | ya eva viśeṣo'bhinneṣvapi guṇaguṇyādiṣu vyavahārabhedanirvāhakaḥ sa eva viśeṣo viśeṣaviṣeṣyādivyavahārabhedanirvāhaka ityaṅgīkārādityarthaḥ | matstādīnāmabhede'pi indrārjunādivattāratamyamapi nāstītyāha || prādurbhāveti || ke te matsyādayaḥ prādurbhāvā ityata uktameva vivṛṇoti || matsyeti || brahmādayo'pi bhagavadavatāratvenānyatrocyante | te hi kimatrādiśabdena gṛhītā utānavatārā evetyapekṣāyāmāha || brahmeti || tarhyati || tarhyavatāratvokteḥ kā gatirityata āha || viṣṇuneti || āveśāviśeṣavattayā taduktirityāśayaḥ | sākṣādavatārā eva kiṃ na syurityata āha || saṃsariṇa iti || teṣveveti || śeṣasanatkumārāniruddhaśakrayamāśviṣu lakṣmaṇabharataśatrughnabalapradyumnāniruddhanarārjunayudhiṣṭhiranakulasahadevatvena jāteṣvatyarthaḥ | arjunādicaturṣu naikaprakārāveśa ityāha || svalpa iti || avatārāṇāmanavatāratvenānavatārāṇāmavatāratvena jñānaṃ saṅ‌karajñānam || 25 || evaṃ svayaṃ yuktīruktvā śoko na kārya ityuktam | tatra dehasiddham | tenaiva śoko na kārya ityucyate "atheti"| tatra muktasyāpi jananamaraṇasadbhāvaṃ parākarvanneva ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || tiṣṭhatviti || "atha ca" ityasyārthastiṣṭhatviti | tathāpītyanūdya tāvanmātrajñānenāpīti vyākhyānam‌ | nityapadasya niyamavācitve mānābhāvātkathaṃ niyameneti vyākhyetyata āha || nityamiti || evaṃ nityapadasyobhayārthatve niyamārthagrahaṇe ko heturityata āha || atra tviti || etacchlokārthavivaraṇātmakottaraśloke nityapadasya dhruva iti vivṛtatvādityarthaḥ || 26 || jananamaraṇaniyamo'tra śokanivāraṇe hetutayoktaḥ sphuṭaṃ pratīyate | prāgabhiprete jīvasyāsvātantrye ca hetutayā'bhimata iti bhāvenā'ha || tanmāditi || tasmājjananādiniyamavattvādeva | atra jīve svātantryabuddhiśca na kāryetyarthaḥ || 27 || yadi jīve nāścaryabuddhiḥ kāryā tarhi kutrāsau kāryā? īsvara ityuktamiti cetsatyam | kiṃ tato'nyatrāpi kvacidityāśaṃkya tatparihāratvenoktopasaṃhārarūpaṃ ślokamavatārayati || kiṃ tarhīti || nanvatrāścaryo'nya eva, īśvarastu tatsadṛśa eva, na svayamāścarya iti pratīteḥ kathamāścaryo bhagavānevetyucyata ityata āha || āścaryamiti || āścaryavadityanena neśvarasyānāścaryatvamabhipreyate kintvāścaryasyaiva sata āścaryopamatvamucyata iti bhāvaḥ | evamapi bhagavaditarasya svātantryamaṅgīkāryam | tasyaiva svatantratāyāmāścaryavadityuktyasambhavāt | svopamāyāḥ kvāpyadarśanāt | tathāca bhagavānevetyavadhāraṇāyoga ityata āha || gaganamiti || itivatsvopamābhidhānamukhena bhagavaditarasya svātantryābhāve tātparyamatreti bhāvaḥ | sāgaraṃ sāgarasamūhaḥ | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || āścarya iti || tadgocaramityanena "āścaryavat" ityetatkriyāviśeṣamityuktaṃ bhavati | nanu bhagavānāścarya eva cettarhi sarveṣāmapyāścaryatvāt "kaścit" iti viśeṣaṇaṃ vyartham | na hi stambhaḥ kasyacideva stambha ityata āha || anāścaryavaditi || yadyapīśvaraḥ sarveṣāmāścarya eva | tathāpi viparītadarśināṃ bahūnāṃ bhāvādyathāvaddarśinaḥ kasyacideva bhāvādāścaryatayā darśanaṃ vivakṣya kaśyiditi viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 29|| ākṣipati || dehīti || jīvo nitya ityuktam | tatra kiṃ svata eva nityo'theśvarasāmarthyena? nādyaḥ | sarvaṃ parameśvarādhīnamityabhimatavirodhāt | na dvitīyaḥ | nityasya svābhāvikatveneśvarādhīnatvānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ | etatparihārāya dehīti ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || yasmāditi || dehe rakṣakatvena sthitaścet pralayādau nāśaḥ syādityata uktam || sūkṣma iti || sūkṣmadehapadena liṅgaśarīraṃ caitanyaśarīraṃ cocyate | nityatvādeḥ svābhāvikatvātkathamīśvarādhīnatvamityata āha || dravyamiti || svābhāvikatve'pi nityatvāderīśvarādhīnatvaṃ yujyate | svābhāvasyāpi bhagavadadhīnatayā smṛtisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | jīvasattāyā bhagavadadhīnatve ceyaṃ smṛtiḥ pramāṇam | tathāpi jīve sthitvā tadrakṣaka īśvara iti viśeṣaḥ kuta ityata āha || tatrate || tataḥ tadadhīne | tatastasmāttannintṛtvāt | bhāvābhāvayorapi nityānityābahirbhāvāt || 30 || "yadvā jayema" ityuktasya pakṣadvaye'pyahāniḥ parihāra ucyate "hato veti" | tatra "hato vā prāpsyasi svargam" ityatreva "jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm"ityatrāpi mahīmātraṃ na svarga ityanyathāpratīnirāsāyā'ha || jitveti || "yuddhe mṛta eva svargaṃ prāpsyasi, jitvā mahīmeva bhokṣyase" iti pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || ya iti || ye śūrāḥ yuddheṣu pirayudhyanti, ye ca tatra mriyante, ye ca sahasrasaṅkhyātadhanadakṣiṇādātāraḥ tānevāyaṃ preto'pi gacchatāditi yamaṃ pirati pretasya svargaprārthanājjaye'pi svargaprāptiḥ śrūyate | ato na pratīta evārtha iti bhāvaḥ || 37 || uktamupasaṃhṛtya prakaraṇāntaramārabhyate "eṣeti" | tatra sāṅkhyayogaśabdau darśanaviśeṣaparāviti pratītinirāsāya tadarthaṃ sapramāṇakamāha || samyagiti || atroktayoḥ sāṅkhyayogayorbuddhya yukta iti praśastatvāditarayorninditatvānna tāvatroktāviti bhāvaḥ | ito'pi na sāṅkhyapadenātra prasiddhasāṅkhyaṃ vivakṣitamityāha || sāṅkhyasyeti || atira sāṅkhyapadena prasiddhasāṅkhyagrahaṇe sāṅkhyoktamabhihitamityuktaṃ syāt | na ca tadyuktam | atra "na jāyate"ityādāvīśvarasyoktatvāt, sāṅkhyasya nirīśvaratvāt | ataśca nātra sāṅkhyaṃ śāstraviśeṣa ityarthaḥ | ito'pi nātra sāṅkhyayogaśabdau prasiddhaśāstraparāvityāha || sāṅkhyairiti || atra pūrvottaraprakaraṇayoḥ | sāṅkhyādibhiḥ pāratrikānarthahetutvameva hiṃsāyā aṅgīkriyate | na tvaihike | atira punā rājyārthameva hiṃsā vidhīyate | ato na virodha ityata āha || mokṣeti || sāṅkhyayogaśabdayoḥ sopapattikamarthāntaraṃ cāha || parameti || pūrvottaraprakaraṇoktārthapratipādakatvādityarthaḥ | na virodho'tra taduktagrahaṇa iti śeṣaḥ || 39 || yogaḥ stūyate neheti | tatra yogātikrame nāśaḥ pratyavāyaśca nāstītyanyathāpratītinirāsāya pūrvārdhe smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || prārambheti || tameva viṣṇudharmaṃ smṛtyā darśayati || svociteneti || pravṛttirhitakaraṇamapravṛttirniṣiddhaparityāgaścānyaviṣaye nānuṣṭhīyata ityarthaḥ | tasmin dharme'dhikārikālapramāṇānyāha || enamiti || tameva vivṛṇoti || taditi || kārtayugatve tretādiṣu na phalaprado'nadhyāyādhītavedavadityata āha || treteti || kārtayugatvoktistatra prācuryeṇa sambhavābhiprāyeṇeti bhāvaḥ | kimasya phalaṃ yat‌tretādiṣvadhikaṃ syādityata āha || evamiti || kathaṃ sa eva mucyate? traividyasāyapi mokṣasadbhāvādityataḥ traividyadharmasvarūpamuktvā tadvato mokṣābhāvamāha || traividya iti || traividyasyāpi bhagavajjñānādisadbhāvāttasyaiva mokṣahetutvātkathamasau svargaṃ bhuktvā nivartata ityata āha || samyagiti || kiṃ tasya kadāpi na mokṣa ityataḥ svargagamanāvadhikathanenaivārthataḥ siddhamarthaṃ sphuṭamāha || krameṇeti || ante samarpayan traividyo yadi niyamāt pratyekaṃ sarvāṇi samarpayatītyarthaḥ | trayyuktakarmakaraṇamātreṇa traividyo bhavetkiṃ bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānādinetyata āha || paramiti || vedavāditvasya bhāgavatatraividyayorapi sāmyādasyaiva kimucyata ityato na vedānusāritvaṃ vedavāditvamatrābhipretamiti bhāvenāha || vāda iti || vivādātpaṭhanāditi || vivādapūrvakapaṭhanādityarthaḥ | astvevaṃ vedavāditvaṃ tathāpi tena mokṣādisiddheḥ kathaṃ bhāgavatasyaiva mokṣa ukta ityataḥ pāṣaṇḍādivattasya niṣiddhatvānna mokṣasādhanatvamiti bhāvenāha || vedeti || na kevalaṃ mokṣanādhanatvābhāvo'pi tu tamaḥsādhanatvaṃ cāstītyāha || tebhya iti || "anārambhamanantaṃ ca" iti tamasi duḥkhānubhavānuvṛtterādyantaśūnyatvamucyate | "yasmānnaivotthitiḥ" iti tatpraptānāmapunarāvṛttirucyate | tamasaḥ punarāvṛttirāhityaṃ kuta ityata āha || vavramiti || svagatānāṃ gamanaṃ vārayatīti vā, sadā vṛṇotīti vā varamānandaṃ vārayatīti vā vavram | "ityādivedamaditam || 40 || evaṃvidhaścedayaṃ vaiṣṇavo dharmaḥ tarhi kimiti kaiścidevaikamatyenānuṣṭhīyate, parasparaviruddhatayā bahubhirnānuṣṭhīyata ityata āha || buddhiriti || keṣāñcideva buddhernirṇītatvāttāvanta evaikamatyena viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ | bahūnāmanirṇītabuddhitvātparasparavirodhena na viṣṇuparatvamiti bhāvaḥ | anena vyavasāyeti ślokopi vyākhyāto bhavati || 41 || yadyavyavasāyātmakabuddhitvameva vaiṣṇavadharmarāhitye nimittaṃ tarhyavyavasāyabuddhistyājyā syāt | tyagaśca kāraṇaparityagena syāt | kena kāraṇenāvyavasāyabuddhirbhavatīti pṛcchati || avyavasāyeti || tatparihārāya "yām"iti ślokān yojayati || yāmiti || samādhāna iti niścayasya tattvaviṣayatayā dārḍhyamucyate | samādhānābhāve ca na viṣṇudharmānuṣṭhānamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ | smṛtyaiva ślokān vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || tathā tathāviṣayīkāri | tatsāmyāditi || vastadusāmyādityarthaḥ | asatāṃ vākyaṃ kuto vaiṣamyaheturityata āha || svargeti || yadyasmāt | nānyadastītyasyārthadvayamāha || na manyanta iti || anugatiḥ prāptiḥ | kriyābāhulyasantatām etatpratipādakām | janmetyasyārtho bahviti | anta ityabhiprāyamātram | nānyadastītyādyarthe śrutiṃ yāha || iṣṭeti || anyacchreyo bhagavajjñānādi | sukṛte sukṛtaprāpye | anubhūtvā | bhogāniti śeṣaḥ | vedavādaratatvamuktārthatayā niṣiddhamityatra pramāṇāntaraṃ cāha || vedeti || iṣṭāpūrtaṃ variṣṭhaṃ manyamānāḥ kecana svargabhogānantaramimaṃ lokaṃ viśanti | kecana hīnataraṃ viśantītyuktam | tatsmṛtyā vivṛṇoti || ya iti || saṃśayāt saṃśayena | viṣayīkurvantīti śeṣaḥ | śraddhādisadbhāvave kathaṃ tattvajñānābhāvaḥ? "śraddhāvān sabhate jñānam" ityāderityata āha || nirṇetṛṇāmiti || tattvajñānarahitaśraddhādikamevaitatphalapradaṃ cettarhi kiyān viśeṣastattvajñānināṃ bhavadityata āha || yairiti || ādhikye ciraṃ neti || brahmahatyāderapyadhikapāpācaraṇe'pyalpakālaṃ yātanāṃ yānti || na tu ciramityarthaḥ | yajñādimātreṇa bhagavad‌dveṣiṇāmapi svargasiddheḥ kiṃ jijñāsādinetyata āha || tadanyeṣāmiti || viparītaniścayānāmaśvamedhādibhirapi na svargaṃ ityarthaḥ | duryodhanādīnāṃ dveṣiṇāmeva svargādidarśanāt kathametadityata āha || ye tviti || tathāpi dveṣiṇāṃ svargaprāptisadbhāvāt kathaṃ tadanyeṣāṃ viparyaya ityuktamityata āha || tadanya iti || bhāgavatācāryavarjitad‌dveṣyabhiprāyeṇa taduktamiti bhāvaḥ | anena "imaṃ lokam" ityajñaviṣayam | pramūḍhatvamajñatvameva | hīnataramiti tvavaiṣṇavācāryavadbhagavaddveṣiviṣayam | teṣāṃ pramūḍhatvaṃ mithyājñānitvamityuktaṃ bhavati || 42 -44 || pratijñāto jñānopāya ucyate || "traiguṇyeti" || tatra vedānāṃ traiguṇyaviṣayatvāt tān parityajya nistraiguṇyo bhavetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || traiguṇyeti || yāpayantītyasya prāpayantītyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || apagamayantīti || pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || āśrityeti || sattvasthatvaṃ sāttvikatvaṃ, ātmavattvaṃ manasvitvamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tattvātmaśabdārthe smṛtyaivā'ha || sattvamiti || santatiḥ samyagvyāptiḥ | sattvaṃ viṣṇuścet tatsthatvaṃ svabhāvikaṃ kiṃ vidhiyata ityata āha || santateti || na tadādhāratayā'vasthānamātramatra vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | ātmā viṣṇuścettadvattvaṃ svabhāvikaṃ na vidheyamityata āha || paramātmeti || na tu tatsambandhamātramiti bhāvaḥ | sattvasthapadenaivāsyārthataḥ prāptatvātkiṃ punarucyata ityata āha || teneti || satataṃ viṣṇusmaraṇamātravidhāvaikyenāpi tatsmaraṇaṃ prāpyate | ata ātmavattvakathanena tannivārya yathāvatsmaraṇaprakāra ucyata iti bhāvaḥ | aprāptaprāptiryogaḥ | prāptaparirakṣaṇaṃ kṣemaḥ | tadubhayaṃ sarvathā tyājyamityanyathāpratītinirāsāyā'ha || viruddheti || na kevalaṃ śāstraviruddhaviṣayayogakṣemaparityāgamātramatra vivakṣitam | api tu tadicchātyāgo'pīti bhāvenecchetyuktam | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyetheti || utthānādīnāmapyaprāptaprāptirūpatvena yogatvāt | tataśca "yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha" ityādivirodha iti bhāvaḥ || 45 || traiguṇyanivṛttyarthaḥ vedāśrayaṇaṃ kāryamityatra yuktirucyate "yāvāniti" | tatrodapānaśabdaṃ, sarvataḥ saṃplutodakaśabdaṃ ca smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || udrekāditi || sarvakāryāṇāṃ pralaye līnatvāt kathaṃ sarvataḥ saṃplutodakaśabdārthatayā pralayo gṛhyata ityata āha || prakṛtiriti || samastaślokaṃ smṛtyā vyācaṣṭe || yāvaditi || sādhakasya sambhavatīti śeṣaḥ | vedajñānena kuto viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ dadātītyata āha || vedeti || astu vedārthajñānaṃ nāma viṣṇujñānam | tathāpi kuto bhāgavān phalaṃ dadātītyata āha || jñānāditi || vākyadvayasiddhaṃ ślokārthamekīkṛtya darśayati || sarvata iti || nanvatra kaścidudriktatvādiguṇaḥ śrūyate | sa viṣṇuriti kutaḥ? anyopi kiṃ na syādityata āha || sarve hīti || muktānāṃ ramāyāścodriktatvāt kathamudriktatvena viṣṇutvaniścaya ityata āha || ye ceti || muktānāmudriktatve'pi pālakavarjitatvābhāvenodapānatvāsambhava iti bhāvaḥ | muktānāmudapānatvāsambhave hetvantaraṃ cāha || na ceti || ramāyāḥ sarvābhimīnitvena kālādiceṣṭakatvādasaṅgrahaḥ | kiñcodriktatvaṃ teṣāmaṅgīkṛtameva na tu mukhyatostyato na teṣāmudapānatvamityāha || na ceti || anena ramāyā api ceṣṭakatvamanumatameveti jñāyate | udriktatvāderanyatrāsambhave'pi kimityata āha || ata iti || kiñcodriktatvādyevānyatra na sambhavati | kimuta sarvataḥ samplutodake | ato'pyudapāno viṣṇurevetyāha || pralaya iti || māstvanyeṣāmasambhavāt sarvataḥ samplutodake'pyudapānatvam | viṣṇorapi tatsambhavaḥ kuta iti cetpariśeṣāditi brūmaḥ | śrutibhyaścetyāha || ānīditi || tadekaṃ brahma vāyupreraṇāṃ vinā svasāmarthyenaiva kālādikaṃ prerayati sma | tasmādanyaduttamaṃ vastu kiñcana nā'sa | api tu tadevodriktamāsa | aparaṃ tamaḥ prakṛtirasmin sarvasmin deśe'vijñātaṃ salilaṃ bhūtvā'sīt | tena salilena pralaye sarvaṃ gūḍhamāsīdityarthaḥ | asyāgre salile samantātpālakavarjito bhagavānāsīdityarthaḥ | advaitaḥ sarvodriktaḥ || 46 || aikyabhāvanaṃ na kāryamityatra heturucyate "karmaṇīti" | tatrārjunasya karmakaraṇe kiñcitsāmarthyamasti, na tu phalāpādana ityevocyate | tatkathamanena sarvajīvānāmīśvarābhedābhāvaḥ sādhyata ityata ityata āha || karmeti || nātra ta ityurjuna eva gṛhyate | api tu sarvajīvāḥ | teṣāṃ phalāpādanāsāmarthyamuktvā īśvare tatsāmarthyamabhipreyate | tenātroktaivābhedābhāve yuktiriti bhāvaḥ | nanvatrāstvetāvadabhipretam | tathāpi pratijñāyā abhāvādabhedābhāve yuktiriyamukteti kathaṃ jñāyata ityata āha || mā karmeti || phalaheturīśvaraḥ sa mā bhūrmanasetyarthaḥ | atra śrutiṃ cāha || eṣa iti || svayaṃ jīvaḥ || 47 || karmākaraṇe sneho mā'stvityuktam | kiṃ tarhītyata ucyate "yogasthaḥ" iti | tatra karmasaṅgaṃ tyaktvā karmāṇi kurviti vyāhatamityata āha || saṅgamiti || na saṅgapadena karmasambandho'bhidhīyate | yena vyāhatiḥ | api tu phalasneha eveti bhāvaḥ || 48 || jñānātkarmādhamamityuktam | tarhi jñānasyottamatvāt jñānāvāsthāyāmīśvaraikyabhāvanaṃ yuktamityāśaṃkāparihārāyocyate buddhāviti | tatraitacchaṃkāparihāraḥ kathamukta ityata āha || buddhāviti || asminnevārthe smṛtisammatiṃ darśayaṃstayaivottarapādamapi vyācaṣṭe || ajñānāmiti || phalahetupadavyākhyānaṃ "taṃ ye svaikyena" ityādi pūrvavat | kṛpaṇāḥ kṛpāviṣayāḥ | tatra hetumāha || tamasīti || 49 || nanvastu jñānasyādhikyaṃ, tataśca kimityataḥ "tasmāt"iti jñānasādhanamāpādyamityuktam | tatrāstu jñānasādhanāpādanam | kiṃ phalasneharahitakarmaṇetyāśaṃkāyāṃ phalasneharahitakarmaiva jñānasādhanamiti vaktavyam | kimarthamatra karmakauśalasya jñanasādhanatvamucyata ityataḥ phalasneharāhityādiyuktakarmaiva karmakauśalapadenocyata iti bhāvenāha || yathāvaditi || "yogasthaḥ" ityatra bhagavajjñānasyāparigṛhītatvādatrāpi na tadabhipretamityata āha || bhagavaditi || etacchlokārthavivaraṇātmakottaraśloke "buddhiyuktaḥ"iti bhagavajjñānasyāparokṣajñānasādhanatvena gṛhītatvādatra pūrvatrāpi tadabhimatamiti bhāvaḥ || 50 || 51 || kiyatparyantamavaśyaṃ kartavyāni mumukṣuṇaivaṃ karmāṇītyata ucyate yadeti | tatra nirvedapadena vairāgyamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || nirvedamiti || etacchlokadvayaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || buddhīti || śrotavyaśrutapadaṃ sarvakarmopalakṣakam | samādhānena śrutyarthajñānaniścalatvenāparokṣajñānaṃ bhavati | anena "namādhāvacalā" iti samādhau satyaparokṣajñānaṃ tena viṣṇāvacaleti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tadyogaṃ bhagavadyogam | bhagavadyogasya sarveṣāmapi vidyamānatvāt ko viśeṣa ityuktaṃ vivṛṇoti || mukti iti || tadaśrnute brahmāpnotītyarthaḥ | atrāpi yadā tadeti sambadhyate | nanvatra "śrutiviprapatipannā" iti śrutiviruddhatvamucyate | tatkathaṃ śrutimārgaṃ prapanneti vyākhyotyata āha || śrutāviti || 52 || 53 || prakṛtajñānilakṣaṇādipraśnaḥ kriyate sthiteti || tatra "kā bhāṣā" ityetadanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || keti || nanu jñānīti bhāṣyata iti siddhatvātkiṃ praśnenetyata āha || kairiti || "samādhisthasya"ityasya samādhiṃ kurvato jñānino lakṣaṇādi pṛcchatītyanyathāpratītinirāsārthamāha || samādhīti || 54 || jñānilakṣaṇamucyate prajahātīti || tatra jñāninaḥ sarvakāmaprahāṇaṃ nāma niṣiddhāniṣiddhasarvakāmaprahāṇamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || sarveti || kuto na jñāninaḥ sarvakāmanivṛttiḥ, yataḥ sarvaśabdasaṅ‌kocaṛ kriyata ityata āha || aparokṣati || jñāninaḥ kadācinniṣiddhamamanivṛttirapi nāsti | kutaḥ sarvakāmanivṛttirityarthaḥ | tarhi jñānasyābhibhavakāle jñānilakṣaṇābhāvājjñānitvābhāvaḥ prasajyata ityataḥ satyamityāha || ata iti || niṣiddhakāmarāhityasya jñānānabhibhavakāla eva sattvādityarthaḥ | nanu yadi kadāyid dṛśirabhibhūyate tarhi sā na mokṣasādhanaṃ syāt | kādācitkatayā daurbalyādityata āha || tathāpīti || yogyā svabimbaviṣayā | "ātmanyevātmanā"ityātmaśabdau jīvamanaḥparāvityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || ātmanīti || kuto na jīvādiparovityata āha || tuṣṭa iti || atrātmasthityādinā tuṣṭyabhidhānājjīvasthityādinā tadasambhavānna tatparāvātmaśabdāviti bhāvaḥ || 55 || etādṛśaṃ cejjñānaṃ tatkiṃ sarve na sādhayantītyato nirāhāratvenendriyajayastenaiva jñānamityatiduḥsaṃpādatvaṃ jñānasyocyate "viṣayā" iti | tatra rasaśabdasyāpūrvamarthamāha || rasa iti || 59 || vītarāgetyādinā rāgādirāhityaṃ jñānilakṣaṇamuktam | jijñāsunā ca tatsādhyam | kāraṇaphalaparijñāne ca rāgādityāgo bhavati | ato rāgādiparihārāya tatkāraṇaphale ucyeti "dhyāyata" iti | tatra saṃmohasmṛtivibhramapadābhyāṃ viparītajñānamevocyate | ataḥ kathaṃ hetuhetumadbhāva ityata āha || saṃmohāditi || atra saṃmohapadena paravittāpaharaṇādyadharme dharmabuddhirityādimithyājñānamucyate | smṛtivibhramapadena ca paravittāpaharaṇāderadharmatvābhidhāyakaśrutyādyarthasya pūrvaṃ svayaṃ jñātasyāpyanyathāsmaraṇamucyate | tayośca hetuhetumadbhāvassambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | smṛtibhraṃśādbuddhināśa iti durghaṭam | cetanasya buddhyavinābhāvitvena buddhernāśāyogādityata uktaṃ vivṛśvannāha || vākyeti || nirṇītaṃ kevalavākyasāpekṣatāṃ vināpi niścitam | na tu jñānamātramiti bhāvaḥ || 63 || indriyajaye jāte manasaḥ svato'pi prāyo viṣayāgatilakṣaṇena prasādena mokṣalābhādasāvāpādya ityuktam | tadanāpādane doṣaścocyate nāstīti | tatra bhāvanāyāḥ śāntisādhyatvāt "na cābhāvayataḥ śāntiḥ " iti kathamucyata ityato na śāntipadenatra cittanirodha ucyate | api tu bhagavanniṣṭhabuddhitvam | tacca bhāvanāsādhyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvena śāntiśabdārthaṃ sapramāṇakamāha || śāntiriti || 66 || piṇḍīkṛtyoktalakṣamucyate yā niśeti | tatra sarvaprerakāṇāṃ devānāmapi jñānitvājjñānināṃ paramātmetarādarśane lokayātrocchedaḥ syādityatastadvākyaṃ devetarajñāniviṣayatayā smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || devebhya iti || "yathā'nyaiḥ " ityanena pūrvārdhatātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | yathājñairbṛhma na jñāyata ityarthaḥ || sūryavaditi || sūryo yathā svatejasā sarvaṃ prakāśayatyevaṃ svajñānena sarvaṃ viṣayīkurvantītyarthaḥ || 69 || evaṃ jñānī sarvatrodāsīnaścetkathaṃ viṣayabho,stasyetyata ucyate āpūryamāṇamiti | tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || bhuñjāna iti || dharmamayīṃ dharmākhyām | viṣayabhoktā na kāmī kathamucyata ityata uktasya "na kāmakāmī " ityasyārtho nāsāviti | nanu kāmābhāve viṣayabhogāsambhavāt kathaṃ jñāninaḥ kāmābhāvo mokṣasiddhyarthamucyata ityato'tra kāmapadena niṣiddhecchaivābhipretā | tasyā eva mokṣavirodhitvāt | necchāmātraṃ tasya mokṣāvirodhitvādityāha || keti || kutsiteyamiti mānaṃ yadviṣaye saivecchā kāma ityarthaḥ | itaśca "na kāmakāmī " ityatra necchāmātraniṣedha ityāha || na ceti || nanu śāntiśabdasya bhagavanniṣṭhāvācitvāt kathaṃ sa mucyata iti vyākhyetyato bhagavanniṣṭhāsambandhādeva mokṣo'pi śāntiśabdābhidheya iti smṛtyaivāha || śāntiriti || 70 || pūrvaślokoktaṃ prapañcyate vihāyeti | tatra kāmapadena yadīcchā gṛhyate tarhi niḥspṛha iti puraruktiḥ | yadi viṣayāntarhi viṣayatyāge kiṃ bhakṣayati | niḥspṛhatvaṃ ca kathaṃ yujyate | sarvakāmanivṛttiriti vacanavirodhāt | jīvanādyabhāvaprasaṅgāccetyata āha || niṣiddheti || sarvakāmapadena viṣayāṇāṃ grahaṇānna puraruktidoṣaḥ | nāpi caraṇāsambhavaḥ | atra niḥspṛha ityanena viṣayāṇāṃ svarūpato hānamantareṇa spṛhābhāvamātreṇa hānasyābhipretatvāt | nāpi smṛtivacanādivirodhaḥ | niḥspṛha iti niṣiddhaviṣayaspṛhābhāvasya vivakṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ || nanu jñānināmapyahaṃ mameti pratyayaprayogadarśanāt kathaṃ tasyocyate nirahaṅ‌kāratvādītyato nāhamityādijñānādimātramahaṅ‌kārādīti bhāvena smṛtyaivāhaṅ‌kārādiśabdarthāmāha || asvarūpa iti || mamatā madadhīnamiti bhāvanā || 71 || uktalakṣaṇamupasaṃhriyate eṣeti | tatra brāhmīti brahmadharmabhūteti pratītinirāsāyāha || brāhmīti || nanu "kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare " ityāderjñānamātreṇa sarvakarmaṇāṃ kṣayājjñānānantarameva mokṣasadbhāvena "sthitvā'syām " ityantakāle bhagavatsmṛtyādividhānaṃ brahmaprāptyarthaṃ kimiti kriyata ityata āha || jñānināmiti || jñānināmapi yadyantakāle bhagavatsmaraṇādi nāsti tarhi janmāntarameva bhavati | na brahmaprāptiratastadarthamantakāle tatsmaraṇādividhānaṃ yuktameva | na ca jñāninaḥ kṣīṇakarmatvājjanmāntarāyogaḥ | jñānamātreṇāprārabdhakarmanāśe'pi yeṣāmantakāle'pi na bhagavatsmaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ prārabdhakarmabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | yadi mokṣarthaṃ sākṣādantakāla eva bhagavatmṛtyādyapekṣitaṃ tarhi tasya duḥsampādatvena kasyāpi mokṣo na syāt | ataḥ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇaṃ sātra bhagavato'bhipretamityata āha || prārabdheti || na mokṣarthamantakālasmaraṇāpekṣāyāṃ kasyāpi mokṣaprasaṅgaḥ | prārabdhakarmaṇa evāntakālasmaraṇapratibandhakatvena tannāśe'ntakāle smaraṇaniyamāt | tadbhāve ca mokṣaniyamāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvantakālasmaraṇādeva mokṣo nānyatheti bhagavadabhimatamiti niścayo yadi bhavettadaivamarthakalpanā bhavet | na eva kuta ityata āha || yaṃ yamiti || "śāntirmokṣo'tha nirvāṇam " ityādernirvāṇaśabdasya mokṣe'pi prasiddherbrahma nirvāṇamiti kathaṃ sāmāsādhikaraṇam | na ca brahma nirvāṇaṃ ceti yojanā | brahmaprāptyatiriktamokṣānirūpaṇādityata āha || bāṇamiti || bāṇaśabdasya śarīravācitvānnirvāṇapadena kāryabrahmavyāvṛttyarthaṃ brahmaṇo'śarīratvamevocyate | na mokṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu kathamaśarīratvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ | sahasraśīrṣetyādivirodhādityāśaṅ‌kāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || abhāvāditi || 72 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
pūrvādhyāyasaṅgatatvenaitadadhyārthaṃ harśayituṃ pūrvādhyāyapratipādyamāha || jñānamiti || "eṣā te'bhihitā " ityantena jñāyata iti jñānamīśvarādisvarūpaṃ nirūpitam | tato'dhyāyaparisamāptiparyantaṃ tatsvarūpajñānopayaścoktaḥ pūrvādhyāya ityarthaḥ tatsaṅgatatvenaitadadhyāyārthamāha || tatreti || tayorjñānayogayormadhye yogo'pi dvividho bhavati | karmadhyānayogabhedāt | tatra prāguktameva karmayogaṃ prapañacayatyanenādhyāyena bhagavānityarthaḥ | nanu "karmajaṃ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṃ tyaktvā " ityādinā pūrvatrāpi karmayogasya prapañcitatvāt kimannādhyāyenetyata uktam || viśeṣata iti || nanvatrāpi "indriyāṇi parāṇi " ityādinā jñānasyāpyukteḥ kathaṃ karmayogaṃ prapañcayatītyucyata ityato vā'ha || viśeṣata iti || prācuryeṇetyarthaḥ | nanu karmaṇaḥ sakāśādbuddherjyāyastvaṃ prāk kutroktam? yadbījo'yaṃ "jyāyasī cetkarmaṇaḥ " ityarjunapraśna ityata āha || dūreṇeti || 1 -2 || "loke'smin " iti parihāravākye keṣāñcidadhikāriṇāṃ jñānameva keṣāñcit karmaivānuṣṭheyamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || jñāneti || nātra jñānayogapadena jñānamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ, karmayogapadena ca karmamātramucyate | kintu pratyekamubhayam | rhyubhāvapi jñānakarmayogāviti baktavyau | kathaṃ kaścijjñānayogaḥ kaścitkarmayoga ucyata iti cenna | ekaikatra jñānakarmaṇoḥ pracuryābhiprāyeṇālpajalamiśre'pikṣīre kṣīraśabdaprayogavat prayogopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | sāṅkhyānāṃ jñānameva yogināṃ karmaiveti pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cettathā'ṅgīkāre smṛtivirodhaḥ syāditi bhāvenāha || sāṅkhyāiti || devānāṃ bahukarmasadbhāvātkathaṃ mukhyahāṅkhyatvamityata āha || bahviti || tato'pi karmaṇo'pi | gṛhasthādīnāmapi kiṃ kevalakarmaivetyapekṣāyāmāha || jñānino'pīti || tarhi kathaṃ karmayogina ityata āha || atīti || sāṅkhyānāṃ kevalaṃ jñānameva yogināṃ kevalaṃ karmaiveti tiṃ na syādityata āha || nobhayamiti || sāṅkhyānāṃ jñānena yogināṃ karmaṇāpuruṣārtho bhavatīti śrutyādau śrūyate | na caikaikena puruṣārtho yujyate | ato naikaikagrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | karmābhāve kuto na puruṣārtha iti cetkiṃ karmapadena karmamātraṃ vivakṣyate atha yajñādikarma vā | ādyaṃ dūṣayati || na hīti || dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati || na ceti || jñānamātraṃ karma vinā saṃsāranivṛttisādhanamapi na sampūrṇapuruṣārthakaramiti bhāvaḥ | tarhyastu kevalaṃ karmaiva puruṣārthakaramityata āha || na ceti || "na karmaṇā na prajayā " ityādiśrutivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | anena "na karmaṇāmanārambhāt " ityādeśca tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | bhavedatra jñānakarmaṇoḥ samuccayakalpanaṃ, yadyatra sāṅkhyayogādeḥ puruṣārthahetutvamucyeta | ekaikasya puruṣārthasādhanatvābhāvokteḥ na ca tadatrocyata ityata āha || niṣṭheti || ṣṭhā gatinivṛttāvityato niṣṭhā paryavasitiḥ | gateriti śeṣaḥ | kathamanena codyaparihāra ityata āha || muktiriti || atra niṣṭhāpadena gatiparyavasitivācinā saṃsāragatiparyavasānaṃ muktirabhipretetyarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ jñānakarmabhyāṃ mokṣa ityaṅgīkāre "na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānaśuḥ " ityādiśrutivirodhaḥ syādityata āha || jñānina iti || jñānakarmabhyāṃ mokṣasiddhyaṅgīkāre'pi naitacchrutivirodhaḥ | karmarahitajñānamātrasya mokṣasādhanatvābhidhānāt | asmābhirapi tadaṅgīkārāt | karmaṇastu jñānamātreṇaiva siddhe mokṣe sukhādhikyahetutvenāṅgīkārāt | jñānādeva mokṣaḥ karmaṇā ānandavṛddhirityetat kuta it cet jñānina iti śrutereveti bhāvaḥ | itaśca "jñānayogena " ityatra karmāpi saṃyojyam | na jñānamātramityāha || anyatheti || anyathā jñānamātreṇaiva puruṣārthāṅgīkāre | karmayogināmapi prakṛtatvātteṣāṃ karmānārambhe puruṣārthāsambhavābhidhāyakametadvākyaṃ kiṃ na syādityata uktam || ubhayeti || na kevalametatkarmayogiviṣayamapi tūbhayaviṣayamityarthaḥ kuta'syobhayaviṣayatvaṃ jñāyata ityata āha || samatvaṃ ceti || mokṣe karmaṇā ānandavṛddhirbhavatītyayuktam | "nānyaḥ panthā " iti śrutau karmaṇo mokṣasambandhasyaiva nirākaraṇādityata āha || nānya iti || jñānāyogameveyaṃ śrutirvyavacchinatti | na tu karmasambandhaṃ nirākaroti | tathātve "jñānino mokṣaniyamaḥ " iti śrutivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ || 3 || 4 || kāryata ityatra svatantrakarturanyasyāpratīteḥ prakṛtiguṇānāmeva svatantrakartutvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || kartṛtvamiti || atra guṇānāṃ vikārakartṛtvamevocyate | na tu svatantrakartṛtvam | avaśa iti viṣṇoḥ svatantrakartṛtvokteḥ | avaśapadena svānadhīnatvaṃ gṛtītvā guṇānāṃ svatantrakartṛtvameva kiṃ na gṛhyata iti cenna | "kartṛtvam " iti śrutivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | śrutiriti kutracitpāṭhaḥ | tatrānyathāpratītinirāsāya śrutyaiva vyākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ svatantrakartṛtvamatra na pratīyata ityata uktam || avaśa iti || avaśapadaṃ kathaṃ viṣṇuvaśatvaṃ vaktītyata āha || aḥ iti || 5 -8 || nanu "karmaṇā badhyate jantuḥ " ityādeḥ karmaṇo bandhakatvātkathaṃ "kuru karma " iti vidhīyata ityāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokāmavatārayati || karmaṇeti || ayajñarthaṃ karma bandhakamityevātra pratīyati, na tvavaiṣṇavaṃ karmabandhakamityato yajñaśabdārthaṃ śrutyaivāha || jña iti || nātra yajña padena prasiddhayajña ucyate | api tu yāto viṣayīkṛto jñānarūpatvājjño bhagavān yenoddeśena sa evetyarthaḥ | ya eṣa uddeśa iti yojanā || 9 || karma kartavyamityatra hetvantaramucyate " annāditi " | atra kathamannasya parjanyāddevaviśeṣādavatpattiḥ | kathaṃ ca tasya yajñādutpattiḥ| kathaṃ cānnāditi paramparāyā evoktatvāt cakramityucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ parihartuṃ brahmākṣaraśabdayoranyārthakalpanāṃ ca nirākartuṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || jananāditi || paraṃ janyaṃ yasyāsau tathoktaḥ | yajñāditi || yajñasamārādhitadevatāyā bhavatītyarthaḥ | yajño devatoddeśena dravyaparityāgaḥ | karma taditarakriyā | vākyājjāyate | kathaṃ nityo jāyate gamyate avagamyata ityarthaḥ | vedena yathāvadavagata eveśvaraḥ satkarma kārayatīti bhāvaḥ | yata evaṃ paramparayā yajñābhivyaṅgyastasmāt | bhagavato yajñe pratiṣṭhitatvādyajñānuṣṭhānena cakrapravṛttau bhagavadabhivyaktinimittaṃ ca sukṛtaṃ bhavati, na kevalaṃ bhūtasthitihetutvanimittamiti bhāvaḥ || cakraṃ nānuvartayatīti || karma na karotītyarthaḥ | viśvasya cakrāntarbhāvātkarmākaraṇena cakrāpravṛttau viśvahantṛtvaṃ cet gārhasthyetarāśramānanuṣṭhānaṃ prasajyeta | karmaṇāṃ yajñadānataporūpeṇa traividyadāśramāntare ca yajñādyabhāvādityata āha || vācika iti || vācikaḥ svadhyāyādiḥ | mānaso dhyānādiḥ || viśeṣata iti || sarvasādhāraṇye'pi anyeṣāmanye'pi santyeṣāmayamevetyarthaḥ | anyeṣāṃ yajñāntaramāha || vanasthasyeti || akratuḥ paśvālambhanahīnaḥ | śuśrūṣādyātmaka ityādipadenāgnipūjā | vidyābhayādītyādipadena svabhoktavyānnadānam | annapūrvakaṃ vidyābhayādidānam | svabhoktavyādadhikamāpādyānnadānamiha vivakṣitam | annaṃ tu mūlaphalādi | " brahmākṣarasamudbhavam " itatra brahmapadena vedo'kṣarapadena brahmocyata ityapavyākhyānaṃ hetvantareṇa pratyākhyāti || brahmeti || yadyatra brahmapadena vedo'kṣarapadena brahmocyate tarhi upira brahmaṇaḥ " tasmātsarvagataṃ brahma " iti brahmapadena pratyabhijñā na syāt | yatpadena yanna prakṛtaṃ tasya tatpadena kāraṇaviśeṣaṃ vinā parāmarśādanāt | na ca tatra vedaparāmarśaḥ | tasya yajñe pratiṣṭhitatvokteranupayuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | doṣāntaraṃ cāha || cakreti || vedātkarmaṇāmutpattyabhāvādbrahmaṇo vedasyotpattyabhāvāt bhūtebhyo brahmaṇo jananābhāvādarthāntarakalpane vedādeścakrāpraveśaḥ syāt | vyaktyarthāṅgīkāre bahūnāṃ padānāmamukhyārthatāpāta iti bhāvaḥ || 14 || 15 || 16 || karma kartavyamityatra yuktyantaramucyate || yastviti || tatra santoṣastuptirāpūrtirityādestṛptisantoṣaśabdayorekārthatvāt " ātmatṛptaḥ " itvaktatvāt " ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭaḥ " iti punaruktirityata āha || tṛptiti || viśeṣo'rtha iti śeṣaḥ | kuta evamarthakalpanetyataḥ ślokaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || viṣṇviti || evaṃ tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorekārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya vigrahabhedenārthabheda uktaḥ | atha tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorevārthabhedācca na punaruktiriti bhāvena tayorarthabhede pramāṇamāha || ratiriti || ānandaḥ svarūpabhūtaḥ | karmaja upakārādijātaḥ | ratitṛptiprītiśabdānāṃ bhinnarthatve kimāyātaṃ tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorarthabhede ityataḥ prītisantoṣaśabdayoḥ paryāyatvāt tṛptiprītiśabdayorarthabhede tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorarthabhedaḥ siddha eveti bhāvena tatparyāyatve pramāṇamāha || santoṣa iti || paryāyavācakāḥ paryāyeṣa vācakāḥ || 17 || 18 || nanu muktasya kāryaṃ na vidyata itvaktvā " tasmādasaktaḥ " ityucyate | tatra karmakaraṇe hetoranuktatvāt " tasmāt " iti kiṃ parāmṛśyata ityata āha || yasmāditi || yathā muktasya prayojanābhāvātkāryābhāvaḥ evaṃ mumukṣorapi karmaṇā prayojanābhāvātkāryābhāvaḥ kiṃ na syādityata ucyate || asakta iti || tatra karmaṇaiva mokṣaprāptirucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tadvyācaṣṭe || asakta iti || karma'carannevetyevārtho na tu karmaivāttaranniti bhāvaḥ | tasmādamuktasya karmaṇā phalasadbhāvādastyeva tasya kāryamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ | nanvamuktasya kāryamastītyanuktatvātkathaṃ tasmāditi tatparāmarśaḥ syāditi cenna | muktasyaiva kāryaṃ nāstītyuktyā'muktasya kārayamastīti prāptatvāt | nanu muktasyaiva kāryaṃ nāstītyevakārābhāvāt kathamamuktasya kāryasadbhāvaprāpitirityata āha || muktasyaiveti || evakārābhāve'pi tadarthāvadhāraṇasya tuśabdenāvagatatvāt tenāmuktasya kāryasadbhāvaḥ prāpyata iti bhāvaḥ | kecittu " yastu " iti vākyaṃ jñānimātraviṣayatayā vyākurvate | na tadyuktam | " yastvevātmarato mukto " " viṣṇuprasādādratimān " ityādismṛtyā muktiviṣayatayā gṛhītatvāt jñānināmapi kāryasadbhāvasyoktatvāccetyabhipretya doṣāntaraṃ āha || tasmāditi || yadyatra jñānimātrasya kāryābhāvo'bhipretaḥ syāttarhyarjunaṃ prati " tasmādasaktaḥ " ityuparaṃhāravākye karmavidhānaṃ viruddhaṃ syāt | tasyāpi jñānitvāditi bhāvaḥ | arjunasya jñānitve pramāṇābhāvenājñatvāt karmādhikāritvamevātastaṃ prati karmavidhānaṃ na viruddhamityata āha || brahmeti || ye teṣāmiti yojyam | muktaviṣayatve'pyasyārjunaṃ prati karmavidhānaṃ viruddham | pāṇḍavānāmetadvacanabalāt brahmaratatvādimuktalakṣaṇavattayā muktasāmyādityata āha || ātmeti || na pāṇḍavānāṃ muktānāṃ cātisāmyam | " ātmaratireva " iti muktānāmarativyāvartaivaśabdena pāṇḍavebhyo viśeṣa ityata āha || eṣāmiti || 19 || nanu jñānādeva mokṣasiddheḥ kathamasaktaḥ karmā'caranneva paramāpnotītyaktamityata ucyate || karmaṇaiveti || tatra karmaṇaiva mokṣa ucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tatsamṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || sahaiveti || kāryaṃ karma jñānināmapīti śeṣaḥ | karma kartavyamityatra hetvantaramucyate || loketi || tatra lokasaṅgrasambhave'pi tena prayojanābhāvātkathaṃ jñānino lokasaṅgrahārthaṃ karma vidhīyata ityato loketyādiślokān smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || ajñānamiti || sā tuṣṭiḥ || 20 || 21 || kiñca prayojanamātrarahitenāpi mayā kevalānugraheṇa lokasaṅgrahārthaṃ karma kriyate, ato muktāvānandavṛddhiprayojanavatā jñāninā tatkartavyamiti kiṃ vaktavyamityuktaṃ " na me pārtha " iti | asyārtho mamaiveti || asyārtho mamaiveti || nanvīśvaraḥ prayojanābhāve'pi lokarakṣādi karotīti na yujyate | prayojanābhāve pravṛttyayogādityāśaṃkāṃ śrutyaiva pariharati || rakṣayeti || prayojanābhāve'pīśvarasya kartṛtvasvabhāvavattvāt rakṣādikarmakaraṇaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | nanu tādṛśasvabhāvatvena pravṛttiracetaneṣveva dṛṣṭā | yathā dahanapavanādīnāṃ prayojanaṃ vinā svabhāvādeva dahanagamanādipravṛttiḥ | cetanapravṛtteḥ prayojanahīnāyā adarśanātkathamīśvarasyāpi prayojanānuddeśena pravṛttirityata āha || matta iti || 22 -26 || ajñavadāgraheṇa jñānināmapi karama kāryaṃ cedvidvadavidvatkarmaṇoraviśeṣaprasaṅga ityataḥ " saktāḥ " iti saktyasaktipūrvakatvaviśeṣa uktaḥ prapañcyate " prakṛteriti " | vidvadavidvatkarmaviśeṣamuktyavā vidvatkarmakaraṇaṃ vidhīyate " mayi " iti | tatra karmāṇi saṃnyasya yudhyasveti vyāhatamityataḥ tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || nāhamiti || " nāhaṃ kartā " iti nirmamatvam | " hariḥ kartā tatpūjā karma cākhilam " iti harau karmanyāsaḥ | harireva kartā cetkathaṃ tatpūjetyādinirūpaṇaṃ yuktamityata āha || tathāpīti || yadyapi harireva kartā, tathāpi tatpreraṇenaiva mamāpi kartṛtvāt tatpūjetyādinirūpaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | tadbhaktiriti nirāśīstvam | tatphalaṃ pūjāphalam | karmanyāso nirmamatvādiyuktaḥ viṣṇostṛptikara ityanena " ye me katam " ityādestātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | evaṃ nirmamatvādiyuktena harau karmanyāsena kuto viṣṇostṛptirityata āha || yasmāditi || yasmādevamarthasthitiḥ tasmāttathā bhāvanaṃ viṣṇostṛptikaraṃ bhavatyeva | yathārthajñānapriyatvādviṣṇoriti bhāvaḥ | svatantrakartṛtvameva kartṛtvam, ataḥ kathaṃ jīvādeḥ kartṛtocyata ityataḥ paratantrādikartari kartṛśabdaprayogaṃ darśayati || pumīniti || nanu kvacidīśvara eva kartā na jīvādirityucyate | kvacijjīva eva kartā neśvarādiriti | kvacicca prakṛtireva kartrī neśvarādiriti | ataḥ kathamīśvara eva kartā, nāham, ahaṃ tu tadadhīnakarteti karmanyāsādyupapadyata ityata āha || itīti || yatreśvarādīnāṃ kartṛtvamucyatate tatreśvarasya svatantrakartṛtvamityādi vibhāgenaiva jñātavyam | yatreśvarādīnāmakartṛtvamucyate tatreśvarasya paratantrakartṛtvamasvakīyaṃ nāstītyādi vibhāgenaiva jñātasyaṃ, na tu yatra kartṛtvamucyate tatra sarveṣāṃ svatantrakartṛtvameva | yatrākartṛtvamucyate tatra sarveṣāṃ sarvathā kartṛtvarāhityaṃ jñātavyam | svatantrakartṛtvaṃ viṣṇorevetyādivacanādevetyarthaḥ | " prakṛteḥ " ityādi vyākariṣyan tatrasthaprakṛtiśabdādīn svabhāvādiparatayā vyākhyātuṃ tadarthatve pramāṇaṃ tāvadāha || kvaciditi || svabhāvo jīvasya | mayītyādivākyavyākhyānarūpāyā " yasmātsvatantrakartṛtvam " ityādismṛteḥ " prakṛteḥ " ityādivākyavyākhyānopayogitvāt vyātyāsena vyākhyānam | prakṛterityādāvīśvarāditrayasya kartṛtvābhidhānāt punarjīvasyākartṛtvābhidhānāt kartṛtvādivibhāgasya smṛtāvuktatvāt prakṛterityādyanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || svabhāvata iti || atra " svabhāvataḥ " ityādi sākṣādvyākhyānāya pīṭhīkāracanam | devādīnāmanyathābhāvasadbhāvātkathaṃ devatvādiḥ svabhāva ityata āha || naiṣāmiti || jayādīnāmanyathābhāvadarśanātkathaṃ nāstītyata āha || śarīreti || devatvādeḥ svābhāvikatve'pi devā evottamā ityādi kuta ityata āha || uttamā iti || phalasyottamatvādinā devādīnāmuttamatvādisiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | devādīnāṃ muktyādiyogyatve kimarthaṃ te saṃsāre vartanta ityata āha || prāptiriti || svayogyaphalasyeti śeṣaḥ | pūrtayabhāvena sādhanasyeti śeṣaḥ | sādhanapūrtitaḥ prāptiścet nityaṃ saṃsārānuvṛttirna syāti | anāditvāt saṃsārasyetaḥ pūrvameva sādhanapūrtisambhavena sarvacetanānāṃ parisamāpterityata āha || naiveti || nityakāle saṃsāro'nuvartatāmiti harīcchayā anādimān yadyapīti śeṣaḥ | svabhāvatastridhā jīvāścet kiṃ tata ityata āha || ata iti || devatvādeḥ svābhāvikatvāttadanusāriguṇāśca svābhāvikā ityarthaḥ miśritāḥ svābhāvikā ityādi yojyam | tataśca kimityata āha || kāryata iti || avaśo viṣṇuvaśaḥ | prākṛtaiḥ svābhāvikaiḥ | kiñcāta ityata jñāha || svābhāviketi || anenāvidvatkarmābhidhāyakasya " prakṛteḥ " ityasyārtha ukto bhavati || svābhāvikaguṇān hetuṃ kṛtveti || yasyottamaguṇāstānapekṣya satkarma kārayatītyādi | viṣṇunā viṣṇoricchādiguṇaiḥ | anena prakṛterguṇairityasyārthadvayamuktaṃ bhavati | upādānatayā sattvādayaḥ prakṛtiguṇāścātrabhimatāḥ | kartā svātantryeṇeti śeṣaḥ | evamavidvān karoti cot kathaṃ vidvānityata āha || tattveti || anena tattvavidityasyārtha ukto bhavati | aviduṣāmahaṅ‌kāre ko heturityata āha || svabhāveti || svabhāvaguṇānāmuttamatve teṣvaparapreritā evaita iti saṃmūḍhāḥ | miśrāditve taiḥ saṃmūḍhāḥ | jñānādiguṇasadbhāve jñānādiguṇavattaraṃ svātantryeṇa pratijānata iti yojyam | abhāve sa eva doṣaḥ | tān guṇān viṣṇvadhīnānna viduḥ sadbhāve | abhāve na santīti na viduriti jñeyam | te jñāninā bodhyantāmityata āha || teṣviti || ayogyāścenna prakāśayet, anyathā parīkṣya prakāśayediti bhāvaḥ | avyaktikṛditi || svavacanaṃ yathā tattvavyakitikṛnna bhavettathetyarthaḥ | anena prakṛteriti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | mandānityasyārtho'yogyeṣviti | ayogyeṣu tattvaṃ kuto na vaktavyamityata āha || buddhveti || manonigrahe svabhāvānugataceṣṭoparatiḥ syādityata āha || svabhāvamiti || etena sadṛśamiti vyākhyānaṃ bhavati || 35 || " tayorna vaśamāgacchet " ityukte pṛcchyate " atha " iti | tatra " prakṛteḥ " ityādau bhagavataḥ prerakatvasyoktatvāt, svayaṃ devatvena devānāṃ ca kathitatvāt siddhapraśno'yamityata āha || parameśvarāditi || arvāktanaṃ balavantamiti śeṣaḥ | praśnavākye naitaducyata āha || atheti || ānantaryavācinā'thaśabdena parameśvarāddevebhyaścānantaramityartho jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ || 36 || " kāma eṣaḥ " ityādiparihāravākyamuktārthe'pi saṃvādarūpasmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || akhileti || tatreti " kāmaḥ " ityasya vyākhyānam | kāmaḥ prabala iti yojyam | " aśubheṣu " ityanenaiva " vairiṇam " ityetadvyākhyātaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ kāmo'śubhaprerakeṣu prabala ityata āha sarvamiti || agnyādarśamarbhān yathā dhūmādyāvṛṇoti tathetvarthaḥ || kramāditi || śubhajanaṃ dhūmo'gnimiva kiñcidāvṛṇotītyādi draṣṭavyam | kāmaśca tadapekṣitaṃ dattvā jetavya ityata āha || mahāśanasyeti || mahadapi dīyatāmityata āha || tasyeti || anena " dhūmena " ityādi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tarhi kathaṃ jetavya ityatastadadhiṣṭhānaṃ tāvadāha || bhuñjāna iti || etena " indriyāṇi " ityasyārtha ukto bhavati | astvidamadhiṣṭhānaṃ, kimāyudhaṃ tadvadhāyetyata āha || jñāneti || anena " indriyāṇi " ityādestātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | nanu " dhūmena " iti kāmasya sarvāvaraṇatvamuktaṃ, tatpunaḥ kimartham " āvṛtaṃ " ityucyata ityata āha || jñāneti || pūrvaṃ jñānotpattipratibandhakatvenā'varaṇatvaṃ kāmasyoktam, idānīṃ tūtpannajñānasyāparokṣajñānasādhanatvapratibandhakatāyā''varaṇatvamucyate | ato na paunaruktyāmiti bhāvaḥ | " duṣpūreṇānalena " iti punaruktamityata āha || na kevalamiti || kāmo nālamiti manyate ceti kuta ityata āha || agneriti || 37 -41 || " indriyāṇi " mano buddhiḥ " ityādinā indriyamanobuddhīnāmuktaṃ prapañcyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || sarvebhya iti || sarvebhyo'rthādyabhimānibhyaḥ | " tato brahmā " ityādi tu " buddherātmā mahān paraḥ | mahataḥ paramavyaktam asyaktāt puruṣaḥ paraḥ | puruṣānna paraṃ kiñcit " iti śrutivyākhyānam | paramātmano'tra buddhiparatvamātroktāvapyanyatroktamatra saṃyojyamiti jñāpayitumudāhṛtam | yaduktamarthābhimānibhyo'pūndriyābhimānināmuttamatvaṃ na tadyuktam | " indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthāḥ " iti śrutivirodhāt | nāpi rudrasya mano'bhimānitvaṃ yuktam | " rudro'haṅ‌kṛtirūpakaḥ " iti vākyavirodhāt | evaṃ sarasvatyā buddhyabhimānitvaṃ ca na yuktam | vijñānābhimānitvoktivirodhādityata āha || na ceti || kuto na virodha ityata āha || sarveti || tarhi śrīravyaktasya, brahmā mahata ityādipṛthagabhimanyamānasthānoktiḥ lakṣmyādīnāṃ śāstreṣu kathamityata āha || uttareti || avyaktādīnāṃ krameṇādhikatvāt tadabhimānitvoktatyābhimānināmapyuttarottarādhikyaṃ jñāpayituṃ pṛthagabhimanyamānasthānānyucyanta ityarthaḥ | kimarthamuttarottarādhikyaṃ jñāpyamityata āha || ādhikyeti || sarve'pi sarvābhimānina ityuktasyāpavādamāha || sthāneṣviti || adhamānāmukteṣvabhimanyamānasthāneṣvabhimānitvenottamā vartante | na tūttamābhumanyamānatvenoktasthāneṣvadhamā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ cedavyāktābhimānitvaṃ sarasvatyādīnāṃ purāṇādau kathamucyata ityata āha || tathāpīti || upacaryate, yasmāditi śeṣaḥ | atira śrutiṃ cāha || yatreti || yasmin vastuni putrasya svāmyamasti tasmin vastuni pituḥ svāmyamastyeva | yasmin vastuni pituḥ svāmyamasti tasmin putrasya svāmyamupacāreṇāstītyetat tatra āpā iti codye samādhānamuktaṃ bhavatītyaktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | anenendrādibhya indriyābhimānibhyo'dhamānāṃ uttamānāṃ sauparṇyādīnāṃ cārthābhimānitvātsauparṇyādivivakṣayā indriyobhyo'rthānāmuttamātvaṃ śrutirāha | idaṃ tu vākyaṃ śivasutavivakṣayā'rthebhya indriyāṇāmuttamatvaṃ vaktītyavirodhaḥ | rudrādīnāṃ ca mano'haṅ‌kārādyabhimānitvādubhayokteravirodha ityuktaṃ bhavati | nanu sarve'pi sarvābhimāninaścedavyaktādiśabdārthanirṇayo na yujyate | sarveṣāmapyarthatayā'nyatarāpohānupapatterityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva
