jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || uktārthasaṅgatatvena etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || uktayoriti || jñānakarmaṇormadhye'nyatarasyeti pratītinirāsāya ubhayorityuktam | karmaṇo'tītādhyāye vivṛtatvāt kimanenetyato viśeṣetyuktam | uktakarmayoge rucijananāya pūrvānuṣṭhito'yaṃ dharma ityucyate " imamiti " tattātparyaṃ smṛtyaivāha || brahmeti || gītā pañcarātrasaṅkṣepaścettarhi tasyāḥ sarvottamaśāstratvahānirityataḥ śabdata eva saṃkṣelo sārthata ityāha || yatheti || sarvapañcarātrārthatve gītāyāḥ pañcarātrādadhamatvamātraṃ māstu | tāvatā sarvaśāstrottamatvaṃ kathamityata āha || vedeti || sarvaśāstrebhyo'tiśayena vedārthapūrakapañcarātrāśeṣārthatvena gītāyāḥ sarvaśāstrottamatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 1 || 3 || idānīntanatvādbhagavato vivasvataḥ prācīnatvāt kathaṃ tadupadeṣṭratvamiti pṛcchati " aparamiti " | tatrārjunasya bhagavadajñānitvapratīteḥ prāguktānupapattirityata āha || jānanto'pīti || naivaṃ praśnenārjuno bhagavantamanādinityaṃ na jānātīti kalpyam | jānanto'pīti vacanāt praśnasya viśeṣajñānādyarthatvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | sthāpanāya jñātasya dṛḍhīkaraṇāya || 4 || 5 || janmānyatītāni cettarhi na jananamaraṇarāhityaṃ bhavataḥ | tathāca " avināśi tu " ityuktavirodha ityata ucyate " ajo'pi " iti | tatra " ātmamāyayā " ityetadajñānavaśādityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || ātmeti || nātrātmamāyayetyajñānavaśādityucyate | sarvamānavirodhāt | api tu avatāre parapreraṇānivāraṇāya mahāmāyetyādinā māyāpadoditasvecchānibandhanatvamevocyata ityarthaḥ | " prakṛtiṃ svāmadhiṣṭhāya " ityetat prākṛtaśarīralābhenetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyānudya prakṛtipadaṃ vyācaṣṭe || prakṛtimiti || nātra prākṛtaśarīralābho'bhidhīyate | śrutyādivirodhasyoktatvāt | kintu " avatarasi cet prayojanena bhāvyam | tathāca nānavāptamityuktavirodhaḥ " ityāśaṃkāparihārāya prayojanābhāve'pyavatārādikaṃ tādṛśasvabhāvatvādyujyata ityevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | bhavedayamartho yadi hareravatārādi prayojanaṃ vinā svabhāvādeveti siddhaṃ syāttadeva kuta ityata āha || devasyeti || sa svabhāvaśca ayaṃ deva eva na tu tato bhinna ityarthaḥ | astu viṣṇoḥ svabhāvādeva vyāpāraḥ | tathāpyatra prakṛtipadaṃ kutaḥ svabhāvavācītyata āha || ata eveti || yato'tra prakṛtipadaṃ sāvabhāvavācyata eva svāmiti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayuktam | kevalamanyārthatve svādhīnatvasya mametyasādhāraṇaśabdenābhidhānaṃ vinobhayasādhāraṇametanna syādityarthaḥ | etameva nyāyamasyatrāpyatidiśati || prakṛtimiti || ityādiṣu ca svaśabdena viśeṣaṇamata evetyarthaḥ | yadi prakṛtipadaṃ svabhāvavāci tarhi " mayā'dhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ " , " prakṛtiṃ viddhi " ityatrāpi kiṃ svabhāvavācītyapekṣāyāmāha || mayeti || ataḥ svabhāvādanyaiva tatra prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ | anyatve hetvantaraṃ cāha || prakṛtimiti || atrā'dipadena " mayā " ityasya saṅgrahaḥ | " mayā'dhyakṣeṇa " ityatrādhīnatyā sambandhitvapratīteḥ " prakṛtiṃ " ityatra " me " iti ṣṭhyā sambandhitvapratīteśceti yojyam | sambandhitvena pratīteranyā cedatrāpi svāmiti sambandhitvena pratīteranyā syādityata āha || atreti || bhavedidaṃ yadi svaśabdaḥ sambandhasavācyeva syāt | na caivam | atra svaśabdasya mukhyataḥ svarūpavācitvāditi | bādhakābhāvat svarūpavācyeva na tu sambandhavācīti bhāvaḥ | svaśabdasya svarūpavācitvaṃ kutra dṛṣṭamityataḥ svabhāvapadagatasvaśabdasya tadṛṣṭamiti bhāvenāha || svabhāva iti || svabhāvapadagatasvaśabdasya sveti śabdasyānyatvamātrāpādane nāniṣṭam | arthadvayāṅgīkārāt | anyaivetyāpādanamayuktam | svaśabdasya svarūpavācitvasyāpi bhāvena " me " itivaditarāvyāvartakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | svabhāvapadagatasvaśabdasya svarūpavācitve tenaiva pūrteḥ bhāvaśabdo vyartha ityata āha || bhāveti || yadi svaśabdamātraṃ prayujye tadā svaśabdasya svīyo'pi prayogāt tadāśaṃkā syāt | tāṃ nivārayituṃ bhāvaśabdaḥ prayujyate | bhāvaśabdayuktasvaśabdasya svarūpa eva pratītijanakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvatra prakṛtipadaṃ svabhāvavācakaṃ cettarhi prakṛtimityukte svasvabhāvamityuktaṃ bhavati | svaśabdadvayaṃ ca svarūpavācītyuktam | tathāca punaruktirityata āha || svati || yathā asvarūpe'pyupacāreṇa svarūpapadapravṛttestatpariharāya svasvarūpamityucyate | na ca tatra svarūpavācisvaśabdadvayasadbhāve'pi punaruktidoṣaḥ | evamasvabhāve'pyupacāreṇa svabhāvapadapravṛttestadāśaṃkānivāraṇāya svasvabhāva ityucyate | ato na punaruktidoṣa ityarthaḥ | ajo'pīti ślokatrayaṃ śrutyaiva vyācaṣṭe || 6 || 7 || 8 || evaṃ svabhāvādevāvatārādivyāpāramuktvā tajjñānaphalamucyate "janmeti " | tatreśvarajanmakarmajñānamātreṇa mokṣo bhavatītyanyathāpratītiṃ nirācaṣṭe || yeṣāmiti || samuccayādeva bhavatīti jñātavyamiti śeṣaḥ | śamādīnāṃ samuccayādeva jñānaṃ bhavatīti jñātavyam | pṛthak‌pṛthagjñānasādhanatvoktāvapītyarthaḥ | ukto grāhya iti śeṣaḥ || 9 || etajjñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ kuta ityata ucyate "vīteti " | tatra "manmayāḥ ", "madbhāvamāgatāḥ " ityetadanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mayamiti || yadyapi bhagavān pradhāno yeṣāṃ te bhagavanmayā iti sākṣādarthaḥ tathāpi sarveṣāṃ bhagavān pradhāno bhavati | jñānināṃ ko viśeṣa ityataḥ "prādhānyaṃ yairharermatam " ityuktam | "madbhāvamāgatāḥ "ityasyārtha "te mucyante " iti | madbhāvapadaṃ kathaṃ mokṣavācakamityata āha || mayīti || mayi bhāvaḥ sāyujyādiḥ || 10 || traividyānāmapi mokṣasadbhāvāt ko viśeṣastvāmupāśritānāmityata ucyate "iti | tatra namantaṃ namatītyādyanyathāpratītinirāsāyā'ha || tathaiveti || na jñānināṃ traividyānāṃ ca phalasāmyam | sevānusāreṇaiva mama phaladatvāt | sevāyāśca vaiṣamyāditi bhāvaḥ | traividyānāmanyadevatāyājitvāt kathamucyate tāṃ prapadyanta itītyato devatā yajanto yadi karmaṇāṃ siddhimākāṅkṣanto bhavanti tarhi mama vartmānuvartanta eva | anyathā karmaphalābhāvādityucyate "mama "iti | tatra traividyā api cedbhagavadvartmānuvartante tarha bhāgavatatraividyabhedo na syādityataḥ ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || anyeti || matsamarpaṇena anta iti śeṣaḥ | atra smṛtisaṃmatiṃ cāha || anyeti || 11 || 12 || bhagavadbhajanaṃ vinā kuto na phalamityatastasya pitṛtvādyujyata ityucyate "cāturvaṇyaṃ " iti | atra guṇānāṃ tritvāt kathaṃ cāturvarṇyasya guṇavibhāga ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || sattveti || rājananāttvikeṣu sāttviko brāhmaṇaḥ | sattvamadhikaṃ yato rajasastadvān kṣatriyaḥ | samasattvarajovān vaiśyaḥ | sajopekṣayā'dhikatamovān śūdra ityarthaḥ | anena sattvapradhānatvaṃ brāhmaṇādīnāmuktam | tasyāpavādamāha || sāttvikā eveti || vaiṣṇavā eva sāttvikāḥ sattvapradhānāḥ | na brāhmaṇatvādiprayuktaṃ sāttvikatvādītyarthaḥ | karmavibhāgaḥ kīdṛśa ityata āha || karmeti || yadi vaiṣṇavā eva sāttvikāstarhi brāhmaṇāḥ sāttvikāḥ ityādyuktiḥ kiṃnimittetyāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharita || vaiṣṇavā iti || apare dveṣiṇaḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ śūdrādiṣu daurlabhyāt brāhmaṇā eva sāttvikā ityādirūpeṇa sāttvikatvādīnāṃ varṇāśramabhedena bhinnatocyata ityarthaḥ | yathā sāttvikatvādikaṃ na varṇāmātralakṣaṇaṃ tathā śamādikamapi na varṇamātralakṣaṇam | kintu svābhāvikavarṇalakṣaṇamityat smṛtimāha || svābhāvika iti || nanvasvābhāvikaṃ brāhmaṇatvādikaṃ kīdṛśamityata āha || yonīti || ayamiti prasiddhaḥ | svābhāvikabrāhmaṇasyaiva śamādikam | svābhāvikakṣatriyasyaiva śauryādītyādyuktam | tatrāpavādamāha || viṣṇviti || śamapadoditā viṣṇubhaktiḥ na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇasyaiva, api tu sarvavarṇeṣvanugatetyarthaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | damādikamapyevaṃ draṣṭavyam | kṣatriye śamavati rāṣṭraviplavaḥ syādityato nāyaṃ śamaḥ prasiddhaḥ | api tu viṣṇubhaktiriti śama iti vaktavye tadartha evoktaḥ | śamādīnāṃ kṣatriyādiṣvapi sadbhāve kathamayaṃ brāhmaṇo'yaṃ neti svābhāvikavarṇabhedajñānamityata āha || viśvapatimiti || brāhmaṇe śamādīnāṃ bāhulyāt kṣatriyādiṣu krameṇābahulatvāt śamādīnāṃ bāhulyābāhulyato'yaṃ brāhmaṇo'yaṃ neti svābhāviko varṇabhedo jñātavya ityarthaḥ | yathā bhavān sarvasca kartā evaṃ bhavato'pyanyaḥ kartā'sti kimityapekṣāyāmucyate "tasyeti " | tatra kartāramapyakartāraṃ viddhi, kartṛtvasya māyikatvādityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || karteti || evaṃvidhakartṛtvākartṛtvayoraviruddhatvāt kartāramapyakartāraṃ viddhītyatrāpiśabdo vyartha ityata āha || apīti || tatprakāraṃ darśayati || karteti || 13 || sarvakartṛtve bhagavataḥ karmalepaḥ syādityata ucyate "na māmiti " | tatra māmityasya siddhatvāt "iti mām " iti punarasmacchabdaḥ kimartha ityata āha || jīveti || svasyeśvarābhedābhiprāyeṇa svātmānamuddiśya "na māṃ karmāṇi lampanti " ityādi yo jānātītyanyathapratītiḥ syāt | tannirākaraṇārtham iti māṃ yo'bhijānāti, na svātmānamiti bhāvena māmiti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayuktamityarthaḥ || 13 -16 || "tatte karma pravakṣyāmi " iti pratijñātamucyate "karmaṇaḥ " iti | taddavargamārthatvādvyācaṣṭe || karmeti|| matta eva bhavatīti boddhavyam | asamānapadasthasya rephottarasya nasya ṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ "brahma ṇa indra upayāhi vidvān " ityādau | ādipadena "boddhavyaṃ ca " ityāderapi pūrvavadyojanāṃ sūcayati || 17 || etadbodhanaṃ stūyate "karmaṇi " iti | tatra pūrvārdhaṃ durgamārthatvādvyācaṣṭe || karmaṇīti || karmavidhiphalayorabhāvāt akarmetyanena tadbhāvājjīvaḥ karmeti sūcitam | jīveśvarayorevaṃ vyutpattyā vyutpattyā karmākarmapadavācyatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || kara iti || amitatvādaviṣayīkṛtatvādityarthaḥ | ko'yaṃ karo nāmetyata āha || kara iti || karaśabdasya hastādivācitvameva dṛṣṭaṃ, nāgṛṣṭādivācitvamityata uktam | sakārānta iti || hantādivācino'yaṃ sakārānto'nya eveti bhāvaḥ | karmavidhivācī ceti draṣṭavyam | ata eva karmavidhītyādyuktam | anena vidhiśabdenāmitvam akarmapadena kathamucyata iti parāstam | akartari jīve kathaṃ karo mīyata ityata āha || taditi || nākartari kriyādarśanaṃ viruddhaṃ, svātantryeṇākartṛtve'pi bhagavadadhīnakartṛtvāditi bhāvaḥ | ata eva pūrvamasvātantryādityādyuktam | karmaśabdasya jīve vidvadrūḍhiṃ ca dśayati || prasiddhaśceti || nanu jñāninaḥ svātantryeṇa pāratantryeṇa vā kṛtsnakarmākaraṇāt kathaṃ kṛtsnakarmakṛttvamucyata ityata āha || kṛtsneti || svayogyāśeṣakarmaphalamokṣasya niyatatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 18 || na kevalaṃ kartṛtvābhimānaparityāgena kṛtsnakarmakṛttvādi | api tu kāmādiparityāgenāpi bhāvyamityucyate -- yasyetyādiślokapañcakena | tatra nirāśraya ityanyathā padavibhāgapratītinirāsāyāha || anirāśraya iti || pratītaprakāreṇaiva padavibhāgaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || bhagavaditi || jñānino'pi bhagavadāśrayatvena "ajñānāṃ caiva " ityādāvuktatvāt nirāśrayatvānupapatterna pratītaprakāreṇa padavibhāga ityarthaḥ | nanvatra jñāninaḥ śarīrasambandhasadbhāvāt kathaṃ muktatvamucyata ityata āha || muktasyeti || 19 -23 || nanu kutra svātantryābhimānatyāgo vivakṣitaḥ? kiñca yajñarthatvamiti pṛcchati "kathamiti " | tatparihārāyottarapraghaṭṭakamavatārayati || brahmeti || atrārpaṇādīnāṃ brahmaikyamucyate, nābhimānaparityāgaprakāra ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || brahmaṇīti || pratītārtha eva kiṃ na syādityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || eka iti || anena havirādiṣu svasya svātantryamanirūpya brahmādhīnatāṃ jñātvā homādikaraṇaṃ svātantryābhimānaparityāgaḥ | brahmārpaṇaṃ tu yajñārthatvamityuktaṃ bhavati || 24 || tatprapañcyate "daivam " ityādinā || tatra pūrvārdhe kasyaciddevasyopāsanamevocyate na tu brahmārphaṇabuddhyā yajanam | ato nāyamardhaḥ pūrvasaṅgata ityata āha || daivamiti || bhagavantaṃ yajña ityupāsata ityanena bhagavāneva yajñaḥ tasya tathopāsanameva yajñakaraṇamityuktaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ bhagavato yajñatvam? yena tathopāsanaṃ yajñakaraṇaṃ syādityata āha || sveti || svarūpamevānandādihaviḥ svayamevāgnirbhagavān bhuṅkte, ato'yaṃ yajña ityarthaḥ | "brahmāgnau " ityetaddurgamārthatvāt pūrvasaṅgatatvena vyācaṣṭe || brahmeti || yajñākhyenetyasya sarvaṃ tadadhīnaṃ jñātvetyarthaḥ || 25 || nanu "śrotrādīni " ityādau śrotrādihaviṣaḥ saṃyamākhyāgnyādau homa evocyate, na tu tasya brahmarpaṇam | ato naitatpūrvasaṅgatamityata āha || taditi || atrāpi brahmārpaṇasya "evaṃ bahuvidhāḥ " iti vakṣyamāṇaparyālocanayā vivakṣitatvāvagamāt nāsaṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ || 26 || || indriyādisaṃyamamiti || karmendriyāṇāṃ prāṇāpānādīnāṃ ca saṃyamamityarthaḥ | nanvatra kriyāyajña eva yajñenaivetyabhimānatyāgokteḥ kathaṃ daivamityādi pūrvasaṅgatamityata āha || yajñenaiveti || svayameva yajña ityādyapūrvārtho'yaṃ kuta ityata āha tenaiveti || 27 -31 || "brahmaṇo mukhe " ityasya vedādāvityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || śrotreti || iti śaṃkā syāt tāmiti śeṣaḥ | pratīta evarthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata uktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || sarveti || 32 || dravyamayādyajñāt jñānayajñasyottamatve heturucyate " sarvamiti " | tatra sarvākhilaśabdayorekārthatvapratīteḥ jñānānantaraṃ karma nāstīnyathāpratīteśca nirāsāyāha || sarvamiti || pūryate saphalaṃ bhavatītyāśayaḥ | samāptiśabdasya pūrtivācitvādarśanāt kathamatra lūrtavācitvamityata āha || samāpteti || dhanurvidyāviṣaye sampūrṇavidyān kṛṣṇasātyakiyuktapañcayavacanam | astu pūrtāvapi samāptiśabdaprayogaḥ | tathāpyatra pūrtivācitvaṃ kutaḥ? pratītārtha eva kiṃ na syādityata āha || jñāneti || punaryogakathanāt jñānānantaramapi karmānuṣṭhānakathanāt || 33 || jñānasya karmaṇo'dhikatvamuktvā tadāpādanaṃ vidhīyate "taditi " tatra svayaṃ jñānopadeśāyaiva pravṛttatvāt "na tvevāham " iti jñānasyopadiṣṭatvācca katham "upadekṣyanti te jñānam " ityucyata ityata āha || jñānamiti || upadekṣyantīti niścitatvābhiprāyeṇa | parokṣatayopadekṣyāma ityevocyamānatvāt na jñānopadeśārthaṃ pravṛttatvavirodhaḥ | na ca jñānasyopadiṣṭatvavirodhaḥ saṅkṣepeṇopadiṣṭatve'pi "jñānaṃ te'haṃ " ityādinā punarupadekṣyamāṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 34 || jñānaṃ stūyate "yat iti | tatra svasmin, mayi cetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || ātmanīti || īśvaramantareṇa sarvabhūtādhāratvasyānyatrānupapatterna pratīta evārtha ityarthaḥ | evaṃ cet "atho " iti samuccayavācī śabdo vyartha ityata āha || atho iti || 35 -40 || jñānaphalamucyate "yoga " iti | tatra "ātmavantaṃ " ityātmā jīvaścet svasambandhoktirayuktā'nupayuktā ca | paramātmā cetsarveṣāmapi tadvattvasāmyāt ko viśeṣo jñānina ityata āha || ātmeti || 41 -43 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || hariḥ oṃ || etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || yogeti || pūrvaṃ samuccitaḥ karmayogo nirūpitaḥ | saca yogasaṃnyāsabhedena dvividhaḥ | dvividhayośca svarūpaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa "kuru karmaṇi ", "saṅgaṃ tyaktvā " ityādāvuktam | tadevānenādhyāyena spaṣṭayatītyarthaḥ | praśnavākyaṃ sābhiprāyamavatārayati || yogeti || "yogasaṃnyastakarmāṇam " ityādau paṭhito nyāsaśabdo yatyāśramaviṣayo "yogamātiṣṭha " ityādau śruto yogaśabdo gṛhasthāśramaviṣaya iti kalpayitvā yatīnāṃ sarvakarmatyāgena jñānamātrādhikāritvāt gṛhiṇāṃ jñānaparityāgena karmamātrādhikāritvāt tayorekapunniṣṭhatvaṃ na yujyata iti bhāvena yogasaṃnyāsayormadhye śreyaḥ pṛcchati | ubhayasyāpi kartavyatayā vihitatvādekenaivānuṣṭhātumaśakyatvāt anyataraparityāgenānyataragrahaṇe śreyasa eva grāhyatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 1 || nanu yogasaṃnyāsayormadhye śreyomātra evāyaṃ praśno, na tūktarītyā virodhābhiprāyeṇa | tathātve parihārābhāvādityataḥ parihāravākyābhiprāyamāha || eketi || ubhayorekapuṃyogyatvāt niḥśreyasakaratvācca anuṣṭheyatvādanyatarasya śreṣṭhatve praśno vyartha eva | atha svarūpajñānamātrārthaḥ praśnaścedyoga eva viśiṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ | yogasaṃnyāsayorekapuṃyogyatvābhidhāyakaṃ padamatra na śrūyata ityatastatpaṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe || ubhāviti || dvāvapi pratyekaṃ śreyaskarāvityarthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || saṃnyāsastviti || yogarahitasaṃnyāsasya anarthakaratvokteḥ saṃnyāsarahitayogasyaivāsambhavāt samuccitayoreva niḥśreyasakaratvamucyate na pratyekamiti bhāvaḥ || 2 || kathaṃ yogasaṃnyāsayoḥ samuccayo yujyate? yatigṛsthayoradhikārabhedādityāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokamavatārayati || dveṣādīti || atra "saṃnyastakarmāṇam " ityādau | evaṃ "yogamātiṣṭha "ityādau bhagavadarpaṇādīyoga evābhipreto na gṛhasthāśrama ityapi draṣṭavyam | nanu kathaṃ dveṣādivarjanasya saṃnyāsatvamatrocyate? "kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ " iti kāmyakarmaparityāgasya saṃnyāsatvābhidhāyakavākyavirodhādityata āha || na ceti || bhavettadvirodho yadyatra dveṣādivarjanamātraṃ saṃnyāsatvena vivakṣitaṃ syāt | naitadasti | kāmyakarmaparityāgenāpi sahitasya dveṣādivarjanasya saṃnyāsatvenābhipretatvādityarthaḥ | kathamatra kāṅkṣādivarjanasya saṃnyāsatvamucyate? "sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ " iti tasya tyāgatvenoktatvāt | na ca saṃnyāsatyāgayoraikyādavirodhaḥ | "kāmyānāṃ " iti śloke nyāsāttyāgasya pṛthaktvenoktestadvirodhādityata āha || na ceti || bhavatyevākāṅkṣādivarjanaṃ nyāsaḥ | na ca tasya tyāgatvoktivarodhaḥ | nyāsatyāgayoraikyāt | na ca pṛthaktvoktivirodhaḥ | yathā khalu pāṇḍavānāṃ kurutve'pi "santānabījaṃ kurupāṇḍavānām " iti pṛthaguktiryujyate, pāṇḍavānāṃ kurvavāntarabhedatvena kurupāṇḍavānāṃ sākṣādaikyābhāvāt, evaṃ tyāgasya nyāsatve'pi nyāsāvāntarabhedatvena tyāganyāsayoḥ sākṣādaikyābhāvāt pṛthag vacanopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | nyasādiśabdasya yatyādyāśramārthatvaṃ gṛhītvā tayoradhikārabhedāt samāveśāyogo yaścodito'sau nyāsādiśabdasya tadarthatvānaṅgīkāreṇa parihṛtaḥ || 3 || athāsāvadhikārabhedo'pi na yujyata ityucyate "sāṅkhya "iti | durgamārthatvāt ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || bālā iti || jñānamārgaṃ samyagāsthita eva jñānaphalaṃ prāpnoti | karmakārgaṃ ca samyagāsthita eva karmaphalaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | jñānaikagamyayatiprāpyasthānaprāptisadbhāvācca gṛdiṇāṃ jñānādhikāro'stītyuktvā upasaṃhriyate "yat " iti | tatra " ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ " ityupasaṃhāravākye jñānakarmaṇoraikyaṃ kimarthamucyata ityato yathāvadvyācaṣṭe || tasmāditi || jñānināṃ yatīnāmiti śeṣaḥ | samyakkarmānuṣṭhānenaiva karmī karmaphalaṃ prāpnoti cettathāpi kutastasya jñānamityata āha || na hīti || evaṃ samyagjñānamārgānuṣṭhānainaiva jñānaphalaṃ prāpnoti cettathāpi kuto jñaninaḥ karmeti śaṅ‌kāyāṃ na hi karma vinā jñānamārgastha samyaganuṣṭhānaṃ bhavati | saṃpūrṇaphalasādhanatvābhāvāditi parihāro draṣṭavyaḥ | atra smṛtisammatiṃ cāha || niṣkāmamiti || anena karmiṇāṃ jñānamucyate | " buddhyā " iti jñānasadbhāve hetvantaramāha || etasmāditi || " muktiḥ " ityubhayam | karmiṇāṃ jñānasadbhāvādevetyarthaḥ | anena " yatsāṅkhyaiḥ " iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | ubhayorapi jñānakarmasadbhāve kathamāśramabheda ityata āha || tasmāditi || ubhayorapyubhayasadbhāvasya yuktyādisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | saṅ‌kocavikāsa sambhavaḥ || 4 || 5 || samuccitayoreva yogasaṃnyāsayorniḥśreyasakaratvamuktam | asamuccaye bādhakamucyate " saṃnyāsastu " iti | tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mokṣeti || yoga iti || ucyata iti śeṣaḥ | viṣṇvarpitatayā tadrūpa iti sambandhaḥ | pādatrayam uttarārdhavyākhyātam | " nānyaḥ " iti pūrvārdhasya | tadvivṛṇoti || viṣṇviti || ādipadena svocitakarmaṇāṃ viṣṇvarpaṇādikaṃ na kāryamiti buddhyā kṛto narakaphala iti jñātavyam | " ayogataḥ " iti yogarūpatvaṃ vineti kimarthamucyate | yogaṃ vinetyeva kiṃ na syādityata āha || yamiti || yaṃ saṃnyāsam " iti yogasaṃnyāsayoraikyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt saṃnyāsasya yogarūpatvameva vācyamityarthaḥ | yogasaṃnyāsayoraikye " saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśya " iti pṛthaguktiḥ kathamityata āha || yogeti || yogo nyāsaścetyeka evārthaḥ | api tu nyāso yogāvāntarabhedaḥ | ataḥ kurupāṇḍavavat pṛthaguktirupapannetyarthaḥ || 6 || yogarūpatāṃ vinā nyāsasyānarthasādhanatvamuktvā | " yogayuktaḥ " ityanena yogarūpasaṃnyāsasyoktaṃ mokṣasādhanatvaṃ prapañcyate || yogayukta iti || tatra yogasaṃnyāsayoreva vaktavyatvāt tayośca yogayuktādipadairuktatvāt " sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā " iti kimucyata ityata āha || rarveti || anenāpi yoga evocyata iti nāsaṅgatiḥ | nāpi yogayuktapadena yogasyoktatvādvaiyyarthyam | yogayuktapadena karmayogasyoktatvāt , anena dhyānayogasyoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atrādhikāriṇaḥ sarvabhūtaikyamucyate | ataḥ kathamiyaṃ dhyānayogokitirityucyata ityataḥ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || ādānāditi || bhūtamanāḥ sthitamanāḥ || 7 || yogarūpasaṃnyāsasya mokṣahetutvamuktam | tatra saṃnyāsasya yogarūpatvaṃ kena prakāreṇetyatantatparihāratvena ślokadvayamavatārayati || yatheti || tatrendriyāṇāmeva svatantryeṇa kartṛtvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || viṣṇunati || 8 || 9 || yogarūpasaṃnyāsavato muktirbhavatīti nopacāramātramiti bhāvena punaḥ phalamucyate " brahmaṇi " iti | tatra karmaṇāṃ brahmaṇyādhānaṃ nāmākaraṇamevetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || tatpūjeti || ādhānaṃ karmaṇāmiti śeṣaḥ | anyathā karotītyasya vyāghātāditi bhāvaḥ | bhavatpakṣe'pi yadi karmāṇi bhagavatkṛtāni tarhi jīvasyākatrṛtvaṃ syāt | tathāca karotīti vyāhataṃ syāt | mama śubhārthamiti cāsambhavītyata āha || svātantryeti || karmaṇāṃ bhagavatkṛtatve jīvasyākartṛtvaṃ syāditi satyameva | na ca tāvatā jīvasya kartṛtvaphalasambandhānupapattiḥ | svatantryābhāvavivakṣayaiva akartṛtvasyābhyupagatatvena bhagavadadhīnatayā kartṛtvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | asvatantratve ca jīvasya bhagavatpūjākartṛtvaṃ śubhayogaśca na yujyate | asvatantre kartṛśabdaprayogasya phalasambandhasya cādarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || svavandanamiti || kāritaṃ śiśuneti śeṣaḥ | śiśukartṛkaṃ bhavediti sambandhaḥ || 10 -12 || itaśca karmaṇāṃ brahmaṇyādhānaṃ nāma tatra svasya svātantryābhimānatyāga eva | na tu svarūpaparityāga ityāha || ata iti || " brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi " iti saṃnyāso hyucyeta | tallakṣaṇaṃ ca " sarvakarmāṇi " ityanena prapañcyate | tatra karmaṇāṃ svarūpaparityāgābhāvādeva hi manasaiva tyāgo'bhihitaḥ | ataśca nātrāpi karmaṇāṃ svarūpatyāgo'rtha iti bhāvaḥ | manasaiva tyāgābhidhāne kathaṃ svarūpatyāgābhāva ityaha āha || asvātantryeti || manasaiva karmanyāso nāma svātantryābhimānaparityāga eva | na tu svarūpatyāgaḥ | tathātve manaseti viśeṣaṇavaiyyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ || 10 -13 || yaduktaṃ jīvānāṃ svātantryābhāvāpekṣayaivākartṛtvaṃ, paratantrakartṛtvaṃ tvastyeveti na tadyuktam | " na kartṛtvaṃ " ityuttaravākyavirodhādityata āha || yatheti || svato jīvānāṃ svatantrakartṛtvādyabhāve'pi paramātmadattaṃ tadasti | ataḥ kathaṃ brahmaṇyādhānamucyata ityāśaṃkāmevātra pariharati | na tu jīvānāṃ sarvātmanā kartṛtvābhāvaṃ vaktīti bhāvaḥ | karmaphalasaṃyoge ca svātantryamityapi saṃyojyam | anena " na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi " iti paunaruktyaṃ ca paridṛtam | nanvatra kartṛtvādyabhāva evocyate, na tu tatrāsvātantryam | ataḥ kathamanenaiṣā śaṃkā parihriyata ityata āha kriyāyāmiti || kartṛtvādikaṃ na sṛjatītyasya tatra svātantryaṃ na sṛjatītyevārthaḥ | ato bhavatyetadāśaṃkāparihāra ityarthaḥ | nanvatreśvarasyaiva kartṛtvādyabhāva ucyata iti kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || yadyatreśvarasyaiva kartṛtvādyabhava ucyate tadā lokasya kartṛtvādikaṃ na sṛjatīti vyarthaṃ syādityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ jīvasya pāratantryeṇa kartṛtavādyastīti na tadyuktam | kartṛtvādi īśvaro lokasya na sṛjatītyuktatvāt | na ca tra tasya svātantryaṃ na sṛjatītyarthaḥ | kartṛtvādisadbhāve'pi svātantryāpradānābhiprāyeṇa kartṛtvādikaṃ na sṛjatītyevaṃjātīyaprayogādarśanādityata āha || janapada iti || yadyatra jīvānāṃ sarvātmaneśvarasya ca kartṛtvaṃ na niṣidhyeta tarhi " svabhāvastu pravartate " iti svabhāvadeva pravṛttikathanaṃ na yujyata ityata āha || svayameveti || nātra svabhāvapadena prasiddhasvabhāvo'bhidhīyate | yonoktavirodhaḥ | kintu svasthitāvanyakaraṇe ca paranirapekṣatvādbhagavānevetyarthaḥ | prasiddhapadaparityāgenāprasiddhapadaprayogaḥ kimarthamityato hetusūcanārthamiti bhāvena vākyārthamāha || svabhāvatvāditi || nanu kimarthamevamarthāntaraṃ kalpanīyam? jīvasyeveśvarasya ca kartṛtvādikaṃ nāstyeva | viśvapravṛttistu svabhāvādevetyarthaḥ kiṃ na syāt? lokasyetyasya lokaviṣaya ityarthopapatterityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || svātantryāditi || nāsyasya sṛjati | api tu svayameva pravartata iti śeṣaḥ | īśvarasyaiva kartṛtve karmalepaḥ syādityata āha || svātantryādeveti || anena " nādatte " ityasyārtho'pyukto bhavati | evaṃ sarveṣu sthitvā svātantreṇa kartā īśvaro'sti cet kathaṃ na dṛśyata ityata āha || ajñāneti || etenājñāneti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | yaduktamīśvaraḥ svayameva bhāvayatīti na tadyuktam | tasya kartṛtvābhāvāt | tasya kartṛtvasadbhāve'pi tasyāsvābhāvavikatvādityata āha || ahamiti || ahaṃ sarvasyeti vacanadvayaṃ kartṛtvasadbhāve mānam | parāsyetyādikaṃ kartṛtvasya svābhāvikatve | tvadṛte dūre samīpe vā kiñcana kenāpi na kriyata ityarthaḥ | atra bhagavaditarasya kartṛtvābhāvoktyā īśvarakartṛtvasyāparādhīnatvasambhavena svābhāvikatvamevocyate | lokavadityatrāpi phalādyapekṣā'bhāvena kartṛtvoktyā tasya svābhāvikatvamevocyate | itaśca neśvarasya akartṛtvamasvābhāvikaṃ kartṛtvaṃ cetyāha || viparīteti || nanvasmābhirīśvarasya kartṛtvamasvābhāvikapadenānirvācyamabhipreyate | na tu phalāpekṣaṃ parādhīnaṃ vā | ato nodāhṛtavacanavirodha ityata āha || anirvācyeti || īśvarasya kartṛtvamanirvacanīyamiti pakṣo dvitīyādhyāye'nirvācyavastuno nirastatvādeva nirastaḥ | ato na punaratra nirasanīya iti bhāvaḥ | nanu brahmaṇaḥ sarvaviśeṣarahitatvāt kathaṃ paramārthataḥ kartṛtvaṃ syādityata āha || na ceti || bhavedbrahmaṇaḥ kartṛtvasyāpāramārthikatveṃ, yadi tasya sarvaviśeṣarāhityaṃ syāt | na ca tadyuktam | tathātve brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvāpattyā tadabhyupagantṛṇāṃ śūnyavāditvāpātāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvaviśeṣarahitatve'pi na brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvāpattiḥ, astitvādityata āha || na hīti || na bhavedbrahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvāpattiḥ, yadi tasyāstitvaṃ sidhyet | na ca tatsiddhiḥ | sarvaviśeṣarahitamityaṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvaviśeṣarahitatve'pi kuto'stitvaṃ na siddhyatītyata āha || vācyatveti || astitve brahmaṇaḥ astitvamastiśabdavācyatvaṃ vā syāt | tasya ca viśeṣatvāt na tatsarvaviśeṣarahitasya yujyata iti bhāvaḥ | bhavennirviśeṣatve'stitvāsiddhiḥ, yadyastitvaṃ brahmaṇo viśeṣatayā aṅgīkrayate | naitadasti | tasya brahmasvarūpamātratvādityata āha || anyatheti || yadyastitvādikaṃ brahmaṇaḥ svarūpamātraṃ na tadviśeṣastarhi brahma brahmetivadasti brahmetyādiśabdānāṃ paryāyatvaṃ syāt | tataśca " asti brahmeti cedveda " ityādisahaprayogānupapattiḥ syāt | tathā copaniṣadāṃ punaruktidoṣeṇa unmattavākyavadanādaraṇīyatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | brahmaṇyastitvādiviśeṣābhāve'pi āropitāsattvādiviśeṣavyāvṛttikathanadvārā astyādipadāni tallakṣayanti | ato na śabdānāṃ paryāyatvādītyata āha || vyāvartyeti || bhavedastyādipadānāmaparyāyatvaṃ, yadyastyādipadāni brahmaṇo'sattvādi vyāvartayanti | na ca tadyuktam | vyāvartyāsattvādiviśeṣavyāvṛtteḥ vyāvṛttatayā'ṅgīkṛtabrahmagatāstitvādiviśeṣanivandhanatvāt | teṣāṃ cānaṅgīkārāt | brahmaṇyastitvādiviśeṣabhāve'pi asattvādivyāvṛttāvasato'pi tadvyāvṛttiprasaṅgāt | gaṅgāpadalakṣyo'pi tīre gaṅgātvābhāve'pi agaghgātvavyāvṛttiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | ito'pyastyādipadāni astitvādiviśeṣabodhakāni neti na yuktamityāha || anyatheti || yadyastyādipadāni na astitvādibrahmaviśeṣabodhakāni tarhi teṣāṃ vaiyyarthyameva syāt | brahmajijñāsuṃ prati brahmakathanasyaiva sārthakyāt | brahmaṇaśca brahmapadādevāvagatatvāt | na cāsattvādivyāvṛttiḥ prayojanam | tadasambhavasyoktatvāt | brahma kuto vyāvṛttamityajijñāsitatvācca | ajijñāsitatve'pi brahmaṇyasattvādibhrāntiḥ nivāryata iti cenna | vikalpāsahatvāt | bhrāntiḥ kiṃ pratīte'pratīte vā brahmaṇi bhavet? | nādyaḥ | brahmapratītau tanmātrasya sattvāderapi pratītatvena bhrāntyanavakāśāt | brahmapratītāvapi sattvādyapratītau tanmātratvānupapatteḥ | na dvitīyaḥ | adṛṣṭakalpanāprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | itaśca na astyādipadairasattvādivyāvṛttidvārā brahma lakṣyam | tasya sarvaśabdāvacyatvāṅgīkārāt | śabdavācyasyaiva lakṣyatvadsanādityāha || na ceti | astitvāṅgīkāre brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgāt na tatsiddhyatītyuktam | ito'pi na brahmaṇo'stitvaṃ siddhyati | tatpramāṇābhāvāt | pramāṇaṃ vinā'rthasiddheḥ kvāpyadarśanāt | pramāṇakathane ca sarvapramāṇāgocaratvāṅgīkārabhaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | yadyastitve pramāṇābhāvāt na tatsiddhyatītyucyate tarhi brahmaṇo nāstitvamapi na siddhyati | tatra pramāṇābhāvāt | tathāca na śūnyavādāviśeṣāpādanaṃ brahmavādasya yujyata ityata āha || nāstitvamiti || brahmaṇo na nāstitve'smābhiḥ pṛthak pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam | tasyāstitvapramāṇābhāvenaiva siddheḥ | yathā khalu saptamarasādyastitve pramāṇābhāvāt nāstitvaṃ siddhyati tathaivetyarthaḥ | anenānupalabdhiliṅgakamanumānaṃ sūcitaṃ bhavati | nanu pramāṇāvedyatve'pi brahmaṇo na nāstitvaṃ vācyam | svaprakāśatayaiva tastiddheriti yenna, vikalpānupapatteḥ | tathāhi -- svaprakāśatve brahmaṇaḥ pramāṇamasti na vā? na tāvāddvitīyaḥ | pramāmābhāve tadasiddherityāha || svaprakāśatvaṃ ceti || ādye svaprakāśatvaṃ brahmātiriktaṃ tatsvarūpameva vā? prathamaṃ dūṣayati || svayaṃprakāśatvāmiti || yadi brahmaṇaḥ svatiriktaṃ svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ syāttadā tasya saviśeṣatvaṃ prasajyata ityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayiti || na cediti || yadi svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ na brahmātiriktaṃ, kintu tatsvarūpameva tarhi svayaṃprakāśatve pramāṇasadbhāvāṅgīkāre brāhmaiva pramāṇagamyāmaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | tathācāprameyatvabhaṅga ityarthaḥ | na svaprakāśapadena svaviṣayaprakāśatvamucyate | yena tasya brahmātiriktatve brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvaṃ syāt | kintu paraprakāśatvābhāva evetyata āha || pareti || yadi svaprakāśapadena paraprakāśanirāsamātramabhipreyate tarhi brahmaṇaḥ prakāśarāhityameva syāt | paraprakāśasyānabhimatatvāt | svaviṣayaprakāśatvākhyāsya svaprakāśatvasyoktarītyā pramāmābhāvena, bhāve ca saviśeṣatvaprameyatvaprāptyā nirastatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tathāpi na nāstitvaṃ brahmaṇo vaktṛṃ śakyate | " asti brahma " ityādiśrutyā asattvādivyāvṛttidvārā brahmaṇi lakṣite'rthatastasyāstitvasiddheriti cenna | dūṣitatvāt | abhyupagamyāpyāha || arthata iti || tatpramāṇata iti || asti brahmeti śrutipramāṇata ityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ svaprakāśatvena brahma siddhyatīti tadvyāhataṃ cetyāha || svaprakāśeti || na svaprakāśapadena svaviṣayaprakāśatvamaṅgīkriyate | kintu paraprakāśatvānaṅgīkāramātrameva | ataḥ svaparaprakāśūnyatayā svaprakāśatvena brahmaṇo'siddhireva syānna tu tena tatsiddhirityarthaḥ | kiñca bhaved brahmaṇaḥ svaprakāśatā yadi prakāśatvameva sambhavet | na ca tatsambhavati | brahmākhyāprakāśasya prakāśyarahitatvāt | na tāvat svayaṃ prakāśyam | anaṅgīkārāt | nāpyanyat | tadabhāvāt | na ca prakāśyarahitaprakāśarūpaṃ brahmeti vācyam | svamanyaṃ vā prakāśyaṃ vinā prakāśasyādṛṣṭatvāt | yathā bhojyarahitaṃ bhojanaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ tathaivetyāha || prakāśa iti || nanvekasyāṃ kiyāyāmekasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ karmatvaṃ ca viruddham | ataḥ kathaṃ prakāśyaṃ vinā prakāśo na dṛṣṭa ityucyate | svasyaiva prakāśyate svayameva prakāśayati prakāśate cetyekasyaiva kartṛtvakarmatvāpatterityata āha || kartṛkarmeti || māmahaṃ jānāmītyekasyaivaikasyāṃ viruddhamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu prakāśo nāma dravyam | ataḥ kathaṃ tasya bhojanādivat karmāpekṣetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharan adhikaṃ ca doṣamāha || jñānaṃ ceti || brahmaṇaḥ prakāśatvaṃ nāma jñānatvamabhyupagatam | na ca jñānatvaṃ brahmaṇo yuktam | jñātṛjñeyarahitatvāt | tadrahitajñānasyādṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ | upasaṃharati || ata iti || yataḥ sarvaviśeṣarahitatvenāprameyatvena ca brahmaṇo na astitvaṃ siddhyatyata ityarthaḥ | bhagavataḥ kartṛtvābhāvādinirākaraṇamupasaṃharati || ata iti || duṣṭatvāt || kartṛtvaṃ nāsti, sadbhāve vā'svābhāvikamiti matasya | punarīśvarasya svabhāvataḥ kartṛtve śrutiṃ cāha || haririti || 14 || " jñānena " iti prakṛtatajñānasya sādhanāntaramucyate " vidyā " iti | tatra na brāhmaṇādiviṣaye samabuddhitvaṃ vivakṣitam | kintu tadgataparabrahmaviṣaya eva | brāhmaṇādīnāṃ viṣamatvāt tadgatabrahmaṇa eva samatvāt viparītajñānasya ca jñānāsādhanatvāditi bhāvena jīvānāṃ baiṣamye brahmaṇaḥ sāmye ca pramāṇamāha || viṣameṣviti || anena " nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma " ityetadapi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati || 18 -20 || yaduktaṃ yogarūpasaṃnyāsasya niḥśreyakaratvaṃ tadupapādyate " bāhya " iti | taddurgamārthatvādvyācaṣṭe || saṃsāre'pi paramātmasmaraṇādyalpayogayuktaḥ saṃnyāsī sukhaṃ vindati yadā tadā dhyānādimahāyogayukto mokṣādiniḥśreyasaṃ vindatīti kimu vāyyamityarthaḥ || 21 -23 || jñānilakṣaṇamucyate " yo'ntaḥsukhaḥ " iti | tatra brahmabhūtapadaṃ brahmaṇaikībhūta ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || brahmaṇīti || manaseti śeṣaḥ | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cenna | jñānino'pi brahmabhedasya sādhitatvāt | doṣāntaraṃ cāha || anyatheti || yadyatra jñānino brahma bhāvo'bhidhīyate tarhi brahmādhigacchatīti viruddhaṃ syāt | na hi kaścit svayaṃ svātmānaṃ gacchatītyarthaḥ | nanvatra antaḥsukhatvādikaṃ bhavatu jñānilakṣaṇam | antarjyotiṣṭvaṃ kathaṃ brahmadarśino lakṣaṇaṃ syāt | yāvatā brahmadarśitvameva tadityata āha || antaḥsukhatvādikamiti || nātrāntarjyotiṣṭvaṃ jñānilakṣaṇamucyate | kintu antaḥsukhatvādyeva | tatra kāraṇatvenāntarjyotiṣṭvamucyata iti bhāvaḥ || 24 -27 || brahmayogādipadena prākṛtadhyānaprakāra ucyate " sparśān " iti | tatra dhyānino'muktasya kathaṃ " mukta eva saḥ " iti muktatvamucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || amukta iti || muktasādṛśyamabhimānādiparityāgaḥ | mukta evocyata iti śeṣaḥ | yasmāt jñānasāmarthyena evaṃ phalaṃ bhavati tasmāt || 28 -29 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpākāyāṃ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || dhyānamiti || " yoge tvimāṃ śrṛṇu " iti pratijñātam | yogaśca karmayogo dhyānayogaśceti dvedhā bhāvati | tatra saṅkṣepavistarābhyāṃ karmayogo nirūpitaḥ | dhyānayogaprakāraśca saṅkṣepeṇa pañcamānte nirūpito vistareṇāsminnadhyāye ucyata iti bhāvaḥ | prakṛtaṃ dhyānamagnyādiparityāgena nissaṅgatayā sartamānasya bhavatītyāśaṃkā nirasyate " anāśrita " iti | tatra niragneḥ saṃnyāsitvaṃ yogitvaṃ ca nāstītyuktaṃ nopapadyate | tathāsati yatyāśramasyānanuṣṭheyatvaprasaṅgāt | yaterniragnitvena yogasaṃnyāsābhāvaprāpteḥ | tayoreva śreyaḥsādhanatvādityata āha || sa iti || bhavedanena yatyāśramasyānanuṣṭheyatvaprasaṅgo yadi yaterniragnitvaṃ syāt | na ca tadasti | sa brahmaniṣṭha iti tasyāpyagniśravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | itaśca na yateragnitvamityāha || ātmeti || yatyaśramasvīkārakāle pūrvāśramasvīkṛtāgnerātmani samāropaṇācca na yateranagnitvamityarthaḥ | anena na kevalaṃ niragnirakriyo yatireva saṃnyāsī yogī ca | kintvanāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ so'pītyapavyākhyānaṃ ca nirākṛtaṃ bhavati || 1 || saṃnyāsī yogī cetyuktyā prāptā saṃnyāsayogayoḥ pṛthaktvāśaṃkā nivāryate " saṃnyāsam " iti | tatra saṃnyāsayogasoraikye kathaṃ pṛthaguktirityata āha || yogeti || 2 || karmayogamadhye kīdṛśo yogo jñānārthino'vaśyāpekṣita ityata ucyate " ārurukṣoḥ " iti | tatra yogarūḍhapadasya durgamārthatvādarthamāha || sampūrṇeti || atra jñānārthinaḥ karma apekṣitamityuktvāt jñaninaḥ karmopaśamo'pekṣita ityucyate | tathāca na niragnirna cākriya ityādivirodha ityata āha || nāneti || nānājanasya uttamādhamamadhyamasya || karavanmiteriti || rājādikaravadāvaśyakatayā pramitatvādityarthaḥ | yogasthenāpi śuśrūṣāyāḥ kāryatve ko viśeṣo yogārthiyogasthayorityata āha || tenāpīti || anyairyogārthibhiḥ | yogārithiyogasthayorviśeṣe vaktavye asiddhasiddhayorviśeṣaḥ kimarthamucyata ityata āha || prāpteti || nānājanasya śuśrūṣā kathaṃ jñānasya sādhanamityato bhagavatprasādadvāretyāha || tasyeti || nanvajñānāmapi harau sthitatvādyogasthena harau sthitiḥ kāryeti kimucyata ityata uktaṃ vivṛṇoti || siddheti || anyat nānājanaśuśrūṣādi | jñānino mokṣaniyamāt kiṃ dhyānādinetyata āha || tasyeti || tataśca muktāvānandapūrtiriti bhāvaḥ | atra karmapadena nānājanaśuśrūṣaivocyate na tu sandhyāvandanādi | śamapadena ca nānājanaśuśrūṣopaśama evocyate | bhagavaddhyānādikaṃ ca | na sandhyāvandanādikarmopaśamaḥ | nānājanasyeti smṛtisamākhyānāt | ato nāsya pūryoktavirodha iti bhāvaḥ | śamapadasya viṣṇudhyānādivācitve spaṣṭarthāṃ smṛtiṃ cāha || śama iti || 3 || yogarūḍhalakṣamucyate " yadā hi " iti | tatra na karmasvanuṣajyata iti jñāninaḥ karmābhāvakathanānna cākriya ityādivirodha ityata āha || kathamiti || nātra jñāninaḥ svarūpataḥ karmānuṣaṅgo'bhidhīyate | kintu sarvakarmasu saṅ‌kalpanyānenaiva | tathā svayameva vyākhyātatvāditi bhāvaḥ | yadi sarvakarmasu saṅ‌lpanyāsastarhi karmasvarūpanyāsa eva prāpnoti | svarūpātyāge saṅ‌kalpatyāgāyogādityata āha || mayīti || bhavetkarmasvarūpatyāgaprāptiryadi saṅ‌kalpasvarūpatyāgo'bhipretaḥ syāt | na cāsāvasti | saṅ‌kalpasaṃnyāsapadena saṅ‌kalpāderbhagavadadhīnatājñānasyaivābhipretatvāt | mayī sarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyaityatra saṃnyāsapadasya bhagavadadhīnatājñānārthatāyāḥ samarthitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | prakāṇāntaraṃ cāha || madadhīnamiti || 4 || yogārohasya bhagavatprasādo mukhyasādhanamityucyate " uddharet " iti | tatrā'tmapadaṃ jīvādimātraviṣayaṃ na paramātmaviṣayamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtvaiva vyācaṣṭe || uddhareteti || kīdṛśāḥ santaḥ kīdṛśā asanta ityata uktaṃ vivṛṇoti || taditi || tadanyasya bhaktyā'vaśīkṛtaparamātmanaḥ puruṣasya | ito'pyatra ātmapadena paramātmagrahaṇaṃ yuktamityāha || paramātmeti || yena ātmā vaśīkṛtastasyāsau bandhutayā kiṃ karotītyapekṣāyāṃ vākyaśeṣe vaśīkṛto'sau paramātmā tasya hṛdi samyagāhito bhavatītyuktatvāt pūrvamapyātmāpadena paramātmaivocyata iti jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ || 5 || 6 || yogārūḍhalaṇaṃ prapañcyate " śītoṣṇa " iti | tatra jñānavijñānaśabdayorarthabhedaṃ smṛtyaivāha || sarvatreti || sarvatra vedādau || 7 || 8 || nanu suhṛdādīnāṃ viṣamatvāt kathaṃ teṣu jñāninaḥ samabuddhitvamucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva paraharati || yasyeti || suhṛnmitrapadayoḥ aridveṣyapadayoḥ udāsīnamadhyasthapadayośca ekārthatvapratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva tadarthamāha || animitteti || jñātvopakārakṛditi || svayameva tasya kleśasthānaṃ nirūpyopakārakartetyarthaḥ || 9 -19 || yogasampūrtisvarūpamucyate " yadā " ityādinā | tatra ātmanā''tmānamityātmaśabdayorjīvādiviṣayatvapratītinirāsāyāha || ātmānamiti || anyathā toṣāyogāditi bhāvaḥ || 20 -26 || yogaphalamucyate " praśānta " iti | tatra brahmabhūtapadasya anyārthapratītinirāsāyārthamāha || brahmaṇīti || anyathā bahupramāṇavirodhaditi bhāvaḥ || anena pūrvoktaṃ matsaṃsthāpadamapi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati || 27 -28 || dhyeyamucyate " sarvabhūtastham " iti | tatrātmapadena jīva ucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || sarveti || bhoktāramiti saṅkṣepoktau paramātmana eva dhyeyatvokteḥ, yo māmityanuvādācceti bhāvaḥ || 29 -30 || paramātmadhyānaphalamucyate " sarvaṃ " iti | tatra " ṇakatvamāsthitaḥ " ityetadanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || sarvatrate || anyathā sarvabhūtasthitamiti svavacanavirodhāditi bhāvaḥ || 31 || yogina eva itthambhāvāntaramucyate " ātmā " iti | tatsarvaprāṇiviṣayamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || ata iti || atra bhagavadīyoṣveva svas‌minniva sneho vidhīyate, na tvavaiṣṇaveṣu | vandhurātmeti vaiṣṇavānānameva bhagavatpriyatvasyoktatvāt , anātmana ityavaiṣṇavānāṃ bhagadapriyatvasyoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 32 -36 || ayatirityarjunapraśnavākyagatāyatipadasya gṛhasthādirityanyathāpratītinirāsāyārthamāha || ayatiriti || gṛhasthādirevārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || prayatnāditi || ayatestatra śraddhāvaśāt caturthāśramī bhavatīti parihāraprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu yogaśabdasya jñānopāyārthatvāt śraddhāvān labhate jñānamityādeḥ śraddhāyā api jñānopāyatvāt śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasa iti parasparavirodha ityata āha || yogeti || bhavedayaṃ virodho yadi yogaśabdenātra sāmānyato jñānopayo'bhidhīyate | na ca tadasti | dhyānasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt | na ca yogaśabdasya jñānopāyavācitvavirodhaḥ | dhyānasyāpi jñānopāyaviśeṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ | yogāccalitamānasasya " prāpya puṇyakṛtān lokān " ityādiphalamupapādyate " jijñāsuḥ " iti | tatra yogajijñānoḥ vidhiniṣedhābhāvapratītinirāsāya tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mokṣeti || tadāsthita iti || tatrālpapravṛttimānityarthaḥ || 44 -45 || yogaḥ stūyate " tapasvibhya " iti | tatra yogasya jñānārthatvāt kathaṃ jñānāduttamatvamuktamityataḥ tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || tapasa iti || ajñānidhyānana iti || samyag dhyānaprakārājñasya dhyānato dhyānaprakārajñānamevottamam | dhyānaprakārajñānasahitaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyānaprakārajñānamātrato'dhikamityarthaḥ | dhyāniṣvapi tāratamyamāha || tatrāpīti || kīdṛśo'bhakta ityata āha || anyeti || na bhaktiryeṣu te'bhaktayaḥ | anyān madadhīnān jānannityanana parivāratayā anyopāsanamucyate | madupāsakeṣvapi viṣuddhadhīḥ niṣkāmo vara ityarthaḥ anena yogināmiti śloko vyākhyāto bhavati | tathāhi -- sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ madhye yaḥ śraddhāśabdoditamadbhaktimān sa eva yukto mataḥ | tatrāpi yo māṃ bhajate sa eva yuktataro mataḥ | tatrāpi phalakāmanāṃ vinā yo māṃ bhajate na yuktatamo mata iti || 46 -47 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || bhagavaditi || yatpūrvoktaṃ dhyānaṃ tadbhaktipūrvakameva jñānasādhanaṃ, nānyathā | ato bhaktyarthaṃ bhagavanmahimā'sminnadhyāye'bhidhīyata ityarthaḥ | na tvevāhamityādinā prāgapi bhagavanmahimno varṇatatvāt kimananetyata uktam || viśeṣata iti || prāk saṅkṣepeṇokto'tra vistareṇocyata ityarthaḥ | uparitanādhyāyānāmapi bhagavanmahimābhidhāyakatvādartetyāhi noktam | pratijñāte jñāne lipsāmutpādayituṃ daurlabhyaṃ tasyocyate "manuṣyāṇām " iti || tatmṛtibhirvyācaṣṭe || anantānāmiti || kecanaiva cet samyagvidustarhi kathamitareṣāṃ mokṣa ityata āha || anyeṣāmiti || anena yatatāmapi kecit siddhā bhavantīti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | jīvanmuktānāṃ sarveṣāmapi siddhipadoditā muktirbhavati | siddhiṃ gatāḥ sarvepi nārāyaṇāyanāḥ, tajjñānādimattvāt | nārāyaṇaparāyaṇastu sudurlabha ityarthaḥ | jīvaghano jīvasāraḥ | anena na kevalaṃ mahājñānino daurlabhyamapi tu mahābhaktyādimānapi durlabha ityuktaṃ bhavati || 3 || pratijñātaṃ jñānamucyate " bhūmiḥ " ityādinā | tatmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || acetaneti || cetanā śrīrityanena jīvabhūtāmiti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | te ubhe ityanena me prakṛtirityasyārtha ukto bhavati | etadyonīnītyasyārtho jagata iti | viṣṇoreva jagatkāraṇatvāt kathametadityata āha || piteti || pitṛtvenaiva viṣṇuḥ kāraṇamityarthaḥ | anenāhaṃ kṛtsnasyeti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tarhi prakṛtyoḥ kīdṛśaṃ kāraṇatvamityatra āha || māteti || acetanaprakṛterupādānatvaśaktirapi bhagavadadhīnetyucyate || viṣṇubaleriteti || 4 -6 || tvadvatsarvottamāntarasyapi pitṛtvādyupapatteḥ kathaṃ kṛtsnasyetyādyuktamityata ucyate " matta " iti | tatra svavyatiriktamātraṃ niṣidhyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyā'ha || matta iti || nātra svavyatiriktaniṣedhaḥ, kintu matto'nyadvastu parataraṃ na bhavati | kintvahameva parataraḥ | ataḥ " ahaṃ kṛtsnasya " ityādi yuktamevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | svātiriktaniṣedho'yaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || yadyatra svātiriktaniṣedhastarhi paratarapadenaiva svātiriktasyoktatvādanyāditi vyarthaṃ syāt | anyaditi padasya svātiriktārthatābhyupagame ca parataramiti vyarthaṃ syādityarthaḥ | yadi viṣṇureva paratarastarhi parāvarādinā bhāvyam | tatkimityata uktārthe smṛtimāha || avarā iti || duḥkhasambandhitvānna paro, duḥkhena samyagapīḍitatvācca nāvaraḥ | ato madhyama ityarthaḥ | viṣṇuḥ parataraścet kaḥ paratama ityata āha || abhāvāditi || atra parataraparatamapadābhyāṃ viṣṇureka evocyate | na tvasau paratama eva | parabhūtaśrītattvasya paratamabhūtaviṣmośca madhye paratarasyānyasyābhāvāt | nāpi viṣṇuḥ paratara eva | paratamasyānyasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu jaḍaprakṛterapi nityanirduḥkhatvāt kathaṃ śrīrekaiva paretyata āha || yasyā iti || nirduḥkhatve'pi duḥkhakāraṇatvena jaḍaprakṛterasandigdhamavaratvamevetyarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ jīvā avarā iti tasyāpavādamāha || atheti || atrāpi taraptamapāvekārthau | nanvacetanādapi cetanasyottamatvāt īśvaravimukhānāmavarataratve kathaṃ prakṛteravaratvamityata āha || na hīti || jīvānāṃ duḥkhasambandha uktastarhi mokṣaḥ kathaṃ syādityata āha || ata iti || uktaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | nanu bhagavajjñānena duḥkhamokṣo bhavati cet muktasya paratvaṃ syāt | tathā ca śrīrekaiva paretyayuktamityata āha || mukta iti || sunityasukhabhojanādavaratvābhāve'pi prāk duḥkhābhāvasāmye'pi na sukhādāvapi sāmyamityāha || tatrāpīti || nanu śrutyādau jñānavijñānābhyāṃ mokṣokteḥ kathaṃ viṣṇoḥ parataratvajñānena mokṣo'bhihita ityata āha || viṣmoriti || ucyate śrutyāhāviti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ śryādīnāṃ paratvādijñānena | anena " jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānam " ityasyāpyartha ukto bhavati | jñānavijñānayordaulabhyaṃ lipsotpādanāyā'ha || etacceti || muktānāṃ tāratamye vā'nena heturucyate | anena manuṣyāṇāmityetadapi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati || 7 || viṣṇutantratvāt sarvasyāsau paratara iti tadadhīnatvapradarśanenāha || sa iti || anena vijñānapradarśakaṃ raso'hamityādi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | rasayati rasamādatte rasaṃ prerayati | prabhāsanāt svayaṃ prabhāsamānatvāt, prabhāpreraṇācca | praṇauti stauti stāvakatvaṃ prerayati ca | śabdayati vakti śabdaṃ prerayati ca || 8 || surabhyasurabhitayā gandhaṃ prerayati, svayaṃ surabhiśceti puṇyagandhaḥ | svayaṃ puṇyagandhapradatvācca | tejasvī vartate, tejaḥ prerayati ceti tejaḥ | jīvanapradaḥ tasmājjīvanam | tapayati tapaḥ kurute prerayati ceti tapaḥ || 9 || vyañjanād vyañjakatvāt prerakatvācca | bodhanāt boddhṛtvad buddhiprerakatvācca || 10 || viṣayabhoganirapekṣatayā nityapūrṇabasatvāt kāmavarjitaṃ balam | asthāne'prayujyamānatvād rāgavivarjitaṃ lasam | rāgiṇo hyasthāne'pi balaṃ prayuñjate | kāmarāgavivarjitabaladaścati vā | arthāntaramucyate || etādṛśeti || etādṛśabalātmetyanuvādaḥ | arthāntaraṃ cocyate || veti || tadgateḥ pūrṇaratitvāt | atrāpi kāmarāgarāhityaṃ pūrvavat | dharmāviruddhecchāprerakatvācceti jñātavyam | apsu rasa ityādivyāvasthayā'bādisarveṣāṃ rasādisarvado'to rasādināmetyarthaḥ | rasādyabhedāttannāmā kiṃ na syādityata āha || sarvata iti || tatra svātantryaṃ hetuḥ | rasāderasvātantryaṃ prasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ || 11 || na kevalaṃ rasādidharmaprerakaḥ kiṃnāmā'bādiprerakaścetyāha || ye ceti || yathā bhagavadadhīnamidamevaṃ bhagavānetadadhīnostu, bhūbhūdharādivadityata āha || tadāyattamiti || idameva tadāyattaṃ na tvasāvetadāyatta iti bhāvaḥ | anena " na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi " ityasya vailomyenārtha ukto bhavati || 12 || evaṃ sarvaprerakaḥ paramātmā kuto lokena na jñāyata ityata āha || acetanayoti || prakṛtyeti śeṣaḥ || tanmeyatvāditi || viṣṇunaiva samyak jñātatvāt | lakṣymā cetyarthaḥ | anena tribhirityāderartha ukto bhavati | mametyasyārtho vaśagayeti | viṣṇunaivetyanenācetanaprakṛtyādyāhitaṃ svaviṣayamohaṃ bhagavān kuto na bārayatītyāśaṅ‌kānivārakasya nāhaṃ prakāśa ityasyārtha ukto bhavati | yadi sākṣādbhagavatyā loko mohitastarhi na kasyāpi jñānamityata āha || ye tviti || anena māmevetyetadvyāṣyātaṃ bhavati | bhagavatprapattyā kathaṃ māyātaraṇamityata āha || lakṣmīriti || nanu pūrvaṃ lakṣmyā eva bhagavadvaśatvasyoktatvāt kathaṃ te ubhe api viṣṇorvaśe ucyate ityata uktam || lakṣmīḥ sā jaḍamāyā yā devateti || lakṣmyā bhagavadvaśatvaṃ bhavati | acetanaprakṛterlakṣmīvaśatvāt | ato mohakaprakṛtyorbhagavadvaśatvāt tatprapattyā māyātaraṇaṃ yuktamevātastaṃ prapadyetetyarthaḥ | anena guṇamayītyetad vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tato'nanyabhaktyetyanenaikabhaktirityādeḥ tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | ananyabhaktirnāma kīdṛśītyata āha || yādṛśīti || tatra bhaktiviṣaye | anenaikasmin bhaktiryasyeti vigrahaḥ sūcitaḥ | tena sāmānādhikaraṇyāṅgīkāre bhaktiśabdasya priyāditvena puṃvadbhāvāprāptiśca parihṛtā | viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvamanyeṣāṃ tadvaśatvaṃ ca jñātvā bhaktiṃ kurvatāṃ kiṃ phalamityata āha || evamiti || evaṃ jānanniti || jñātvā bhajannityarthaḥ | anena " jñānī tvātmaiva me matam " ityādyuktārthaṃ bhavati | avadhāraṇārthatuśabdasyārtho nānyatheti | bhagavajjñānināmeva mokṣo nānyeṣāmiti kuta ityata āha || pūrṇamiti || bhagavata eva purṇatvena mokṣadānaśaktirnānyeṣāmityarthaḥ | anena vāsudeva ityasyartha ukto bhavati | yadi bhagavajjñānena mokṣastarhi sarveṣāṃ syādityata āha || evaṃvīditi || vāsudevajñānena mokṣasadbhāve'pi tajjñānino na sarva iti na sarveṣāṃ mokṣa ityarthaḥ | etena sa iti vyākṛtaṃ bhavati | loke bhagavajjñānināṃ bahūnāṃ dṛśyamānatvāt kathaṃ daurlabhyamityata āha || yaditi || miśrayājina iti || vaiparītyena yajanta ityarthaḥ | etena kāmairityādestātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | kiṃ teṣāṃ phalamityata āha || viṣṇumiti || tatparaṃ ramādibhyaḥ param | ajñātvā viparītaṃ jñātvā ca | kāraṇaviśeṣājjñānarahitasya viparītajñānābhāvenānyadevatārādhanena kiṃ syādityata āha || ajñānāmiti || upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | nirṇetrabhāvādikāraṇāntaraṃ ca draṣṭavyam | samarcanaṃ kartavyamitīti śeṣaḥ | pṛthak sevā parivāratāṃ vinaiva anyadevatāyajanaṃ vidyādi tadviṣayajñānaṃ stavanādi cetyarthaḥ | etacca phalaṃ nājñānimātrasya, api tu jñānānantaraṃ yaḥ pūrvamārgaṃ tyaktvā bhagavadbhajanameva kuryāttasyaiva | keṣāñcittamoyogyānāmapi kadācidajñatvasambhavāditi bhāvenāha || yadīti || idaṃ ca tamoyogyavyāvṛttimātram | nityatraividyānāmapi phalasadbhāvāt | prājīnāparādhasadbhāvāt kathamuttarāpekṣayā phalamityata āha || ajānateti | svato bhagavata eva yadi viṣṇutattvaṃ jñātvā'pi kāraṇaviśeṣāt pūrvamārgaṃ na jahāti tasya kiṃ syādityata āha || atyāga iti || jñāpayati tyaktumiti śeṣaḥ | janmāntara ityupalakṣaṇam | yadi svīya iti sambandhaḥ | kecana gurvādikaṃ nimittīkṛtya, na tu sākṣāt | anena labhate cetyāderviṣaya ukto bhavati | evaṃ rasādikāraṇatvādgasādināmakatvaṃ viṣṇornābhedeneti pramāṇavacanenoktam | upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatvokteśca tajjñāyata ityāha || matta eveti || jñānī tvātmaiva me matam " ityetat " evaṃ jānaṃstamāpnoti " iti pramāṇavacanena vyākhyātam | yuktyā ca taduktārthameva na tvabhedārthamiti sādhayitumāha || āpnotīti || ātmaśabdasyāptivācitvaṃ kuta ityata āha || yacceti || " yaccāpnoti yadādatte yaccātti viṣayāniha | yaccāsya santato bhāvastasmādātmeti bhaṇyate || " iti bhāratavākyam | kuto'yamātmaśabda āptyarthaḥ, svarūpārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || āsthita iti || etadarthavivaraṇātmake vākyaśeṣe paramāṃ gatimuddiśyabhagavantamupāsīnasya jñāninastatprāpteruktatvāt atrāpi prāpyarthaṃ evā'tma śabdo na svarūpārtha ityarthaḥ | nanu jñānānantaraṃ mokṣasya karmakṣayamātrāvadhitvād " bahūnāṃ janmanām " iti bahujanmaniyatiḥ kathamucyata ityata āha || bahūnāmiti || vāsudeva ityetat pūrṇaṃ vastviti pramāṇavacanena vyākhyātam | yuktyā caitamarthaṃ sādhayitumāha || vāsudeva iti || atra vāsudevasya pūrṇatvamevocyate, na tu sarvābheda ityarthaḥ | pramāṇavacanena bhagavajjñānināmevānuttamagatirbhavatītyatra hetvabhidhāyakatayaiva etadyojitam | atha bahūnāṃ ḍanmanāmante vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti jñānavān bhavatītyapi yojanāṃ sūcayati || jānanniti || abhedārthamevedaṃ vākyaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || prapadyanta iti || " devān devayajo yānti " ityetad " viṣṇuṃ tatparamajñātvā " ityādinā vivṛtam || 21 -22 || vākyāntareṇāpi vivṛṇoti || jñātveti || kimajñānamātreṇa tama iti, netyāha || tathāpīti || yadyapyevamucyate tathāpītyarthaḥ | tāvaditi saṃyojyam | kecana bhāgavatāḥ puruṣāḥ | kecana traividyāḥ santi | teṣāṃ ca mokṣādikaṃ phalamityuktam || 23 || atha kecana dveṣiṇo'pi santītyucyate " avyaktam " iti || tadarthaṃ pūrvavadeṣāṃ phalasyānuktatvāt phalaṃ ca smṛtyaivāha || anyakta iti || evaṃ sarvaprerakatvādimahimavāṃścadbhagavān tatkathaṃ bhagavataḥ kecijjīvābhedaṃ manyanta ityato vaitaducyate | sarvātmanā jñeyatvājñeyatvābhyāṃ jīveśvarayorvyaktāvyaktatvam || 24 -25 || yadi māyāvaśādajñānaṃ lakasya bhagavadviṣayaṃ tarhi bhavato'pi lokaviṣayaṃ tadasti kiṃ, kuḍyobhayabhāgāvasthitayoranyonyādarśanavadityata ucyate || vedāhamiti || tatra kasyāpi bhagavajjñānābhāve rvedādivaiyyarthyāpatteḥ kathaṃ " māṃ tu veda na kaścana " ityucyata ityatastatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || 26 || yatkeṣāñcidadvaitajñānaṃ tadapi madicchayetyuktaṃ nāhaṃ prakāśa iti | tadayuktam | " aikātmyaṃ nāma yadidaṃ kecid brūyuranaipuṇāḥ | kāmakrodhābhibhūtatvādahaṃkārayaśaṃ gatāḥ || " ityādāvicchādveṣāderevādvaitajñānahetutvokterityata ucyate || iccheti || tatra mohasaṃmohaśabdayorarthabhedapradarśanāya dvandvamohapadamanūdya mohaśabdārthamāha || dvandveti || mohaśabdasya mithyājñānavācitvaṃ kuta ityata āha || tama iti || śarvarīsaṃbandhitamovadāvarakamajñānamityarthaḥ | astu moho mithyājñānaṃ, dvandvamoho nāma ka ityata āha || jīveti || ādipadena sarvajñatvālpajñatvāditaddharmagrahaṇam | mohaśahdāgatārthatayā saṃmohaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe || saṃmoha iti || tadāgraho mithyājñānadārḍhyamityarthaḥ | kuto'yaṃ saṃmohaśabdartha ityata āha || tadagraha iti || " mohaścaiva viparyayaḥ " iti prakṛtaviparyayaḥ taditi parāmṛśyate | krodho yathārthajñāniṣu | uktaśaṅ‌kāparihārāyoktaṃ sargapadaṃ tadāśaṃkāparihārakaṃ yathā syāttathā vyācaṣṭe || sarga iti || satyamicchādveṣādinā mithyājñānaṃ bhavatīti || tathāpi tadavāntarakāraṇameva | sargakālamārabhyaiva tasya kāraṇatvāt | śarīrānutpattāvicchādyabhāvāt | viṣṇostu sarvadā kāraṇatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | nanvatra jīveśvarādi viṣayadvandvamohasyecchādyavāntarakāraṇatvamucyate | na tu jīveśvarābhedajñānasya | na hi viśeṣyaikyajñānameva dvandvamoha iti niyāmakamastītyata āha || jīveti || 27 || bhagavajjñānena kiṃ bhavatītyata ucyate -- jareti | tatra bhagavatā tadbrahmetyukte'pi na brahmaṇo bhagavataḥ sakāśādanyatvaṃ śaṅ‌kanīyam | tadāśaṅ‌kāparihārāyaiva sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ brahmeti vaktavye māmityuktatvāditi bhāvenāha || taditi || ityukte jātāmiti śeṣaḥ || 30 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpākāyāṃ saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || pūrvādhyāyasaṅgatatvenaitadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayiti || ukteti || yaduktaṃ"te brahma tadviduḥ" ityādi tadvyākhyānamatrādau kriyate || "prayāṇakāle'pi ca mām" ityuktavyākhyānaprasaṅgena antakālasmaraṇaphalaṃ, tadupāyaprakāro, brahmaprāptimārgaścetyetaducyata ityarthaḥ | antakālasmaraṇādīnāṃ brahma prāpyate ebhiriti brahmaprāptiśabdābhidheyatvaṃ jñātavyam | nanvarjunasya jñānitvājjānātyevāsau bhagavāneva brahmeti | ataḥ "kiṃ tadbrahma" it praśnaḥ kathaṃ yujyate, kāraṇābhāvādityata āha || taditi || arjunasya jñānitve'pi yukto'yaṃ praśnaḥ | tadbrahmetyatra brahmaṇo bhagavatā taditi pārokṣyeṇoktatvād bhagavato'nyadevatā''troktaṃ brahmeti pratīyate | vāsudevātmakaṃ brahmetyāderbhagavān brahmeti pratīyate | evamubhayathāpratītijanitasaṃśayasya praśnakāraṇasya sadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu brahmaśabdasya bhagavanmātravṛttitvāt kathaṃ taditi viśeṣitatve'pyanyatvapratītirityata uktam || prakṛtīti || brahmaśabdasya bhagavati mukhyatve'pi prakṛtivedāderapyamukhyatayā tadarthatvāttaditi viśeṣitatvena mukhyārthāsambhave'pyamukhyārthaḥ prakṛtyādīnāṃ madhye yatkiñcidatra syāditi pratītiryukteti bhāvaḥ | nanu taditi viśeṣaṇena prāptā viśeṣaṇena prāptā brahmaṇo bhagavadanyatvaśaṃkā "sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ mām" ityuparitanavākye bhagavataiva parihṛtā | brahmeti vaktavye māmityuktatvāt | ataḥ kathaṃ brahmaṇo bhagavadanyatvapratītirityata uktam || uparīti || yadyapyeṣā pratītiruparitanavākye parihṛtā, tathāpi punarbhavatyeva | tatra "sādhiyajñaṃ ca" caśabdasya sādhibhūtādhiyajñaṃ māṃ ceti saṃyojanenādhibhūtādisahitatvena brahmajñānādanyadeva viṣṇujñānamucyata iti taditi viśeṣaṇādeva pratītisambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | yatkiñcidityatra anyadevetyatra ca iti pratītyā jāta iti śeṣaḥ | nanu "sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ mām" iti bhagavata eva brahmatvokteḥ kiṃ tadbrahmeti praśne'haṃ brahmeti parihāro baktavyaḥ | "akṣaraṃ brahma paramam" iti kathamucyata ityata āha || parameti || tathaiva paramākṣaraṃ brahmetyeva | bhavatu paramākṣaraṃ brahmetyuktiphalaṃ, paramākṣaraśabdasya viṣṇau prasiddhatvāt | tathāpyahamiti sākṣādanuktvā evaṃ kathane ko heturityata āha || ajñānāmiti || tadapi svasya paramākṣaratvamapi | nanu ye paramākṣaraṃ viṣṇuriti na jānanti teṣāmahaṃ brahmeti noktam | akṣaraṃ brahmetyevoktam | ato brahma akṣaraṃ ca bhagavato'nyadevetyāśaṃkaiva syānna tu paramākṣaraṃ brahma ca bhagavāniti jñānamityata āha || punariti || satyameva śaṃkā bhavatīti | sā ca "avyakto'kṣara ityuktaḥ" ityuparyakṣarasyāvyaktatvoktyā parihriyate | "avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante mām" ityavyaktaśabdasya bhagavati prayuktatvāt | ataḥ "akṣaraṃ brahma paramam" iti parihāre ahamityuktādapi lābhasambhavāt tathā parihāro yukta iti bhāvaḥ | yadyakṣaraśabhdo viṣṇāvena mukhyastarhi "ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktam" ityatra, "kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate" ityatra ca akṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇuḥ syādityata āha || ye ceti || akṣaraśabdasya viṣṇau mukhyatve'pi "ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktam" ityatra tāvadviṣṇoranyadeva akṣaraśabdavācyamityevāvasīyate | "ye bhaktāstvaṃ paryupāsate", "ye cāpyakṣaram" iti bhagavadakṣarayoḥ pṛthaktvena tadapāsakayostāratamyasya pṛṣṭatvāt | ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyam", "ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi" ityādinā'kṣaropāsakānāṃ bhagavadupāsakānāṃ ca phalatāratamyasya kathanācca | tathā "kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate" ityatrāpi viṣṇoritadevākṣaramityavasīyate" | "ahamakṣararādapi cottamaḥ" iti viṣṇorakṣarāduttamatvakathanāt mukhyārthāsambhave gauṇāṅgīkārasyanyāyyatvāt | prakṛte tu bādhakābhāvādviṣmuvaṣayatvameveti bhāvaḥ | nanvadhiyajñabrahmaṇo'pi viṣṇutve tatra brahmāhamevetyanuktvā adhiyajño'hameveti kimarthamucyate | kāraṇaviśeṣamantareṇoktibhedāsaṃbhavāt | ato'dhiyajña eva viṣṇurna brahmetyata āha || adhiyajña iti || brahmādhiyajñayorubhayorviṣṇutve'pi brahmāhamevetyanuktvā'dhiyajño'hameveti kathanaṃ yujyate | "sādhiyajñaṃ mām" iti bhagavatā svasyādhiyajñasāhityenoktatvāt adhiyajño bhagavato bhinna evetyāśaṃkā prāptā | tannivṛttyārthatvādahamevetyukteḥ | tadityuktyā brahmaṇo bhagavadanyatvaśaṃkāprāptāvapi māmityanena tasyāḥ prājñabuddhimapekṣya nirastatvena trāhamevetyuktyabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | etena "evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe" ityuktatvādadhiyajñapraśnaparihārau prāptiśūnyāviti ca nirastaṃ bhavati | bhagavānevādhiyajñaścet kathaṃ tatsāhityaṃ prāguktamityata āha || tasyaiveti || bhagavata evādhiyajñatve'pi tatsāhityaṃ yujyate | adhiyajñasya sarvaprāṇidehagatarūpāntaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | anena deha ityasyābhiprāyo varṇito bhavati | atra pramāṇaṃ darśayan bhagavata eva brahmatve kathaṃ tadityuktirityāśaṃkāṃ ca piraharan ślokadvayaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || prāṇināmiti || brahmaṇaḥ sarvagatarūpāntaratvāt tadityuktiryukteti bhāvaḥ | taistaiḥ sarvaprāṇibhiradhikayājyatvādadhiyajño, bṛṃhitatvāt brahmetyarthaḥ | bhūtādhikatvata ityatra bhūtapadena pṛthivyādīni | puruprāṇā'taḥ puruṣākhyeti śeṣaḥ | "ṣakāraḥ prāṇa ātmā" iti śruteḥ | nanu "adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra" ityatra kuto'dhiyajñaḥ kathaṃpūpa iti praśnaḥ kasmānna parihṛta ityata āha || kathaṃrūpa iti || tallakṣaṇoktyeti || "kaviṃ purāṇam" iti bhagavallakṣaṇokyetyarthaḥ | bhagavallakṣaṇoktyā kathamadhiyajñasvarūpapraśnaḥ parihṛta ityata uktam || ahameveti || "adhiyajño'hameva" ityadhiyajñasya bhagavadabhinnatvenoktatvādityarthaḥ || 4 || prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'sītyasya kimarthaṃ kathambhūtaḥ kena prakāreṇa smartavyo'sītyarthaḥ | tatra kimarthaṃ smartavyo'sītyasya parihāra ucyate "anteti" | tatra madbhāvapadasya anyathāpratītinirāsāyārthamāha || madbhāvamiti || anyathā taṃ tamevaitīti vākyaśeṣavirodha iti bhāvaḥ | nanvantakāle smaraṇādeva tatprāpteḥ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvaṃ kimarthamucyata ityata āha || sadeti || na tatprāptyarthaṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvamucyate | kintu smaran tyajatītyuktaṃ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇaṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitānāmeva bhavatīti sākṣādantakālasmaraṇopāya evocyata iti bhāvaḥ | nanu antakāla eva mahatā prayatnena bhagavatsmaraṇasya kartuṃ śakyatvāt kiṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvenetyata āha || na cediti || sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvābhāve mahatā prayatnena smarato'pyanyaviṣaya eva prārabdhakarmavaśāt smṛtirbhavati | tataśca tatprāptireva bhavati | yathā khalu mahatā prayatnena samādhiṃ kurvato'pi prārabdhakarmavaśāt tataḥ skhalanaṃ bhavati | ataḥ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvena bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ | yadi prārabdhakarmavaśādantakāle brahmasmṛtirna bhavet tarhi jñānināmapi prārabdhakarmabhāvādantakāle brahmasmṛtyabhāvena mokṣābhāvaḥ prasajyata ityata āha || aparokṣeti || aparokṣajñānināṃ smaran tyajatītyuktaṃ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇaṃ bhavutyevāto nāmokṣaḥ | tasyāprārabdhapūrvottarakarmanāśāśleṣasadbhāvāt prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ parimitatvena bhogenāvasānasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ vyākhyāne bhagavadvākyasammtimāha || prayāṇeti || nanvevaṃ sati antakālasmaraṇasya prārabdhakarmāvasānameva kāraṇaṃ, tatkāraṇatayā'parokṣajñānaṃ ceti prāptam | tathāca kiṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvenetyata āha || yukteti || satyaṃ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇasya prārabdhakarmāvasānameva kāraṇam | katkāraṇatvādaparokṣajñānaṃ ceti | tathāpi sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvaṃ ca antakālasmaraṇakāraṇaṃ bhavatyeva | aparokṣajñānasādhanatvāt | sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvasyāparokṣajñānasādhanatvena yuktacetasa ityuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anena yuktacetaso māmāśritya yatanti ye te tadbrahma viduriti yojanā sūcyate | yannityasmaraṇaṃ bhagavadaparokṣajñānasādhanamuktaṃ tadbhaktyādiyuktameva tathā | na svayameveti smṛtyā''ha || bhaktyeti || 5 || kathambhūtaḥ smartavyo'sītyasya parihāra ucyate " kavim " iti || tatrā'dityavarṇaśceccharīritvena janmādiprasaṅga ityata uktaṃ " tamasa " parastāt " iti | tadanūdya vyācaṣṭe || tamasa iti || "avyaktaṃ vai tamaḥ " iti hi śrutiḥ || 9 || kena prakāreṇa smartavyo'sītyasya parihāra ucyate " yadakṣaram " iti | tatra pūrvamantakālasmaraṇasya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvaṃ sādhanamuktvā brahmacarye tathā kathamucyata ityato brahmacaryapadaṃ tatparatayā vyācaṣṭe || mana ādīnāmiti || " tatte padaṃ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye " ityatra tatsmaraṇaprakāraṃ pravakṣya ityarthaḥ || 11 || " ekākṣaraṃ brahma " ityetadekamakṣaraṃ śabdabrahmeti pratītinirāsāya vyāyaṣṭe || eketi || āomityekamakṣaraṃ vācakaṃ yasya tadekākṣaramityarthaḥ | brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaṇyeva mukhyatvāt na pratīta evārthaḥ || 13 || brahmādīn prāptānāmapi punarjanmābhāvāt kiṃ viśiṣyābhidhīyate māmupetya punarjanma nāmuvantīti | ata ucyate " ābrāmeti " | tatrā'janānnajanirbhuvīti vacanāt janalokādisthitānāmapi janmādyabhāvāt kathaṃ brahmabhavanamārabhya punarāvṛttirucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || niyamīditi || atra janmapadaṃ maraṇasyāpyupalakṣakam || aṃsalayāviti || aṃśena bhūmau jananaṃ, layānte ca jananaṃ, tadādau maraṇaṃ cetyarthaḥ | aṃśasya maraṇaṃ cāstītyāha || tatrāpīti || aṃśato'vatīrṇatve'pi naitadayuktam | muktasyaiva mukhyatayā jananādyabhāvāt janādāvalpajananādibhāvādetadvākyasya ca tadarthatvādityuktaṃ bhavati || 16 || matprāptāvevāpunarāvṛttirityuktasthāpanāya aśeṣasṛṣṭipralayādikartṛtvamātmana ucyate " sahasra " iti | tatra sahasrapadaṃ daśaśatavācītyanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || sahasramiti || bahveva prasiddhasahasrāditi śeṣaḥ | nanu " caturyugasahasrāṇi brahmaṇo dinamucyate " ityādau yugasahasramatrasya viriñcadināditvenoktatvāt kathaṃ sahasrapadaṃ tato'pi bahvarthamityata āha || brahmaṇa iti || nātra caturmukhasyāhorātramucyate, yena sahasrapadaṃ tato'pi bahvarthaṃ na syāt | kintu parabrahmaṇo dvirarārdhātmakamahorātramiti bhāvaḥ | kuto brahmapadena parabrahmetyaṅgīkṛtya tadahorātraparatvamucyate, viriñcāhorātraparatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || avyaktāditi || evaṃ vākyaśeṣasadbāve'pi kuto nāsya viriñcāhorātraparatvamityata āha || na hīti || āhanīti || tadavasāna ityarthaḥ | evaṃ na aharāgame sarvavyaktiprabhava ityapi draṣṭavyam | nanu kathaṃ bhagavato'horātrasadbhāvaḥ | kālakṛtavikārābhāvāt | " paranāmanimeṣakānte " ityādau dviparardhakālasya nimeṣatvenoktatvāccetyāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || nityasyeti || nirvikārasyetyarthaḥ | upacāre bījamapravṛttyeti | rātrāviva pralayakāle pravṛttyābhāvādanhīvānyadā pravṛttisadbhāvāt pralayādikālo rātryāditvenopacaryata ityarthaḥ || 17 -22 || bhagavantaṃ prāptānāmapunarāvṛttiḥ, anyeṣāṃ punarāvṛttirityuktam | tatra punarāvṛttimatāmanyeṣāṃ ca kena pathā''gamanamityata ucyate " yatra " iti | yatra yanmin kāle mṛtā anāvṛttiṃ gacchanti, yasmiṃśca punarāvṛttiṃ gacchanti, yasmaṃśca punarāvṛttiṃ gacchanti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmītyanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || yatreti || nanvagnijyotirdhūmānām akālābhimānināmapi mārge mamyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt kathaṃ pratijñāvākye yatra kāle taṃ kālamityucyata ityata āha || agnīti || agnijyotirdhūmānāṃ gamyatayā vakṣyamāṇānāmiti śeṣaḥ | gamyatayā vakṣyamāṇeṣu kālābhimānināṃ bāhulyāt alpasalilayutapayasī payaḥpadasya salilopalakṣakatvavat kālapadasyetaropalakṣakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu " te'rciṣamabhisambhavanti " , " arcirādinā tatprathiteḥ " ityādau jyotiṣaḥ prathamaprāpyatayoktatvāt kathamatra joyatiṣaḥ prathamamagneḥ prāptirucyate | kutaścāharādipadasya devatāviṣayatvamityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || agniriti || evaṃ smṛtisamākhyānādukta evārtho nāharādikāle mṛtānāmapunarāvṛttyādiriti samarthitam | vipakṣe bādhakaṃ cāha || tatkāleti || yadyatrāharādikālamaraṇe apunarāvṛttyādi syāditi vivakṣā bhavettarhi agnijyotirdhūmakathanasyāhaṅgatiḥ syāt | na hyaharādāviva agnicyotirdhūmoṣu maraṇaṃ nāmāstīti bhāvaḥ | itaśca na pratīto'rtha ityāha || atheti || " ya evaṃ vidvānudagayane pramīyate devānāmeva mahimānaṃ gatvā''dityasya sāyujyaṃ gacchatyatha yo dakṣiṇe pramīyate " iti śrutāvuttarāyame kṛtasya jñānino'punarāvṛttyā brahmaprāptiṃ, dakṣiṇāyane mṛtasya karmiṇaḥ punarāvṛttyā candraprāptiṃ coktvā punarjñānina uttarāyaṇe dakṣiṇāyane vā mṛtasyāpunarāvṛttyā brahmaprāptirucyate | ata uttarāyaṇe mṛtānāṃ punarāvṛttirdakṣiṇāyane mṛtānāṃ punarāvṛttiriti niyamābhāvānnānyo'rtha iti bhāvaḥ | mahimānaṃ pūjām | maha pūjāyāmiti dhātaḥ | " ādityāccandramasam " iti śruteḥ brahmamārge'pi sūryācandramasoḥ vidyamānatvāt sūryācandramasoḥ mahimānamāpnotīti yuktam | atra jñānina uttarāyaṇe mṛtasya brahmaprāptikathanaṃ phalādhikyābhiprāyamiti jñātavyam | atra smṛtiṃ cāha || vidvāniti |. yatra tatretyasyāharādiṣu vā rātr‌yādiṣu vetyarthaḥ || 23 -26 || mārgakathanasya prayojanamucyate " naite " iti | tatra parokṣataḥ sṛtijñānamātreṇedaṃ phalamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛteyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mārgāviti || yogītyasyārtho brahma ca paśyediti | vedeṣvityasyārthaḥ " sarvapuṇyātigo yātyasau brahma tatparam " iti || 27 -28 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || saptameti || bhagavanmahimānamiti śeṣaḥ | na caivamasyāṣṭamatvena bhavitavyamiti vācyam | arjunapraśnaparihāreṇāntaritatvāt | pratijñātaṃ jñānamucyate " mayā " iti | tatra " matsthāni sarvabhūtāni " , " na ca matsthāni bhūtāni " iti vyāhatamityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || viṣṇugānīti || viṣmoḥ sparśarahitatvāt spṛṣṭvā tatrasthatvābhāvādavirodha ityarthaḥ | nanu " matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ " ityuktatvāt " bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā " iti punaruktirityata āha || mameti || pūrvaṃ svasya bhūtādhāratvādyuktam | idānīṃ svadehasyetyapaunaruktyamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhagavallakṣaṇaṃ bhūtādhāratvādikaṃ kathaṃ taddehe sambhavatītyata āha || taditi || bhagavadananyatvāddehasya tatra bhagavallakṣaṇaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ bhagavatastaddehasya cābhede punaḥ punaruktirāpannetyata āha || dehasyeti || bhagavatastaddehasya ca bhedamaṅagīkṛtya dehatvena yā lokasya bhagavaddeheṣapyacetanatvaśaṃkā jāyeta tannivṛttaye'pra bhagavallakṣaṇayuktatayā tadaikyena cetanatvamucyate | ato na punaruktiriti bhāvaḥ | yadyatra deho vivakṣitastarhi mama deha iti prasiddhaśabdaṃ vihāyātmaśabdaprayoge ko deturityato vā'ha || dehasyeti || yadyatra mama deha ityevocyeta tarhi kathamacetanasya dehasya bhagavallakṣaṇaṃ syādityāśaṃkā syāt | tatparihāsāya tasya cetanatvaṃ ca pṛthagvaktavyaṃ syāt | ātmaśabdaprayoge tūbhayamuktaṃ syāt | dvyartho hyayamātmaśabdo dehārthastasya cotanatvārthaśca | ato mamātmetyuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 4 -9 || jagatprakṛtivaśaṃ tvamudāsīnaścet tarhi prakṛtereva svātantryaṃ prāptamityata ucyate " mayā " iti | tatrāpyadhyakṣapadenaudāsīnyamevocyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || adhyakṣa iti || etadadhikṛtyākṣāṇi yasyāsāvadhyakṣa ityarthaḥ || 10 || yadyevaṃvidho bhavāṃstarhi kathaṃ kecittvāmavajānanti, kā ca teṣāṃ matirityata ucyate " avajānanti " iti | tatra bhagavato mānuṣaśarīrokteḥ " bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtasthaḥ " ityuktivirodha ityata āha || mānuṣīmiti || nātra bhagavaddehasya mānuṣatvamucyate, yena virodhaḥ syāt | kintu mūḍhānāmavajñānakāraṇatayā mānuṣasādṛśyena pratīyamānatvamevetyarthaḥ | tathāpyatra " tanumāśritam " iti bhagavatastaddehasya ca bhedokteḥ pūrvoktavirodha ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || tanveti || yathā devadattaśarīraṃ tadadhīnamevaṃ bhagavaddehasyāpi tadadhīnatvāt bhagavatastatāśritatvaprayogo gauṇa ityarthaḥ | avajñānaṃ ca na kevalamavaratayā jñānaṃ kintvanyadapyastīti bhāvena ślokaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || brahmeti || " ananyatā " , " apurṇatā " ityatra dṛṣṭiriti saṃyojyam | avatāreṣu saṅ‌karo nāma anavatārāṇāmavatāratvena, avatārāṇāmanavatāratvena jñānam | sarvasmādbhinnaḥ sarvottamaḥ svagatabhedavivarjito yathāvaditi ca jñātavyam || 11 -14 || bhagavato doṣitvādevāvajānantīti kiṃ na syādityataḥ tathātve devaprakṛtayo'pyavajñāṃ kuryuḥ, na ca tadastītyucyate " mahātmānaḥ " iti | tatraikatvenetyetadanyathāpratītinirasāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || eketi || ekatevenetyādipadacatuṣṭayasya ekamūrtarityādi yathākramaṃ vyākhyānam || 15 || pratijñātaṃ vijñānamucyate " ahaṃ kratuḥ " iti | tatra hareḥ kratvādisvarūpatvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || arcyatvāditi || ṛgañcana iti dhātuḥ | " sarvadā samaḥ, tena sāma " iti svadhā | mānāt trātīti mantro, jñāto rakṣatītyarthaḥ | uṣa pluṣa dāha iti dhātostāpatrayadagdhā uṣṭāḥ | darbhaśabdo daraṃ bibhartītyanyartastho vyākriyate | āhūtatvādyajñādāviti śeṣaḥ | agateḥ svaśaktyā gantumaśaktasya jagataḥ | kratvādibhinnasyaiva hareryogavṛttyā tattannāmakatvamitratra smṛtyantaraṃ cāha || tatattaditi || etatsmṛtāvapi pūrvamevāsyārthasyoktatvaṃ dyotayatyevaṃśabdaḥ | tattatpadārthabhinnatve hetuḥ svātantryaṃ sarvakartṛtvaṃ ca | bhinnatve kathaṃ tattannāmavācyatvam? kevalaṃ tattacchabdapravṛttinimittānantaguṇatvādevetyarthaḥ | tadadhīnatvādarthavaditi nyāyena svātantryādikaṃ ca tattacchabdavācyatve kāraṇam | oṃkāra ityāderarthaṃ smṛtyantareṇāha || omiti || ākriyate āhūyate | pāti pālayati | mānāt jñānāt || piturmahāniti || jagatpituḥ viruñcādapi mahānityarthaḥ | nidhātṛtvāt dhārakatvāt | vyāñjanāt jagadabhivyāñjakatvāt | pralayamṛtyuśabdasorarthabhedaṃ papramāṇakamāha || pralayeti || pralayādanyadā'pi saṃhartṛtvādityarthaḥ | indriyeṣu sthitvā teṣāṃ dehadhāraṇena mṛtiṃ pariharati yasmāttasmādamṛtamityarthaḥ | pravilāpayan pralaya iti śeṣaḥ | ahaṃ kraturityāderaśeṣakratvādibhoktṛtvaṃ cārthaḥ || 16 -19 || tatra bhagavataḥ sarvayajñādibhoktṛtve traividyabhāgavatayoḥ phalabhedo na syādityāśaṃkya parihriyate " traividyāḥ " iti | tadeva prapañcyate " ye'pīti " | tatra traividyābhāgavatayoḥ bhagavadyājitvasāmye'pi phalabhedaḥ sahetukamuktaḥ | tasya sphuṭamapratīteḥ smṛtyaiva tadvyācaṣṭe || ananyeti || anyadevatābhaktā yajanta iti traividyānāmanyadevatāyājitvamuktam | bhāgavatānāṃ tatpratiyogitayoktasya " ananyāḥ " ityasyārthaḥ " ananyadevatāyāgāt " iti | " na tu māmabhijānanti tattvena " iti traividyasyātiśayabhaktijñānābhāva uktaḥ | tattvajñānābhāve bhaktyabhāvāt | tatpratiyogityoktasya " paryupāsate " ityasyārtho " bhaktyudrekāt " iti | bhakyudrekeṇopāsanasyaiva paryupāsanatvāt | " svargatiṃ prarthayante kāmakāmāḥ " iti traividyānāṃ kāmanamuktam | tatpratiyogitayoktasya " cintayanto mām " ityasyārthaḥ " akāmanāt " iti | māmeva cintayanto na tu kāmamityarthaḥ | " māmiṣṭvā māmaiva yajanti " iti traividyānāmante samarpaṇamuktam | tatpratiyogitayoktasya " nityābhiyuktānāṃ " ityasyārthaḥ " sadāyogāt " iti | sarvadā smaraṇoddeśādiyogādityarthaḥ | vaiśiṣṭyaṃ phalenādhikyam | " yogakṣemaṃ vahāmi " ityapunarāvṛttipuruṣārthadānasyoktatvāt | vaiṣṇavādapi bhagavadyājitve'pītyarthaḥ | " paśūn devatābhyaḥ pratyauhat " ityādau brahmādīnāmapyanyadevatāyājitvaṃ śrūyata ityata āha || vaiṣṇavā iti || na tu devatātvenetyarthaḥ | nanu traividyānāmavidhipūrvakatvavivaraṇapūpeṇa " na tu mamābhijānanti " iti padena tattvājñānābhāva uktaḥ | tatpratiyogitayā bhāgavatasya tattvājñānaṃ kimiti noktamityataḥ paryupāsanapadenaivauktamiti bhāvena tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || 20 -23 || " na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaḥ cyavanti te " ityatra bhagavantamajānatāṃ tattveneti viśeṣaṇāt viparītaṃ jānatāṃ vā'traividyānāṃ svargabhogānantaraṃ cyavanamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || māmiṣṭveti || na cātra " na tu māmabhijānanti tattvena " ityuktatvāt bhagavantamajānatāṃ mithyājñānāṃ vā traividyānāṃ svargāt cyavanamucyata iti kalpyam | " na tu māmabhijānanti tattvena " ityasya sarvadevavaratvena jānanto'pi brahmarudrādīnāṃ tatparivāratvādikaṃ samyaṅ na jānantītyarthopapatteḥ | kuto'yamarthaḥ kalpyate? " traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante " iti traividyasyānte sarvasamarpaṇena bhagavadyajanaprārthanayoruktatvāt sarvadevavaratvājñāne tadasambhavāt | abhiśabdabalācceti bhāvaḥ | itaśca svargabhogānantaraṃ cyavanaṃ nātra kevalājñānāṃ mithyājñānināṃ cocyata ityāha || sarveti || sarvadevavaratvaneti kevalājñānāṃ yajñādikarmāṇi moghāni mithyājñānināṃ viparītaphalāni bhavantītyuktatvāt " bhogānantaraṃ cyavanamatra kevalājñāsya mithyājñanino vocyata ityarthaḥ | mithyājñānī ced yāti cāndhantamo dhruvamiti | uktaṃ vivṛṇvannupasaṃharati || 24 -28 || bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmīti bhaktapriyatvamuktam | tathāsatyabhakteṣvaprītiśca syāt | tataśca bhagavato vaiṣamyamāpannamityata ucyate " samo'haṃ " iti | tadasphuṭārthatvāt smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || nāsyeti || bhakto'pi yo deveṣyo'sau nāsti | abhakto'pi yaḥ priyo'sau nāstītyarthaḥ | anena " na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ " ityatrāpi bhaktobhaktaśceti saṃyojyamityuktaṃ bhavati | bhaktyanusāreṇa phalada iti bhakteṣveva prītiṃ karomyabhakteṣvevāprītimityarthaḥ | yadi bhakteṣu dveṣam abhakteṣu prītiṃ kuryāttarhyeva viṣamaḥ syāt | na caivam | ataḥ sama eveti bhāvaḥ | ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā teṣu prītiṃ karomīti vaktavyam | kimetadabhaktasādhāraṇaṃ mayi ta ityādyucyata ityata āha || prītyeti || vartanta ityādi | śeṣaḥ | tadevocyata iti bhāvaḥ || 29 -31 || nanu bhagavadāśritāḥ sarve'pi puṇyā eva | " sattvādhikaḥ pulkaso'pi yastu bhāgavataḥ sadā " ityadeḥ | ataḥ kathaṃ " māṃ hi pārtha " iti strīvaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ pāpayonaya iti viśeṣaṇaṃ, brāhmaṇarājarṣīṇāṃ puṇyā iti viśeṣaṇamucyata ityata āha || pāpādīti || svato viprādyuttamasarṇānāṃ kṣatriyādyamavarṇitvaṃ pāpakāritam | svataḥ śūdrādyadhamavarṇānāṃ vaiśyādyuttamavarṇitvaṃ puṇyakāritamityarthaḥ | atrādipadena kāmaśca bhavati | svābhāvikavipratvādyāḥ puṇyā ityucyanta ityarthaḥ | tallakṣaṇamāha || muktigā iti || muktāvavaśiṣyāmāṇavipratvādyāḥ svābhāvikā ityarthaḥ | yathā svato viprādīnāṃ kṣatriyāditvaṃ svataḥ kṣatriyādīnāṃ viprāditvaṃ bhavati tathā svābhāvikapuṃsāṃ strītvaṃ, svābhāvikastrīṇāṃ puṃstvaṃ syātkimityāśaṃkāyāmāha || yāntīti || pāpato yathā sudyumnasya ilātvaṃ, kāmato yathā'gniputrāṇāmapsarastvam | ilāyāḥ sudyumnatva darśanāt kathaṃ " na striyo yānti puṃstvaṃ " ityucyata ityata āha || svabhāvāditi |. svabhāvādeva striyā ambāyāḥ śikhaṇḍitvaṃ sthūṇākarṇavareṇa dṛṣṭamityata āha || puṃseti || ambāyāḥ sthūṇākarṇavareṇa taddehe tena saha tasmin janmani sthitirevāsīnna tu svātantryeṇa puruṣadehaḥ | tāvanmātraṃ tvaṅgīkrayata iti bhāvaḥ | svabhāvāt puṃsāṃ pāpataḥ strītve tāsāṃ svābhāvataḥ strīṇāṃ ca madhye kāsāṃ śreṣṭhatvamityapekṣāyāmāha || varā iti || pāpajātabhya ityanena kāmato jātānāṃ varatvaṃ sūcitam | svabhāvataḥ strīṇāṃ pāpajātābhyaḥ śreṣṭhatāyām ilādibhya āsurīṇāṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ prasajyate | tannirāsārthamuktaṃ -- satstriya iti | atrāvaratvamaupādhikamabhipretam | svābhāvikāvaśeṣasya kālāntaraṃ cāha || sarveṣāmiti || caramadehaḥ svabhāvānusārītyarthaḥ | pūrvānuvādena kālāntaraṃ cāha || muktau tviti || iti vacanānusāreṇa aviruddhatayā vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvādetadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | anena etadevaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | ye pāpādiyonayo'svābhāvikāḥ striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrā brāhmaṇā rājarṣayaśca te'pi yānti parāṃ gatim | kiṃ punaḥ punaḥ puṇyāḥ svābhāvikā ete strīvaiśyādayaḥ | atra pāpayonayaḥ striya itivat pumāṃsa ityanuktiḥ pāpādikāritapuṃsāmabhāvāditi || 32 -33 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || hariḥ oṃ|| ṣaṣṭhe dhyānamuktam || tatra dhyeyatayā bhagavadvibhūtirūpāṇyatrocyanta ityadhyāyārthasyātirohitatvādanuktiḥ | bhūyo mahimānaṃ śrṛṇviti pratijñātamucyate " na me viduḥ " iti | tatra me mahimānaṃ suragaṇāḥ maharṣayaśca na vidurityevoktatvād gandharvādayo vidurityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || upalakṣaṇārthamiti || suragaṇā maharṣaya iti padadvayaṃ sarvopalakṣakam | suragaṇādīnāmajñāne'nyeṣāṃ sutarāṃ tadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ || 1 -2 || svajñānānmokṣākhyamahimā'trotyate " yo mām " iti | tatra ajamityuktatvādanādimiti punaruktirityata āha || anasyeti || ano mukhyaprāṇaḥ ||3 || svajñānānmokṣākhyamahimā cocyate " buddhiḥ " iti | tatra buddhijñānaśabdayorekārthatvamityato buddhiśabdasyārthāntaratve smṛtimāha || buddhiriti || bhut bodhaḥ | tadāśrayatvāt jaladhiritivat tajjñānāśrayo'ntaḥ karaṇaṃ buddhirityucyata ityarthaḥ || 4 || na kevalaṃ bhūtānāṃ buddhyādikaṃ matto pratimanvantaraṃ saptarṣibhedokteratra ke vivakṣitā iti cetpūrvamanvantarasthā eva | pūrva iti viśeṣaṇāt | ke pūrvamanvantarasthā ityatastān smṛtyaiva darśayati || marīciriti || caturdaśamanuṣu catvāro'tra ke vivakṣitā ityato na kevalamatra manupadena prasiddhamanavo'pi tu sarvadevāḥ | teṣāṃ catuṣṭvaṃ viprādivarṇavivakṣayetyetra smṛtimāha || manava
