tatsvarūpaṃ tasyaiva viśiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ | viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoratyantābhede kathamākārabhedenāpi jñātatvājñātatvamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharannuktaṃ vivṛraṇoti || ekatveti || viśiṣṭavaśeṣyayorevatvānubhavāt nānavasthādoṣaḥ | abhede'pi viśeṣānubhavāt tadbalenaikasyaiva jñātatvājñātatvānubhavāt na praśnāsambhavadoṣo'pītyarthaḥ | nanu viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoḥ bhedābhedau kiṃ na syātām | tathātve bhedena praśnāsambhavasya parihartuṃ śakyatvādabhede nānavasthādeśca parihartuṃ śakyatvāditi cet | kiṃ viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoḥ kvacidbhedābhedāvaṅgīkriyete uta sarvatrāpi ? ādye sampratipattiḥ | ayāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya viśeṣyeṇa bhedābhedāṅgīkārāt | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati || bhedābhedāviti || tau pareṇāṅgīkṛtau | sarvatra viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoriti śeṣaḥ | kartṛbhoktṛviśeṣaṇa iti || kartṛtvabhoktṛtve viśeṣaṇe yasya viśiṣṭasya tasminnityarthaḥ | kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādiyāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaviṣaye kartā bhoktā madanyo'haṃ ceti viśeṣeṇa bhedābhedānubhavābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | etena kartṛbhoktrādiviśiṣṭaviśeṣayayorabhedapratipādanenaiva yaduktaṃ cetanaviśeṣāṇāmāvirbhāvatirobhāvavatāṃ kartṛtvadīnāṃ viśeṣiṇā'bhinnatvaṃ tadapi samarthitaṃ bhavati | atha nityābhivyaktānāṃ svarūpatvādīnāṃ cābhedaṃ sādhayati || bheda iti || nityābhivyaktasyeti śeṣaḥ || āntarasyeti || dehopādhitvaṃ vinā cetanagatasyetyarthaḥ | śuddhasvarūpa ityādau śuddhasvarūpatvavastutvādīnāṃ nityābhivyaktaviśeṣāṇāṃ śuddhasvarūpo mukta iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenābhedasyaiva darśanādviśiṣṭaviśeṣyayorabhede viśeṣaṇābhedasya niyatadatvāditi bhāvaḥ | āvirbhāvatirobhāvavatāṃ kartṛtvādiviśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣicaitanyaikyajñānādiviśeṣāṇāmapi viśeṣyaikyaṃ sādhayati || apṛthagiti || pṛthaktvena darśanābhāvaniyamādityarthaḥ | nanu yathocyate śuddhasvarūpa ityādi yathā ca kartā bhoktā balavān vidvāniti tathā kṛṣṇaḥ sthūla ityādi yocyate | ato dehanimittānāṃ kārṣṇyādiviśeṣāṇāmapi caitanyaikyaṃ syādityata āha || bāhyeti || nāsmābhirubhayavidhaviśeṣṭaviśeṣyayoḥ sāmānādhikaṇyamātrādviśeṣāṇāṃ caitanyaikyamucyate | kintu bhedādarśane sati sāmānādhikaraṇyena | na cātra kṛṣṇadevadattayoḥ bhedādarśanaṃ, yena ca kārṣṇyaṃ devadattasvarūpaṃ syāt | bhedasyaiva dṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | eke tu śuddhasvarūpatvādīnāṃ nityābhivyaktānāmeva viśeṣāṇāṃ caitanyaikyaṃ, na tu kartṛtvādīnāmiti manyante | nān nirākaroti || viśeṣeti || śuddhasvarūpatvādīnāmeva caitanyaikyaṃ na tu kartṛtvādīnāmiti devaividhyaṃ kiṃ yatkiñciddhetubalena kalpyate tadvinā vā? nādyaḥ | tadadarśanāt | na dvitāyaḥ | rakartṛtvādīnāmapyaikyopapattau vṛthā dvaividhyakalpne kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt | aprāmāṇikapramāṇaviruddhakalpanaprasakteśca | yadi kalpanāgauravādidoṣānaṅgīkṛtyāpi kartṛtvādīnāṃ bhinnatvamucyate tarhi śuddhasvarūpatvādayo'pi viśeṣā bhinnā evetyatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt | parasya doṣabhayābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ cetane viśeṣāderatyantābhedaḥ samarthitaḥ | tannyāyenācetane'pi yāvad‌dravyabhāvino viśeṣāderviśeṣiṇā'tyantābhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | ayāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣasya yau bhedābhedāvuktau tau samarthayati || naikatvamiti || ekatvaṃ nānātvaṃ ca nāstītyakte'nirvacanīyatvaśaṃkā syāt | tannirāsāya niyamādityuktam | ata ekaikasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | anubhavādantathā gatyabhāvācca naikatvam, nāpi nānātvamiti sambandhaḥ | nanu cetane'pi bhedābhedasadbhāvena cetanācetanayorekaprakāratvāt acetana iti kiṃ viśiṣyābhidhīyata ityata āha |. eka iti || ahaṃ madabhinno ghaṭāderbhinna iti cetane bhinnapratiyogikāveva bhedābhedāvanubhūyete | acetane tvekapratiyogikāveva | ato na cetanācetanayorekaprakāratetyarthaḥ | kathamacotane bhedābhedāvanubhavasiddhāvityataḥ tantvādyavayavebhyaḥ paṭādyavayavino bhedābhedasadbhāve'nubhavakathanena tantvādīnāṃ paṭatvādiviśeṣairbhetābhedasadbhāve'nubhavaḥ pradarśita eva bhavatīti manvāna āha || ekamiti || tantūnāṃ paṭarūpeṇaikatvasya parasparaṃ bhedasya cānubhavāderakaikatantoḥ paṭena bhedābhedāvanubhūyete | ekaikatantoḥ paṭenātyantābhede'nyonyabhedānubhavāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | gatyantarābhāvaṃ cāha || tantubhya iti || yadyekaikatantoḥ paṭo'tyantabhinnastarhyekaikatantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ pṛthag dṛśyata | na caitadasti | nāpyekaikatantunā paṭo'tyantābhinnaḥ | yathāsvasaṃsthānaviśeṣeṇāvasthitaikaikatantubhāve paṭābhāvānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ | sarvāvayavasamudāyasya svayamabahutvāt tadbhāve'vayavyabhāvābhāvāt saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇāvasthitānāmevāvayavatvāt avayavinā'tyantābhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | yathā''tmagatānāṃ kartṛtvādiviśeṣāṇāṃ bahutve'pyekenā'tmanā'tyantābhedaḥ tathā bahutvepi tantūnāṃ ekena paṭenātyantābhedaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || na ceti || kimannoktasya vyabhicāraścocyate utātmagataviśeṣadṛṣṭāntena jaḍe'pyantābhedasādhanamātram? nādyaḥ | atra kartṛtvādīnāṃ bahutvābhāvāt | vyavahāraviśeṣasya svanirvāhakaviśeṣeṇaivopapatteruktatvāt | nāpi dvitāyaḥ | kartā'haṃ bhoktā'hamityekaikaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyātmano bhedānubhavenaikaikaviśeṣasyāpi kevalābhedānubhavāt | ekaikasmiṃśca tantau paṭapratyayābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | kimacetane paṭādāvantyāvayavinyeva avayavāvayavinorbhedābhedāviti ? netyāha || atreti || acetane paṭādau svāvayavairbhedābhedau tadavayavasyāpi svāvayavairbhedābhedāvityevam aparyavasānameva bhavedityarthaḥ | paramāṇornityatvena tatra paryavasānasambhavāt kathamanavasthitirityata āha || na ceti || na kevalaṃ niravayavatve pramāṇābhāvāt kathamanavasthitiritya āha || na ceti || na kevalaṃ niravayavatve pramāṇābhāvāt paramāṇoḥ sāvayavatvam | api tu pūrvāparādibhāgabhedena sāvayavatvāvagamāccetyāha || pūrveti || svataḥ paramāṇoravayavābhāve'pi pūrvādidigupādhikṛtāvayavasadbhāvāt tadviṣayo'sāvavagama iti cet kimupādhiḥ paramāṇorekadeśasambaddho bhavet tarhyekadeśasya prāgeva sattvāt prāgeva santamavayavabhedaṃ jñāpayedityeva prāptamityarthaḥ | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati || akhilamiti || nanu guṇādīnāṃ niravayavatvāt kathaṃ "na cānavayavaṃ vastu kvacit syāt " ityucyata ityata āha || tasmāditi || pūrvāparādibhāgabhedena aṃśāvagamādaupādhikāṃśasya nirastatvādityarthaḥ | evamavayavāyavayavinorbhedābhedasamarthanena || bhāveti || jaḍe vastuni guṇakriyādīnāmayāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣāṇāṃ svasadbhāvadaśāyāṃ bhedābhedāveva yuktau | nīlaṃ phalamiti teṣāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena bhāvavyavahṛtarabhedasyāṅgīkāryatvāt | vastuni vidyamāne'pi kadācinna nīlaṃ phalamityabhāvavyavahṛterbhedasyāpyaṅgīkāryatvāt | atyantābhede vastuni sati tadvināśāsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ vināśānantaraṃ tu bheda eveti jñātavyaṃ, svayamasato'bhedāyogāt | tvadanyenetyarjunādadhamavivakṣayoktatvādityāha || tvaditi || naitāvata'rjunādhamairna dṛṣṭamiti kalpanīyam | adhamairapyarjunavanna dṛṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇaivādṛṣṭatvasyoktatvādityāha || tairiti || bhavedevaitad vyākhyānaṃ yadi viśvarūpaṃ brahmādibhirindreṇārjunādadhamaiśca dṛṣṭaṃ, indreṇa cārjunavadeva dṛṣṭaṃ, arjunādadhamaintadvanna dṛṣṭamityetatsidhyet, tadeva kuta ityata āha || viśvarūpamiti || indrasyādhikadarśatve'lpadarśitve vā viśiṣya tvayendraśarīreṇa draṣṭamityuktirna nambhavati | ādhikye'nukterādhamye niṣedhasya cādarśanāt || 47 || yadyanyeṣāmapi vaśvarūpadarśanamatrābhipretaṃ syāttarhi "na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānaiḥ " ityuttaravākyavirodha ityata āha || vedeti || nottaravākye'rjunādanyeṣāṃ viśvarūpadarśanābhāva ucyate | kintu tvadavaraistvadvanna dṛṣṭamityukteḥ svatastathā darśanābhāve'pi vedādisādhanaistathā tairdṛśyatāmityāśaṃkya tvadavarairvedādisādhanairapi tvadvanna draṣṭuṃ śakyata ityevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | viśvarūpasyārjunādanyenādṛṣṭatvamevārthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cenna | udāhṛtasmṛtivirodhāt | atrāpi "dṛṣṭvā'dbhutaṃ pūpaṃ ", "dṛṣṭā lokāḥ " ityādipūrvavākyavirodhaḥ syādityata āha || anyatheti || 48 -49 || "svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa " iti kṛṣṇarūpasya viśiṣya svīyatvokteḥ yaduktaṃ viśvarūpasya sākṣādīśvarasvarūpatvaṃ tadayuktamityata āha || svavaditi || nātra svakaśabdena kṛṣṇarūpasya svakīyatvamucyate, yena viśvarūpasya svakīyatvaṃ na syāt | kintu svavat svakīyavat kriyate pradarśyata iti vyutpattyā svakīyatayā pradarśanīyatvamevetyarthaḥ | nanūbhayorapi bhagavadīyatayā pradarśyamānatvāt kṛṣṇarūpasyaiva kuto viśeṣoktirityata āha || viśvarūpamiti || satyamubhayaṃ pūpaṃ bhagavadīyatayā pradarśyata, iti, kintu jñānināmeva | ajñānināṃ tu kṛṣṇarūpameva bhagavadīyatayā pradarśyate | na tu viśvarūpamato'jñavivakṣayā viśeṣoktiryukteti bhāvaḥ | ata evālpajñānivivakṣayā svavadityuktam | kimarthamevaṃ vyākhyeyam? viśvarūpaṃ bhagavadīyameva kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || kṛṣṇarūpaviśvarūpayoḥ svakīyatvāsvakīyatvapratītinirākaraṇaprasaṅgena paramaṃ pūpaṃ darśayāmāseti viśvarūpasya paratyoktyā kṛṣṇarūpasyāparatvaṃ smṛtyaiva nirākaroti || pareti || anyathā svabhāvataḥ | tarhi viśvarūpa eva paratvaṃ viduṣāmapi kathaṃ dṛśyata ityata āha || vyaktiriti || viśvarūpe paratvavyāktirnāvatārarūpeṣu || atastathā dṛṣṭiryukteti bhāvaḥ | iyaṃ ca vyaktiralpajñānivivakṣayocyate | na tu brahmādimahājñānivivakṣayaṭā | teṣāṃ kṛṣṇādāvapi paratvasya pratīterityāha || ajñeti || 50 || nanu "dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ " iti kṛṣṇarūpasya mānuṣatvokteḥ kathaṃ nāvaratvamityata āha || kiñciditi || anyathodāhṛtavākyavirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ || 51 || nanu "sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ " ityatra apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇa eva vartante, na tu paśyantītyuktatvāt kathamarjunāduttamairadhamaiśca viśvarūpasya dṛṣṭatvamucyata ityatastadvākyaṃ yathāvadyojayati || ya iti || anena yanmama rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi, asya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇo ye devāste'pi yaddṛṣṭantastadidaṃ sudurdarśamiti yojanāsūcitā bhavati | anyathoktavirodha iti bhāvaḥ || 52 || iti śrīmadānandatirthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitayāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || atha dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || sādhaneti || mokṣasādhanayoravyaktabhagavadupāsanayormadhye prāguktabhagavadupāsanasyādhikyanirṇayo'smin adhyāye kriyata ityarthaḥ | nanu bhagadupāsanasyevāvyaktopāsanasyāpi yadi mokṣasādhanatvaṃ kvaciduktaṃ syāttadā "evaṃ satatayuktāḥ" iti sandihya praśno yujyate | na ca tadastītyataḥ kathaṃ praśna ityata āha || śriya iti || yaḥ puruṣaḥ śrīsamārādhanārthaṃ jāto'sau tadarthameva gṛhānnirgato bhavati sa śriyaṃ upadeṣṭrabhyo gurubhya eva svasya vayo dhatte | evaṃ śriyamupāsīnāḥ puruṣā amṛtatvaṃ yānti | tasmin guruśiṣyākhye mithune samīhitāni satyāni bhavantītyarthaḥ | kiṃ śriya upāsanaṃ svātantryeṇaiva mokṣasādhanamityataḥ śrīprasādamutpādya tato bhagavatprasādadvāreṇaiveti bhāvena smṛtimāha || śrīriti || śrīprasādasya bhagavatprasādotpādakatvaṃ kuta ityataḥ śriyo'timānamāha || avyaktamiti || evambhūtā cet śrīstarhi tatprasādaḥ svayameva puruṣārthahetuḥ kiṃ na syāt? īśvaraprasādasādhanatvaṃ tasya kimarthamucyata ityata āha || tasyā iti || śriyo'pi viṣṇoḥ paramatvānna tatprasādasya svātantryeṇa puruṣārthasādhanatvaṃ, kintu viṣṇuprasādatvenaivetyarthaḥ | viṣṇoḥ mahadbrahmabhūtaśriya uttamatve hetumāha || ya iti || evaṃ śrutipurāṇavākyebhyo viṣṇūpāsanasyevāvyaktopāsanasyāpi mokṣasādhanamiti śaṃkayottamasādhanaṃ pṛcchatītyarthaḥ | yadi bhagavadupāsanasyeva śriya upāsanasyāpi mokṣasādhanatvaṃ pratīyeta tarhi tadviṣaya eva praśnaḥ kartavyaḥ | avyaktopāsanaviṣaye kimarthaṃ kriyata ityata āha || kūṭastha iti || "kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate" ityuparitanavākye citprakṛtāveva prayuktakūṭasthākṣaraśabdayoratrāpyavyakte prayuktatvenāvyaktaṃ citprakṛtireva | ataḥ citprakṛtyupāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvapratītyā'vyaktopāsanaviṣaye praśno yukta eveti bhāvaḥ | etena "ityādiśrutibhyaḥ", "avyaktopāsanāt" ityasyāpyanavadyatvaṃ sidhyati | nanvavyaktādiśabdānāṃ parabrahmaṇi mukhyatvādatra tatkiṃ vivakṣitaṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || yadyatrāvyaktaśabdena parabrahmocyeta tarhi tvadupāsakāvyaktopāsakānāṃ madhye ka uttama iti bhagavato'vyaktasya ca bhedenārjunapraśno'nupapannaḥ syādityarthaḥ | kuto'nupapanna ityato'rjunenaiva bhagavataḥ parabrahmatvasyoktatvādityāha || paramiti | anye tvatrāvyaktapadena yatkiñcicchūnyāparanāmakaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahmocyata iti manvānāḥ tadupānakeśvaropāsakayoḥ ko'dhika iti praśnārthaṃ kalpayitvā'vyoktopāsakānāmevādhikyaṃ parihāre kathyata iti vadanti | tān pratyāha || ye tviti || "te me yuktātamā matāḥ" iti bhagavatā svopāsakanāmuttamatvamuktvā "mayyeva" iti madupāsakānāmevottamatvāt madupāsaka eva bhaveti sphuṭamuktatvādavyaktopāsakānāmādhikyaṃ vadatāmapalāpakatvameva | tataśca sāhasikatvāt "aho naṣṭā ete" iti śokaviṣayatvameva na tu parihāraṃ vaktaṃ prativāditvamityarthaḥ | nanu ceṣṭāvatyāḥ śriyo'calatvam "acalaṃ dhruvam" iti kathamucyata ityataḥ smṛtyaiva tadghaṭayati || neti || "anirdeśyamavyaktamacintyaṃ paryupāsate" iti vyāhatam | anirdeśyāvyaktācintayasyopāsanāyogādityataḥ anirdeśyatvādikamupāsyatvāvirodhena smṛtyaiva ghaṭayati || sūkṣmatvāditi || madupāsakā evottamā ityucyate "mayi iti | tvadupāsakānāmivāvyaktopāsakānāmapi mokṣasadbhāvāt kathaṃ teṣāmuttamatvamityato'vyaktopāsakānāṃ mokṣamaṅgīkṛtya sahetukaṃ svopāsakānāmuttamatvamucyate "ye tvakṣaram' iti | tatrocyamānabhagavatprāptiḥ na kevalaśākteyānāmiti bhāvena mayītyādikaṃ śrutyaiva vyācaṣṭai || aviṣṇujñairiti || atra "dhyāyīta nityadā" ityantena parītyupasargābhiprāya ukto bhavati | "tena tuṣṭā"ityanena "te prāpnuvanti māmeva" ityasyābhiprāya ukto bhavati | evamavyaktopāsanasya mokṣasādhanatve'pi na tadevottamaṃ mantavyamiti bhāvenāha || tathāpīti || upāsate śriyā saheti śeṣaḥ | anena "mayyāveśya" ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | avyaktopāsakānāmapi mokṣasadbhāve kathaṃ bhagavadupāsakānāmuttamatvamityata āha || yata iti || anena "kleśaḥ" iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | anena uktaprakāreṇa paryupāsanam indriyagrāmātiniyamanaṃ, sarvatra samabuddhitvaṃ, sarvabhūtahiteratvādisuṣṭvācāramantareṇa avyaktaprasādābhāvāt paramaśraddhāmātrayuktānāṃ suṣṭvācārāderaunye'pi bhagavatprasādasambhavāt kleśādhikayaṃ jñātavyam | itaśca bhagavadupāsanamevottamamityāha || viṣṇuneti || śriyā saha bhagavadupāsane dvayorapi paramaprasādasambhavenācirāt mokṣo bhavati | pṛthagavyaktopāsanapakṣe tu kiñcidbhagavadupāsanaṃ kṛtvā bahukālaṃ pṛthak śriyamupāsya punaḥ śriyā saha nirantaraṃ bhagavadupāsanaṃ kartavyam | tato muktiriti cireṇaiva bhavatītyato'pi bhagavadupāsanamevādhikamiti bhāvaḥ | anena "ye tu sarvāṇi" ityetaduktārthaṃ bhavati | hetudvayenoktaṃ viṣṇūpāsanasyādhikyamupasaṃharati || tasmāditi || teṣāmādhikyaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ || ye nityayuktāste yuktatamā ityayuktam | ekārthatvādityata āha || yukteti || nityuyuktapadaṃ nityodyuktārthamiti ca draṣṭavyam | nanu 'ye tu sarvāṇi'ityatrānanyayogena bhagavadupasanasyottamatvamucyate | ataḥ kathaṃ śriyā sahitabhagavadupāsanasya ādhikyakathanaparatayaitadvyākhyāyata ityāśaṃkāṃ pramāṇavākyenaiva pariharati || viṣṇoriti || nātrānanyayogapadena anyopāsanasmbandho niṣiddhyate | kintvanyasya bhagavadadhīnatvaṃ tatparivāratvaṃ vinopāsanam | ato yuktaṃ prājīnavyākhyānamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadi bhagavadupāsakānāmivāvyaktopāsakānāmapi mokṣaśravaṇāt tadupāsanaviṣaye kimuttamamiti praśnaḥ kriyate tarhi 'jñātvā śivaṃ śāntimatyantameti', 'hariṃ haraṃ virañcaṃ ca jñātvā mucyeta saṃsṛteḥ' ityanyadevatopāsanasyāpi mokṣahetutvaśravaṇāt tadviṣaye kimiti praśno na kriyata ityāśaṃkāṃ siṃhāvalokananyāyena pariharati || antavaditi || anyadevatopāsanāyā mokṣasādhanatvasya pūrvameva niṣiddhatvena śrutyādau taduktāvapi tasyānyārthatvaṃ kalpayitvā'vyaktopāsanaviṣaya eva praśnaḥ kṛto nānyadevatopāsanaviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ | tarhi nāmānyato bhagavadanyopāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvasya pūrvameva niṣiddhatvenāvyaktopāsanasyāpi tadabhāvaprāptestadvacanānāmapyarthāntaram akalpayityā kimiti tadviṣaye praśnaṛ kiyata ityata uktam || lakṣmyā iti || sāmānyato bhagavadanyopāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvamiṣedhe'pi lakṣmyāḥ bhagavadatipriyatvenānyebhyo viśeṣasadbhāvāt tadupāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvasambhavena niṣdhasya tadatiriktopāsanaviṣayatvaṃ kalpayitvā'rjunenānyopāsanaviṣayapraśnamakṛtvāpyavyaktopāsanaviṣaya eva praśnaḥ kṛta iti bhāvaḥ | madupāsanasyādhikatvāttadeva kuru | tadalābhe māṃ jānīhī | tadabhāve cābhyāsayogena māṃ jānihī | tadabhāve ca matkarmaparo bhava | tadaśaktau ca madyogamāśritaḥ karmaphalatyāgaṃ kurvityucyate -- 'mayi' iti | tatra matkarmakṛttvameva madyogaḥ | ataḥ kathametadityataḥ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || vāṣṇavānīti || sarvakarmāṇi vaiṣṇavāni karotīti yojanā | viṣṇuviṣayatayā karotītyarthaḥ | arcāmārjanaṃ pratimāsnāpanam | ādipadena dhyānaṃ ca grāhyam | tadyogamātravān tatkarmatvopāyamātravān | anena madyogamiti matkarmatvayogamiti vyākhyātam | yadi bhagavatkarmatvaṃ kāmayate tarhyeva tadyogo bhavati | na tu kāmyenānyopāsanādinetyarthaḥ | anena 'sarvakarma' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | bhagavadupāsane'pi tāratamyamāha || asamyagiti || dhyānālābhe jñānaṃ, tadalābhe'bhyāsa ityetatsamarthyate -- 'śreyo hi' iti | tadanena vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | jñānapūrvadhyāne'pi sakāmānniṣkāmamevādhikamityāha || tasmāt || iti | tatra hetumāha || tasmāditi || anena 'dhyānāt' ityetad vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | nanvatra tyāgācchāntiḥ phalamucyate | ataḥ kathamucyate tasmānmuktirityata āha || śāntiriti || nanvatra karmaphalatyāgamātrasyaiva dhyānādhikyamucyata iti kiṃ neṣyate? jñānapūrvaṃ dhyānasāhityaṃ kimucyate? ityato vā''ha || śāntiriti || atra tyāgasya śāntipadoditamuktihetutvamicyate | na ca tatkevalatyāgagrahaṇe yuktam | 'saṃnyāsastu mahāvāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ' ityuktatvāt | jñānapūrvakadhyānasahitatyāgasya tatsambhavāt sa evatra vivakṣita iti bhāvaḥ || 4 -15 || 'ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi ityādi prapañcyate -- 'adveṣṭā' iti | tatra 'sarvārambhaparityāgī' ityetadanyathāpratītinirāsāya caturdhā vyācaṣṭe || avaiṣṇaveti || uktārthānupapādayati || sarveti || sarvakarmaphalatyāgamityanena sarvārambhaphalaparityāgena sarvārambhaparityāgītyuktaṃ siddhyati | mayītyanena sarvāmbhābhimānatyāgena sarvārambhāṇāṃ bhagavati samarpaṇena ca sarvārambhaparityāgītyuktaṃ siddhyati | 'mayi' iti vākyasya smṛtyaiva tathā vyākhyātatvāt | ādipadagṛhītena 'sarvadharmān parityajya' ityādinā'vaiṣṇavārambhaparityāgena sarvārambhaparityāgītyuktaṃ siddhyati | tasya tathā sayuktikaṃ vyākariṣyamāṇatvāt | nanu 'sarvārambhaparityāgī' ityasya 'śubhāśubhaparityāgī' iti prapañcyamānatvāt avaiṣṇavārambhapirityāgītyādikaṃ kiṃ viśiṣyābhidhīyata ityatastatsmṛtyaiva uktāviruddhatayā vyācaṣṭe || bhaktimiti || upalakṣaṇe caitat | tatsādhanatayā vaiṣṇavārambhāṃśceti jñātavyam | 'samaduḥkhasukhaḥ', 'harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmuktaḥ' ityetanniyamapratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || prāya iti || tathocyate sukhādiṣu samo harṣādivarjita ucyeta | evaṃ cedalpavaiṣamyādervidyamānatvāt kathaṃ tadabhāvoktirityata āha || yatheti || mukhyārtha eva kiṃ na syādityata āha || na hīti || nanu harṣasya guṇatvāt kathaṃ tatparityāgo'pekṣitatayocyata ityato harṣaśabdasya heyārthatāṃ smṛtyaiva darśayati || hṛtiriti || manasa iti śeṣaḥ | nanu 'adveṣṭā' ityādāvadveṣādimatāṃ priyatvamātramuktvā ' ye tu dharmyāmṛtam ' ityatra śraddhādimatāmatipriyatvaṃ kiṃ nimittamucyata ityata āha || vyastenet || ' adveṣṭā ' ityādau yat pṛthak pṛthak sādhanamuktaṃ tattanmātreṇa priyatvamuktam | ' ye tu ' ityatrādveṣṭetyādiprāguktasamastasādhanenātīvapriyatvam | vyastāt samastasyādhikyāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu ' adveṣṭā ' ityādāvadveṣādisādhanena priyatvamucyate, ' ye tu ' iti bhaktyā'tīva priyatvamucyata iti kiṃ na syāta bhakteḥ sarvasādhanottamatvādityata āha || bhaktiriti || adveṣādikathane'pi bhakteruktatvāt nāyaṃ vibhāgo yukta iti bhāvaḥ | ' yanmānnodvijate lokaḥ ' iti vyastasādhanakathane bhakteranuktatvāt kathaṃ bhaktistu vyasteṣvayuktaivetyucyata ityata āha || yasmāditi || 17 -19 || dharmyāmṛtapadasya durgamārthatvādarthamāha || dharmeti || 20 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || sarveti || yat prathamaṣaṭke prācuryeṇa jñānasādhanamuktaṃ, yacca dvitīye bhagavatsvarūpaṃ nirūpitaṃ, ' na tvevāhaṃ ' ityādau yajjīvasvarūpaṃ pradarśataṃ, ' bhūmirāpo'nala ' ityadau yat kṣetramabhihitaṃ tadviprakīrṇatayoktaṃ sarvaṃ buddhyārohārthaṃ saṅkṣipyāsminnadhyāye pradarśayatītyarthaḥ | sarveṣāmadhyāyānāmarthān saṅkṣipati saṅkṣipya darśayatīti sarvārthasaṅkṣepaḥ | tatra ' tat kṣetraṃ yacca ' iti pratijñātam | bhagavajjñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvāt kṣetraṃ bhagavatsvarūpaṃ cobhayaṃ kimarthamucyata ityāśaṃkā tāvatparihriyate ' idaṃ ' iti | tatra ' saṅghātaścetanā ' iti kṣetravikāratvenoktaśarīrasya kathaṃ samastakṣetratvamucyata ityāśaṃkāparihārāya śrutyaitadvyācaṣṭe || hiṃseti || jīvasya svato nityatvāt dehāditayā pariṇataitadupaghātadeva cīvo hiṃsita ityatucyate | avyaktādikaṃ hiṃsāhetujīṃvasya bhavati | śrṛ hiṃsāyāmiti dhātorhiṃsāhetutvāt śar | pareṇeryatvādīramiti śarīramityarthaḥ | kṣi nivāsagatyoriti dhātoḥ | avyaktādītyanena mahābhūtānītyasyārtha ukto bhavati | taddhikārāḥ kṣetravikārāḥ | anena ' icchādveṣa ' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | vikāritvaṃ ca na cidrūpecchādīnāmiti bhāvenāha | cidrūpeti || anena svayamacidrūpā iti labhyate | vartanta iti śeṣaḥ | kimeteṣāṃ sadā miśratayā'vasthānamityataḥ saṃsāra eva na sarvadeti bhāvenāha || vikāreti || muktau dveṣaduḥkhābhāvāt kathaṃ cinmātrecchādisaṃyuto muktaḥ syādityata āha || muktiśceti || āsurī daivī ceti śeṣaḥ | tarhi daivamuktau dveṣādyayogādāsuramuktau ca sukhādyayogādadhikaṃ saṅ‌kaṭamevetyataḥ pratyekamicchādyaśeṣāsambhave'pi vibhāgena tatsambhavādavirodha iti bhāve'nāha || cinmātreti || yatra syurutyuttaratrāpi sambaddhyate | icchādiṣvapaṭhitā'pi viṣṇubhaktirdveṣasya paṭhitatvena tatpratiyogitayā gṛhyate | ' etadyo vetti ' ityetajjīvaviṣayatayā pratītinirāsāya vacanāntareṇa vyācaṣṭe || kṣetrajña iti || yaḥ kṣetraṃ jānāti sa sarvo'pi kṣetrajñaḥ, ato viṣṇuriti kiṃ viśiṣyocyata ityata āha || na hīti || kimayaṃ svayaṃ kṣetrāntarbhūtaḥ san tajjānātītyapekṣāyāmāha || asāviti || anena ' na sattat ' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | sarvāsannihitatvāt kathaṃ sarvajñānaṃ harerityata āha || sa iti || etena ' bahirantaśca ' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | viṣṇoḥ sarvajīvābhinnatvāt kathaṃ teṣu sthitirityata āha ||vilakṣaṇaśceti || kathaṃ vailakṣaṇyamityata āha || sarvata iti || keśādiṣu pāṇyādiśaktimattvaṃ yuktiviruddhamityataḥ pratītatvānna yuktiviruddhamiti bhāvenāha || kṛṣṇeti || anena ' sarvataḥ ' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | kā nāma bhagavatpāṇyādiśaktirityata āha || sarveti || vettītyetat karmaṇo'pyupalakṣakam | anena ' sarvendriyaguṇa ' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | sarvendriyaguṇā ābhāsyanate'nu yante'neneti | bhagavataḥ pāṇyādimattve śrutyādāvanindriyatvoktiḥ kathamityata āha || sa iti || anena ' sarvendriyavivarjitaṃ ' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | jñānādiguṇasadbhāve kathaṃ tasya nirguṇatvoktirityata āha || guṇairiti || kuta evaṃ nirguṇatvaśruterarthāntaraṃ kalpyate sarvathā guṇarāhityameva kiṃ na syādityataḥ tasya sarvakalyāṇaguṇamūrtimattvena pramāṇasiddhatvādityāha || sarveti || anena ' nirguṇaṃ ' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | hareḥ pāṇipādādimattve'caratvoktiḥ kathamityata āha || anyatheti || kvaciccaratvokteḥ kathaṃ vikāritvābhāva ityata āha || cara iti || anena ' acaraṃ carameva ca ' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ sarvagatasya caraṇamityato na tasya sarvagatatvameva kintvaṇutvaṃ madhyamatvaṃ cāstītyāha || vyāpta iti || anena ' sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭati ' , ' hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam ' ityādyuktatātparyaṃ bhavati | taddūre tadvantika ityādau viruddhadharmoktyeśvarasya niḥsvabhāvatvokteḥ kathamuktaṃ yuktaṃ syādityatastadghaṭayati || sarvagatvāditi || anena ' dūrasthaṃ ' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | vyāptatvāṇutvādīnāṃ vastvantare sahānavasthānāt kathaṃ harau saha sthitirityatata āha || ananteti || anantāvyayaśaktitve'pi virodhinaḥ kathaṃ te'tira santītyata āha || na ceti || kṣetrajñanāmno jīve prasiddhyabhāvācca nātrāsāvucyata ityāha || na ceti || kvacit sadbhāve'pi bhāvaḥ | na ca viṣṇāvapi kṣetrajñanāmno na prasiddhiriti vācyam | uktavacana eva prasiddhatvāt | vacanāntare'pi tatprasiddhiṃ darśayati || kṣetrajña iti || manaso vibhūtīrmanaso vikārān | māyāracitāḥ nimittabhūtasvecchāracitāḥ | itaśca ' etadyo vetti ' ityetanna jīvaparamityāha || ata iti || yato'tra na jīvo vivakṣito'ta eva etadyo vettīti bhagavadabhiprāyeṇa | sāmānyataḥ kṣetrajñaśabdasya vyutpāditatvāt jīvasyāpi kiñcitkṣetrajñānasadbhāvāt tsaya kṣetrajñatvaprāptestannirākaraṇāya kṣetrajñaṃ māmityuktamityarthaḥ | jīvasya kṣetrajñatvanirākaraṇāya kṣetrajñaṃ māmityuktamiti kuta iti cet? kim ' etadyo vetti ' ityasyeśvaraparatvamabhyupagamyedamucte uta jīvaviṣayatvam? pakṣadvayaṃ dūṣayati || anyatheti || ' etadyo vetti ' ityasyeśvaraparatvamaṅgīkṛtya ' kṣetrajñaṃ māṃ ' ityasya jīvavyāvartakatvānaṅgīkāre parameśvarasya ' etadyo vetti ' ityanenaiva kṣetrajñatvasiddheḥ kṣetrajñaṃ māmiti punastadvacanasya vaiyyarthyaṃ syāt |etadyo vettītyasya jīvaparatvamaṅgīkṛtya kṣetrajñaṃ māmityasaya javavyāvartakatvānaṅgīkāre vaktavyasya jīvakṣetrajñatvasyaitadyo vettītyuktenaiva pūrṇatvāt kṣetrajñaṃ māmiti nirarthakaṃ viruddhārthaṃ ca syāditi bhāvaḥ | etadyo vettītyasya jīvaparatve'pi nottaravākyavaiyyarthyam | jīvasya kṣetrajñatvamuktvā īśvarasyāpyucyata iti kṣetrajñatvenoktajīvasya kṣetrasya ceśvaraikyamucyata iti sārthakyopapatteḥ | pratyutaivamanabhyupagamyeśvarasyaiva kṣetrajñatvasiddherityata āha || bhedeti || jīvasya kṣetrajñatvamuktvā tasyeśvarabheda ucyata ityādiyojanāmanaṅgīkṛtyeśvarasya kṣetrajñatvāṅgīkāre'pyetadyo vettīti sārthakameva | kṣetrajñanāmaniruktyartatvādityarthaḥ | kṣetraṃ jānātīti kṣetrajña iti kṣetrajñanāmanirukteḥ prasiddhatvāt kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māmityetāvataivālaṃ kiṃ niruktyetyata āha || sarveti || ' kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi ' ityevokte kṣetra ca jñaśceti kṣetrajña iti vyutpattyā jaḍajīvātmakatvamīśvarasyaivocyata iti pratītiḥ syāt | tannirākaraṇāya prasiddhā'pi vyutpattirucyate | na ca prasiddhavyutpattiṃ parityajyaivaṃ vyutpattyā śaṃkāprāptireva nāstīti vācyam | jaḍajīvātmakasya sarvasyāpīśvareṇābhedamaṅgīkurvatāṃ tathā pratītisambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | īśvarasya kṣetrajñanāmaniruktiḥ, jīvasya tadabhāva ityetatsarvasya etadyo vettīśvarastaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ prāhurityādivākya eva īśvaravācipadaprakṣepeṇa vaktuṃ śakyatvāt tadarthaṃ pṛthag vākyakalpane gauravamityata āha || kṣetrajñamiti || nottaravākye jīvavyāvṛttyarthameva svasya kṣetrajñatvamātramucyate | yena gauravaṃ syāt | kintu jīvavyāvṛttyarthamiśvarasyāsphuṭamuktaṃ kṣīyate'tra īśvareṇeti kṣetramityarthasūcānāya svasya kṣetre sthitiścocyata iti bhāvaḥ | yaduktametadyo vettīti jīvasya kṣetrajñatvamuktvā kṣetrajñaṃ cāpīti īśvarasyāpi taducyate'to na vaiyyarthyamiti tannirācaṣṭe || tatpakṣa iti || etadyo vettītyasya jīvaviṣayatvapakṣe kṣetraṃ jānātīti kṣetrajña iti vyutpatterjīva iva īśvare'pi sāmyena etadyo vettītyuktyaiveśvarasyāpi kṣetrajñatvaṃ siddhyatyeva | ataḥ kṣetrajñaṃ cāpīti vākyaṃ vyarthameveti bhāvaḥ | kṣetrajñatayoktajīvasya kṣetrasya ceśvarābhedakathanāya kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhīti sārthakamityuktaṃ dūṣayati || sarveti || yadi kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhīti sārthakamityuktaṃ dūṣayati || sarveti || yadi kṣetirajñaṃ cāpi māmityatra kṣetrakṣejñarūpasya sarvasyābhedo vivakṣitaḥ syāttarhi sarvakṣetraṃ kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhīti vaktavyam | sarvakṣetreṣviti saptamīprayogo'nupapannaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tarhi kṣetrajñasyaiveśvarābhedo'trocyatām | tathātve bādhakābhāvādityata āha || na ceti || yadi kṣetrajñatayoktajīvasyeśvarasya caikyamātra vivakṣitaṃ syāttarhi kṣetrajño'haṃ caika eveti vaktavyam | na tu kṣetrajñamanūdyeśvaratvavidhānaṃ yujyate | jīvamanūdya māṃ viddhīti vidhātumasyeśvarasyāpi jīvavat kalpitatvena viśeṣābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ || 3 || ' tatkṣetraṃ yat ' ityuktatvāt ' yataśca yat ' iti punaruktirityata āha || yataśceti || tarhi ' sā ca yā ' iti vaktavyamityatastatpratijñāntaramiti bhāvenāha || sa ceti || keyamanumatirityata āha || anusāriṇīti || kāryotpādasyeti śeṣaḥ | anenānumantṛśabdārtho'pyukto bhavati | atra pramāṇamāha || preraṇeti || ' yataśca yat ' , ' sa ca yaḥ ' iti pratijñādyayaṃ cettarhi tadubhayamuttaratrocyate | na cobhayoktiḥ śrūyata ityata āha || upadraṣṭeti || atra pramāṇamāha upadraṣṭā'numantā ityādinā'numanturuktatvāt taddharmatayā'numatirapyuktaiveti bhāvaḥ | yatprabhāvaśca iti pratijñātaṃ kutrocyata ityata āha || jñeyamiti || nanu caitanyasyāvikāritvāt kathaṃ vikāreṣu cetanā paṭhyata ityata āha || cetaneti || nanu mahābhūtānītyādinoktānāṃ saṅghātasya kṣetratvāta kāryatvaṃ kathamucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharan uktarthaṃ pramāṇamāha || suṅghāta iti || 7 || jñeyaṃ vaktuṃ jñānamucyate amānitvaṃ iti | tatra tattvajñānārthadarśanapadasyāsphuṭārthatvāt tadarthamāha || tattveti || nanvamānitvamityādinā jñānasādhanaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanamiti jñānaṃ coktvopasaṃhāre katham etajjñānamiti proktaṃ ityucyata ityata āha || jñāyata iti || proktamityatra jñānaśabdeneti śeṣaḥ | uktamityucyata iti vā || 12 || nanu anādimatparaṃ brahma ityatrānādītyetāvatā pūrṇatvāt anādimaditi kimarthamucyata ityata āha || anādīti || na cātra bhāṣyavirodhaḥ tatroktasya matupo mukhyārthasyānaṅgīkāre bhāṣye doṣasyoktatvāt | atra punastamaṅgīkṛtyaiva prayojanāntaraṃ matupā cinotīti || paraṃbrahma na sattannāsaducyata ityetat pramāṇavākyenaiva vyācaṣṭe || mukhyata iti || kathaṃ mūrtāmūrtayoḥ sadasacchabdavācyatvaṃ, kathaṃ ca bhagavatastadvilakṣaṇatvamitta āha || mūrtamiti || paraṃ amūrtam || 17 || jñānagamyamiti jñānaviṣayatvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyaha || svayameveti || atra svajñeyatvamevocyate, na tu parajñeyatvam | na ca bhagavataḥ svajñeyatvābhāvaḥ | svayamiti tasyoktatvādityarthaḥ | anyajñeyatvamarthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi āha || anyeti || jñānaṃ jñeyamiti jñeyaśabdenaikasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ kartṛkarmaṇoraikyavirodhānneśvarasya jñeyatvamuktamiti badatāṃ vādināṃ matanirāsāya svajñeyatvamevocyate | na tvanyajñeyatvam | tasya 'jñeyaṃ yattat pravakṣyāmi ' ityupakramavākya evoktatvena punaruktiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | svajñeyārthatve prabhāvoktiriyaṃ kathamityata āha || kartṛkarmeti || aghaṭitamapyekasyāṃ jñānakriyāyāṃ kartṛrmabhāvamātmani īśvaro ghaṭayatītyevamabhiprāyeṇedamucyate | ato bhavati prabhāvoktiriyamiti bhāvaḥ | īśvarasva jñeyatve pramāṇāntaraṃ cāha || svavettā svatantravettā | tasya vedanaṃ ca svatantram | kasya vettetyata āha || sveneti || yacca tasya vedanaṃ svatantramuktaṃ tadapi na tasmādbhinnamityāha || vittiśceti || kiṃ svenaiva vedya ityata āha || vedyaśceti || kvaciditi kimarthamucyate, sarvathā parairvedyaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || taditi || yathā'nyeṣāṃ bhagavajjñāne tatprasādasāpekṣatā tathā bhagavato'pi svavedanādo parasāpekṣatā nāstīti svātantryaṃ vivṛṇoti || sveti || tena svavettṛtvādinā | tathāhi -- svaḥ svatantraḥ prakāśo yasyāsau prakāśaśceti svaprakāśaḥ | parasya vettā vedyaśca syāditi na svaprakāśaśabdārthakathanam | jīvānāmapi svaprakāśatvāt kathameka ityucyata ityata āha || jīvānāmiti || jīvānāṃ svatantratvettṛtvābhāvādeka iti yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 18 || uktamupasaṃhṛtyata tajjñānaṃ stūyate itīti || tatra madbhāvapadamanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || madbhāvāyeti || 19 || yataśca yat sa ca ya iti pratijñātaṃ vaktuṃ prakṛtyādisvarūpamucyate 'prakṛtimiti ' | tatra prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ cetyuktamiti śeṣaḥ | ubhāvikyuktasya pulliṅgenānvayāya vyutkramaḥ | anenobhāvityetat pṛthagvākyamityuktaṃ bhavati | ubhe apīti saṅgrahaśca | vikārāṃśca guṇāṃścetyatra vikārādīnāṃ prakṛtiḥ svatantraṃ kāraṇamityanyathāpratītim icchādayo vikārā ityuktatvād guṇaśabdārthameva vadan nirākaroti || vikārāṇāmiti || upadraṣṭā'numantā cetīśvarasyaiva svātantryasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt na prakṛteḥ svātantryaṃ, kintūpādānatvamevetyarthaḥ | nanvicchādivat sattvādiguṇānāmapi vikāratvād vikārāṃśca guṇāṃśceti pṛthaguktiḥ kinimittetyata āha || guṇānāṃ ceti || sattvādiguṇānāṃ vikāratve'pi vikānāṃśca guṇāṃśceti pṛthaguktiḥ sattvādīnāmalpavikāratvādicchādīnāṃ tato'dhikavikāratvāttadvivakṣayā yuktetyarthaḥ | 'kāryakāraṇakatrṛtve ' iti ślokamacetanaprakṛtijīvaviṣayatvapratītinirāsāya cetanaprakṛtīśvaraviṣayatayā pramāṇenaiva vyācaṣṭe || svadeheti || viṣṇutattvamāvṛtyeti || viṣṇoryathāsthitimajñāyitvetyarthaḥ | viṣṇutattvājñasyaiva bandhakarmasambhavena dehendriyahetutvādajñānahetucitprakṛterjīvasya śarīrendriyahetutvam | īśvaraparatayottarārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe || jīvasyeti || sarvakattṛtvādīśvarasya bhogaśaktikartṛtvaṃ kiṃ viśiṣyocyata ityata āha |. sarveti || yathā sarvapālo'pi vikuṇṭhapo viśiṣyocyate, sthānāntarasyeva viṇṭhasya pālakāntararahitatvāt tathā sarvakartā'pi hariḥ keṣāñcidbhoktṛtvādīnāṃ kartā viśiṣyocyate | kāryāntara iva bhoktṛtvādāvanyeṣāṃ pravṛttyabhāvādityarthaḥ | viśeṣeṇa svakarmaṇā kevalena svakarmaṇā | etena bhagavataḥ kāryakāraṇakartṛtvahetutve'pi citprakṛterbhoktṛtvapradāne svapravṛttimapekṣya kāryakāraṇakartṛtve'dhikapravṛttiriti kāryakāraṇakatṛtve hetutvoktiriti sūcitaṃ bhavati | etadubhayaṃ gītāyāmeva sūcitamityāha || parameśvarasyeti || parameśvarasyaiva kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetutve'pi citprakṛtestaduktiryuktā | bhoktṛtvadāne tasyā alpapravṛttitvena tadapekṣayā kartṛtve'dhikapravṛttimattvāt | tathā parameśvarasya sarvakartṛtve'pi viśiṣya bhoktṛtvadānoktiryuktā | bhoktṛtvadāne citprakṛtyādīnāmanyatra pravṛttimapekṣyālpapravṛttitvena bhagavata evādhikapravattitvādityetatsūcayitumasya ślokasya pūrvottarārdhayorucyata ityuktamityarthaḥ | kathamanenaitatsūcitamityata āha || kartṛtve'pīti || bhoktṛtvāpekṣayeti || svasyā bhoktṛtvadāne pravṛttyapekṣayetyarthaḥ | adhikapravṛttiḥ kāryakāraṇakartṛtva iti śeṣaḥ | bhoktṛtve heturucyate | viśeṣeṇeti śeṣaḥ | 'puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi ' ityatreśvara ucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || puruṣa iti || īśvarasya 'puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ ' iti puruṣaśabdena prakṛtatvāt kathamatra jīve puruṣaśabda ityata āha || ubhayoriti || yadyapyatra puruṣaśabdeneśvaraḥ prakṛtastathāpyatra puruṣaśabdasya jīvaviṣayatvagrahaṇaṃ yuktam | 'prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva ' ityatra puruṣaśabdeneśvaravat jīvasyāpi pirakṛtatvāt | anyathā 'ubhau ' ityasya vaiyyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ | astu jīvaḥ prakṛtastathāpi samīpaprakṛtaṃ parityajya dūraprakṛtagrahaṇaṃ nopapannamityata āha || yatheti || samīpaprakṛtatve'pīśvarasya tatparityāgaṃna dūraprakṛtajīvagrahaṇamupapadyate | asya puruṣasya prakṛtijaguṇabhoktṛtvapratīteḥ | īśvarasya tadayogāt, jīvasya tadyogyatvāt | yathāyogyamevārthāśrayaṇasyopapannatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ubhayoḥ prakṛtatve jīvamātragrahaṇaṃ kathamityato vā'ha || yatheti || 21 || yadyatra puruṣapadaṃ jīvaparaṃ tarhi punaruktiḥ syāt | jīvasya 'kāryakāraṇakartṛtve ' ityanenoktakāryakāraṇasaṃbandhasyaiva prakṛtisthapadenokteḥ | sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve ityanenoktasukhaduḥkhādibhogasyaiva 'bhuṅkte prakṛtijān guṇān ' ityuktatvādityata āha || kāryeti || kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhasya sukhādibhogasya ca prāguktatve'pi tanmithyātvavādināṃ nirāsāya 'puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi ' ityuktatvānna punaruktidoṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nisākaraṇasya pramāṇasāpekṣatvāt tadanuktoktābhidhānamātreṇa kathaṃ nirākaraṇamityata āha || hīti || atra kāryakāraṇasambandhasya sukhādibhogasya ca hiśabdenānubhavaprasiddhikathanena tanmithyātvavādināmanubhavavirodhasya tarśitatvāt naitaduktābhidhānamātramiti bhāvaḥ | ahaṃ sukhīduḥkhītyādyanubhavasya bhrāntitvasambhavāt sukhādibhogasya mithyātvāṅgīkāre kathaṃ tadvirodha ityata aha || na hīti || sukhādiviṣayānubhavo na bhramaḥ āntarārthānubhavatvāt | āntarārthānubhavasya bhramatvārśanāditi bhāvaḥ | bādhakābhāvācca nāyamanubhavo bhrama ityāha || na ceti || nanvātmādau jainādīnāṃ madhyamaparimāṇatvādijñānasya bhramatvadarśanāt kathamāntarārthānubhavatvādabhratvamucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharan vyāptimāha || śarīramiti || nātrā'ntarānubhavatvameva hetuḥ | yena vyabhicāraḥ syāt | api tvaparokṣatvaviśiṣṭam | aparokṣānubhavasya ca vahireva bhramatvadarśanādāntarānubhavasya tadabhāvaḥ siddhyati || jainādīnāṃ cānumānādinaiva madhyamaparimāṇatvādibhrama iti bhāvaḥ | bādhakābhāve'pi sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || tatrāpīti || yatra bahirarthānubhavasya bhramatvaṃ tatrāpi balavatpramāṇavirodhādeva tat kalpyate | ataḥ sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bādhakābhāvenābhramatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | itaśca na sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatvena sukhādermithyātvaṃ vācyamityāha || sākṣīti || sākṣiyanubhavasidhdhasyāpi sukhāderbhrāntikalpitatve sarvaṃ mithyā, ātmā satya iti vyavasthā'pi na siddhyati | etadvyavasthāyā api sākṣyanubhavasiddhatvena mithyātvāpātāditi bhāvaḥ | bhrāntitvamabhrāntitvamiti || bhrāntikalpitatvamabhrāntikalpitatvamityarthaḥ | sarvaṃ mithyā ātmā satya iti vyavahārata evāsti, na tu paramārthataḥ | atastadasiddhirnāniṣṭetyata āha || vyavahārata iti || vyavahārata eveyaṃ vyavasthā'stītyapi na siddhyati | sākṣiṇo'prāmāṇye tatra pramāṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiñca sākṣyanubhavasyāprāmāṇye stambhādau sthāṇvādimanovṛttirbhrāntiḥ | stambhādimanovṛttirabhrāntirityapa na siddhyati | sākṣiṇa eva jñānasya bhrāntitvābhrāntitvagrāhakatvāt | tadasiddhau ca vyavahāramātraṃ ca na siddhyatīti bhāvenāha || bhrāntiriti || etena sarvaṃ mithyā ātmā satya iti vyavasthā vyavahārato'stītyetadāgamādinā siddhyatītyetadapi nirastam | āgamādiprāmāṇyasyāpi sākṣigrāhyatvāt | 'sākṣisiddhasya ' ityāderekagranthatve bhrāntirityasya sādhyābhidhānaparatayā taccheṣatvaṃ jñātavyam | yaduktaṃ sukhādiviṣayasākṣyanubhavasya na bhrāntitvaṃ, bādhakābhāvāditi tadayuktam | 'vimuktaśca vimucyate ' ityādipramāṇasadbhāvādityata āha || anubhava iti || nānena sukhādiviṣayasyānubhavasya bhrāntitvaṃ siddhyati | tatsvarūpaprāmāṇyayoḥ siddhyabhāvāt | sākṣyanubhavasyaiva tatsādhakatvāt | tasya ca bhrāntitvābhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | na ca sukhādiviṣaya eva sākṣyanubhavasya bhramatvaṃ, pramāṇasvarūpādāvabhramatvamiti yuktam | viśeṣapramāṇābhāvenānāśvāsāt | sākṣyanubhavasya bhramatve'pi pramāṇasvarūpapramāṇye lokavyavahārādeva setsyata ityāśaṃkyāha || vyavahārata iti || na lokavyavahārataḥ pramāṇasvarūpādisiddhiḥ | lokasya ca tadvyavahārasya cāsiddheḥ | sākṣiṇa eva tadgrāhakatvāt | tasya ca bhrāntitvāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ | sākṣiṇo bhrāntitve'pi vyavahāravyavahartṛsiddhiḥ pratītita eva bhaviṣyatītyāśaṃkya pariharati || pratītita iti || bhavet pratītyaiva vyavahārādisiddhiḥ yadi saiva siddhyet | na ca tatsādhakaṃ vaktuṃ śakyata iti bhāvaḥ | sākṣiṇa eva pratītisiddheḥ kathaṃ tatsādhakābhāva ityāśaṃkya pariharati || svata iti || na sākṣiṇā pratītisiddhiḥ | tasya sukhādau bhrāntitvāṅgīkāreṇa pratītyabhāve'pi pratītirastīti bhramo'yamiti śaṃkākuṇṭhitaśaktitvāditi bhāvaḥ | itaśca na sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatvamityāha || sveti || sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatvāṅgīkṛtāvātmābhāvo'pi syāt | ātmasādhakābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvahamiti pratyakṣata evātmopalabhyate | ataḥ kathaṃ tatsādhakābhāva ityata āha || svayamiti || nāhamityanubhavenātmasiddhiḥ, anubhavasya sukhādau bhrāntitvābhyupagemenātmanyapi bhramatvaśaṃkāvārakābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | niradhiṣṭhānabhramāsambhavāt sukhādiramānyathānupapattyā'dhiṣṭhānabhūtātmasiddhirityata āha || nirālambana iti || nānena tarkeṇātmasiddhiḥ | etattarkānubhavasyāpi sukhānubhavavat bhramatvaśaṃkāyāḥ prasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | śrutirātmani pramāṇamityata āha || taditi || yacchrutiḥ pramāṇamātmanyucyate tacchrutiprāmāṇyasādhakābhāvenāpramāṇyasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt na tenātmasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | śruteḥ prāmāṇyānubhavāt kathamaprāmāṇyamityata āha || pramāṇatveti || nānubhavena śruteḥ prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ | sukhānubhavavadasyāpyaprāmāṇye pramāṇatvabhramatvasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | sākṣisiddhasyetyādyuktamupasaṃharati || itīti || evamuktaprakāreṇa sākṣyanubhavasya bhramatve sarvaṃ mithyā ātmā satya iti vyavasthādi kiñcidapi na siddhyatītyarthaḥ | sukhādyanubhavo bhrama ityarthasādhakaśruteḥ prāmāṇyāsiddherna tayā sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvasiddhirityuktam | atha tasya śrautānubhavasyāpi bhramatvopapattyā sukhādyanubhavasyābhramatvameva bhavati | na tu tena tasya bhramatvasiddhiḥ | parasparaviruddhayoranyataraniṣedhasyetaravidhināntarīyakatvāditi bhāvenāha || bhrama iti || ito'pi na sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvamityāha || sukheti || yadi lasukhādyanubhavo bhramastarhi yat pracchannaṃ nairātmyamatamaṅgīkṛtaṃ tatparakaṭitaṃ syāt | sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya ātmasvarūpatvādityarthaḥ | sukhādiviṣayānubhavasyātmarūpatvaṃ bhavanmata eva nāsmanmate | kintu manovṛttirūpatvamevetyato'pasiddhānta ityāha || na hīti || nanvastu sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvamātmasvarūpatvaṃ ca | tathāpi kathamātmābhāvaprasaṅga ityata āha || bhramasyeti || sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatve'vidyākāryatvaṃ syāt | bhramasyāvidyākāryatvāṅgīkārāt | tathācātma no'pyavidyākāryatvaṃ syāt | sukhādiviṣayānubhavasyātmasvarūpatvāt | avidyākāryatve cātmano mithyātvaṃ durnivāramiti bhāvaḥ | astvevamātmano yuktyā durghaṭatvam | tathāpi na tadbādhakam | ātmanaḥ pramāṇasiddhatvāt | na hi pramāṇasiddhasya yuktyā durghaṭatvamātreṇa bādho'stītyāśaṃkya pariharati || durghaṭatvamiti || yadyātmanaḥ prāmāṇikatvādyuktyā durghaṭatvamapi na bādhakamityucyate tarhi sukhādīnāmapi durghaṭatvaṃ sughaṭatvaṃ vā'stu | na tadbādhakaṃ, pramāṇasiddhatvāditi vaktavyamityarthaḥ | yuktyā durghaṭatvamastu | na tadbādhakamiti kathamityata āha || na hīti || aṅgīkṛtya cedamuktam | yuktyā durghaṭatvamaparihṛtya tasyābādhakatvābhyupagame'tiprasaṅgaḥ syādityāha || durghaṭatvamiti || yadi yuktyā durghaṭatvaṃ na bādhakamityātmāstitvaṃ durghaṭatayā'ṅgīkriyate tarhyātmano'vidyātvaṃ durghaṭamapyaṅgīkriyatāmaviśeṣādityarthaḥ | prāmāṇikasyaiva yuktyā durghaṭatvaṃ na bādhakamityucyate | na cātmano'vidyātvaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ, yena yuktyā durghaṭatvamabādhakaṃ syādityata āha |. atīti || nātmano'vidyātvamaprāmāṇikam | kiñciccetanaṃ kiñcidacetanamityaṅgīkāre gauravaprāpteḥ | sarvasyācetanatvāṅgīkṛtereva jyāyastvamiti yuktisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ prāmāṇike yuktyā durghaṭatvamabādhakam | kintu yadaṅgīkāre pramāṇāvirodhastatraiva | ātmano'vidyātvaṃ pramāṇaviruddhamato yuktyā viruddhatvaṃ tatra bādhakamevetyata āha|| na ceti || atmano'vidyātvaṃ vadatāṃ pratipakṣiṇāmuktarītyā na ko'pi pramāṇavirodho'stīti bhāvaḥ | nanvevamanubhavabalena kāryakāraṇasambandhasya sukhaduḥkhādibhogasya ca satyatvaṃ vadatā bhagavatā'nubhavasya bhramatvamabhyupagacchatāṃ matamevaṃ kimiti na nirākṛtamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharannuktamupasaṃharati || ata iti || anubhavabhramatvasya sphuṭamuktarītyā anantadoṣaduṣṭatvapratīterna svayaṃ bhagavatā tannirākṛtiḥ kṛteti bhāvaḥ | puruṣaḥ prakṛtistha ityuktam | tatra svataḥ śuddhasya jīvasya prakṛtisthatve kiṃkāraṇamityata ucyate 'kāraṇam ' iti || tatra paramātmano jīvabhāvena śarīrasambandhādyuktau śuddhasya kiṃ kāraṇaṃ śarīrasambandhāderityataḥ saguṇatvaṃ tatkāraṇamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyā'ha || asyeti || 22 || atra jīvasya śarīrasambandhe sattvādiguṇasaṅgaḥ kāraṇamucyate, na tu paramātmanastatra saguṇatvam | paramārthatastadanupapatteḥ | tanmithyātvasya dūṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃ jīvasya sattvādiguṇasaṅgaḥ sadasadyonijanmasu svatantrakāraṇamuta nimittamātram? nādyaḥ | jaḍatvena tadanupapatteḥ | dvitīye svatantrakāraṇaṃ vācyamiti śaṃkāparihāratvena ślokamavatārayati || svatantreti || kathamanena hareḥ svatantrakāraṇatvamucyata ityataḥ pramāṇavākyena ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || sarvebhya iti || upari upari vartamānaḥ, uttama iti yāvat | svānukūlyena svātmano'vikṣepakatayā | matyā buddhipūrvakam | svātantryaṃ tatra hetutvenaivoktam | paramatvādityanena paramātmetyuktārthaṃ bhavati | upadraṣṭetyādau sarvatretiśabdānvayonānumantṛtve hetvabhidhāyakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | dehinonya ityanena paraśabdo vyākhyāto bhavati | nanvanumantuḥ prāgdehasthitatvenānuktatvādapyukto dehe'sminniti kathamucyata ityata āha || māmiti || ' kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata ' iti prāganumanturdehagatatvenoktatvādapyukto dehesminnityuktiryukteti bhāvaḥ | nanūpadraṣṭṛtvādikamanumantṛtve hetutvenocyatām | anumanturdehasthatayoktatvaṃ kimarthamucyata ityata āha || teneti || ko'yamanumantetyato dehe'pyukta ityanenāhamevānumanteti darśayati || dehasthatvenātmanaḥ kathitatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 23 || 'prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva' ityādyuktārthaṃ bubhutsātiśayotpādanāya tajjñānaphalamucyate -- 'ya enaṃ' iti | tatpramāṇavacanenaiva vyācaṣṭe || dvividhamiti || jñātvā parokṣataḥ | 'sarvathā vartamānaḥ' ityasya pramādādanyāyena vartamāno'pi niyatamokṣa ityarthaḥ | paramapuraṣādidarśane kiṃ sādhanamityata āha || anādīti || kathaṃ nānātvamityata āha ||tatreti || svayamiti || svapratibhayā || tatheti || uktaprakāradvayena | anena 'dhyānena' ityuktākteṃ bhavati | 'kiñcit' ityuktyāteṣāṃ dhyānātiriktasādhanasadbhāve'pi tasyālpatvādanuktirityuktaṃ bhavati | ṛṣayo'ntaḥprakāśā ityādau ṛṣīṇāmantardarśananiyamokteḥ kecanetyuktiḥ kimarthetyata āha || keciditi || ṛṣyantaraviṣayā śrutiriti bhāvaḥ | 'devāḥ' ityanena 'anye sāṅkhyena' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | krameṇa kālakrameṇa | devānāṃ dhyānābhāve darśanaṃ bhavati cettarhi darśanavirodhidhyānaṃ kimarthaṃ te kurvantītyata āha || yeṣāmiti || sāṅkhyaṃ pratibhā yogo darśanopāyo yeṣāṃ te sāṅkhyayogāḥ | 'pratibhā spaṣṭatākramāt' ityuktam | tatra sarvottamapratibhā deveṣu kasya mukhyetyata āha || brahmeti || kecidityanena 'karma' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | atrāpi śravaṇapratibhayolpatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | anya ityanena 'anye tu' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | ṛṣidevarājñāṃ pratibhoktā | tatra kimeteṣāmekavidyaiva pratibhā'sti, atha tāratamyenetyapekṣāyāmāha || ṛṣīniti || brahmaṇaḥ pratibhāpramāṇamāha || brahmaṇa iti || tarhi tasya hareḥ sakāśāt śravaṇaṃ kimarthamityata āha || viṣṇoriti || prītyarthameva, na tu jñānārtham | keṣāṃ tarhi jñānārthaṃ śravaṇamityata āha anyeṣāmiti || mānuṣettaramiti || mānuṣāṇāṃ prāyaḥ śravaṇādeva jñānamityarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ dhyānādiyogināmapi śravaṇādisadbhāve kathaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ śrutaveditvaṃ kvaciducyata ityata āha || atyalpeti || evaṃ darśanasādhanaṃ nānāvidhamuktvā prakṛtamanusandhatte || sarva iti || yaduktaṃ dhyānādiyogināmapi śravaṇādyastīti tadayuktam | tathāsati keṣāñcit 'śrutvā'nyebhyaḥ' iti viśiṣyoktyasambhavādityata āha || anyeṣāmiti || dhyānādiyogināṃ śravaṇādisadbhāve'pi manuṣyāṇāṃ 'śrutvā'nyebhyaḥ' upāsate iti viśeṣoktiryuktā | teṣāmatyalpapratibhānatvena śravaṇabāhulya.sadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | anenātyalpapratibhānatvāditi vivṛtaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ manuṣyāṇāmatyalpā'pi pratibhā yujyate | śrutiparāyaṇā iti śravaṇaikāśrayatvokterityata āha || manuṣyāṇāmiti || manuṣyāṇāmatyalpapratibhāsadbhāve'pi śrutiparāyaṇā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam | tatpratibhāyā mūlapramāṇāpekṣatvena svātantryābhāvāt prāyeṇāsamyaktvācca | asvatantre'sādhuni cāsattvoktidarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | yaduktaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ piratibhā mūlapramāṇasāpekṣā prāyo na samyagutpadyate, alpā ceti tadayuktam | pāṇḍavādimanuṣyāṇāmaśrutārthe'pi samyak bahupratibhādarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ pramāṇenaiva pariharati || aśruteti || viśrutā vyāptā bahuletyarthaḥ | tallakṣaṇāntarāṇi cāha || yaśceti || yaḥ puruṣaḥ svamukhaparimāṇenanavaparimāṇādhodehavān, yā ca strī svamukhaparimāṇenāṣṭaparimāṇavatī tau punaḥ svasvāṅguliparimāṇena ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgalau, svasvatālaparimāṇena daśatālau, svasvapādaparimāṇena saptapādau tau ca surottamau vidyādityarthaḥ | atra tālo nāma madhyamāṅgulyagrāt maṇibandhaparyantaḥ kara ucyate | devottamalakṣaṇamuktvā devamātralakṣaṇamāha || yāvaditi || tat ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulaṃ krameṇa hrasadekanavatyaṅgulaparyantamuttamāvarasurāvadhikadevamānaṃ bhavati | atra saptapādaparimāṇaṃ krameṇa hrasadekāṅgulonameva bhavatītyarthaḥ | mandharvādilakṣaṇamāha || tadūnamiti || tadekanavatyaṅgulaṃ saptāśītyaṅgulaparyantaṃ krameṇa hrasadgandharvādiparimāṇaṃ bhavati | atrāpi saptapādaparimāṇaṃ krameṇa hrasatpunarekāṅgulonaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ ||manuṣyalakṣaṇamāha || tāvaditi || saptāśītyaṅgulaṃ manuṣyaparimāṇamityarthaḥ | asuralakṣaṇamāha || tata iti || saptāśīteradhastāt asuraparimāṇamityarthaḥ | devopadevānāṃ mānasya sambhūya kiyatīpvaṅgulādupari devottamaparimāṇāt | ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulādadho yadaṣṭacāṅgulaṃ taddevopadevaparimāṇaṃ jñātavyamityarthaḥ | ṛṣyādilakṣaṇamāha || deveṣviti || cyavanādīnāṃ pṛthvādīnāmavaradevavat parimāṇaṃ jñātavyamityarthaḥ | etallakṣaṇatāratamye hetumāha || yāvaditi || anenaitat svābhāvikamiti coktaṃ bhavati || 25 -26 || yaduktaṃ harireva sarvajīvānāṃ sadasadyonijanmasu svatantrakāraṇamiti tatprapañcyate 'yāvaditi' | tatra kṣetrajñasya hareḥ kṣetrasaṃyogo nāma jaḍadehasaṃyoga ityantathāpratītinirāsāyāha || kṣetreti || 'yāvat sañjāyate' ityetadvivaraṇarūpe 'mama yoniḥ' ityuttarādhyāyagatavākye lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃyogātsarvabhūtasambhavasyoktatvāt atrāpi kṣetrapadena śrīrevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | avyaktatatve prasiddhaḥ kṣetraśabdaḥ śrīvācītyetatkuta ityataḥ śriyaḥ śretraśabdavācyatvaṃ, prasaṅgāt mahābhūtānītyādyuktāhaṅ‌kārādiśabdānāṃ ca devatāvācitvaṃ pramāṇena darśayati || avyaktamiti || sarasvatyādīnāmapi śrīśabdavācyatvāt tadvyāvṛttyarthamāha || sadeti || kiṃ jaḍāvyaktābhedāt tacchabdavācyetyata āha || nirdoṣeti || kathaṃ tarhi avyaktādipadavācyatvamityata āha || sā hīti || na vyajyata ityavyaktam | viṣṇurasyāṃ nivasatīti kṣetram | mahāguṇeti mahadbrahma, jīvottameti pradhānamucyata ityarthaḥ | atra mahato'nuktatvepyādikāryatvāt grāhya eva | kriyāḥ uddiśya | uktaṃ vivṛṇoti || jīveti || śabdādi bodhayatīti buddhirityarthaḥ | tatsuto'niruddho'pi || sparśayatīti sparśaḥ | hṛñ haraṇa iti dhātoḥ rasāharaṇahetutvāt jihvetyarthaḥ | āghrātergandhāghrāṇahetutvāt | vacanāt vacanapravartakatvāt | hānilābhayornimittatvāt | sana lābha iti dhātuḥ | kvacidviṣṇoḥ pādadevatvokteḥ viṣṇunetyuktam | yajñaśambhū ca na hariharāvityuktam || śacīti || padanāt gatipravartakatvāt | pada gatāviti dhātuḥ | nirāvṛtyā pratibandhābhāvena | vātīti vāyuḥ | adanādagniḥ | prathanād vistṛtatvāt pṛthivī | janmalayahetutvāt jalamityarthaḥ | pṛthu vistāra iti dhātuḥ | utpattilayayorjalādhīnatvadarśanāt tanniyāmakadevatāyāstatsiddham | śabdanādityādeḥ śabdādipravartakatvāditvātyarthaḥ | mukhyavāyuḥ sukhanāt sukhamityādi draṣṭavyam | sā śrīreva | evaṃ sarasvatīvadvāyoḥ patnīvirdhṛtirmatetyarthaḥ | śrīrevecchetyuktam | tadupapādayati | iccheti || yadyavyaktacetanecchādiśabdaiḥ lakṣmyādidevatā ucyante tarhi kvacidavyaktamuktvā punaścetanādikaṃ kathamucyata ityata āha || sthāneti || avyaktapadoktaśriyaḥ cetanādipadena punaruktiryuktā | aibhimānyamānasthānabhedena rūpabhedādityarthaḥ | evaṃ devatāntare'pi draṣṭavyam | kathaṃ tarhi jaḍapadārtheṣvavyaktādiśabdāḥ pravartanta ityata āha || etairiti || avyaktādināmakadevatābhimanyamānatvāt jaḍānāmavyaktādiśabdavācyatvamiti bhāvaḥ | kṣiṇoti nāśayati | kṣitiṃ kṛtvā trāti svanivāsanimittena rakṣati | kṣīṇam adhamam || viśeṣavikṛtisthitā iti || mahadādibhyo'tiśayena vikāritayā'vasthitā ityarthaḥ | ghaṭādāvapyetadeva vikāraśabdapravṛttinimittamityāha || viśeṣāditi || vigatamityādeḥ atrāntimakārye nāśaṃ vinā kāryāntarotpādakatvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | abhimānināmapīcchādiśabdavācyatvāt kathaṃ vikāratvamityata āha || taditi || sambandho niyamyaniyāmakabhāvaḥ | yaduktaṃ cetanācenataṃ sarvaṃ kṣetramiti, taduktam | cetanasya 'idaṃ śarīraṃ' ityuktaśarīratvānupapatteḥ | hiṃsāheturityādinirvacanasya tatrāsambhavādityata āha || yasyeti || cetanasya kṣetratve'pi na tasyoktaśarīratvāsambhavaḥ | 'yasyātmā śarīram' ityuktatvāt | uktaniruktyasambhave'pi bhagavattantratvena śarīratvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | 'yāvatsañjāyate kiñcit sattvaṃ'ityatra sattvaśabdo jīvavācīti 'mama yoniḥ' iti vākyasyodāharaṇenaiva sūcitam | tatra sattvaśabdasya jīvavācitve pramāṇamāha || sattvamiti || tayoranya iti yaducyate sa jīva iti vaktavye sattvamiti śrutyocyate | sattvaśabdena jīvagrahaṇe tasyānāditvāt saṃjāyata ityuktajananaṃ na yujyata ityata āha || janīprādurbhāva iti || 27 || parameśvarasya sarvaśarīrasthātvamuktam | tarhyadhiṣṭhānatāratamyāttasya tāratamyaṃ duḥkhisahāvasthānāt duḥkhaṃ ca syādityata ucyate -- 'samaṃ' iti | tatra 'vinaśyatsvavinaśyantam' ityayuktam | jīvānāṃ vināśābhāvāt | na ca tasyācetanaviṣayatvam | caśabdādyabhāvādityata āha || jīveṣviti || evaṃ vijānanneva jñānītyuktam | tajjñānaphalamucyate 'samaṃ' iti | ślokadvayaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || duḥkheti || na hinastītyasyārthaḥ 'sa eva' iti || 28 -29 || īśvaraḥ sadasadyonijanmasu karmānapekṣyaiva kāraṇaṃ cettarhi tasya vaiṣamyādi syāt | karmāpekṣāyāṃ svātantryapracyutiḥ | tathā tasyāpi ḍanakasadbhāvācca na svātantryamityata ucyate -- 'prakṛtya' iti | tatra prakṛtireva katrīṃ na paramātmetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || prakṛtyeti || svayameva prārabhyeti || pūrvakarmādikaṃ svayameva prabodhyetyarthaḥ | abhiprāyaṃ vakti || viṣṇoriti || karmasāpekṣatve'pi na bhagavataḥ svatantryapracyutiḥ | yāvatā'sau svayameva pūrvakarmādikamudbodhya tadapekṣyedānīṃ karmāṇi kārayati | na tu karmādikaṃ viṣṇorudbodhakamiti bhāvaḥ | kuta etadityata āha || pūrvamiti || astu karmādi harirudbodhayati, na tu ddharimudbodhayatīti | tathāpi harestadapekṣatvādasvātantryamityataḥ karmādisattāyā api bhagavadadhīnatvāt tadapekṣāyāmapi nāsvātantryamiti bhāvena karmādisattāyā bhagavadadhīnatve pramāṇamāha || dravyamiti || kuta evamarthakalpanetyata uktarthe smṛtisamākhyāṃ darśayati || svayamiti || nanvatra īśvareṇetyaśravaṇāt kathamayamarthaḥ syādityata āha || teneti || 'samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram' iti īśvarasya prasatutatvāt teneśvareṇetyanukte'pi siddhyatītyarthaḥ | kimanayā kalpanayā? prakṛtereva kartṛtvaṃ neśvarasyetyevārthaḥ kiṃ nasyādityata udāhṛtaḥ smṛtivirodhastāvat vākyāntaravirodhaṃ ca darśayati || ahamiti || teneśvareṇetyatra sūcitaṃ cetyāha || prakṛtyeti || caśabdena kathametatsiddhyatītyata āha || prakṛteneti || ucyamānakriyāyāḥ prakṛtakartṛtvamīrayedityarthaḥ | īśvarasya kartṛtvābhidhāyakavacanavirodhānnārthāntarakalpanā yuktetyuktam | prakṛteḥ kartṛtvasya śrutyādiviruddhatvācca nāsau yuktetyāha || prakṛteriti || tvadṛte dūre'pi kiñcana kenāpi na kriyata ityarthaḥ | itaśca nārthāntarakalpanā yuktetyāha || kevaleti || īśvarasamuccacārthaścaśabda ityataḥ kevaletyuktam ātmānamakartāramityatra pareṇeśvarasyākartṛtvāṅgīkārāt na tatsamuccayārthaścaśabda iti bhāvaḥ | itaśca neśvarasyākartṛtvametadarthaṃ ityāha || tata eveti || ito'pi nārthāntarakalpanā yuktetyāha || ahamiti || atra yāvatsañjāyata itīśvarasya sarvakartṛtvaṃ prakṛtamiti tenāpīśvarākartṛtvavyākhyānaṃ viruddham | na ca vācyaṃ pūrvavākye'pi prakṛtereva kartṛtvaṃ kṣetrajñasya tatsaṃyogāt kartṛtvopacāra iti | mama yonirmahadbrahmetyādinā uttarādhyāye'nyathaitadvākyārthasya vakṣyamāṇatvādityarthaḥ | ito'pi na prakṛtereva kartṛtvamiti asyārtha ityāha || acetanamiti || kathaṃ svoktivirodha ityata āha || iccheti || icchāpūrvakriyāsvīkāro hi kartṛtvam | tathā śruteḥ | acetanaṃ nāmecchārahitam | ato'cotanaṃ ca karoti ceti vyāhatiriti bhāvaḥ | nanu prakṛteḥ svatantrakartṛtvābhāve'pi pariṇāmarūpaṃ kartṛtvamaṅgīkriyata eva siddhāntinā'pi | atantadartho'yaṃ ślokaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || vikāreti || yadyapi prakṛteḥ pariṇāmarūpaṃ kartṛtvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ, tathāpi na tadartho'yaṃ ślokaḥ | atra sarvakarmaṇāṃ prakṛtyaiva kriyamāṇatvokteḥ | etadarthatve ca parameśvarādikarmasu prakṛtivikāratvābhāvāt sarvaśa iti padasyārthasaṅ‌kottaprāpterityarthaḥ |parameśvarādikarmaṇaḥ prakṛtivikāratvābhāvaḥ kuta ityata āha || acetaneti || 30 || na kevalaṃ bhagavataḥ sarvaprerakatvādijñānamātreṇālam | kintu tasya sarvādhāratvādyapi jñātavyamityucyate -- " yadā " iti | tat tirohitārthatvāt pramāṇavākyenaiva vyācaṣṭe || eketi || bhūtapṛthagbhāvasya paramātmasthatvoktyā pṛthagbhūtānāṃ tatsthatvamabhipretam | tadevātroktam || 31 || sarvacetanācetanātmakatvāt paramātmanaḥ kathaṃ bhūtānāṃ tataḥ paṛthagbhāva ityata ucyate -- " anāditvāt " iti | tatra paramātmano'kartṛtvapratītiṃ ca nirākartuṃ śarīrasthapadaṃ vyākhyāti || śarīrastha iti || śarīrasthaśabdasya kuto jīvavācitvamityataḥ tatparayogaṃ darśayati || svapneneti || nanu jīvavadīśvarasyāpi śarīrasthiteḥ jīvasyaiva tatpadavācyatvaṃ kutaityata āha || śarīrastha iti || viṣṇorapi mayedaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ, madadhīnamityabhimāno'styeva | ataḥ kathaṃ tadanabhimāna ityata āha || tadgatānāmiti || śarīrasthapadaṃ jīvavācakaṃ cet kathaṃ yojanetyata āha || anāditvāditi || iti vācyamiti śeṣaḥ | jīvasyāpyanāditvāt kiṃ viśiṣyeśvarasyaiva taducyate, yenāsya jīvābhedanivāraṇe hetutvaṃ syādityata āha || śarīreti || evambhūtādimattvābhāve'pi kathaṃ paramātmano jīvādviśeṣa ityata āha || jīvasyeti || itiśabdo hetau | nanu nirguṇatvaṃ kathamīśvarasya jīvabhede heturbhavati jagatkartṛtvādiguṇānām īśvare bhāvena hetorasiddherityata āha || sattveti || nātra guṇapadena jagatkartṛtvādayo vivakṣitāḥ | kintu sattvādaya eva | tatsambandhaśceśvare nāsti, jīve'stīti bhavati heturiti bhāvaḥ | karoti na lipyata iti jīveśvarabhede hetvantaram | tadvyācaṣṭe || sarvamiti || jīvo na karoti lipyata eveti draṣṭavyam | lepaśca tatphalena | nanvatra jīvādyabhedasyāprāptatvātkathaṃ niṣedho yukta ityata āha || vādīti || yathā śūnyavādisiddhatvāt śūnyakāraṇatvasya " taddhaika āhuḥ " ityādinā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tathā sarvādvaitavādiprāptatvāt advaitaniṣedho yujyate | yathā ca jñānadvārā mokṣārthaṃ karmabhirīśvara evārādhya iti karmaśrutyabhiprāyāparijñānaprāptasya kevalakarmaṇaivasvargādipuruṣārthalābho bhavatītyasya " iṣṭāpūrtaṃ " ityādinā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tathā bhagavatā sarvaṃ vyāptamiti " sarvaṃ khalidaṃ brahma " ityādiśrutyābhiprāyāparijñānaprāptasyādvaitasya niṣedho yukta iti bhāvaḥ | prātītika evarthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata uktārthe vākyāntarasammatimāha || kurvāṇa iti || mṛtyādirahita ityanenāvyayapadaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | īśvarasya cetanācetanabhinnatve śrutisammatiṃ cāha || sa eṣa iti || 32 -34 || adhyāyārtha upasaṃhriyate || kṣetreti || tatra bhūtaprakṛtimokṣapadaṃ tirohitārthatvāt vyācaṣṭe || jīvānāmiti || mokṣaṃ mokṣasādhanamamānitvamityādyuktam || 35 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracatasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || || atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || kṣetreti || prādhānyenottarādhyāyaiḥ sādhanamevocyate | tatra bandhaprakāraparijñāna eva tanmokṣasādhanānuṣṭhānaṃ yujyate | bandhaśca triguṇātmakaḥ | ato " yāvatsañjāyate " ityuktavivaraṇapūrvakaṃ triguṇavikārasthitiṃ tadatyayopāyaṃ ca darśayatyanenādhyāyeneti bhāvaḥ | " kāryate hyavaśaḥ karma " ityādau traiguṇyasya saṅkṣepeṇoktatvāt vivicyetyuktam | " paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi " iti pratijñātamucyate " mama yoniḥ " iti | tatra yoniśabdasya kāraṇārthatvapratītinirāsāya bhāryādyarthatve pramāmamāha || yoniriti || sthānaṃ guhyasthānam | astvevaṃ yoniśabdo bhāryādyanekārthaḥ | prakṛtaḥ kimartha ityata āha || atreti || yoniśabdasyānekārthatvāt kathamayamevārtha ityata āha || tasminniti || 3 || traiguṇye vivicyokte sati tarhi guṇā eva sarvottamāḥ, na tu tato'nyaḥ sarvottama iti śaṃkā syāt | sā nirākriyate -- nānyamiti | atra guṇānānameva kartṛtvaṃ, neśvarasyaityanyathāpratītinirasāyāha || etabhya iti || ajñasyāpi puruṣatvāt ko viśeṣo jñānina ityata āha || antheti || evaṃ yojanāyāṃ " madbhāvaṃ so'dhigacchati " iti vyarthaṃ syāt | vākyasya tadvinaiva samāptatvādityataḥ tatsārthakyaṃ darśayati || kathamiti || bhagavati bhāvaprāptiyogyasyaiva puruṣatvaṃ " puruṣatve vā vistarādātmā " ityādiśrutisiddham | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityato " mama yoniḥ " ityādi smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mahālakṣmīriti || parā ṣaḍbhyo'dhikā | dguṇatvāt sat, tviṣa dīptāviti dhātoḥ prabhārūpatvāt tvamiti sattvamityarthaḥ | sṛṣṭyā hi rañjanaṃ bhavati | kimiyaṃ prasiddhā pṛthivīdevatā'sāvityata āha || yaditi || tamu glapana iti dhatuḥ | glapanaṃ saṃsāreṇa glānidānam | amuktigā ityanena " dehe dehinaṃ " ityasyārtha ukto bhavati | keṣāṃ ko bandhiketyata āha || sarvāniti || anena tatra sattvamityādinā tāratamyenoktabandhatraividhyasya viṣayaḥ pradarśito bhavati | evametāsāṃ sarvabandhakatvenātisāmarthyāt sarvottamatvamiti na mantavyamityāha || etābhya iti || viṣṇuṃ sarvottamatvena jānanneva yato vimucyate'taḥ sa eva puruṣaḥ | ato naitābhyo vidyate paraḥ iti jānan nṛpaśurityarthaḥ || 16 -19 || " rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkham " ityatra duḥkhaśabdaḥ kevaladuḥkhārtha ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || rajasa iti || duḥkhaśabdaḥ kathaṃ duḥkhamiśrasukhavācītyata āha || duḥkhamiti || atra kevaladuḥkhavācī kiṃ na syādityato rajaso miśraphalatve smṛtimāha || karmaṇa iti || ajñānajamityanena ajñānamiti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tena kevaladuḥkhasya tamaḥphalatvoktiścārthāntare bādhiketi sūcitaṃ bhavati || 20 -21 || guṇātyayopāyādipraśnasya parihāra ucyate " prakāśaṃ " iti | tatra svasmin prakāśaṃ necchati, svagatamohaṃ na dveṣṭi, duḥkhādisāmyaṃ ca spṛhādyabhāvamātraṃ, sarvārambhaparityāgaśca sarvatrodāsīnatvamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya pramāṇāntareṇa tadvyācaṣṭe || loketi || puruṣāntare sthitaṃ prakāśādi sādhu na dveṣṭi | tatra mohādyasādhu necchatītyarthaḥ | svasya prāptaprakāśatvāt mohojjñitatvāt svasminneva tadicchādyabhāvaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || svayamiti || mohaṃ dveṣṭi ceti draṣṭavyam | taṃ cāpītyanena māṃ cetyuktārthaṃ bhavati | sukhaduḥkhādītyasya viṣṇubhaktiparityāge sukhasya, anyathā duḥkhasya bhāve'pītyarthaḥ | arthārthamityādinā samaloṣṭhetyādyuktarthaṃ bhavati | avaiṣṇavetyanena sarvārambhetyuktārthaṃ bhavati | viṣṇu yātītyanena saguṇānityādeḥ tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati || 22 || itaśca sarvārambhaparityāgīti na kevalodāsīnatvamucyate | udāsīnavaditi pūrvavākye kevalodāsīnatvābhāvasyokteḥ | neṅgata iti pūrvavākye karmābhāvasyoktatvāt kathaṃ kevalodāsīnatvābhāva ityata āha || neṅgata iti || neṅgata iti na sarvapravṛttiniṣedhaḥ, kintu bhagavadudāsīnapravṛttiniṣedha evetyarthaḥ | tarhi neṅgata ityanenaiva avaiṣṇavakarmākaraṇasyoktatvāt sarvārambhaparityāgīti punaruktirityata āha || iti vaktīti śeṣaḥ | neṅgata iti sāmānyoktiriti draṣṭavyam | neṅgata ityalpāvaiṣṇavapravṛttyabhāva ucyate | sarvārambhaparityāgīti dīrghāvaiṣṇavapravṛttyabhāva ucyata ityataśca na punaruktiriti bhāvena iṅganārambhaśabdayoḥ alpamahatkarmārthatve pramāṇamāha || iṅganamiti || 23 -25 || nanu guṇaśabdena śryādīnāṃ vivakṣitatvāt " saguṇān samatītyaitān " iti tadatyayaḥ kathamucyate | aśakyatvādityata āha || lakṣmyādibhiriti || lakṣmīti śrīrucyate | smṛtyuktārthānuvādeva arthāntaraṃ cāha || taditi || ubhayatra prayogaṃ darśayati || yatheti || yathā dvārapālakṛtabandhātyayena gacchan dvārapālamatītya rājānaṃ gacchatītyucyate, yathā ca yo rājānaṃ gacchati sa dvārapālamatītya gacchatītyucyate tathaivetyarthaḥ | brahmabhūyāya ityasya brahmabhāvāyetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || brahmeti || 'mama yonirmahadbrahma' iti mahālakṣmyā eva brahmaśabdena prakṛtatvāt atrāpi saivocyata ityarthaḥ | pramāṇāntarasamākhyānenāpyetat sādhayati || atītyeti || guṇātītasya bhagavatprāptyādyeva vaktavyaṃ, lakṣmīprāptyā bhagavatprāptiḥ | yena taduktiḥ saṅgatā syādityato'bhiprāyamāha || maditi || tatsthatva iti śeṣaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇayoraviyogaścet guṇatīto māmāpnotītyeva vaktavyam | kiṃ paramparoktyetyata āha || tathāpīti || yadyapi tayoraviyogastathāpi lakṣmīsamīpaṃ prāpya tadanujñayā bhagavatprāptirbhavatīti paramparoktiryuktetyarthaḥ | 'sukhasyaivakāntikasya' iti tirohitārthatvādvyāyaṣṭe || ekāntikasyeti || ekamevāsmādadhikamiti gaṇane'nte sthitamekāntikam | tattu mokṣa eveti bhāvaḥ || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || etadadhyāyapratipādyaṃ darśayati || trayodaśeti || yat trayodaśādhyāye jagatsvarūpaṃ varṇitaṃ tadasmin adhyāye vivicya darśayati | tasyaiva saṃsārarūpatvāt | saṃsāraṃ jihāsatā tatsvarūpasya jñātavyatvāt | yaśca tatra saṃsārātyayopāyo nirūpitastaṃ cātra darśayatītyarthaḥ | tatrāpratipattyanyathāpratipattinirāsāya śrutyaivādhyāyo vyākhyāyate || pṛthagiti || tatrordhvamulamityasyārthaḥ pṛthagiti | jagadvṛkṣasya harirmūlaṃ cettarhi tasya jagadekadeśatvaṃ syādityataḥ pṛthagityuktam | yathā prasiddhasya vṛkṣasya bhūmiratadekadeśatvena mūlaṃ tathaivetyarthaḥ | prakārāntareṇordhvamūlatvaṃ darśayati || sattvādīti || mūlabhāgavaditi || prasiddhavṛkṣasyaikadeśabhūtamūlavanmūlamityarthaḥ | sattvādiyukte ityanena trimūlo jagadvṛkṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati | guṇapravṛddhā ityasya tātparyaṃ coktaṃ bhavati | mūlairhi śākhā pravardhante | nanu jagato'cetanatvāt acetanaprakṛtereva etanmūlatvaṃ, tarhi tasya jagadrūpeṇa pariṇāmaḥ syāt | bhūmyaṃśānāṃ loke pariṇāmitvadarśanādityata āha || pṛthivīti || tattatra jagadvṛkṣe hariḥ prasiddhavṛkṣasya pṛthivīdevatāvannimittatvenaiva mūlaṃ na tu mṛdvadupādānatayetyarthaḥ | tarhi tadvatpariṇāmitayā mūlaṃ kimityata āha || mṛdvaditi || acetanā acetanaprakṛtiḥ | evaṃ cejjagadvṛkṣo viṣṇvādimūlaḥ syāt, ūrdhvamūlaḥ kathamityata āha || uttamatvāditi || viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvāt, śriyaḥ paratantreṣūttamatvāt, acitprakṛteracetaneṣūttamatvāt ūrdhvāni uttamāni viṣṇavādimūlāni yasyāsāvūrdhvamūla ityarthaḥ | adhaḥśākhamityasyārtho nīcā iti | adho bhagavadapekṣayā nīcā mahadādayaḥ śākhā yasyāsāvadhaḥ śākha ityarthaḥ | jagadvṛkṣasyeti sambadhyate | chandasāṃ parṇatvamupapādayati | kāmeti || loke parṇotpattyanantarameva phaladarśanādatrāpi phalahetutvācchandanāṃ parṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | anena dharmārthayoḥ kāmamokṣārthatvāt kāmamokṣākhyadviphalo jagadvṛkṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati | adhaścordhvaṃ cetyasyārthaḥ anyonyeti || anenādhobhūtāḥ śākhā ūrdhvamūleṣu prasṛtāḥ, mūlāni cādhaḥ śākhāsu santatānītyuktaṃ bhavati | tasyopapādanaṃ kāraṇeṣviti | kāraṇeṣu kāryasya sthitatvāt śākhānāṃ mūleṣu prasṛtiryujyate | kāryeṣu kāraṇasya vyāptatvānmūlānāṃ śākhāsu santatiryuktetyarthaḥ | vṛkṣamātrasāmyasyoktatvāt ' aśvatthaṃ prāhuḥ' ityādāvaśvatthoktiḥ kathamityata āha || jagaditi || aśvavat sthito'śvattha ityarthaḥ | cañcalaścet kiṃ sarvātmanocchidyata ityata āha || avyaya iti || kimato yadyevaṃ jagadvṛkṣa ityata āha || svasaktīti || saṅgarāhityasahitajñānāsinetyarthaḥ | asya viṣṇoḥ pṛthaktvameva kutaḥ? tajrānena ca kimityata uktaṃ vivṛṇvannāha || avyaktādīti || neti netītyādeḥ pṛthaktvajñānena ca bhagavanmārgaṇaṃ bhavati | jagato bhagavadvailakṣaṇye jñāte hi tatsvarūpaṃ jñātuṃ śakyata iti bhavaḥ | anena 'tameva' iti vivṛtaṃ bhavati | vṛkṣacchedārthamiti śeṣaḥ | nanu jagadvakṣacchedo brahmādipratipattyā'pi bhavati | ataḥ 'tameva' iti kimavadharyata ityata āha || yaditi || brahmādīnāṃ bhagavadaṃśābhāsatvenāsamarthatvāt jagadvṛkṣacchedāya bhagavantameva prapadyetetyāśayaḥ || 1 -4 || aṃśa eva kiṃ na syāditi cenna | bhinnatvāt | tarhyaṃśābhāvaso'pi kathamityata āha || kiñciditi || anena 'mamaiva' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | kiñca jīvasya viṣayān prati indriyapreraṇādikamapīśvarādhīnamiti tatprapattirjagadvṛkṣacchedanopāya iti bhāvena bhagavanmahimānaṃ darśayat | bhuṅkta ityanena 'śrotraṃ' ityasyārtha ukto bhavati | śubhānityanena 'guṇān' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | īśvarasya pūrṇānandatvāt kiṃ viṣayabhogenetyata āha || pūrṇeti || 9 -12 || upajīvyatayā viśvanarasambandho vaiśvānara ityarthaḥ | kṣaraṇaṃ vināśaḥ | kṣara vināśasantatadānayoriti dhātoḥ | atrātmapadaprayogeṇa 'dvāvimau puruṣau' iti puruṣaśabdaḥ cetanārtha ityuktaṃ bhavati | tataśca na śriyaḥ puruṣatvavirodhaḥ || 13 -20 || iti śrīādānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracite śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇaye pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || deveti || abhayādidevatālakṣaṇānāṃ mokṣahetutvāt tadāpādanāya dambhādyasuralakṣaṇānāṃ tadvirodhitvāt tatparityāgāya tadubhayamasminnadhyāye nirūpyata iti bhāvaḥ | tatra 'abhimānaśaca', 'īśvaro'haṃ', 'asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram | 'aparasparasambhūtaṃ', 'māmātmaparadeheṣu praddhiṣantaḥ', 'tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatiṃ, 'trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ' ityādinā cārvākāṇāmasuratvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || ya iti || parebhyo na ca jāyate | bhramajatvādeva | kuta ete'surā ityata āha || akṣeti || satī pṛthivītyādipratyakṣasya, viśvaṃ satyamityādyāgamasya, pramāṇadṛṣṭatvādyanumānasya sarvasya mithyātve sarvamithyātvasyāpi mithyātvaprāptyā sarvasya tvamiti svoktivirodhaḥ | na kevalaṃ parameśvaro'hamityādi manvānā asurāḥ, kintu yo'nye pratyakṣādiviruddhavādinaste sarve'pyasurā ityāha || evamiti || devalakṣaṇamāha || ye tviti || anena 'jñānayogavyavasthitirdānaṃ' ityādi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | kuta evaṃvidhānāṃ devatvamityata āha || pratyakṣeti || vamuktigā ityanenaiva devītyuktārthaṃ bhavati | nanu 'tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatiṃ' ityāsurasampado'ndhatamasahetutvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt kathaṃ 'nibandhāyasurī matā' iti bandhahetutvamucyata ityata āha || nibandhāya nīceti || nātra saṃsārahetutvamucyate, kintvatinīcāndhatamasasādhanatvameveti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhūtasargāṇāmatibahuprakāratvāt 'dvau bhūtasargau' ityādi kathamucyata ityata āha || sargāṇāmiti || sargāṇāṃ subahutve'pi dvāviti vaktuṃ śakyate | śubhāśubhaphalādhikyavivakṣayeti bhāvaḥ | gandharvamanuṣyādhamādīnāmapi śubhāśubhaphalādhikatvāt ko viśeṣo devādīnāmityata āha || gandharveti || tadubhayaphalāntarvartamānā evetyarthaḥ | tadvivṛṇoti || muktigā iti || evaṃ tamogā eveti ca draṣṭavyam | tarhi devādīnāmapi muktyādigatvādebhyaḥ ko viśeṣa ityata āha || devā iti || evamasurā evātidāruṇatamogā iti draṣṭavyam | yaduktaṃ dvāvityuktighaṭanāya mokṣasyānekavidhatvāt devānāmebādhikamokṣo nānyeṣāmiti tadgītāyāmapi jñāyata ityāha || vimokṣāyeti || nanu devatvādeḥ kāraṇaviśeṣeṇa hānopādānadarśanāt dvau bhūtasargāviti nisargatvoktiḥ kathamityata āha || deveti || nisargatvādeva nānyathā bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanu prahlādādyasurāṇāṃ devatvadarśanātkathamanyathābhāvābhāva ityata āha || devā iti || prahlādādīnāṃ svato devānāmeva kāraṇaviśeṣeṇaivāsuratvam | atastadvihāya devatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu tatrāpyasuratvaṃ naṣṭamityastyevetyata āha || hetuta iti || aupādhikatvādasuratvasya nāśo yukta eva | na tena svābhāvikāsuratvānāśamatasya virodha iti bhāvaḥ | māstvasurāṇāṃ devatvaṃ, devānāṃ tu devatvaparityāgenāsuratvaṃ prāptamityata āha || nāpīti || nāsurabhāvaḥ prahlādādīnāṃ devatvasvabhāvanivartakaḥ | aupādhikatvāt | sphaṭikaśauklyānivartakalauhityavaditi bhāvaḥ | tarhi śāpādivaiyarthyamityāśaṃkya pariharati || kintviti || tato devānāmasuratvābhāvāt | devatvasyānapagame'pi kuto'śocyatvamityata āha || mokṣeti || tadupapādayati || hareriti || anenaiva mā śuca ityasya tātparyaṃ coktaṃ bhavati || 1 -24 || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || atha saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || saditi || satkarmaṇa eva puruṣārthasādhanatvenānuṣṭheyatvāt asatkarmaṇastadviruddhatvena tyājyatvāt anuṣṭhānatyāgayośca vivicyājñāne'sambhavāt sadasatkarmaṇī vivicyātrocyete iti bhāvaḥ || 1 -2 || 'ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya'iti praśnasyottaramucyate -- trividheti | tatra nājñānācchāstravidhimutsṛjya yajanaṃ sāttvikatvādijñāpakam | kintu sāttvikatvādibhedena śraddhā trividhā bhavati | tatra yo yajamāno yādraśaśraddhaḥ sa tādraśa iti śraddhayaiva tajjñānamityuktasyopapādasāyoktam || sattvānurūpeti || tatra śraddhāyāḥ sattvaguṇānurūpatvoktyā kathaṃ yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva sa ityasyopapādanamityata āha || sattveti || sattvaśabdasya jīvavācitvaṃ pūrvameva sādhitam | kimato yadyevamityata āha || ata iti || śraddhāyā jīvānurūpatvāt tayā tatsvarūpaṃ jñāyata ityarthaḥ | śraddhāyā jīvasvarūpatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || śraddhāmaya iti || tatra mayaṭ‌śabdasyānekārthatvādatropayuktamarthamāha || śraddheti || 'tāṃ śrṛṇu'iti pratijñānaṃ 'yo yacchraddhaḥ'ityasya vivaraṇenocyate || yajanta iti || tatrāntaḥkaraṇavṛttiśraddhāyā api vidyamānatvena svarūpabhūtāyā vivektumaśakyatvāt tayā kathaṃ jīvasvarūpajñānam sarveṣāmapi devatāyājitvāt kathaṃ yakṣarakṣāṃsītyādi? kathaṃ ca nityākṛśamīśvaraṃ tāmasāḥ karśayanti? ityādiśaṃkāparihārāya sattvānurūpetyādi pramāṇavākyenaiva vyācaṣṭe || śraddheti || kiṃ śraddhā svarūpabhūtaiva uta bhinnā'pyastītyata āha || svarūpeti || tarhi svarūpaśraddhāyā eva jñātumaśakyatvāt na tayā jīvasvarūpaviveka ityata āha || tatrate || vyajyate'ntaḥkaraṇe | evaṃ rājasatvāpi sāttvakī tāmasī kvacideva bhavatīti jñātavyam || kiṃ tata ityata āha || bhūyastvāditi || evaṃ svarūpaśraddhāyā evādhikyenābhivyakterjñātuṃ śakyatvāt tayā jīvasvarūpaṃ vivicyata ityarthaḥ || 3 || kathaṃ śraddhayā jīvasvarūpaviveka ityata āha || śraddheti || anena yajanta ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | vyāmiśrayājino'krameṇa yājinaḥ | akhilaṃ jaganmithyeti manyanta ityarthaḥ | anena sarvayājināṃ devatāyājitvasāmye'pi bhoktṛvivakṣayā devānityādyuktirityuktaṃ bhavati | 'adhyakṣavidyākhyā', 'dīnatvāt', 'śivaskandādi'ityanena kvacittathoktīnāṃ gatiruktā syāt | trividhānāṃ teṣāṃ yajanaphalamāha || mokṣa iti || svargapratinidhitvena kalpitaḥ sāṅ‌kalpikaḥ svargaḥ | uktarītyā sāttvikānāṃ kiṃ śāstravidhiṃ jānatāmajānatāmapi mokṣa ityata āha || tyaktveti || anena śāstravidhyutsargādyaprayojakīkṛtya śraddhāyā eva prayojakatvakathanasyābhiprāyo'pi varṇito bhavati | tāmasānāṃ bhūtāditvamavāntaraphalameva | mukhyaṃ tu tama evetyupapādayati || aśāstreti || jñeyāścetyanena 'tān viddhi'ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | annaiścetyanena 'āhāraḥ'ityādestātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | śraddhāyā jīvasvarūpatvena tayā tajjñānamupapadyate | āhārādyaistatkathamityata āha || sāttvikā iti || atra jīvānāṃ sāttvikatvādi uttamatvādīti jñeyam | sāttviyajñādīnāmitthaṃbhāvāntaravidhānāyāha || omiti || anena oṃ tatsat' ca ityādi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | kena hetunā viṣṇoromiti nāmetyata āha || viprā iti || tasmādoṅ‌kārasya bhagavannāmatvāt, omityuccāryeti śeṣaḥ || pravartanta iti || pravartayantītyarthaḥ | anena brāhmaṇā ityādyuktārthaṃ bhavati | bhagavannāmāntarasadbhāvāt kathametaduccāraṇaniyatirityato'sya viśeṣamāha || anoṅ‌kṛtamiti || oṅ‌kāroccāraṇaṃ tadarthajñānapūrvakameva kāryamiti bhāvenāha || oṅ‌kṛtaṃ tviti || kiṃnimittaṃ viṣṇostaditi nāmetyata āha || phalamiti || anena tadityuktārthaṃ bhavati | nanu mayaṭ‌pratyayasya vikāraikārthatvāt kathaṃ śraddhāmaya ityasya śraddhāsvarūpa iti vyākhyetyata āha || maṭamiti || śraddhaiva prayojikā na tu śāstravidhānānusāritvādīti yatparihāravākyābhiprāyavarṇanaṃ tatkuta ityata āha || śāstreti || bhagavataiva śraddhābhāve śāstravidhānānusāriṇo'pyasattvasyaivoktatvāt śraddhaiva prayojikā nānyaditi jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | hutamityatra śāstravidhānānusāreṇeti siddham | vidhānoktiprasaṅgāt | aṅgīkṛtya cedamuktam | bhagavacchraddhābhāve śāstravidhānānusāritvaṃ ca nāsti | tato'pi śraddhaiva sāttvikatvādau prayojiketyāśayenāha || bhagavaditi || tatkuta ityata āha || viṣṇubhaktīti || viṣṇubhaktividhānārthameva śāstrapravṛttiśruteḥ tadabhāve na śāstravidhānānusāritvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | śāstravidhānāsyāprayojakatve kathaṃmaśāstravihitamiti tāmasatve prayojakatvamucyata ityato āha || bhagavaditi | 'rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ'ityāhārāṇāṃ kiṃnāma sthiratvaṃ, keṣāṃ cocyata ityata āha || sthirā iti || bahukālaṃ guṇapradā ityarthaḥ | kaṭ‌vāmlalavaṇeti kaṭūvādīnāṃ yadrājasatvamuktaṃ tanna niyataṃ, kadācit sāttvikatvamapi syādityāha || kaṭūvādīnāmiti || raso rasāyanam | evaṃ rasyāḥ sthigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā iti sāttvikatvenoktānāṃ rasyādīnāṃ sāttvikatvaṃ na niyataṃ, kadācit rājasattvamapi bhavatītyāha || rasyeti || kaṭūvādīnāṃ rājasattvaniyamaḥ kiṃ na syāt kadācitsāttvikatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || dukheḥti || duḥkhādipradāścet rājasā ityuktatvādārogyādihetutve kaṭūvādīnāṃ sāttvikatvāvagaterna rājasattvaniyama ityarthaḥ | rasyādīnāṃ sāttvikatvāniyame cāyuḥsattvetyādyudāhartavyam | balaśabdāt sattvaśabdasyānatibhinnārthatvāt punaruktirityata āha || sattvamiti || nātrāyaṃ sattvaśabdārthaḥ sādhubhāvaḥ | tasyānnotpannatvābhāvādityata āha || bhavatīti || 'sukhaprītivivardhanāḥ' 'hṛdya'iti śabdasyaikārthatvapratīti nirāsāyāha || hṛdyamiti || sevānantaramapi yatpurbhūyāditi mano harati tad hṛdyam | upayogakāla eva saukhyapradaṃ priyam | sakṛdupayuktaṃ dīrghakālaṃ sukhaṃ dadat sukhadam | bahuvāropabhoga eva saukhyadaṃ rasyamityarthaḥ || 8 || rūkṣaśabdasyānekārthatvādatra vivakṣitamarthamāha || rūkṣamiti || annasya tīkṣṇatvaṃ ghaṭayannāha || tīkṣṇamiti || 9|| paṅktipāvanapuruṣaśeṣānnasya sāttvikatvaprasiddheḥ kathaṃ yātayāmaṃ tāmasamityataḥ prakārāntareṇa pramāṇata eva vyācaṣṭe || yāmeti || yāmaṃ yāmyaṃ niyamyam apekṣitāṃśaḥ sāra iti yāvat | tarhi gatarasamiti punaruktirityata āha || purvamiti || yo vā ko vā yasya rasastadapagame yātayāmaṃ, svadutvāpagame gatarasamityarthabheda iti bhāvaḥ | rūkṣaśabdena rājasatayoktanīrasasya kathaṃ tāmasatvamucyata ityato vā'ha || pūrvamiti || svata eva nīrasaṃ rūkṣam, pūrva svadveva paścādanyathā jātaṃ gatarasamityadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ | apagatasvadutvaṃ tāmasattvamiti durgamam | ekasyaiva vastunaḥ puruṣabhedena svādutvāsvādutvasambhavena svādvāderaniścayādityata āha || śuddheti || yaduktaṃ rājasayajanena sāṅ‌kalpikaḥ svarga eveti tanna yujyate | 'abhisandhāya tu phalaṃ'iti tatra phalābhisandhinā pravṛtteḥ, rājasayāgena indrādidevalokaḥ svargo bhavatīti kvacidvacanāccetyāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyantareṇa pariharati || yāgāditi || svargābhisandhānāttatra pravṛtteḥ kathaṃ tadabhāva ityata āha || viṣṇāviti || svargakāmanena pratyuta naraka eva bhavati, na svargaḥ | teṣāṃ viṣṇāvaśraddhāsadbhāvena svargayogyānāṃ tatkāmasyāyogyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | rājasānāṃ sakāmayajñābhāve'pi narakasadbhāvāt kathamayogyakāmādi tatkāraṇamityata āha || vineti || kvacinnarakadarśanasya gatimāha || niṣiddhamiti || atra narakalokapracuratvoktyā rājasoṣu madhyamā vivakṣitāḥ na tu nityatraividyā iti jñātavyam | yadi rājasakarmaṇā narakaḥ syāttarhi sāttvikānāmapi tatkaraṇasambhavāt narakaprāptiḥ stādityata āha || kadāciditi || yadyapi sāttvikā rājasatāmase, rājasāḥ sāttvikatāmase, tāmasāśca sāttvikarājase karmaṇī yadyapi kurvanti | tathāpi tatkādācideva | svābhāvikakarmaṇyeva prādhānyena sthitiḥ | mahatā cālpābhibhava iti na phalasaṅ‌kara iti bhāvaḥ | svābhāvikaṃ mahāphamasvābhāvikam alpaphalamityato'pi svābhāvikenānyābhibhavasambhavānna phalasaṃkara ityāha || svamiti || yadi sāttvikādīnāṃ svābhāvikāsvābhāvikakarmakaraṇaṃ syāttarhi idaṃ svābhāvikaṃ karma, idaṃ neti kathaṃ jñāyata ityata āha || bāhulyamiti || svābhāvikādikarmasu yad bahulaṃ tat svābhāvikam, alpamasvābhāvikamiti bāhulyādijñāpakamiti bhāvaḥ || 10 -15 || 'manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunaṃ' ityatra maunaśabdasyānyarthatvapratīti nirāsāyāha || maunamiti || kathaṃmanyathā mānasaṃ tapaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | 'aphalākāṅkṣibhiryuktaiḥ' ityatra yuktatvaṃ nāma kimityata āha || yuktairiti || nanu sāttvikayajñadānayorbhagavadarpaṇamanuktvā tapasyeva kimucyata ityata āha || yuktairiti || na kevalaṃ tapasyevaitaducyate kintu yajñadānatapassvapi etadanuṣañjanīyamiti bhāvaḥ | 'oṃtatsaditi nirdeśaḥ' ityetadvākyāntareṇa vyākhyātam | tadvākyavivaraṇenaitadvākyaṃ vivṛṇoti || 16 -22 || saditi || tataśca kimityata āha || omiti || karmādīnāṃ satsambandhitvādeva hi sattvam | tacca padaṃ brahmaiva | oṃtatsaditi nāmnāṃ viṣṇau prasiddhatvāt | ato viṣṇusambandhyeva karmādi saditi bhāvaḥ | anena 'oṃ tatsaditi yadviṣṇoḥ' iti vivṛtaṃ bhavati | anoṅ‌kṛtaṃ hyāsuraṃ syāt ityanoṅ‌kṛtasyāsuratvaprasiddhiḥ taduccāraṇe hetutayoktā | kā'sāvityato vaidikītyāha || sravatīti || 'oṅ‌kṛtaṃ tvapi'ityuktārthe śrutiṃ cā'ha || anarthajñeti || nirartho niṣprayojanaḥ | kutaḥ? yasmādarthajñānata eva jñātāraṃ trāti tena hi mantraḥ kathitaḥ | nanvasminnadhyāye sadasatkarmavivekhaḥ kāryaḥ | taṃ vihāya oṃ tatsadityādinā kimucyata ityato'bhiprāyamāha || tadarthatveneti || atra hyoṅ‌karārthasmaraṇapūrvakaṃ tamuccārya bhaktyā bhagavadarthatvena niṣkāmatayā kṛtameva karma sāttvikamanyadrājasādītyucyate | tataścaitādṛśameva satkarma anyadasatkarmeti sadasatkarma vivicyoktameveti bhāvaḥ | na ca vācyamatraivaṃvidhakarmaṇaḥ sattvamanyasyāsattvaṃ svayamevocyata iti | anyathā prasaṅgānanuguṇatvaprasaṅgena sadādiśabdasya sāttvikādyarthatvāt | etena 'aphalākāṅkṣibhiḥ' ityāderapyevamevādhyāyasaṅgatiḥ sūcitā bhavati | nanu 'karma caiva tadartho'yaṃ' iti sāttvikaṃ karmoktvā rājasamanabhidhāya 'aśraddhayā hutaṃ' iti tāmasameva kimucyata ityata āha || rājasasyeti || nātra tāmasamevāsacchabdenocyate api tu rājasamapīti bhāvaḥ | takuta ityato'śraddhayetyuktāsallakṣaṇasya rājase'pi bhāvādityāha || viṣṇivati || 'na ca tatpretya no iha' iti yadrājasatāmasakarmaṇoḥ phalamuktaṃ tadvivicya smṛtyā darśayati || sāttvikamiti || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || atha aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || sarveti || yatsarveṣvadhyāyeṣu viprakīrṇatayā puruṣārthasādhanamuktaṃ tanmandānāṃ buddhyārohārthaṃ saṅkṣepeṇāsminnadhyāye nirūpyate | caturdaśādyanuktaṃ traiguṇyaṃ cocyata ityarthaḥ || 1 -2 || 'sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ' iti svoktatyāgasvarūpāvadhāraṇāya prātītikī vidvanmatavipratipattirudbhāvyate -- 'tyājyam' iti | atra yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ, kāryameva taditi bhagavanmatavirodhitvāt tyājyaṃ doṣavaditi tyāgapakṣiṇo nindyā ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || manīṣiṇa iti || ata iti || 'kāryamityeva vatkarma' ityatra yathā karmaṇi saṅgaphalatyāgena karmatyāgo varṇyate, na tu karmasvarūpatyāgena, tathā tyājyamityetadartho varṇayituṃ śakyate | ato na tasya bhagavanmatavirodhaḥ | kuto'rthāntarakalpaneti cet manīṣiṇa ityuktatvādeveti bhāvaḥ || 3 -4 || niścayaṃ śrṛṇviti pratijñātamucyate -- yajñeti | tatra jyotiṣṭomādiyajñeṣu hiraṇyādidāneṣu yatīnāṃ śūdrādīnāṃ cādhikārābhāvāt ūrdhvaretastvāditapassu gṛhasthādīnām adhikārābhāvāt kathaṃ sarveṣāṃ yajñādividhīyata ityata āha || dravyeti || nātra sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣṭomādiyajñaḥ, hiraṇyādidānāni, ūrdhvaretastvāditapāṃsyeva vidhīyante, kintu dravyayajñādiyajñāḥ, vidāyādidānāni, satyavacanāditapāṃsi | teṣāṃ ca yatyādīnāmapyucitatvāt yuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ tadvidhiriti bhāvaḥ | 'nāgnirna yajñaḥ' ityādeḥ trivarṇabāhyānāṃ na kvāpi yajñe'dhikāra ityata āha || viṣṇviti || dravyādiyajñābhāve'pi teṣāṃ svādhyāyayajñe'dhikāro'styeva | na ca vedānadhikāreṇa tadabhāvaḥ | viṣṇunāmasvādhyāyayajñe'dhikārasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | teṣāṃ kiṃ tapa ityata āha || satyeti || 5 -6 || 'tyāgo hi' ityuktaṃ prapañcyate -'niyatasya' iti | tatra karmatyāgasya svayameva stūyamānatvāt kathaṃ mohanimittatvamucyata ityata āha || saṅgeti || svarūpatyāgasyāpi mohanimittatvaṃ kutaḥ? yonāyamarthaḥ syādityata āha || sveti || nanu puruṣārthasādhane|pi karmaṇi duḥkhasādhanamiti mithyājñānena tatsvarūpaparityāgasya rājasatvakathanāt kathaṃ tāmasatvamityata āha || mohamiti || nohaṃ vineti || paratrāpīdaṃ duḥkhasādhanamiti mithyājñānaṃ vinetyarthaḥ | duḥkhaśabdena śarīrāyāsa ucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || duḥkheti || kevalamiti || śarīrāyāsadvārā prāptaṃ na cetyarthaḥ | śarīrāyāsa evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || kāryeti || na kevalamanyathā punaruktiprasaṅgādatra
