duḥkhaśabdo mānasaduḥkhārthaḥ | kintu tathā vacanāccetyāha || duḥkhamiti || arthaviśeṣavivakṣāyāmevaṃ jñeyam | tadabhāve dvayamapi śabdadvayenocyata iti bhāvaḥ || 8 -9 || sāttvikatyāgī punarnirūpyate -- ' na dveṣṭi' iti | tatra kathaṃ sāttvikatyāgino'kuśalakarmādveṣaḥ kuśalakarmāsaṅgaścocyate | 'kāryamityeva' ityuktivirodhādityataḥ pramāṇāntareṇa tadvyācaṣṭe || na dveṣṭīti || puṇya iti || tatphala iti yāvat || tameva stauti || ya iti || samyagityanena modhāvītyādyuktārthaṃ bhavati | tadarpaṇenetyanena tyāgītyuktārthaṃ syāt | tasyetyanenāniṣṭamityasya tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | kiṃ tasya sarvathā bandhakaṃ karma na bandhāya bhavatītyata āha || bahulaṃ cediti || bahulaṃ cet sarvatyāgināmapyatyalpadoṣakaraṃ kiyatparyantamityata āha || yāvaditi || 10 -11 || 'aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca' ityatra bandhakaṃ karmaphalaṃ tyāgina iṣṭamityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || anyeṣāmiti || tyāgina eveṣṭaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || asyeti || na tyāgino bandhakaṃ karmaphalamiṣṭam | tyāgitvādeva 'yastu karmaphalatyāgī' iti karmaphalecchātyāgina eva tyāgitvenoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | bhavedevaṃ yadi 'aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca' ityatra bandhakakarmaphalaṃ vivakṣitaṃ syāt | na caivamabandhakakarmaphalasyāpi grahaṇe bādhakābhāvādityatastyāgino bandhakakarmaphalasyaivābhāve'tyāgino bandhakakarmaphalabhāve pramāṇamāha || jñānāderiti || tyāgimātrasya jñānabhaktyādeḥ | tasyaivāparokṣatastattvasaṃvettuḥ mokṣabhogyānandātiśayāt | tadṛte jñānādikamṛte | anena 'bhavatyatyāgināṃ' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu tyāgināmityatyāgināṃ pratiyogitvena tyāgina eva vaktavyāḥ | saṃnyāsinastu kimityucyanta ityata āha || kevaleti || atyāgipratiyogitayā saṃnyāsikathanaṃ nānupapannam | svārthe phalecchābhāve'pi paropakārārthaṃ kārīryādikevalakāmyakarmakaraṇasti tyāginām | tadapi nyāsināṃ nāstītyetāvanmātraviśeṣavattvāt tyāgibhyo viśeṣo nyāsināmityarthaḥ | etāvāneva cedviśeṣaḥ tat kiṃ tayo -- sāmyam? yena tyāgiṣu vaktavyeṣu nyāsināmuktirityata āha || tyāgitvamiti || karmaphalecchābhāvo dvayorapi sama ityarthaḥ | tyāgibhyo nyāsināmukta eva viśeṣa ityetat kuta ityata āha || pareti || 12 || karmaṇyabhimānatyāgo'pi saṃnyāsa iti bhāvena karmakāraṇānyucyante -- 'pañca' iti | tatra sāṅkhyakṛtāntapadena paramasāṅkhyasiddhānta evocyate, na tu prasiddhasāṅkhyameva | atra daivaśabdeneśvarasya gṛhītatvāt paramasāṅkhyasya ca seśvaratvāt prasiddhasāṅkhyasya nisīśvaratvāt, tathā paramasāṅkhyasya vaidikatvenātropādānasambhavāt anyasyāvaidikatvena tadasambhavāditi bhāvena tayoḥ seśvaratvādau pramāṇamāha || kathitamiti || 13 || adhiṣṭhānapadasyātra vivakṣitamarthamāha || adhiṣṭhānamiti || 14 -16 || tajjñānaṃ stūyate -- 'yasya' iti | etacca sarvānahaṅ‌kārādimatāṃ samamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vacanāntareṇaiva vyācaṣṭe || svātantryamiti || ātman ātmani || lakṣaamyādeśca svātantryaṃ vettītyanuṣajyate | tadarthaṃ lokahananārtham | tadarthaṃ jātatvenaivālaṃ, kimīśvarasyātantryādijñānenetyata āha || ajña iti || lokān hanti cediti śeṣaḥ | tarhi jñānenaivālaṃ, kiṃ tadarthaṃ jātatvenetyataḥ parokṣāparokṣajñāninorapi tadarthamajātayorlokahanena vibhāgena bādhakāmaha || aparokṣeti || parokṣajñastadarthajāto yadi lokān hanti tarhi kiñciddoṣeṇa lipyata ityarthaḥ | aparokṣetyuktyā jñānaṃ cāparokṣamapekṣaitamiti sūcitam | parotraānena tadarthaṃ jātatvenaivālaṃ, kimaparokṣajñānenetyato vā''ha || parokṣeti || atra tadarthaṃ jātaiti grāhyam | nanu sarvoṣāmapyasvatantratvenāhantṛtvāt asyaiva na hantīti kiṃ viśiṣyocyata ityata āha || asvātantryeti || bhāvo'sya nāstītyanyasya bhāvo'stīti hetorna hantīti viśeṣo yukta iti yojyam | na hantītyucyata ityato na paunaruktyam | nanu buddheralopo nāma svātantryābhimānaparityāgaḥ | ataḥ punaruktirityata āha || buddhiriti || bhavedevaṃ, 'yasya nāhaṅ‌kṛto bhāvo' 'buddhiryasya na lipyate' ityanayorarthabhedo yadi svātantryābhimānaphalarāgayorubhayorapi bandhakatvaṃ syāt | tadeva kuta ityata āha || svātantryamiti || 17 || 'daivaṃ caiva' itīśvarasya karmasu prerakatvamuktam | tatpreraṇāsvarūpaṃ nirūpyate -- 'jñānam' iti | tatsmṛtyopapādayati || samprerayituriti || preraṇāyā bhagavaddharmatvāt kathaṃ jñātṛtvādītyata āha || seti || preraṇāyā jñānādirūpabhagavatsvarūpatvena tathātvamupapadyata ityarthaḥ | preraṇāyāstadā tadā jāyamāsāyāḥ kathaṃ bhagavatsvarūpatvamityata āha || svarūpeṇeti || na preraṇā tadā tadotpadyate || kintu bhagavatsvarūpatayā sarvadā vidyamānaiva vyaktirūpeṇa jāyate | ato bhagavatsvarūpatvamupapannamiti bhāvaḥ | yo'ya preraṇāyā vyaktirūpo viśeṣaḥ so'pi nānitya iti śaṃkanīyam | tasya nityapreraṇārūpatvena sadā vidyamānasyaiva viśeṣato jāyamānatvādityāha || viśeṣo'pīti || evaṃ viśeṣasyāpi viśeṣastasyāpītyanavasthā syādityata āha || svanirvāhakateti || bhavedanavasthā, yadi preraṇāyā bhinno viśeṣastasyāpi tathetyaṅgīkriyate | na caivam | sā preraṇā svarūpameva svātmānaṃ viśeṣatayā viśeṣitayā nirvahati | sa viśeṣo'pyevamityaṅgīkārādityarthaḥ | etad dṛṣṭāntenopapādayati || viśiṣṭavaditi || tadeva vivṛṇoti || viśeṣyasyeti || asti tāvad viśeṣyaviśiṣṭayoravipratipanno'bhedaḥ | dharmadharmibhedavādinā'pi tasyāṅgīkṛtatvāt | na ca viśeṣyaviśiṣṭayornirviśeṣābhedaḥ | tathāsati jñātṛdevadattaśabhdayoḥ paryāyatvāpatteḥ | na caivaṃ viśeṣyasyāpi viśeṣāṅgīkāreṇānavasthā'sti | viśeṣyavastunastadviśeṣāṇāṃ ca svanirvāhakatvāt | evaṃ īśvarapreraṇāyā viśeṣastasyāpi viśeṣa ityaṅgīkāre na kaściddoṣa iti bhāvaḥ | bhavedetadviśeṣyaviśiṣṭayorabhedasiddhau, sa eva kuta ityata āha || jñāturiti || viśeṣyaviśiṣṭayorbhedānubhavābhāvāt abhedānubhavasadbhāvācca na bheda iti bhāvaḥ | viśeṣyaviśiṣṭayorabhede'nubhavāntaraṃ ca darśayati || paśyāmīti || ma iti viśeṣyamucyate | viśeṣaḥ samutthita iti tasyaiva viśiṣṭatvam | viśeṣaṇayuktaṃ viśiṣṭam | tadviśeṣaṇaṃ nirūpayati || viśeṣuṇamiti || viśeṣākhyaṃ yathā 'yastuno'stitvaṃ', phalasya nīlatvam' iti | itahadatyantabhinnaṃ daṇḍādi | tadubhayamapi viśeṣaṇamiti kasmāducyata ityata āha || viśeṣamiti || aṇayet gamayet | nanu daṇḍādiviśeṣaṇaṃ vastuni daṇḍatvādiviśeṣaṃ gamayati, viśeṣaḥ kiṃ gamayedityata āha || viśeṣeti || pūrvoktakarmakāraṇāni saṅkṣipyatrocyante -- 'karaṇaṃ' iti | tatra karmasaṅgrahakathanaṃ kvopayujyata ityatastadanūdya madhyamapadalopisamāso'yamiti bhāvena vyācaṣṭe || saṅgraha iti || kathamadhiṣṭhānādipañcakasya karaṇāditritvamityata āha || adhiṣṭhānasyeti || nanu pūrvānuktakarmaṇo'tra kathanāt kathaṃ teṣāmayaṃ saṅkṣepaḥ syādityata āha || karmeti || 18 || sāttvikajñānādisādhanānuṣṭhānāya guṇabhedā ucyante -- 'jñānam' iti | tatra, guṇāḥ saṅkhyāyante'sminniti guṇasaṅkhyānapadena prasiddhasāṅkhyaśāstramucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || evamiti || prasiddhasāṅkhyaśāstramevātra kiṃ na syādityata evamityuktam | evaṃ sarvagatasyeśvarasya sarvato bhedādiviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ sāttvikamityādi guṇasaṅkhyāne procyata iti hyatrocyate | tacca paramasāṅkhyaśāstragrahaṇa evopapadyate, na nirīśvarasāṅkhyagrahaṇa iti bhāvaḥ || 19 || tatra pratijñātaṃ jñānatraividhyamucyate -- 'sarva' iti | tadapratītyādi nirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || astitvāditi || pṛthaktvenetyantena sarvabhūteṣviti saptamyā abhiprāyo'pyukto bhavati | viṣṇorityādinā avibhaktamityuktārthaṃ bhavati | tāratamyenetyanena vibhakteṣviti dvedhā vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | atha bhūtaśabdena bhavatīti jaḍaṃ cocyata ityabhiptetya vibhakteṣvityasyārtha ucyate || jaḍebhya iti || tebhyo jaḍebhya ityanena saptamyartha ukto bhavati || samyagiti || viṣṇuḥ sarvottamaḥ jīvāstadadhīnajñānādimantaḥ, jaḍaṃ tadrahitamityato viṣṇvādīnāṃ bheda ityarthaḥ | anenaikamityuktābhiprāyaṃ bhavati || 20 || viṣṇorityanena pṛthaktvenetyuktatātparyaṃ bhavati | sāttvikajñānasyāpi viṣṇoranyathra yathārthatvenoktatvāt kathaṃ rājasatvamasya syādityata āha || yadīti || miśratattvavit sandigdhatayā bhagavatsvarūpaṃ jānannityarthaḥ | anyathetyanena yattvityuktārthaṃ bhavati | yatkiñcidekaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jānātīti cādau draṣṭavyam | jānātītyantena kārye kṛtsnavat saktamityasya tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | kṛtsnamakāryatvādiguṇapūrṇaṃ brahma yathā viṣayīkaroti brahmeti tathetyarthaḥ | sa evetyanena kārye kṛtsnayat saktamityasya kṛtsnapadamakhilajagadviṣayamaṅgīkṛtya artāntaramuktaṃ bhavati | eketyanena ekasmin kārye kṛtsnavatsaktamityuktatātparyaṃ bhavati | yuktītvanenāhaitukamityasya yuktirāhityacca tathā manyata ityarthaḥ | alpetyanenālpamityuktārthaṃ bhavati | alpasamyagjñānaṃ ityarthaḥ | bhrāntasyāpyadhiṣṭhānādi viṣayasambagjñānavattvāt | atattvārthamityanenātattvārthavadityuktārthaṃ bhavati | yathāvasthitākārād viparītākāramityarthaḥ | tattvārthajñānavarjanāditi || yathāsthitākārajñānābhāvādityarthaḥ | nanu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktevena yajjñānamityetadeva nānābhāvān pṛthagvidhānityucyate | ataḥ punaruktideṣa ityata āha || pṛthaktveneti || vyākhyānavyākhyeyabhāvāt na punaruktideṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktvājñānaviṣayasya sāttvikatvenoktatvāt kathaṃ rājasatvamatrocyata ityata āha || sarveti || na kevalaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktvaviṣayaṃ sāttvikajñānamuktam | kintu tadgateśvaramapṛthaktvena sarvottamatvena ca viṣayīkurvat | tadabhāvādbhūteṣu pṛthaktvaviṣayatve'pyasya rājñasatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | anena yadīti smṛtirvivṛtā bhavati | 'yattu kṛtsnavadekasmin kārye saktaṃ jñānaṃ tadahaitukaṃ, atattvārthavadalpasajjñānayuktam' iti niyatamevātaḥ taduktau punaruktirityata uktaṃ vivṛṇvannāha || ekasyeti || yasya kasyacidekasya nāstītyantamuktārthaḥvivaraṇam | na pūrvoktasyaivāhaitukatvādiviśeṣaṇāni vidhīyante, yena punaruktiḥ syāt | kintvahaitukatvādīnāṃ svayameva tāmasānāmuktaviśeṣaṇayogitayā atitāmasatvajñāpanāya uktaviśeṣaṇānyucyanta iti bhāvaḥ | sadasadvailakṣaṇyādyavidyamānākārakalpanāyuktamityarthaḥ | evameṣāṃ padānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamaṅgīkṛtyaiva punaruktiṃ parihṛtyānekādhikaraṇa tayā'pi tāṃ pariharati || ekasminniti || kārye sarvaṃ jagaditi, saktamekasmin kārye sarvaṃ jagaditi caitāni padāni yojyānīti vā na punaruktiriti samyaddhyate | nanvevaṃvidhajñānasya kvāpyabhāvāt tasya tāmasatvakathanaṃ kathaṃmityata āha || māyeti || 21 -22 || guṇabhedena karmatraividhyamucyate -- 'niyataṃ' iti | tatra niyatapadena svavarṇāśramocitamātramucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || mayīti || viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvajñānapūrvakaṃ tadbhaktyā tadarpaṇabuddhyā kriyamāṇameva karma niyatamityatrocyate | na tu svavarṇāśramocitatvamātram | kutaḥ? 'mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi' iti bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānapurvakaṃ tadarpaṇabuddhyā karmakaraṇaṃ vidhāya 'ye me matamidam' iti tasya mokṣādhanatvokteḥ | 'ye tvetat' iti tadakaraṇe pratyavāyasya cokteḥ | yatkaraṇe phalaprāptiḥ, yadakaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ tasyaiva niyatatvāditi bhāvaḥ | bhavatu bhagavadarpaṇabuddhya kriyamāṇaṃ karma niyatam | tasya bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānādipūrvakatvaṃ kutaḥ mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi ityatra tadanukterityata āha || adhyātmeti || sarvādhike paramātmani cetaḥ adhyātmacetaḥ | apekṣitatayā jñāyata iti sambaddhyate | bhavedetat, yadyadhyātmacetaseti padaṃ bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānārthaṃ syāt | tadeva kuta ityata āha || ye tviti || mayi sarvāṇi iti ślokārthānuvādarūpe ye tu sarvāṇi ityanmin śloke'dhyātmacetaseti padasya 'matparāḥ' ityādinā bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānatatsmaraṇādyarthatayā vyakhyātatvāt bhavedevaitatpadaṃ tadarthamiti bhāvaḥ | ahaṃ paraḥ sarvottamo yeṣāṃ te matparāḥ | na ca vācyametacchlokasya tacchlokānuvādarūpatvaṃ kuta iti | 'evaṃ satatayuktā ye ' ityarjunena prāguktaprakārānuvādena pṛṣṭasya bhagavatastathaiva parihārokteryuktatvāt | samākhyāvaśācca etacchlokārthānuvāditvaṃ vijñāyate | kimetanniyatatvaṃ karmaṇa eva sāttvikatve prayojakamuta jñānādīnāmapītyata āha || evamiti || bhagavadarpaṇādikaṃ cātra draṣṭavyam || 23 -25 || guṇabhedataḥ kartustraividhmucyate -- 'mukta ' iti | tatra kartā cedanahaṃvādīti kathamityata āha || sarvasyeti || kartā'pyahameva karteti sāttviko na vadati | tena svakartṛtvādeḥ sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatayā niścitatvādityarthaḥ || 26 -27 || nanu sāttvikasyāpi prakākṛtatvadīrghasūtritvayoḥ sadbhāvāt kathaṃ tattāmasasyaivocyata ityataḥ tatpadadvayasyārthaṃ smṛtyaiva darśayati || bhagavaditi || smaranniti | cintayannityarthaḥ | paścāt kuryāmiti cintanaṃ sāttvike'pi samamityata āha || prāpteti || yasya karmaṇo yaḥ kālo vihitaḥ tasmin kāle prāpte'pi paścāt kuryāmiti cintayan dīrghasūtrītyarthaḥ | anena alasādapyasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ sūcitam | saḥ prāptakālaṃ karma udāsta eveti | nanvevaṃ ceddīrghasūtritaḥ stabdhādīnāṃ utkṛṣṭatvāt kathaṃ tāmasatayā gaṇanamityataḥ gaṇanamityataḥ pramāṇavākyenaiva tāmaseṣveva tān vibhajyāha || alasa iti || ayukto bhagavadarpaṇādiyogarahitaḥ | stabdho nāma ātmasambhāvanayā kvāpyanataḥ | naikṛtiko nīcakarmā | śaṭho gūḍhadveṣī | trividhatāmasānāṃ phalamāha || durnaratvamiti || 29 -30 || 'buddheḥ ' iti pratijñātamucyate -- 'pravṛttiṃ ' iti | tatra 'yayā darmamadharmaṃ ' ityuktaddhyorekaprakāratvāt kathaṃ rājasatāmasatvamityataḥ tadvibhāgaṃ vākyāntareṇa darśayati || kiñciditi || anena 'ayathāvat ' iti niyamena yathāvannetyuktaṃ bhavati | 'yogena ' iti upāyabalenetyalpārthapratītinirāsāya tad vākyāntareṇa vyācaṣṭe || vaiṣṇava iti || anena yogena yuktyeti pūritaṃ bhavati | dhṛtiśced vyabhicāraśūnyaivāto'vyabhicāriṇyeti viśiṣyāsyā eva kimucyata ityata āha || vihiteti || na cātrāvyabhicāritvamaskhalitatvamiti bhāvaḥ | yayā svapnamityuktamātraṃ yayā na muñcati sā tāmasīti pratītinirāsāyāha || svapnamiti || sarvaniṣiddhaṃ bhagavad‌dveṣādi | bhagavad‌dveṣādeḥ vṛddhāniṣiddhatvena tāmasatvāt tadviṣayadhṛterapi tāmasatvamiti bhāvaḥ | vṛddhaniṣiddhatve'pi kutastāmasatvamityata āha || taditi || nanu bhagavad‌dveṣādeḥ kaiścana vṛddhairvihitatvāt kathaṃ tanninditatvamityata āha || mahātmāna iti || ye bhagavad‌dveṣādividhāyakā na te vṛddhāḥ, kintu bhagavantaṃ bhajanta eva | tathoktatvādityarthaḥ || 35 -36 || 'sukhaṃ ' iti pratijñātamucyate -- 'abhyāsāt ' iti | tatra 'ātmabuddhiprasādajaṃ ' ityasya svamanaḥprasādajamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaivārthamāha || viṣṇoriti || jātamiti śeṣaḥ | manaḥprasādo nāma manasaḥ svato'pi prāyo viṣayāgati ḥ || 37 -39 || sarvajīvānāmapi guṇatastraividhyamucyate -- 'na tat ' iti | tatra sattvasyāpi guṇaviśeṣatvāt kathaṃ guṇabaddhatvamucyata ityata āha || sattvamiti || nanu guṇātītaṃ sattvaṃ nāstītyetāvatā pūrṇatvāt pṛthivyāṃ divīti viśeṣoktiḥ kimarthetyata āha || muktānāmiti || muktānāṃ guṇabaddhatvābhāvāt guṇātītaṃ sattvaṃ nāstītyukte teṣāmapi tatprasaktestadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ pṛthivyāmityādiviśeṣoktiryuktetyarthaḥ | 'imān lokān kāmānnī kāmarūpyanusañcaran ' ityādeḥ muktāḥ nāmapi pṛthivyādau sañcaraṇāt kathamanena tadvyāvṛttirityāśaṃkāṃ pariharan vākyāntareṇa jīvānuguṇabhedato bahudhā vibhajya darśayati || yatheṣṭamiti || tadgatadoṣasambandhābhāvāditi śeṣaḥ | ato bhūmyādisthā eva guṇabaddhā ityukte tadvyāvṛttiḥ siddhyatīti cātra draṣṭavyam | amuktāḥ kathaṃ guṇabaddhā ityatastadvibhajyāha || nareti || sāttvikarājasatāmasāstrividhā jīvāḥ | teṣu tāmasāḥ trividhāḥ | ta ucyante -- 'narādhamāḥ ' iti | tatra tāmaseṣu tāmasabhedamuktvā rājasān sāmānyenāha || rājasā iti || narā uttamā madhyamā adhamāśceti | te'pi trividhāḥ | tatra bhagavatā viprādipulkasāntāḥ rājasasāttvikāḥ | varṇabhedena teṣvapyanekavidhatāmāha || tatreti || teṣu rājasasāttvikasāttvikeṣu vipreṣvapyāśramabhedena anekavidhatāmāha || tatrastheti || rājasasāttvikasāttvikeṣu śuddhasāttvikā ityarthaḥ | paramahaṃsāḥ śikhāyajñopavītahīnāḥ ekadaṇḍinaḥ | yajñopavītanān ekadaṇḍī śikhārahito haṃsaḥ | tridaṇaḍī śikhāyajñopavītavān grāmaikarātriḥ bahūdaḥ | tridaṇḍī śikhāyajñapavītavān yāvajjīvaṃ putradattānnādaḥ kuṭītakaḥ | adhikaṃ kramāditi sambaddhyate | tat paramahaṃsānāmapi samaṃ kimityata āha || dharmā iti || śamo dama ityādau brāhmakarmatayoktā ityarthaḥ | karmabāhulyād haṃsādīnāṃ rājasatve devādīnāmapi tadbhāvād rājasatvaṃ syādityata āha || devāderiti || kuto netyata āha || na hīti || karmaṇi manaścalatu mā vā, tathāpyasti tāvad vahulaṃ karma | ato haṃsādivadrājasatvameva devāderityata āha || anyeṣāmiti || na haṃsādiṣvapi karma svarūpata eva rajo'numāpakam | kintu cittacalanahetutvenaiva | devādikarmaṇastu tadabhāvānna rājasatve liṅgatvamiti bhāvaḥ | karmaṇaḥ svarūpata eva rajo'numāpakatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || yadīti || bhagavatsmaraṇahetukarmaṇaḥ sattvānumāpakatvadarśanānna karma svarūpata eva rājasatvānumāpakamiti bhāvaḥ | ata eva prāyaḥ syādityuktam | paramahaṃsādarvāg gṛhasthāntānāṃ yat krameṇa karmabāhulyamuktaṃ talleśato vibhajya darśayati || dharmeti || haṃsādiṣu karmabāhulyakramo'neyato draṣṭavyaḥ | caturvidhayatito brahmacāriṇaḥ samidādicchedanamagnipūjā śrāddhakaraṇamiti viśeṣaḥ | brahmacārito gṛhasthasya dārasaṅgraho viśeṣaḥ | apatyānutpādanaṃ, grāmabhavavastusevābhāvaḥ, paśvahiṃseti gṛhasthād vanasthasya viśeṣa ityarthaḥ ra| grāmyasaṃtyāgoktyā vanasthasya brahmacārto'pi karmālpatvamuktaṃ bhavati | itarat svocitaṃ yajñādi | rājasasāttvikeṣu bhāgavateṣu varṇabhedenānekaprakāreṣu viprasvarūpamuktam | kṣatriyādisvarūpaṃ rājasarājasādisvarūpaṃ ca vākyāntareṇa darśayati || sāttvikā iti || rājasasāttvikeṣviti draṣṭavyam | sattvarājasā iti || samasattvarājasā ityarthaḥ | atisvalpasattvādhikyeneti || tamaso'pyatisvalpatayā sattvamadhikaṃ yathā tathaivetyarthaḥ | kṣatriyādimātrasyaivaṃ sthitiḥ kimityata āha || ya iti || varṇabāhyā bhāgavatāścet kimityata āha || sattveti || yaḥ pulkaso'pi bhāgavato'sau rājaseṣvapi sattvādhika ityarthaḥ | rājasasāttvikānuktvā rājasarājasādīnāha || traividyeti || kālato bhāgavatān jāyamānān vyavacchinatti || traividyamātrā iti || sarvādhikya iti || sarvaprakāreṇādhikye iti gamayitavyam | sāttvikaprabhedamāha || pitṛgandharveti || śreṣṭā evetyanena pitṛgandharvapūrvakāḥ sāttvikatāmasāḥ, munayaḥ sāttvikarājasāḥ, devā sāttvikasāttvikā ityucyante | devān vibhajyāha || devā iti || kramottarā iti || sāttvikasāttvikeṣu bṛhaspatyādayastāmasāḥ, indro rājaso, brahmādirudrāvasānāḥ sāttvikā ityucyante | viriñcādīn vibhajyāha || śiva iti || uttarottarā iti || sāttvikasāttvikeṣu rudrasya tāmasatvaṃ, sarasvatyā rājasatvaṃ, brahmaṇaḥ sāttvikatvamuktaṃ bhavati | evaṃ cedviriñcaḥ kimucyata ityata āha || sattveti || tasmāduktarītyā guṇanibandhanameva teṣāṃ tāratamyaṃ kimityata āha || muktāviti || guṇābhāve'pyuktaprakārāvasitanukhakrameṇaiva tāratabhyopapattiriti bhāvaḥ | 'narādhamāstāmaseṣu sāttvikāḥ ' ityuktam | te kīdraśā ityatastadvivṛṇoti || viṣṇāviti || 'rājasāstu sarāstatra viprā rājasasāttvikāḥ ' ityuktam | tatra 'ye tu bhāgavatā varṇāḥ ' iti vacanāntarabalena rājasasāttvikānāṃ bhāgavatatvaṃ grāhyamiti sūcayan bhāgavataviprāṇāṃ rājasasāttvikatvamevetyanyathāpratītinirāsāya anuktaṃ pūrayati || rājasānāmiti || rājasasāttvikeṣu vākyadvayenoktaṃ varṇabhedaṃ buddhyārohārthamegīkṛtya darśayati || rājasastheti || anena 'viprā rājasasāttvikāḥ ' ityādi prāguktarītyā vivṛtaṃ bhavati | rājasasāttvikā na sādhāraṇaviprādayaḥ | api tu bhāgavatā eveti vākyāntarānusāreṇoktaṃ hetvantaraṃ cāha || sattveti || rājasasāttvikānārabhya hiraṇyagarbhāvasānāḥ sarve'pi hi mokṣayogyāḥ | guṇāntarāpekṣayā yeṣu sattvādhikyānmokṣayogyatā ca bhāgavatānāmeva | ato rājasasāttvikādayaḥ sarve'pi bhāgavatā eveti bhāvaḥ | sattvapradhānatve'pi kuto mokṣayogyatetyata āha || sattvāditi || 'rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati ' ityadhikaguṇasyetarābhibhavena svaphalapradatvasyoktatvāt sattvapradhānye rajastamasorabhibhavena mokṣasādhanajñānasya sambhavāt sattvādhikye mokṣo bhavati | jñānasya sattvaphalatāyā uktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra sphuṭārthaṃ vākyāntaraṃ cāha || sattvādhika iti || sattvādhiko rājasasāttvikādiḥ | tamauttaro narādhamādiḥ | rajobhūyān traividyaḥ | samaḥ ekaprakāreṇa guṇatrayo'jñaḥ || 41 || brāhmaṇetyuktaṃ prapañcyate -- 'śamaḥ iti | tatra śamādayo brāhmaṇasyaivetyanyathāpratītinirāsāya tat pramāṇāntareṇa vyācaṣṭe || śama iti || anena brāhmaṇe taduktirādhikyavivakṣayetyuktaṃ bhavati | tapo brahmacaryādi | śaucaṃ śuddhiḥ | kṣāntiḥ krodhāsamutthitiḥ | ārjavaṃ manobākkāyakarmaṇāmavaiparītyam | jñānaṃ sāmānyataḥ | vijñānaṃ viśeṣataḥ | āstikyaṃ dharmādau 'astyevānena mama prayojanam ' iti bhāvaḥ | kārtavīryādikṣatriyeṣu brāhmaṇobhyo'pyādhikyenaitadguṇadarśanāt kathametadityata āha || adhikā veti || satyaṃ kṣatriyeṣu brāhmaṇādhikāḥ śamādayaḥ santīti, tathāpi noktavirodhaḥ | teṣām ṛṣitvāt | taditarakṣatriyāṇāmatra vivakṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | śauryamabhīrutvam | tejaḥ śarīragatam | dhṛtirthairyam | dākṣyaṃ pāṭavam | kṣatriyādūnāḥ brāhmaguṇāḥ śamādayo yasyāsau tathoktaḥ | tato vaiśyāt | śuśrūṣuḥ śuśrūpājīvanaḥ | neyaṃ niyatiryuktā | śūdarasyāpyadhikaguṇatvadarśanādityata āha || adhikāścediti || brāhmaṇādiriti || brāhmaṇasamaśamādiguṇa ityādi draṣṭavyam | śūdra evetyupalakṣaṇam | tattatsamaguṇo'sāviti jñatavyam | jātimanapekṣya guṇamātreṇa kathaṃ brāhmaṇatvādikalpanetyata āha || naro'pīti || yatheti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa kṣatriyādiṣvapi śamādyanuvṛttirastītyuktvā vākyaśeṣabalenāpyetadupapādayati || svakarmaṇeti || atra sarveṣāṃ bhagavadabhyarcanamevocyate, na tu śamādikamityata āha || na hīti || yadā sarveṣāṃ bhagavadabhyarcanamevocyate, tadā śamādikamuktameva | tadvinā'bhito'rcanasyaivāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | tatkuta ityata āha || samyagiti || samyagarcanaṃ hyabhito'rcanaṃ ca śamādibhirarcanamevetyarthaḥ | śamādikaṃ vinā'pi sādhanasampūrtyā'rcanamātramatra vivakṣaitaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || na ceti || śamādibhirarcanamevātrābhyarcanaṃ vivakṣitam | na tu śamādikaṃ vinā'nyat | etadabhyarcanasya mokṣaulatvaśravaṇāt | śamādyabhāve tadayogāditi bhāvaḥ | upakramabalena kṣatriyādiṣu brāhmaṇadhramānuvṛttirjñāyata ityāha || yajñeti || śamādyabhāve kuto mokṣābhāva ityata āha || śama iti || bhagavanniṣṭhādikaṃ hi śamādikaṃ nāma | bhagavanniṣṭhādyabhāve ca mokṣābhāvaḥ suprasiddha iti bhāvaḥ | niṣedhābhāvācca kṣatriyādiṣu śamādyaṅgīkāryamityāha || na ceti || niṣedhaśca bhavaṃstaddharmakathaṃnasthala eva bhavatīti tattaddharmeṣvatyuktam | ito'pi kṣatriyādiṣu śamādyaṅgīkāryamityāha || yuktā hīti || tulādhāro vaiśyaḥ | ādipadena daṇḍadhārādiśūdrasaṅgrahaḥ | hīti bhāratādiprasiddhiṃ sūcayati | evaṃ cet svaparadharamavivekaḥ kathamityata āha || ata iti || uktanyāyenānyeṣāṃ sādhāraṇatvādityarthaḥ | evaṃ kṛṣyādayo vaiṣyasya jīvanārtham | śūśrūṣā śūdrasya | yājanaṃ jīvanārthamadhyāpanaṃ pratigrahaśca viprasyeti draṣṭavyam | paradharmānāha || tau yeti || śamādīnāṃ sāthāraṇatve'pi kṣatriyasya śauryādayaḥ sarve'pi viśeṣadharmāḥ kiṃ na syuḥ brāhmaṇasyādhyāpanādimātraṃ, śūdrasya śuśrūṣāmāteraṃ ca svadharmaḥ kiṃ na syāt? ityatasteṣāṃ sādhāraṇyaṃ pramāṇena darśayati || śauryamiti || etena kṣatriye śauryādyuktirādhikyaviṣayeti coktaṃ bhavati | satāmadhyāpanaṃ ca śuśrūṣeti sambandhaḥ | śūdrasyādhyāpanaṃ vinā kimuktaṃ bhavatītyata āha || tasmāditi || śuśrūṣāyāḥ sarvadharmatvādityarthaḥ | satāmiti sambaddhyate | śauryādīnāṃ sādhāraṇatve kṣatriyādīnāṃ ke viśeṣaguṇā ityata āha || eta iti || sādhāraṇatayoktebhyo'nye yuddhe'palāyanaiśvaryādaya ityarthaḥ | naisargikā asādhāraṇāḥ | kimete puṃsāmasādhāraṇā eva dharmā niyatyā bhavantītyata āha || syāditi || eteṣāmasādhāraṇatvādavaśyānuṣṭheyatvamiti ca nāśaṅ‌kanīyamityāha || balāditi || yathā brāhmaṇasya jīvanārthaṃ yājanamityādi | evamasādhāraṇyenātmīyatvābhāve'pi tyājyatvaṃ ca na mantavyamityāha || anisarga iti || yathā brāhmaṇasya jīvanārthamadhyāpanamityādi | uktasyāpavādamāha || yājaneti || asvābhāvikāḥ śubhā api sādhāraṇā eva vardhanīyāḥ | na tu viprādyasādhāraṇā yājanādaya ityarthaḥ | śauryādīnāmasādhāraṇatvoktyā yuddhe'palāyanamaiśvaryaṃ ca kṣatriyasya viśeṣadharmāvityuktam || tasyāpavādamāha || apalāyanamiti || viprakṣatrārthamiti viśeṣoktyā sāmānyataḥ kṣatriyasyaiva siddhyati | tato noktavirodhaḥ | yathā kṣatriyaikadharmatayoktaṃ yuddhe'palāyanaṃ kāraṇaviśeṣādanyeṣāmapi syāttathaivaiśvaryamapyanyadharmaḥ syāt kim? ityataḥ tatsvarūpanirūpaṇapūrvakaṃ tasya kṣatriyetareṣvavṛttiṃ pramāṇena darśayati || prasahyeti || prasahya vittaharaṇādi keṣāmityataḥ tadvadanūnakāryaḥ kṣatriyetarairityasya vyāvartyamāha || sarva iti || tarhi kiṃ brāhmaṇādibhirvidharmiṇāṃ śāsanameva na kāryamityata āha || aṅgādīti || śiṣyo nāma kīdṛśa ityata āha || śiṣyaśceti || tarhi putrādīnāmaśāsanaprasaṅga ityata āha || putreti || anisargaśiṣyasvarūpaṃ taditi bhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇādeyaiḥ śiṣyā eva śāsyāḥ kintu gurvādayo'pītyāha || gurava iti || śikṣaṇīyeṣu bhāveṣviti || śikṣaṇīyārthaviṣaya ityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ gurvādaya eva śāsyāḥ kintvajñātā apītyāha || pāpamiti || atra sarvatra aṅgādyahānikṛddaṇḍaḥ śiṣyeṣu guravaśca deśakālānusārata iti viśeṣoktyā kṣatriyādviśeṣo draṣṭavyaḥ | pāpaṃ caranto vāraṇīyā ityuktam | yadi svottamavirodhākhyaṃ mahāpāpaṃ kuryustarhi kiṃ kāryamityata āha || taditi || kiṃ sahasā tyājyā evetyata āha || yatheti || svottamaviroddhāro gurvādayaḥ kiṃ sarvathā tyājyā evetyata āha || viṣṇāviti || tacchikṣāprakāramāha || śikṣayanniti || viṣṇau paramabhaktaḥ svottamavirodhetarapāpamācarati cet kiṃ kāryamityata āha || mahānta iti || prasaṅgādviprādīnām āpaddhakmān smṛtyā darśayati || āpatsviti || kṣātriyasya vipradharmācaraṇe viśeṣamāha || kṣatriya iti || bhikṣetarahiraṇyādipratigrāhī syādityarthaḥ | śaudraṃ tu dharmamācarediti sambaddhyate | na śūdrastu viprakṣatriyayordharmamācaredityuktam | tarhyāpatsu tena ko dharma āśrayaṇīya ityata āha || śūdra iti || śūdrasya vaiśyadharmatve viśeṣamāha || śūdra iti || vedākṣarādiśravaṇādimān na bhavedtyarthaḥ | kṣatriyo brāhmamāpatsu, tadāpatsu viśāṃ dharmamācaredityuktam | tato'pyāpadi kiṃ kāryamityata āha || atyāpadīti || viprakṣatriyeṣu śūdradharmaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ carannityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūdradharmaṃ caran na dupyatītyeva, kiṃ tarhītyata āha || yeṣviti || yadi kṣatriyasya svadharmakṛtāvāpado bhavanti tarhi tasya sānubandhāt svamino balādhikye'pi dharmārthaṃ tamanabhibhūya yeṣu karmasu niyuktaḥ svaminā'pi yācyaḥ syānna tu svayaṃ yācitā | tāni śaudrāṇyapi karmāṇyarthādyarthaṃ sevamānasya viprādidharmopajīvanādipi varo dharmo bhavatītyarthaḥ | tatra svāmyanabhibhavādapi svāminā yācyatvaṃ viśeṣeṇa dharmakāraṇamityāha || prabhuṇeti || vipradharmādyāśrayaṇe paropajīvanābhāvāt śūdradharme dadbhāvāt kathaṃ sānubandhāt prabhorbalādhikyādau satyapi tato'sya varatvamityata āha || bāhvoriti || sarvasya tadīyatvānna paropajīvanamiti bhāvaḥ || 48 || 'sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate ' ityuktasyaiva itthambhāvāntaramucyate -- 'asakta ' iti | tatra naiṣkarmyasiddhipadasya mokṣārthatvapratītinirāsāyārthamāha || naiṣkarmyeti || sarvapadamaprārabdhaviṣayam || 49 || asaktetyādinā naiṣkarmyasiddhisādhanavivaraṇapratijñāpūrvakaṃ tadanantaraphalamucyate -- 'siddhiṃ ' iti | tatra naiṣkarmyasiddhyanantaraṃ ca yenopāyena paraṃbrahmāpnoti taṃ prakāraṃ nibodhetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || vakṣyamāṇeti || atra yathā yena vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa vartamāno neṣkarmyasiddhiṃ prāpto bhūtvā mahālakṣmīṃ prāpnoti taṃ prakāraṃ nibodhetyevocyate | na tu naiṣkarmyasiddhyanantaraṃ parabrahmaprāptisādhanaṃ nibodhetyarthaḥ | brahmaśabdasya lakṣmīvācakatvameva kuta ityata āha || mameti || atra brahmapadena parabrahmaiva kiṃ na syādityata āha || brahmeti || etadbrahmaprāptyanantaramapi parabrahmaiva kiṃ na syādityata āha || brahmeti || etadbrahmaprāptyanantaramapi bhaktyādilāśravaṇāt lakṣmītattvamevedaṃ, na tu paraṃ brahmetyarthaḥ | bhavedetadyadi naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ prāptasya lakṣmīprāptyanantaramapi bhaktyādilābho'sti, na tu parabrahmaprāptyanantaramiti siddhyati | tadeva kuta ityata āha || sarveti || pāpapadam aprārabdhāniṣṭakarmaparam | nanvaparokṣajñānino hi naiṣkarmyasiddhiḥ | tatkathaṃ tadanantaramapi jñānādilābhaḥ? tathātve muktāvāpi tatprasaṅgādityata āha || aparokṣeti || purā dehatyāgāt | aparokṣajñānānantaramapi jñānādivṛddhirbhavedeva | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ | pramāṇānuguṇena muktau tadabhāvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ || 50 -52 || yaduktaṃ naiṣkarmyasiddhisādhanaṃ nibodhetyevocyate, na tu tadanantaraṃ brahmaprāptisādhanamiti | tadayuktam | buddhyā viśuddhayetyādisādhanamuktvā brahmabhūyāya kalpata ityuktatvāt | anyathā naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ prāpto bhūtveti vaktavyatvādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharan brahmabhūyapadasyānyathāpratītinirāsāyārthamāha || vimucyeti || jñānānantaraṃ lakṣmīprāptau sādhanānāmanāvaśyakatvāt naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ prāpto bhūtvetyatrābhipretameveti bhāvaḥ || 53 -55 || 'yataḥ pravṛttiḥ ' ityuktameva viśiṣyate -- 'sarva ' iti | tatra madvyapāśrayaścet yatheṣṭato niṣiddhānyaniṣiddhāni vā sarvamarmāṇi kurvāṇaḥ śāśvataṃ padaṃ prāpnotītyanyathāpratītinirāsāya tadvyācaṣṭe || vihitānīti || madvyapāśraya iti || mayyeva samarpayannityarthaḥ | pratītārtha eva kiṃ na syādityata āha || na hīti || nātra yatheṣṭato niṣiddhāniṣiddhakarmācaraṇe tātparyaṃ kalpyam | tathāsati bhagavadāśrayasya vihitākāraṇe'pyatra tātparyaprasaṅgāt | niṣiddhakaraṇavihitākaraṇayoḥ samānatvadityarthaḥ | atra bhagavadāśritasya vihitākaraṇe'pi tātparyaṃ syādevetyata āha|| māmiti || yadyatra bhagavadāśritasya vihitākaraṇe'pi tātparyaṃ tarhi bhagavadāśritasyaivārjunasya 'māmanusmara udhya ca ' ityādau vihitayuddhākaraṇe 'atha cettvamimaṃ dharmyaṃ ' ityādau prāk pratyavāya uktaḥ | tadvirodhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | pratītārthānaṅgīkāre'piśabdavaiyyarthyamityata āha || apīti || 55 || yadi bhagavadāśritatayā vihitakarma kurvato kurvato muktistirhi traividyasyāpi syāt | tasyāpi vihitakarmāṇi kṛtvā bhagavadarpaṇasadbhāvena bhagavadāśritāviśiṣṭatvādityāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokamavatārayati || bhagavaditi || bhagavadāśritatraividyayorvihitakaraṇādisāmye'pi mokṣabhāvābhāvāvupapadyeti | vihitāśeṣakarmāṇi cetasā bhagavati saṃnyasya bhagavadāśritaḥ karoti | na tathā traividya iti tayoścaitasaiva viśeṣasadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | matpara iti traividyādbhāgavatasya viśeṣa ucyate | tatra bhagavati tātparyavānityarthāṅgīkāre tat traividyasyāpi samam | ahaṃ paraḥ sarvottamo yasyetyabhyupagame vā vasyuni vikalpāyogāt tadapi traividye samamityata āha || sa eveti || paraḥ sarvaprakāreṇeti śeṣaḥ | bhāvaḥ sarvadeti ca draṣṭavyam | evaṃ cenmaccitta iti punaruktiḥ syāt | na hi bhagavatsarvottamatvabhāvādanyat taccitvamastītyāśaṃkāparihārāya tadarthamāha || tatreti || tatra bhagavati | traividyād bhāgavatasya viśeṣa iti śeṣaḥ | tarhi buddhiyogamupāśrityeti punaruktiḥ syāt | bhagavati buddheryogo hi buddhiyoga ityata āha || buddhīti || buddherjñānasya yogaḥ pratyāhārādyupāya ityarthaḥ | atha cettvamahaṅ‌kārādityabhyupagamyoktam || 57 -58 || taduktākaraṇamaśakyaṃ ca tavetyucyate -- 'yadi' iti | tatra prakṛtipadena svabhāvādyucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || prakṛtiriti || īśvarecchāyāḥ prakṛtiśabdavācyatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || prakṛtiriti || prasaṅgādatroktārthamanyatrāpyatidiśati || eṣeti || atra prakṛtiśabdaḥ parameśvarecchāvācī kutaḥ? svabhāvādyartha eva kiṃ na syādityata āha || tasyā eveti || prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyatītyatra prakṛteḥ jīvāniyoktṛtvamucyate | tacceśvarecchāyā eva mukhyamiti saivātrocyata iti bhāvaḥ | nanu svābhāvajenetyetadvivaraṇātmakottaraśloke prakṛtiśabdasya svabhāvārthatva grahaṇāt kathaṃ netyata āha || svabhāveti || jīvamiti seṣaḥ | neyaṃ prakṛtiruttaratra svabhāvapadenocyate, kintvasyā jīvaniyoge sādhanatayā svabhāvādyuttaratrocyata iti bhāvaḥ | ito'pyatreśvarecchaiva prakṛtiśabdārtha ityāha || tadeveti || etadvivaraṇātmakottaraślapoke bhagavadicchāyā eva sarvaniyoktṛtvasyoktatvācca atra prakṛtipadaṃ tadarthamiti bhāvaḥ | māyetīśvarecchaivocyate || 59 -61 || īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmityādau bhagavateśvarasya pārokṣyeṇa nirdiṣṭatvādayamīśvaro bhagavato'nya iti pratītinirāsāyāha || niściteti || parokṣyeṇokteḥ anyathā'pyapapatterna tanmātreṇeśvarasya bhagavadatiritaktatvaṃ kalpyamiti bhāvaḥ | itaśca tanna kalpyamityāha || maditi || atra tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha ityanyavyāvṛttyā īśvaraśaraṇaprāptimuddiṣyopasaṃhāre 'manmanā bhava' ityādinā svaśaraṇaprāptyupadeśācca na bhagavaditaro'yamīśvaraḥ | anyathā vyāhateriti bhāvaḥ | sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvataṃ' ityuktaṃ śāśvatasthānaṃ kimityata āha || śāśvatamiti || sarvasthānānāṃ pralaye vināśāt kathaṃ vaikuṇṭhādeḥ śāśvatatvamityata āha || śrīreveti || 63 || 'idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ' iti pratijñāya yajjñānādipadoditaṃ guhyatamaṃ tattvamuktaṃ tadevātra sarvaguhyatamaṃ iti punarucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || tattveti || nātra 'iti guhyatamaṃ' iti vākyaśeṣādupasaṃhṛtatvaṃ jñātavyam | tarhi kimatra guhyatamamucyata ityata āha || atreti || nanu 'etadbuddhvā buddhimān syāt' iti sādhanasārasyopasaṃhṛtatvāt kathamatra taduktirityata uktam || tattveti || na tatra sādhanasārasyopasaṃhārarūpeṇa bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānapraśaṃsā kṛtā | kintu tajjñānamātreṇa mokṣasadbhāvāt kimasya mahimā varṇanīya iti bhagavatpraśaṃsārthameveti bhāvaḥ | tatroktaguhyatamasyātrānuktatvevarṇanīya iti vyarthamityata āha || manmānā iti || sādhanasārasya prāguktatvāt tadapekṣayā bhūya ityupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ | tarhi punaruktiḥ syādityataḥ sādhanasāropasaṃhāra ityuktam | nanu 'manmanā bhava' ityādinā'nyavyāvṛttipūrvakaṃ svabhajanasyātropadiṣṭatvena bhagavatsārvottamatvamevoktamiti kathaṃ tattvasārakathanaṃ netyata āha || arthata iti || satyamatra viṣṇvādhikyamuktamiti | tathāpyanyabhajananirāsapūrvakaṃ svabhajanopadeśānyathānupapattyaivoktam | na tu mukhataḥ | ato nātra tattvasārakathanamiti bhāvaḥ || 64 -65 || anyabhajananirāsattyātra akṛtatvāt kathamarthato'pi viṣṇvādhikyamuktamityata āha || aneti || anyadharmān sarvān parityajya manmāna bhavetyevaṃ prakāreṇa sarvadharmān parityajyeti vacanaṃ manmanā ityādyuktaśeṣatvena hi vartate | ato'nyavyāvṛttipūrvakaṃ svabhajanamatropadiṣṭameveti bhāvaḥ | nanvatra manmanā ityādyuktasarvadharmān parityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajetyupadiśyata iti kiṃ na syādityata āha || māmiti || 'māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja' ityanenanāpi manmanā ityādyuktasyaiva vyākhyāyamānatvādanyathā'rthakalpane manmanastvādikaṃ parityajyānutiṣṭhasya ceti vyāhatoktiḥ syīditi bhāvaḥ vyarthamidamuktavyākhaayānamityato nigamanātmanetyuktam | manmanā bhavetyādinā kimuktaṃ bhavati māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja iti vyākhyānatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | bhavedetadyadi bhagavanmanastvādikaṃ śaraṇāgatiḥ syāt, tadeva kuta ityata āha || sarvottamatveti || atra yathāsambhavaṃ manmanā ityādyuktārthenaikārthatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | trividhā manovacanaśarīrabhavā | svabhāvataḥ na phalāntarāpekṣayā | mokṣaphalapradetyanena māmevaiṣyasītyuktārthe bhavati | māmekamiti sarvadharmānityasya vyākhyānaṃ draṣṭavyam | 'ahaṃ tvā sarva ityarthaḥ | nanvarjunena svoktamadyāpi nāṅgīkṛtam | tatkathaṃ bhagavatā tadbodhanaṃ samāpyata ityāśaṃkāṃ 'yathecchasi tathā kuru' iti yatheṣaaṭācaraṇamanujñāyata ityanyathāpratītiṃ parākurvan pariharati || yatheti || bhagavaduktānusaraṇamarjunena kṛtamityatraivoktatvāt tataḥ prāgeva tajjñasya bhagavataḥ tadbodhanoparamo yukta iti bhāvaḥ || 73 -78 || atha samāpitagrantho'yaṃ bhagavānācāryaḥ svapratipāditaprakārameva vāsudevaṃ namati || nama iti || svasvarūpaparijñānasyāpi kaivalyādyakhilapuruṣārthahetutvāt svakṛtāṃ granthanirmāṇarūpaparicaryāṃ keśave samarpayan tadāha || yasyeti || atha tameva harimādaraviśeṣāt punaḥ stauti || niḥśeṣeti || bhūtirmahālakṣmīḥ | śrīmadānandatīrthāryahṛdayāmalamandiraḥ | indirāramaṇaḥ prītiṃ yātu dīnadayāparaḥ || iti śrīmadānandatīrithabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
